original: śaktihetunallakṣyakriyādyapekṣāḥ śatrādayaḥ śaktyādyapekṣiṇaḥ, yathā vrajatā kṛtam, kriyamāṇaṃ paśya, ārjayam vasati caṅkramyamāṇo'dhīte, pakṣyam vrajati, bhojake vrajati iti apekṣitānuprayogataddhitādyanuṣaṅgāṇalulādayo'nuprayogādyapekṣiṇaḥ, yathā raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, coraṃkāramākrośati, kārayāñcakāra, kṛtrimam, vyāvakrośī, sāṃrāviṇam, iti |

original: dvigorvā lugvacanaṃ jñapakam, yadayaṃ “dvigorluganapatye” iti dvigostaddhitasya lukaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayaty utpadyate dvigostaddhita iti |

original: yadyevaṃ samāhārasamūhayoraviśeṣāt samāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam, “tasya samūhaḥ” iti taddhitārthenaivakṛtatvāt, tathā hi samāhāraḥ samuha ityāviśiṣṭāvetāvarthau, tatra samūha iva samāhāro'pi taddhitārthe dviguḥ ityeva bhaviṣyati | yadi taddhitārthe dvigurbhavatītyucyate, taddhitotpattiḥ prāpnoti | utpadyatām lugbhaviṣyati | lukkṛtāni prāpnuvanti |

original: kāni punakastāni? pañcapūlī daśapūlī iti, , “na taddhitaluki” iti ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, pañcagavaṃ daśagavamiti “gorataddhitaluki” iti ṭac na prāpnoti |

original: naiṣa doṣaḥ, aviśeṣeṇa dvigoḥ ṅīp bhavatītyuktvā aparimāṇabiktācitakambalyebhyaḥ samāhāre iti vakṣyāmi, aviśeṣeṇa ca goṣṭac bhavatītyuktvā dvigoḥ samāhāre iti vakṣyāmi, tadubhayamapi niyamārthe bhaviṣyati samāhāra eva nānyatreti | evaṃ tarhi, abhidhānārthe samāhāragerahaṇam, samāhoreṇābhidhānaṃ yathā syāte na taddhitārthena |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ aviśeṣeṇa dvigoḥ ṅīp bhavati iti uktvā aparimāṇa bikta ācita kambalyebhyaḥ samāhāre iti vakṣyāmi aviśeṣeṇa ca bhavati iti uktvā dvigoḥ samāhāre iti vakṣyāmi tat ubhayam api niyama arthe bhaviṣyati samāhāre eva na anyatra iti evam tarhi abhidhāna arthe samāhāra gerahaṇam abhidhānam yathā syāte na taddhita arthena

original: yadi syāt ko doṣaḥ syāt? taddhitotpattiḥ prasaḍaḍḍatdhjyeta | prasajyatām, lugbhaviṣyati | lukkṛtāni prāpnruvanati |sarvāṇi parihṛtāni | na sarvāṇi parihatāni, pañcakumāri daśakumārīti “luk taddhitaluki” iti ṅīpo luk pralajyata iti |

original: nanu ca yadi taddhitārthe dviguḥ ityucyate pañcakhaṭvaḥ daśakhaṭvaḥ iti matvarthe'pi dvigusaṃjñāyāṃ “dvigoḥ” itīkāraḥ prāpnoti | bahuvrīhisaṃjñayā dvigusaṃjñāyā bādhitatvānna bhaviṣyati, samānādhikaraṇānāṃ matvarthe bahuvrīhirbhavati | yadyuttarapade dvigurityicyate, uttarapadoktirvaktavyā |

original: iyamucyate “uttarapadena parimāṇinā dvigoḥ samāsavacanam”, dovau māsau ḍātasya dvimāsajātaḥ, dve ahanī jātasya dvyahnajāta iti | kimucyate parimāṇinaiveti, na punaranyatrāpi, tadyathā pañcagavapriyaḥ pañcagavadhana iti |
analyzed: iyam ucyate uttara padena parimāṇinā dvigoḥ samāsa vacanam dovau māsau ḍātasya dvi māsa jātaḥ dve ahanī jātasya dvi ahna jātaḥ iti kim ucyate parimāṇinā eva iti na punar anyatra api tat yathā pañcagava priyaḥ pañcagava dhanaḥ iti

original: anyatra samudāyasya bahuvrūhitvādittarapadaṃ prasiddhameva, tathā hi “anekamanyapadārthe” samasyate, bahuvrīhiśrca samāso bhavati | atha dvandvasya kā vārtā? dvandvo'grato viśeṣeṇa vyākariṣyata iti | atha bahubhirbahuvrīhiḥ “cañcadbhujabhramiticaṇḍaḍḍatdhgadābhighātasaṃcūrṇitoruyugalasya” iti|
analyzed: anyatra samudāyasya bahuvrūhi tvāt ittara padam prasiddham eva tathā hi anekam anya padārthe samasyate bahuvrīhiḥ ca samāsaḥ bhavati atha dvandvasya kā vārtā dvandva ugrataḥ viśeṣeṇa vyākariṣyate iti atha bahubhiḥ bahuvrīhiḥ cañcat bhuja bhramiti caṇḍaḍḍatdh gada abhighāta saṃcūrṇita ūru yugalasya iti

original: tatra cañcadbhyāṃ bhūjābhyāṃ bhramitāyāśrcaṇḍāyā gadāyāḥ abhighātena saṃmacūrṇitamūsyugalamasyeti vigrahaḥ | na caitadvācyaṃ samānādhikaraṇānāmeva bahuvrīhiḥ, “saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau” iti jñāpakena vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi bahuvrīheḥ smaraṇāt |
analyzed: tatra cañcadbhyām bhūjābhyām bhramitāyāḥ caṇḍāyāḥ gadāyāḥ abhighātena saṃmacūrṇita mūsi ugalam asya iti vigrahaḥ na ca etat vācyam samāna adhikaraṇānām eva bahuvrīhiḥ saptamī viśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau iti jñāpakena vaiyadhikaraṇye api bahuvrīheḥ smaraṇāt

original: etena sarvapadapradhāno dvandvo'pi vyākhyātaḥ, yathā “sūryānalānilahimāṃśudhaneśaśakrapretādhināthāvaruṇaāḥ karuṇāspadaṃ naḥ |” iti || nanu ca anyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ smaryatte, tatra citragurdevadattaḥ iti devadattāderanuprayogo na prāpnoti, na hi caitrādiśabdaprayogādavadhṛteṣu caitrādiṣu punaśrcaitrādiśrutayaḥ prayujyante |
analyzed: etena sarva pada pradhānaḥ dvandvaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ yathā karuṇā āspadam naḥ iti nanu ca anya padārthe bahuvrīhiḥ smaryatte tatra citraguḥ devadattaḥ iti devadatta ādeḥ anuprayogaḥ na prāpnoti na hi caitra ādi śabda prayogāt avadhṛteṣu caitra ādiṣu punar caitra ādi śrutayaḥ prayujyante

original: naivam, citraguśabdaḥ citragamīnāṃ svāmisāmānyamabhidhatte, tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣārthinā viśeṣo'nuprayoktavyaḥ | citraguḥ kaḥ? denadatta iti, yatra tvasādhāraṇaviśeṣaṇādibhirviśeṣa eva samāsaḥ tatrānuprayogo na bhavatyeva, yathā citragu sarvam, citragu viśvam, iti |
analyzed: na evam citragu śabdaḥ citragamīnām svāmi sāmānyam abhidhatte tatra avaśyam viśeṣa arthinā viśeṣaḥ anuprayoktavyaḥ citraguḥ kaḥ denadattaḥ iti yatra tu asādhāraṇa viśeṣaṇa ādibhiḥ viśeṣaḥ eva samāsaḥ tatra anuprayogaḥ na bhavati eva yathā citragu sarvam citragu viśvam iti

original: sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣaḥ, tathā hi yathā citrā gāvo'sya devadattasyeti ṣaṣṭhyarthasya samāsenādhināt ṣaṣṭhī nānuprayujyate, saṃbandhī tu na samāsopādāna ityanuprayujyate | evaṃ tarhi, vibhaktyarthābhidhāyino bahuvrīhipadasya devadattādibhipdravyavacanaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti | matublopādbhaviṣyati |
analyzed: sāmānyam api yathā viśeṣaḥ tathā hi yathā citrāḥ gāvaḥ asya devadattasya iti ṣaṣṭhī arthasya samāsena ṣaṣṭhī na anuprayujyate saṃbandhī tu na samāsa upādāne iti anuprayujyate evam tarhi vibhakti artha abhidhāyinaḥ bahuvrīhi padasya devadatta ādibhiḥ dravya vacanaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam na prāpnoti matup lopāt bhaviṣyati

original: maivam, matipo'pi saṃbandharthatvāt dravyavacanairasāmānādhikaraṇyameva | na ca bahuvrīheḥ vibhaktyarthābhidhāyino matupo'pi vidhātuṃ śakyate, sa hi prathamāsamarthādastyupādhirvidhāyate, na ca vibhaktayarthavṛttepbahuvrūhipadasyāstyādikriyābhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃbandho bhavati|
analyzed: mā evam saṃbandha ṛtha tvāt dravya vacanaiḥ asāmānādhikaraṇyam eva na ca bahuvrīheḥ vibhakti artha abhidhāyinaḥ matupaḥ upi vidhātum śakyate sa hi prathamā samarthāt asti upādhiḥ vidhāyate na ca vibhakta yartha vṛtteḥ bahuvrūhi padasya asti ādi kriyābhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃbandhaḥ bhavati

original: atha, abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapatsyate | tanna, abhihito'pyasau yato yatretyādivanna svarūpaṃ hāsyati |
analyzed: atha abhihitaḥ saḥ ṛthaḥ antarbhūtaḥ prātipadika arthaḥ saṃpannaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam upapatsyate tat na abhihitā upi asau yatas yatra ityādi vat na svarūpam hāsyati

original: evaṃ tarhi, yathā jātau padārthe jāteḥ kāryamucyamānamasaṃbhavāc tatsahacaritāsu vyaktiṣu niviśate, tathā bahuvrīhyarthe saṃbandhe sāmānādhikaraṇyākriyāyogādikārye prayujyamānaṃ tadāśraye bhavipyati, evaṃ ca so'yamityupacaritasaṃbandheṣu saṃbandhiṣu bahuvrīhipadairabhidhīyamāneṣu, śuklādiviśeṣaṇānāmivāśrrayato liṅgavacanānyapi na virotsyante |
analyzed: evam tarhi yathā jātau padārthe jāteḥ kāryam ucyamānam asaṃbhavāt tad sahacaritāsu vyaktiṣu niviśate tathā bahuvrīhi arthe saṃbandhe sāmānādhikaraṇya akriyā yoga ādi kārye prayujyamānam tad āśraye bhavipyati evam ca saḥ uyam iti upacarita saṃbandheṣu saṃbandhiṣu bahuvrīhi padaiḥ abhidhīyamāneṣu śukla ādi viśeṣaṇānām iva āśrrayataḥ liṅga vacanāni api na virotsyante

original: upamārthaḥ, tatra prathamaḥ samāsārthaḥ kākatālamiti, dvitīyaḥ pratyayārthaḥ kākatālīyamiti, samāsaśrcāyamasmādeva jñāpakāt, yadāha samāsāñca tadviṣayādākasmika ivārthe ccho bhavati, tadviṣayādityatra hi tadityanena “ive pratikṛtau” itīvārthaḥ paramṛśyate| evamajākṛpāṇīyaṃ, andhakavartakāyaṃ, ghuṇākṣarīraṃ, ardhajaratīyaṃ, gomayapāyasīyaṃ iti |

original: saṃbandhinā'vacchinnaḥ saṃbandhiviśiṣaṭaḥ, yathā halyaḥ kāṣaḥ, saudhaḥ samakocaḥ, pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ, atharvaṇa āmnāyaḥ, vaido ghoṣaḥ, chāndosagyo dharmaḥ iti | upādhirapi saṃbandhyeva bhavati, yathā gārgikayā vikatthate, kāṭhikayā'dhikṣipati, gārgikāmanvavetaḥ, gārgikāmavagavān, kāṭhikāmāvagatavān iti|
analyzed: saṃbandhinā avacchinnaḥ yathā halyaḥ kāṣaḥ saudhaḥ samakocaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ vadhaḥ atharvaṇaḥ āmnāyaḥ vaidaḥ ghoṣaḥ chāndosagyaḥ dharmaḥ iti upādhiḥ api saṃbandhī eva bhavati yathā gārgikayā vikatthate kāṭhikayā adhikṣipati gārgikām anvavetaḥ gārgikām avagavān kāṭhikām āvagatavān iti

original: dhātvarthopi bhāva eva, kriyā'pi hyupamānena parītā paricchinnā sādhyasiddhabhāvo bhavati| sa tridhā bhāvakārakaḥ, rājñā saddaśaṃ vartate rājavat, jaḍhasya tulyaṃ brāhmaṇādisthāsvadhyayanādikriyāsu sāhacaryādvṛttiḥ, jātidravyayoranyatareṇa kriyāyāḥ sāddaśyānupapatteḥ|

original: yadāha “tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvattiḥ, teneti tṛtīyāsamarthāt tulyamityetasminnarthe vatipratyayo bhavati | kārakaviśiṣṭo yathā rājñeva vyavahṛtamanena rājavat, devamva bhavantaṃ paśyāmi devavat, asineva dātreṇa cchinacci asivat, brāhmaṇayeva yadā devadttaya dadāti brāhmaṇavat, parvatādivāsanādavarohati pravatavat, pitarīva gurāvacarati pitṛvat|
analyzed: yat āha tena tulyam kriyā ced vattiḥ tena iti tṛtīyā samarthāt tulyam iti etasmin arthe vati pratyayaḥ bhavati kāraka viśiṣṭaḥ yathā rājñā iva vyavahṛtam anena rāja vat devam va bhavantam paśyāmi deva vat asinā iva dātreṇa asi vat brāhmaṇayā iva yadā dadāti brāhmaṇa vat parvata ādi vāsanāt avarohati pravata vat pitari iva gurau acarati pitṛ vat

original: atra punaridameva sūtramanyathā vyākhyāyate tena kārakaviśeṣeṇa tulyaṃ yathā bhavati| evaṃ cet kriyā bhavati bhāvotpanne vihitapratyaye kadācit pratyayamukhona kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, kadācit prakṛtimukhena, yathā tīvraḥ pākaḥ, tīvraṃ pākaṃ iti |
analyzed: atra punar idam eva sūtram anyathā vyākhyāyate tena kāraka viśeṣeṇa tulyam yathā bhavati evam ced kriyā bhavati bhāva utpanne vihita pratyaye kadācid pratyaya mukhona kriyā viśeṣaṇam bhavati kadācid prakṛti mukhena yathā tīvraḥ pākaḥ tīvram pākam iti

original: saṃbandhiviśiṣṭo yathā brāhmaṇasyovādhyanamasya brāhmaṇavat, rājña iva raudraṃ vṛttamasya pājavat, jaḍaḍḍatdhsya saddasaṃ vacanamasya jaḍaḍḍatdhvat, sūryasyeva prakāśo'sya sūryavat, puturyathā pālanamasya pitṛvat, gurostulyamanuśāsanamasya guruvate, iti | atratu “tatra tasyeva” ityanena vatiḥ |
analyzed: saṃbandhi viśiṣṭaḥ yathā brāhmaṇasya uvā adhyanam asya brāhmaṇa vat rājñaḥ iva raudram vṛttam asya pāja vat jaḍaḍḍatdhsya vacanam asya jaḍaḍḍatdh vat sūryasya iva prakāśaḥ usya sūrya vat putuḥ yathā pālanam asya pitṛ vat guroḥ tulyam anuśāsanam asya guru vate iti atra tu tatra tasya iva iti anena vatiḥ

original: nanu ca “tena tulyaṃ” ityanenaiva siddhe kimarthe “tatra tasyeva” iti sūtrārambhaḥ? dravyaguṇayostulyayoḥ pratyayo na labhyaḥ iti, yathā madhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre prāsādāḥ madhurākt, brāhmaṇasyeva kṣatriyasya śuklā dantāḥ bāhmaṇavat iti |
analyzed: nanu ca tena tulyam iti anena eva siddhe kimarthe tatra tasya iva iti sūtra ārambhaḥ dravya guṇayoḥ tulyayoḥ pratyayaḥ na labhyaḥ iti yathā madhurāyām iva pāṭaliputre prāsādāḥ brāhmaṇasya iva kṣatriyasya śuklāḥ dantāḥ bāhmaṇa vat iti

original: yadyeva pūrvasūtre kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, sāhacaryāñca kriyāyāmiva dravyaguṇayoḥ prātipadikaṃ vartiṣyate, tataśrca maitreyatulyā gāvaśrcaitrasya, brāhmaṇena tulyā dantā kṣatriyasya iti vigṛhya pūrvasūtreṇaiva vatiḥ setsyatīti |
analyzed: yadi eva pūrva sūtre kriyā grahaṇam na kariṣyate sāhacaryāt ca kriyāyām iva dravya guṇayoḥ prātipadikam vartiṣyate tatas ca maitreya tulyāḥ gāvaḥ caitrasya brāhmaṇena tulyāḥ dantā kṣatriyasya iti vigṛhya pūrva sūtreṇa eva vatiḥ setsyati iti

original: tadasat, evaṃ hi gavayena tulyoṣanaḍḍḍatdhvān ityatrāpi pratyayaḥ prasajet, ivārthe tu pratyaye saptamīṣaṣṭhyantābhyāṃmeva vidhīyamāne gavaya ivānaḍḍḍatdhvān ityatra pratyayapraṅgo na syāt, saptamīṣaṣṭhyantāyorhi bāhyaṃ saṃbandhinamapekṣya ivaśabdaprayogo bhavati, na punarivārthāpekṣayaiva, ivaśabdo hi upamānopameyabhāvalakṣaṇasaṃbandhadyotakaḥ,
analyzed: tat asat evam hi gavayena iti atra api pratyayaḥ prasajet iva arthe tu pratyaye saptamī ṣaṣṭhī antābhyām eva vidhīyamāne gavayaḥ iva anaḍ ḍatdhvān iti atra pratyaya praṅgaḥ na syāt saptamī ṣaṣṭhī anta ayoḥ hi bāhyam saṃbandhinam apekṣya iva śabda prayogaḥ bhavati na punar iva artha apekṣayā eva iva śabdaḥ hi upamāna upameya bhāva lakṣaṇa saṃbandha dyotakaḥ

original: upamānāvivakṣāyāṃ tadvidhānaṃ na labhyate|| upāmānopameyatvamanyasyānyeva vā saha| avasthābhedabhinnatvādekasyāpyātmanaiva vā|| tatrānyasyānyena yathāvaiyākaraṇo'pyayaṃ vaiyākaraṇavahrṛte, yoṣidapyeṣā puṃvadvaktīti, avasthābhdabhinnatvādekasyāpyātmāno yathā vaiyākaraṇo'pyayavajñayā kadācidavaiyākaraṇavadbrūhīte, yoṣidapyucyate satrīvadvadeti |

original: vāyākaraṇo'pyavajñayā kadāṭacidavaiyākaraṇavadbrūte, śrūyate hi yarvāṇastarvāṇā nāma sākṣātakṛtadharmāṇa ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ | te hi “antarvedyāmeva na mlecchitavyam, ato'nyatrāvajñayā” iti yadvā nastadvā na iti vaktavye yarvāṇastaparvāṇa ityūcuḥ | yoṣudapi kadācidāśritāprāgalbhyāt puṃvadvakti, yathocyate sarasvatīva karṇāṭī vijayāṅkā jayatyasau|
analyzed: vāyākaraṇaḥ upi avajñayā śrūyate hi yarvāṇaḥ tarvāṇāḥ nāma sākṣāta kṛta dharmāṇaḥ ṛṣayaḥ babhūvuḥ te hi antarvedyām eva na mlecchitavyam atas nyatra avajñayā iti yat vā naḥ tat vā naḥ iti vaktavye yarvāṇaḥ taparvāṇaḥ iti ūcuḥ yoṣudh api kadācid āśrita a prāgalbhyāt puṃvat vakti yathā ucyate sarasvatī iva karṇāṭī vijaya aṅkā jayati asau

original: yā vaidarbhagirāṃ bhūmiḥ kālidāsādanantaram|| asyaipamyadvayasyāpi vivakṣāto'parigrahe| vatiḥ kathamivārthīya iti (matvā) yamucyate|| tatra rājavadvṛttamityatra yadaivaṃvidhārthavivakṣā pṛthvādinā rājñā tulyaṃ vṛttamanena rājñā rājavadvṛttaṃ rājñeti, tadādyenaiva sūtreṇa siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ |
analyzed: yā vaidarbha girām bhūmiḥ kālidāsāt anantaram asya aipamya dvayasya api vatiḥ katham iva arthīyaḥ iti matvā yam ucyate tatra rāja vat vṛttam iti atra yadā evaṃvidha artha vivakṣā pṛthu ādinā rājñā tulyam vṛttam anena rājñā rāja vat vṛttam rājñā iti tad ādyena eva sūtreṇa siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ

original: yadā tvetāddaśī vivakṣārājña iva pṛthorasya vṛttaṃ rājavadvṛttaṃ rājña iti, tāda dvitīyasūtreṇa | yadā tvidaṃ vṛttaṃ rājānamevārhati nānyamityupamānopameyabhāvābhāve rājavadvṛttamiti prayogaḥ, tadā “tadarham” ityanena vatirvidhīyata iti nānarthakaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ ||
analyzed: yadā tu etāddaśī vivakṣā rājñaḥ iva pṛthoḥ asya vṛttam rāja vat vṛttam rājñaḥ iti dvitīya sūtreṇa yadā tu idam vṛttam rājānam eva arhati na anyam iti upamāna upameya bhāva abhāve rāja vat vṛttam iti prayogaḥ tadā tad arham iti anena vatiḥ vidhīyate iti na anarthakaḥ sūtra ārambhaḥ

original: anye tu “tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ” ityatra dvitīyavyānapakṣe kriyāyāḥ kriyā viśeṣaṇaṃ na saṃbhavatīti kārakaviśiṣṭabhāvapakṣaṃ “tadarham” ityanena samavāhayati, rājānamarhati yadvyavaharaṇaṃ, devamarhati yaddarśanaṃ, asimarhati yacchedanaṃ, brāhmaṇamarhati yaddānaṃ, parvamarhati yadavarohaṇaṃ, pitaramarhati yat pāratantrayam, taducyate rājavat,
analyzed: anye tu tena tulyam kriyā ced vatiḥ iti atra dvitīya vyāna pakṣe kriyāyāḥ kriyā viśeṣaṇam na saṃbhavati iti kāraka viśiṣṭa bhāva pakṣam tad arham iti anena samavāhayati rājānam arhati yat vyavaharaṇam devam arhati yat darśanam asim arhati yat chedanam brāhmaṇam arhati yat dānam parvam arhati yat avarohaṇam pitaram arhati yat pāratantrayam tat ucyate rāja vat

original: devavat, asivat, brāhmaṇavat, parvatavat, iti | rājñeva vyavahṛtamityādibhistu tasyārthaḥ pradarśita iti || kārakamapi bhāvavadevāntaraṅgaṃ bahiraṅgaṃ ca, toyarākhyātābhidheyamantaraṅgaṃ, anākhyātābhidheyaṃ bahiraṅgaṃm, kartā hetukartā, karma ceti, karaṇaṃ saṃpradānapadānamadhikaraṇaṃ ceti tatrāntaraṅgabhedeṣu kartā śuddhaḥ, miśraḥ, saṃkīrṇaśrca |
analyzed: deva vat asi vat brāhmaṇa vat parvata vat iti rājñā iva vyavahṛtam ityādibhiḥ tu tasya arthaḥ pradarśitaḥ iti kārakam api bhāvavat eva antaraṅgam bahiraṅgam ca kartā hetu kartā karma ca iti karaṇam saṃpradāna padānam adhikaraṇam ca iti tatra antaraṅga bhedeṣu kartā śuddhaḥ miśraḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ ca

original: teṣu kriyākarakāntarāsaṃpṛktaḥ śuddhaḥ, yatheṣṭamanena iṣṭī yajñī, kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kaṭo'nena katapūrvī kaṭamiti | kriyāntarasaṃpṛkto miśraḥ, yathā vyākaraṇaṃ vetti adhīte vā vaiyākaraṇaḥ, śaśvadbhavaḥ śāśvatikaḥ iti |
analyzed: teṣu kriyā karaka antara asaṃpṛktaḥ śuddhaḥ yathā iṣṭam anena iṣṭī yajñī kṛtaḥ pūrvam kaṭa ūnena kata pūrvī kaṭam iti kriyā antara saṃpṛktaḥ miśraḥ yathā vyākaraṇam vetti adhīte vā vaiyākaraṇaḥ śaśvat bhavaḥ śāśvatikaḥ iti

original: kriyākārakāntarasaṃpṛktaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ, yathā śālāyāṃ praveśamarhati, śālīnaḥ adhṛṣyaḥ, teṣu ātmāsthakriyo yathā pārāyaṇaṃ vartayati pārāyaṇikaḥ, cāndrāyaṇaṃ vartayati cāndirayaṇika iti | parasthakriyo yathā vātaṃ śamayati vātikaṃ tailaṃ, pittaṃ śamayati pauttikamiti |
analyzed: kriyā kāraka antara saṃpṛktaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ yathā śālāyām praveśam arhati śālīnaḥ adhṛṣyaḥ teṣu ātmā stha kriyaḥ yathā pārāyaṇam vartayati pārāyaṇikaḥ cāndrāyaṇam vartayati cāndirayaṇikaḥ iti para stha kriyaḥ yathā vātam śamayati vātikam tailam pittam śamayati pauttikam iti

original: parātmasthakriyo yathā yathākṣadyūtena nirvṛttamākṣadyūtikaṃ dhanaṃ, pākena nirvṛttaṃ pākimaṃ, māṇikaṃ iti | udriktakarmāśo yathā vasante pacyante vāsantyaḥ kundalatāḥ, ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante ṣāṣṭikāḥ śālaya iti| anudriktodriktakrarmośo yathā vaṃśaṃ gato vaśyaḥ, śārṣacchedamarhati śārṣacchedya iti | karma nirvatryaṃ, prāpyaṃ ca |
analyzed: parātma stha kriyaḥ yathā yathā akṣa dyūtena nirvṛttam ākṣadyūtikam dhanam pākena nirvṛttam pākimam māṇikam iti udrikta karma āśaḥ yathā vasante pacyante vāsantyaḥ kunda latāḥ ṣaṣṭi rātreṇa pacyante ṣāṣṭikāḥ śālayaḥ iti anudrikta udrikta krarma uśaḥ yathā vaṃśam gataḥ vaśyaḥ śārṣa chedam arhati śārṣa chedyaḥ iti karma nirvatryam prāpyam ca

original: teṣu yadasajjanyate, sadvāprakāśyate, tannirvatryam, yathorasā nirmitaḥ aurasaḥ putraḥ, pāṇininā proktaṃ pāṇinīyaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ iti | yasya prakṛtyucchedo guṇāntaraṃ vā vidhīyate tadvikāryam, yathā viṣeṇa vadhyaḥ viṣyaḥ śatruḥ, kusumbhena raktaṃ kausumbhaṃ vastramiti |
analyzed: teṣu yat asat janyate sat vā prakāśyate tat nirvatryam yathā urasā nirmitaḥ aurasaḥ putraḥ pāṇininā proktam pāṇinīyam vyākaraṇam iti yasya prakṛti ucchedaḥ guṇa antaram vā vidhīyate tat vikāryam yathā viṣeṇa vadhyaḥ viṣyaḥ śatruḥ kusumbhena raktam kausumbham vastram iti

original: āsthitamanāsthitaṃ vākriyayā yadāptumiṣyate tat prāpyam, yathā nāvā tāryaḥ nāvyo hradaḥ, ayānayaṃ neyaḥ ayānayīnaḥ śāra iti | nanu ca śāropyāsthitaḥ kasmānna bhavati? tyāgarūpaṃ prahātavye'pyarthe (prāpye) saṃsargadarśanam| āsthitaṃ karma yattatra ddairūpyaṃ bhajate kriyā|| yathāṃ panthānaṃ gacchati, gartamuttaratīti |
analyzed: āsthitam anāsthitam vā akriyayā yat āptum iṣyate tat prāpyam yathā nāvā tāryaḥ nāvyaḥ hradaḥ ayānayam neyaḥ śāraḥ iti nanu ca śāropya āsthitaḥ kasmāt na bhavati tyāga rūpam prahātavye api arthe prāpye saṃsarga darśanam āsthitam karma yat tatra bhajate kriyā yathām panthānam gacchati gartam uttarati iti

original: śārastu prāpya eva, yathājāṃ nayati grāmaṃ, (grāmaṃ) vahati bhāram iti | nanvevaṃ grāmasya prāpyatā prāpnoti, nājādeḥ, kaḥ punarāha na prāpnotīti, kiṃntu akathitatvena tatra kriyāvyāpyatvenāddvitāyaiva, na pratyayāntaraṃ gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ, pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate iti | bahiraṅgabhedeṣu karaṇaṃ bāhyaṃ, ābhyantaraṃ, bāhyābhyantaraṃ ca |
analyzed: śāraḥ tu prāpyaḥ eva yathā ajām nayati grāmam grāmam vahati bhāram iti nanu evam grāmasya prāpya tā prāpnoti na aja ādeḥ kaḥ punar āha na prāpnoti iti kiṃntu a kathita tvena tatra kriyā vyāpya tvena āt dvitāya eva na pratyaya antaram gām dogdhi payaḥ pauravam gām yācate iti bahis aṅga bhedeṣu karaṇam bāhyam ābhyantaram bāhya abhyantaram ca

original: teṣu bāhyaṃ yathā śupāṃ vyākhyānaḥ saupaḥ, sasāṭasya bhūṣaṇaṃ lalāṭikā | ābhyantaraṃ yathā matasya karaṇaṃ matyaṃ, caturṇāṃ pūrāṇaścaturthaḥ iti| bāhyābhyantaraṃ yaātha samidha ādhīyante'nena sāmidhenyo mantraḥ, (sa eva) hṛdayasya bandhanaḥ hṛdya iiti| saṃpradānaṃ dādatikarmāpyaṃ, karmamātrāpyaṃ, kriyāpyaṃ ca |
analyzed: teṣu bāhyam yathā śupām vyākhyānaḥ saupaḥ bhūṣaṇam lalāṭikā ābhyantaram yathā matasya karaṇam matyam caturṇām pūrāṇaḥ caturthaḥ iti bāhya abhyantaram samidhaḥ ādhīyante inena sāmidhenyaḥ mantraḥ saḥ eva hṛdayasya bandhanaḥ hṛdyaḥ iti saṃpradānam ca

original: samapradīyate bhojanādikakamasmai ityānvarthasaṃjñakaṃ dadātikarmāpyaṃ, yathāgrabhojanaṃ niyuktamasmai dīyate āgrabhojanikaḥ, pañcāsmai vṛddhirvā, āyo vā, śulkaṃvā, upadā vā dīyante pañcakaḥ puruṣaḥ iti|
analyzed: bhojana ādikakam asmai iti ānvartha saṃjñakam dadāti karmāpyam yathā agra bhojanam niyuktam asmai dīyate āgrabhojanikaḥ pañca asmai vṛddhiḥ vā āyaḥ vā śulkam vā upadāḥ vā dīyante pañcakaḥ puruṣaḥ iti

original: “karmaṇā yamabhaipraiti sa saṃpradhānām” iti pāribhāṣikasaṃtrakaṃ karmamātrāpyaṃ, yathā rāṣṭriyo rājanyaḥ, kaliṃ kurvantayasmai kāleyaṃ gandhadravyaṃ iti | karmaśabdena kriyāyā apyabhidhānāt kriyayā'pi yamabhipraiti sa samapradatānamiti kriyāpyam, yathālaṅkarmāsmai nirdiśyate alaṅkarmīṇaḥ anyūnaḥ, na ṣaḍaḍḍatdhkṣātakriyaṃ ca |
analyzed: karmaṇā saḥ iti pāribhāṣika saṃtrakam karma mātrāpyam yathā rāṣṭriyaḥ rājanyaḥ kalim kāleyam gandha dravyam iti karma śabdena kriyāyāḥ api abhidhānāt kriyayā api yam abhipraiti sa sama prada tānam iti kriyāpyam yathā alaṅkarma asmai nirdiśyate alaṅkarmīṇaḥ anyūnaḥ na ca

original: teṣu “dhruvamapāye'pādānam” iti nirdriṣṭaviṣayam, yathāgriḥ patati asmāt āgneyaḥ grāvā, nadyaḥ syandante asmāti nādeyaḥ śaila iti | bhūtrārthādiyogoktamupāttaviṣayam, yathā kukṣiṃ rakṣanti asamāti kaikṣeyakaḥ kṛpāṇaḥ, mudgā bhavantyasmāt maudgīnaṃ kṣetraṃ iiti |
analyzed: teṣu dhruvam apāya apādānam iti nirdriṣṭa viṣayam yathā agriḥ patati asmāt āgneyaḥ grāvā nadyaḥ syandante nādeyaḥ śailaḥ iti bhūtra artha ādi yoga uktam upātta viṣayam yathā kukṣim rakṣanti kaikṣeyakaḥ kṛpāṇaḥ mudgāḥ bhavanti asmāt maudgīnam kṣetram iti

original: avadhimātrārthamapekṣitākriyam, yathā karṇasya mūlaṃ karṇajāhaṃ, pakṣasya mūlaṃ baśratiḥ iti | adhikaraṇaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ, aupaśloṣikaṃ, naimittikaṃ ca | teṣu vividhamanekaprakāraṃ jātikriyāgiṇadravyādibhiḥ sinotīti viṣayaḥ deśakālādiḥ, viṣaya eva vaiṣayikaḥ, yathā gāvaḥ santyasmin gomāne deśaḥ, pauṣī paurṇamāsyasmin pauṣo māsa iti |
analyzed: avadhi mātra artham apekṣita akriyam yathā karṇasya mūlam karṇajāham pakṣasya mūlam baśratiḥ iti adhikaraṇam vaiṣayikam aupaśloṣikam naimittikam ca teṣu vividham aneka prakāram jāti kriyā giṇa dravya ādibhiḥ sinoti iti viṣayaḥ deśa kāla ādiḥ viṣayaḥ eva vaiṣayikaḥ yathā gāvaḥ santi asmin gomāne deśaḥ pauṣī paurṇamāsī asmin pauṣaḥ māsaḥ iti

original: upaśloṣo'vaṣṭambhaḥ, tasmai prabhavati aupaśloṣikaṃ, yathā daṇḍiḍḍatdhno'syāṃ santi daṇḍiḍḍatdhmatī śālā, viṃśatirihādhikā viṃśaṃ śatamiti | nimittameva naimittikaṃ, yathā pūrṇo māso'syāṃ paurṇamāsī(ti), parisvatrasyāt parikheyo deśa iti |
analyzed: tasmai prabhavati aupaśloṣikam yathā santi daṇḍiḍḍatdhmatī śālā viṃśatiḥ iha adhikā viṃśam śatam iti nimittam eva naimittikam yathā pūrṇaḥ māsaḥ asyām paurṇamāsī iti parisvatrasyāt parikheyaḥ deśaḥ iti

original: kārakaṃ ca antaraṅgabahiraṅgabhodād dvirūpamapi prakṛtyacupādheḥ kārakaviśiṣṭaṃ yathāyānayaṃ neya ayānayīnaḥ śāraḥ karaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā cakṣuṣā gṛhyate caikṣuṣaṃ rūpaṃ, adhikaraṇaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā śtrughne kṛto vā, labhyo vā, krīto vā satraughnaḥ, apādānaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā tantrādacirāhṛtaḥ tantrakaḥ paṭa iti, kartṛviśiṣṭaṃ yathāśvairuhyate āśvo rathaḥ,
analyzed: kārakam ca antaraṅga bahiraṅga bhodāt dvi rūpam api prakṛti a c upādheḥ kāraka viśiṣṭam yathā ayānayam śāraḥ karaṇa viśiṣṭam yathā cakṣuṣā gṛhyate caikṣuṣam rūpam adhikaraṇa viśiṣṭam yathā śtrughne kṛtaḥ vā labhyaḥ vā krītaḥ vā satraughnaḥ apādāna viśiṣṭam yathā tantrāt acira āhṛtaḥ tantrakaḥ paṭaḥ iti kartṛ viśiṣṭam yathā aśvaiḥ uhyate āśvaḥ rathaḥ

original: kartṛrviśṣṭaṃ yathāśvairuhyate āśvo rathaḥ, kartṛviśeṣaṇamapi kartaiva, caturbhiruhyate cāturaṃ śakaṭaṃ, apica kaumārī sā bhavedbhāryā yāṃ kumāraḥ prapatsyate| prapadyate kumāri yaṃ sa kaumāro mataḥ patiḥ|| saṃpradānaviśiṣṭaṃ tu kārakaṃ nāsti |
analyzed: kartṛḥ viśṣṭam yathā aśvaiḥ uhyate āśvaḥ rathaḥ kartṛ viśeṣaṇam api kartā eva caturbhiḥ uhyate cāturam śakaṭam api ca kaumārī sā bhavet bhāryā yām kumāraḥ prapatsyate prapadyate kumāri yam sa kaumāraḥ mataḥ patiḥ saṃpradāna viśiṣṭam tu kārakam na asti

original: kartā karmaviśiṣṭo yathā śrāddhamanenādya bhuktaṃ śrāddhikaḥ, kriyāviśeṇabhitiśabdopasaṃhāraṃ ca karmaivaṃ, tiddhiśiṣṭo yathā pratikūlaṃ vartate pratikūlikaṃ, māśabda ityāha māśabdika iti, karaṇaviśiṣṭo yathākṣairdīvyati ākṣikaḥ adhikaraṇaviśiṣṭo yathā prāvṛṣikaḥ, prāvṛṣi bhavaḥ pravṛṣeṇyaḥ, apādānāviśiṣṭo yathā pituṃrāgataṃ pitryaṃ dhanaṃ iti |
analyzed: kartā karma viśiṣṭaḥ yathā śrāddham anena adya bhuktam śrāddhikaḥ ca karma evam ca karma evam yathā pratikūlam vartate pratikūlikam mā śabdaḥ iti āha māśabdikaḥ iti karaṇa viśiṣṭaḥ yathā akṣaiḥ dīvyati ākṣikaḥ adhikaraṇa viśiṣṭaḥ yathā prāvṛṣikaḥ prāvṛṣi bhavaḥ pravṛṣeṇyaḥ apādāna a viśiṣṭaḥ yathā pituṃrāgatam pitryam dhanam iti

original: kratṛviśiṣṭaḥ kartā nāsti| karaṇaṃ karmaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā grīvāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ grīvāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ graiveyaṃ rukmadāma| evaṃ saṃpradānamapi yathā māṃsamebhyo niyuktaṃ dīyate māṃsikāḥ pitaraḥ | apādānaṃ kratṛviśiṣṭaṃ yathā vrīhayo bhavtyasmāt vraiheyaṃ kṣetram| evamadhikaraṇamapi yatā śarkarāḥ santi asmin śarkarilo deśaḥ |
analyzed: kratṛ viśiṣṭaḥ kartā na asti karaṇam karma viśiṣṭam yathā grīvāyāḥ bhūṣaṇam grīvāyāḥ bhūṣaṇam graiveyam rukma dāmaḥ evam saṃpradānam api yathā māṃsam ebhyaḥ niyuktam dīyate māṃsikāḥ pitaraḥ apādānam kratṛ viśiṣṭam yathā vrīhayaḥ bhavti asmāt vraiheyam kṣetram evam adhikaraṇam api yatā śarkarāḥ santi asmin śarkarilaḥ deśaḥ

original: tadeva karmaviṣṭaṃ yathā padamasmin ddaśyaṃ padyaḥ kardamaḥ, karaṇāviśiṣṭamapi yathā daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ dāṇḍā krīḍā iti | karaṇādayo'sya viśiṣṭā na vidyante | karmakatrraurevākarakasaṃbandhinipātairviśeṣaṇayogaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva karma viṣṭam yathā padam asmin padyaḥ kardamaḥ karaṇa a viśiṣṭam api yathā daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ praharaṇam asyām dāṇḍā krīḍā iti karaṇa ādayaḥ asya viśiṣṭāḥ na vidyante

original: sa karmaṇo'kārakeṇa yathā māsāya bhūto māsikaḥ, samavatsaramadhīṣṭaḥ sāṃvatsarika iti, kartiryathā śaṃtāpāya prabhanati sāṃtāpikaḥ, varṣe bhūto bhāvī vā vārṣika iti | kramaṇaḥ saṃbandhinā yathā vākyapade adhikṛtyt tittiriṇā proktaṃ vidanti adhīyate vā taittirīyāḥ, pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhuktaṃ pītaṃ vā ebhiḥ pūrniṇā iti |
analyzed: sa karmaṇā ukārakeṇa yathā māsāya bhūtaḥ māsikaḥ sama vatsaram adhīṣṭaḥ sāṃvatsarikaḥ iti kartiḥ yathā śaṃtāpāya sāṃtāpikaḥ varṣe bhūtaḥ bhāvī vā vārṣikaḥ iti kramaṇaḥ saṃbandhinā yathā vākya pade tittiriṇā proktam vidanti adhīyate vā taittirīyāḥ pūrvam kṛtam bhuktam pītam vā ebhiḥ iti

original: kramaṇo nipāte na yathā yathākathāca kriyate yāthākathyamidaṃ, bahiḥ ddaśyate bāhyaṃ iti, karturyathārādṅavaḥ ārādīyaḥ sākṣāddraṣṭā sākṣī iti |

original: evaṃ “tenaikadik” “tadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau” “tasya nimittam” “tena vittaścuñcupcayaṇapau” “tasmai hitam” vatupprakaraṇe “yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ dhandasi sāddaśya upasaṃkhyānam” ityādiṣu sahārthatādathryavittahitalakṣaṇopapadapariśeṣādayaḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣāḥ ṣaṣṭhyantā api dviṣṭhatvādekavibhaktivācyatvenāvagantavyāḥ |
analyzed: evam tena ekadiś tad artha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau tasya nimittam tena vittaḥ cuñcup cayaṇapau tasmai hitam vatup prakaraṇe yuṣmad asmadbhyām dhandasi sāddaśye upasaṃkhyānam ityādiṣu sahārtha tādathrya vitta hita lakṣaṇa upapada pariśeṣa ādayaḥ saṃbandha viśeṣāḥ ṣaṣṭhī antāḥ api dviṣṭha tvāt eka vibhakti vācya tvena avagantavyāḥ

original: nanu ca tṛtīyādīnāṃ vyatirekavibhaktitvāt ṣaṣṭhīvadeva bhavati, saṃbandhābhidhānasāmathryate, prathamāyāḥ punaravyatiriktaprātipadikārthābhidāyinyāḥ kathamivaitadupapadyate tvāmiva tvāvān, ahamivamavān iti|
analyzed: nanu ca tṛtīyā ādīnām vyatireka vibhakti tvāt ṣaṣṭhī vat eva bhavati prathamāyāḥ punar avyatirikta prātipadika artha abhidāyinyāḥ katham iva etat upapadyate tvām iva tvāvān aham ivam avān iti

original: atraike varṇayanti tvāvataḥ puruvaso, yajñaṃ viprasya māvataḥ, na tvāvānanyo divyo na pārthiva iti prathamāntāyāḥ prakṛteḥ pradhānabhūte'pi saṃbāndhini prayogadarśanāt pratyayo'vagamyate | anye tvāhur tvamiva tvāvān, ahamiva māvān ityupamānamatra prathamāntaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, upameyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ| na tatra tāvadavacdhedakatvādupamānaṃ pradhānam |
analyzed: atra eke varṇayanti tvāvataḥ puruvaso yajñam viprasya māvataḥ na tvāvān anyaḥ divyaḥ na pārthivaḥ iti prathama antāyāḥ prakṛteḥ pradhāna bhūte api saṃbāndhini prayoga darśanāt pratyayaḥ uvagamyate anye tu āhuḥ tvam iva tvāvān aham iva māvān iti upamānam atra prathama antam prakṛti arthaḥ upameyam pratyaya arthaḥ na tatra tāvat avacdhedaka tvāt upamānam pradhānam

original: avacchedakādapyupamānāt ṣaṣṭhī notpadyate, vyatirekahetorasaṃbhavāt, ivaśabdo hyasattvabhūtābhidhāyitvānna vyatirkābhidhāyakaḥ, sāddaśyadyotako hyasau| anyaśca na kaścidiha vyati rkahetuḥ śrūyate |
analyzed: avacchedakāt api upamānāt ṣaṣṭhī nā utpadyate vyatireka hetoḥ asaṃbhavāt iva śabdaḥ hi a sattva bhūta abhidhāyi tvāt na vyatirka abhidhāyakaḥ sāddaśya dyotakaḥ hi asau anyaḥ ca na kaścid iha vyati rka hetuḥ śrūyate

original: ataśca gauriva gavayaḥ ityādāvivatra ṣaṣṭhyā abhāvaḥ, vyatirekahetau tu satīvaśabdaprayoge upamānāt ṣaṣṭhyatpadyate devadattasyeva yajñadattasya dantā iti | taduraktam ivaśabdaprayoge tu bāhyāt saṃbandhino vinā | nādhikyamupamāne'sti dyotakaḥ sa prayajyate|| mā bhūt ṣaṣṭhī, prathamayā'pi na bhavitavyameva, upamānasyāvacchedakatvenāpyādhikyāt |
analyzed: atas ca gauḥ iva gavayaḥ ityādau iva tra ṣaṣṭhyāḥ abhāvaḥ vyatireka hetau tu satī iva śabda prayoge upamānāt ṣaṣṭhī atpadyate devadattasya iva yajñadattasya dantāḥ iti tat uraktam iva śabda prayoge tu bāhyāt saṃbandhinaḥ vinā na ādhikyam upamāne sti dyotakaḥ sa prayajyate mā bhūt ṣaṣṭhī prathamayā api na bhavitavyam eva upamānasya avacchedaka tvena api ādhikyāt

original: kaḥ punarāhānadhika eva prātipadikārthe prathameti, pāṭaliputrādrājakaṃ sapta yojanāni, saptasu vā yojaneṣu ityadhvanaḥ prathamā saptamī ca smaryate, saṃbodhane ca prathamaiva vidhīyate, dhik devadattaṃ, hā devadattaṃ, iti ca dvitīyāviṣaye prathamāprayogo ddaśyate, yathā “hā dhikkaṣṭaniṣṭamastakaruṇaḥ ko'yaṃ vidheḥ prakramaḥ |” “kanyāntaḥpurameva
analyzed: kaḥ punar āha anadhike eva prātipadika arthe prathamā iti pāṭaliputrāt rājakam sapta yojanāni saptasu vā yojaneṣu iti adhvanaḥ prathamā saptamī ca smaryate saṃbodhane ca prathamā eva vidhīyate dhik devadattam hā devadattam iti ca dvitīyā viṣaye prathamā prayogaḥ ddaśyate yathā hā dhik kaṣṭa niṣṭa masta karuṇaḥ kaḥ yam vidheḥ prakramaḥ kanyā antaḥpuram eva

original: hā praviśati kruddho munirbhārgavaḥ ||” iti|| ṣaṣṭhyantābhidheyo guṇabhūtaḥ, sa tridhā bhāvaviśiṣṭaḥ, kārakaviśiṣṭaḥ, samavandhiviśiṣṭaśca | teṣu bhāvenāvacchinno bhāvaviśiṣṭaḥ, sa dvidhā mukhyena, upādhinā ca | tayormukhyena yathā kṛṣirasyāstīti kṛṣīvalaḥ, māyāvī, āmayāvī, dayāluḥ, śraddhāluḥ iti|
analyzed: hā praviśati kruddhaḥ muniḥ bhārgavaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī anta abhidheyaḥ guṇa bhūtaḥ sa tridhā bhāva viśiṣṭaḥ kāraka viśiṣṭaḥ samavandhi viśiṣṭaḥ ca teṣu bhāvena avacchinnaḥ bhāva viśiṣṭaḥ sa dvidhā mukhyena upādhinā ca tayoḥ mukhyena yathā kṛṣiḥ asya asti iti kṛṣīvalaḥ māyāvī āmayāvī dayāluḥ śraddhāluḥ iti

original: upādhinā yathā mṛdaṅgo vādyata iti śilpamasya mārdaṅgikaḥ, apūpāḥ kriyanta iti śilpamasya āpūpikaḥ, māsaṃ brahmacaryamasya bhikṣoḥ māsikaḥ, asti paraloka iti matirasya sādhoḥ āstikaḥ, nāsti narakādikamiti matirasyāsādhoḥ sa nāstikaḥ, diṣṭameva prabhanatīti matirasya jigīṣoḥ daiṣṭikaḥ iti |
analyzed: upādhinā yathā mṛdaṅgaḥ vādyate iti śilpam asya mārdaṅgikaḥ apūpāḥ kriyante iti śilpam asya āpūpikaḥ māsam brahmacaryam asya bhikṣoḥ māsikaḥ asti para lokaḥ iti matiḥ asya sādhoḥ āstikaḥ na asti naraka ādikam iti matiḥ asya asādhoḥ sa nāstikaḥ diṣṭam eva prabhanati iti matiḥ asya jigīṣoḥ daiṣṭikaḥ iti

original: kārakeṇāvacchinnaḥ kārakaviśiṣṭaḥ, sa dvidhā śvatantreṇa ca | tayoḥ svatantreṇa yathā dhanamasyāstīti dhanavān vadānyaḥ, pañcamo'sya māso jātasya vartate pañcamo bālakaḥ, prāsādo'sya syāt prāsādīyaṃ dāru, tārakaḥ saṃjātā asya tārakitaṃ nabhaḥ, samayaḥ prāpto'sya sāmayikaṃ karma, ekamanyat karmādhyayane vṛttamasya aikānyikaḥ iti |
analyzed: kārakeṇa avacchinnaḥ kāraka viśiṣṭaḥ sa dvidhā śvatantreṇa ca tayoḥ svatantreṇa yathā dhanam asya asti iti dhanavān vadānyaḥ pañcamaḥ asya māsaḥ jātasya vartate pañcamaḥ bālakaḥ prāsādaḥ usya syāt prāsādīyam dāru tārakaḥ saṃjātāḥ asya tārakitam nabhaḥ samayaḥ prāptaḥ usya sāmayikam karma ekam anyat karma adhyayane vṛttam asya aikānyikaḥ iti

original: asvatantreṇa yathā lavaṇaṃ paṇyamasya prāsthikaḥ, vāsudeve bhaktirasya vāsudevakaḥ, dhanuḥ praharaṇamasya dhānuṣkaḥ, prasthaḥ parimāṇamasya prasthikaḥ, salāturo'syābhijanaḥ sālāturīyaḥ, grāmo nivāso'sya grāmāṇaḥ iti | saṃbandhināvacchinnaḥ saṃbandhiviśiṣṭaḥ, sa dvidhā viśeṣyeṇa, viśeṣaṇena ca |
analyzed: asvatantreṇa yathā lavaṇam paṇyam asya prāsthikaḥ vāsudeve bhaktiḥ asya vāsudevakaḥ dhanuḥ praharaṇam asya dhānuṣkaḥ prasthaḥ parimāṇam asya prasthikaḥ salāturaḥ asya abhijanaḥ sālāturīyaḥ grāmaḥ nivāsaḥ usya grāmāṇaḥ iti saṃbandhinā avacchinnaḥ saṃbandhi viśiṣṭaḥ sa dvidhā viśeṣyeṇa viśeṣaṇena ca

original: tayoḥ viśeṣyeṇa yathāpūpā hitā eṣāṃ āpūpikāḥ avantayaḥ, mīlamābarhi eṣāṃ mūlyā māṣāḥ, bṛhatyādirasya bārhataḥ pragāthaḥ, kālaḥ prakṛṣṭo'sya kākalikamṛṇam, kiṃca niśāsaṃbavdhādhyayanamapi niśā, tadasya soḍhaṃ naiśaḥ, evaṃ praidoṣikaḥ iti |
analyzed: tayoḥ viśeṣyeṇa yathā apūpāḥ hitāḥ eṣām āpūpikāḥ avantayaḥ mīlam ābarhi eṣām mūlyāḥ māṣāḥ bṛhatī ādiḥ asya bārhataḥ pragāthaḥ kālaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ asya kākalika mṛṇam kiṃca niśā saṃbavdha adhyayanam api niśā tat asya soḍham naiśaḥ evam praidoṣikaḥ iti

original: viśeṣaṇena yathendro devatā asya aindraṃ haviḥ, saṃśaptakāḥ yoddhāro'sya sāṃśaptakaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ, vinayaḥ prayojanamasyāṃ vainayikī vidyā, devadatto grāmaṇīrasya daivadattakaḥ saṅgaḥ, pañca avayavāḥ asyāṃ pañcatayī gatiḥ, pañca asya bhṛtirvasnne vā pcakaḥ padārthaḥ iti |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇena yathā indraḥ devatā asya aindram haviḥ saṃśaptakāḥ yoddhāraḥ sya sāṃśaptakaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ vinayaḥ prayojanam asyām vainayikī vidyā devadattaḥ grāmaṇīrasya daivadattakaḥ saṅgaḥ pañca avayavāḥ asyām pañcatayī gatiḥ pañca asya vā padārthaḥ iti

original: nanu ca “tasyāpatyam” ityādau upagorapatyaṃ aupagavaḥ iti “samarthānāṃ pratamādvā” ityadhikārāt ṣaṣṭhyantā prakṛtirapatyāvato guṇabhūtasya vācikā, prathamāntaṃ tu pradhānabhūtamapatyaṃ pratyayārtha eva | “tasyedam” ityādāvapi pradhānaṃ saṃbandhi taddhitavācyamityupapadyate |
analyzed: nanu ca tasya apatyam ityādau upagoḥ apatyam aupagavaḥ iti samarthānām iti adhikārāt ṣaṣṭhī antā prakṛtiḥ apatyāvataḥ guṇa bhūtasya vācikā prathama antam tu pradhāna bhūtam apatyam pratyaya arthaḥ eva tasya idam ityādau api pradhānam saṃbandhi taddhita vācyam iti upapadyate

original: “sā'sya devatā” ityādau tu indro devatā asya endraṃ haviḥ iti pūrvoḍāśādirasayetyanenādhānabhūtasaṃbandhivācakatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ pratyāyārthaḥ | tatkathamivāyaṃ viprayastaḥ pradhānaguṇaṅāva upapanno bhavati? ucyate guṇabhūto'pi saṃbandhī buddhyantareṇāpradhānābhāvāt pracyāvyāsāditapradhānabhāvaḥ pratyayārthatvena pradaśryate|
analyzed: sā asya devatā ityādau tu indraḥ devatā asya haviḥ iti pūrva uḍāśa ādi rasayā iti anena ādhāna bhūta saṃbandhi vācaka tvena nirdiṣṭaḥ pratyāya arthaḥ tat katham iva ayam viprayastaḥ pradhāna guṇa ṅāvaḥ upapannaḥ bhavati ucyate guṇa bhūtaḥ api saṃbandhī buddhi antareṇa apradhāna abhāvāt pracyāvya āsādita pradhāna bhāvaḥ pratyaya artha tvena pradaśryate

original: ata eva indro devatā asyetyetāvāneva vigraho na kāryaḥ, vṛttisamānārthena hi tena bhavitavyam| na caitāvato vṛttisamānārthatā, vṛttau hi indrādidevatāvacchinnaṃ puroḍāśādyavagamyate, vākye tu puroḍāśādyavacchinnendrādidevateti| ayaṃ tu vigraho vṛttyā samānārtha indro devatā asya tadidamindrasvāmyavacchinnamaindraṃ haviḥ iti |
analyzed: atas eva indraḥ devatā asya iti etāvān eva vigrahaḥ na kāryaḥ vṛtti samāna arthena hi tena bhavitavyam na ca etāvataḥ vṛtti samāna artha tā vṛttau hi indra ādi devatā avacchinnam puroḍāśa ādi avagamyate vākye tu puroḍāśa ādi avacchinnā indra ādi devatā iti ayam tu vigrahaḥ vṛttyā samāna arthaḥ indraḥ devatā asya tat idam indra svāmi avacchinnam aindram haviḥ iti

original: tadidamuktam anantaroktaḥ sabandhī pratipadya pradhānatām| buddhyantarapāramarśādvācyatāṃ pratipadyate|| prakṛtyarthāviśiṣṭo hi pratyayārtho'bhidhānabhāk| nyāyaḥ sa nataḥ sāsyetyadhikārasāmāśrayāt|| evaṃ “so'syadiriti chandasaḥ pragātheṣu” ityādāvapi guṇabhūtaḥ saṃbandhī taddhitābhidheyo boddhavyaḥ |
analyzed: tat idam uktam anantara uktaḥ sabandhī pratipadya pradhāna tām buddhi antara pāramarśāt vācya tām pratipadyate prakṛti artha aviśiṣṭaḥ hi pratyaya arthaḥ abhidhāna bhāj nyāyaḥ sa nataḥ sā asya iti adhikāra sāmāśrayāt evam saḥ usyadiḥ iti chandasaḥ pragātheṣu ityādau api guṇa bhūtaḥ saṃbandhī taddhita abhidheyaḥ boddhavyaḥ

original: yatra tu guṇabhūtaḥ saṃbandhī pratyayārthaḥ tatra na pradhānam, yatra pradhānaṃ tatra na guṇabhūtaḥ, kutaḥ punaridaṃ jñāyate? ācāryapravṛtijrñāpayati yadayaṃ nivāsanivāsavatsaṃbandhe ubayamāha “tasya nivāsaḥ” “so'sya nivāsaḥ” iti| nanu ca apatyāpatyavatsaṃbandhe'pyubhayaṃ saṃbhāvyate mātā apatyamasya mātāmahaḥ, pitā'patyamasya pitāmahaḥ iti|
analyzed: yatra tu guṇa bhūtaḥ saṃbandhī pratyaya arthaḥ tatra na pradhānam yatra pradhānam tatra na guṇa bhūtaḥ kutas punar idam jñāyate ācārya pravṛtiḥ jñāpayati yat ayam nivāsa nivāsavat saṃbandhe ubayam āha tasya nivāsaḥ saḥ asya nivāsaḥ iti nanu ca apatya apatyavat saṃbandhe pi ubhayam saṃbhāvyate mātā apatyam asya mātāmahaḥ pitā apatyam asya pitāmahaḥ iti

original: naivam, pituḥ pitā pitāmahaḥ, mātuḥ pitā mātāmahaḥ iti kariṣyate| tathā'pi hṛdayasya bandhanaṃ śṛṅkhalamasya bandhanaṃ karabhe, iti katham? nānyotra bandhanaśabdaḥ sabāndhivacano yathā hi bandhanamityanenadāmocyate | naivam bandhanamityanena saṃjñāśabdopāśrayaḥ śṛṅkhalakaḥkarabha iti|
analyzed: na evam pituḥ pitā pitāmahaḥ mātuḥ pitā mātāmahaḥ iti kariṣyate tathā api hṛdayasya bandhanam śṛṅkhalam asya bandhanam karabhe iti katham na anyaḥ utra bandhana śabdaḥ sa bāndhi vacanaḥ yathā hi bandhanam iti anena dāma ucyate na evam bandhanam iti anena saṃjñā śabda upāśrayaḥ śṛṅkhalakaḥ karabhaḥ iti

original: evaṃ ca nivāsatadvatorapi śeṣaṣaṣṭhyabhyupagamatve kartṛviśiṣṭamadhikaraṇaṃ vācyaṃ śibīnāṃ nivāsaḥ śaibaḥ iti, aparatra adhikaraṇaviśiṣṭaḥ kartā grāmo nivāso'sya so'yaṃ grāmyaḥ iti | nanu ca grāmaśabdo'yaṃ samūhavacanaḥ, tadyathā “aśvagrāmavidhau kṛti na samareṣvasyāsti tulyaḥ pumān” “na rūṇātsīndriyagrāmam” iti |
analyzed: evam ca nivāsa tadvatoḥ api śeṣa ṣaṣṭhī abhyupagama tve kartṛ viśiṣṭam adhikaraṇam vācyam śibīnām nivāsaḥ śaibaḥ iti aparatra adhikaraṇa viśiṣṭaḥ kartā grāmaḥ nivāsaḥ asya saḥ ayam grāmyaḥ iti nanu ca grāma śabdaḥ yam samūha vacanaḥ tat yathā aśva grāma vidhau na samareṣu asya asti tulyaḥ pumān na iti

original: kiṃ cātaḥ? samūhaśca samūhyapekṣa iti sāpekṣatvādasāmathrye taddhitotpattirna bhavati| na ca sāmānyena samūhādbhaviṣyatīti vācyam, tāvatyevārthe tasyāparisamāpterduradhigamābhidhāne ca sāmathryabhāvāt |
analyzed: kim ca atas samūhaḥ ca samūhi apekṣaḥ iti sāpekṣa tvāt asāmathrye taddhita utpattiḥ na bhavati na ca sāmānyena samūhāt bhaviṣyati iti vācyam tāvati eva arthe tasya aparisamāpteḥ duradhigama abhidhāne ca sāmathrya bhāvāt

original: na ca yatā devadattasya mātuḥ pitā mātāmaho devadattasya, viṣṇumitrasya guroḥ kulaṃ gurukulaṃ viṣṇumitrasyeti taddhitaḥ samāso vā bhavati, evamasyāpi bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, na hyayaṃ saṃbandhuśabdānāmeva ca sāpekṣāṇāṃ vṛttayo bhavanti, yadāha saṃbandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ pravartate| svārthavat sā vyapekṣā'sya vṛttāvapi na hīyate||
analyzed: na ca yatā devadattasya mātuḥ pitā mātāmahaḥ devadattasya viṣṇumitrasya guroḥ kulam guru kulam viṣṇumitrasya iti taddhitaḥ samāsaḥ vā bhavati evam asya api bhaviṣyati iti vācyam na hi ayam saṃbandhu śabdānām eva ca sāpekṣāṇām vṛttayaḥ bhavanti yat āha saṃbandhi śabdaḥ sāpekṣaḥ nityam sarvaḥ pravartate svārtha vat sā vyapekṣā asya vṛttau api na hīyate

original: anyeṣāṃ tu saviśeṣaṇānāṃ na vṛttiḥ, vṛttānāṃ vā na viśeṣaṇamityeva, na hi bhavati ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ṛddharājapuruṣa iti, nāpi brāhmaṇānāṃ grāmo nivāso'sya brāhmaṇānāṃ grāmyo'yamiti | kathaṃ tarhi rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ śobhano rājapuriṣaḥ śobhanaḥ iti? bhavati vai pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ |
analyzed: anyeṣām tu sa viśeṣaṇānām na vṛttiḥ vṛttānām vā na viśeṣaṇam iti eva na hi bhavati ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ṛddha rāja puruṣaḥ iti na api brāhmaṇānām grāmaḥ nivāsaḥ usya brāhmaṇānām grāmyaḥ yam iti katham tarhi rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ śobhanaḥ rāja puriṣaḥ śobhanaḥ iti bhavati vai pradhānasya sāpekṣasya api vṛttiḥ

original: kathaṃ tarhi grāmo nivāso'syoti grāmasya viśeṣyatvāt prādhānye sāpekṣsayāpi vṛttirna bhavati? anantaroktanyayenātra ṣaṣṭhyarthasya prādhānyāt | nanu, ayamapi saṃbandhiśabdaḥ kasmānna bhavati? samūhārthamātra eva vṛttyaparisamāpteḥ |
analyzed: katham tarhi grāmaḥ nivāsaḥ usya iti grāmasya viśeṣya tvāt prādhānye sāpekṣsayā api vṛttiḥ na bhavati anantara ukta nyayena atra ṣaṣṭhī arthasya prādhānyāt nanu ayam api saṃbandhi śabdaḥ kasmāt na bhavati samūha artha mātre eva vṛtti aparisamāpteḥ

original: tatra anyatamanibandhanāḥ kutsādayo yathā kiṃ dvāri daivahatike sahakārakeṇa saṃvradhitena viṣavṛkṣaka eṣa pāpaḥ| yasminmanāgapi vikāsavikārabhāji bhīmā bhavanti madanajvasaṃnipātāḥ||

analyzed: neḥ biḍaḍ ḍat dhjvirīsacau inac piḍāñci kaci ca kacika ādeśaḥ ca iti nanu ca dhātuḥ prathamam sādhanena saṃbadhyate paścāt upasargeṇa tat katham ucyate yathā icchasi tathā astu viśeṣyam hi pūrva suddham viśeṣaṇa saṃbanavdham anubhavati viśeṣyaḥ ca dhātvarthaḥ kriyā rūpaḥ upasargāṇām uktam ca kriyā vacanaḥ dhītuḥ iti kriyā ca sādhyam ucyate sādhyam ca iti

original: sādhanasaṃbandhamantareṇa na syāt| taduktaṃ prayogārheṣu siddhassanbhettavyo'rtho viśiṣyate | prāk ca sādhanasaṃbandhātkriyā naivopajāyate|| tanna, bhāvisaṃbandhayogyatāsamāśrayaṇāt | idaṃ cāvaśyamabhyupagantavyam, anyathā hi kriyāvacano dhātuḥ ityapi na syāt|

original: na ca “dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ sāmānakartṛtādicchāyāṃ vā” iti sana utpattiḥ, tadāha dhātossādhanayogasya bhāvinaḥ prakramādyathā | dhātutvaṃ karmabhāvaśrca tathā'nyadapi ddaśyatām||

original: yadi ca dhātoḥ pūrvapasargeṇa saṃbandho na syāt, kathamucyate “viparābhyāṃ jeḥ” “adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma” iti? nanu pūrvamupasargasaṃbandhaḥ kkopayujyate? sādhanasaṃbandhamantareṇa tadviśeṣanabhivyakteḥ | naivam, phalakāle bījasaṃskārasyeva tasyopayogāt, taduktaṃ bījakāleṣu saṃbaddhā yathā lākṣārasādayaḥ | varṇādipariṇāmena phalānāmupakurvate ||

original: buddhisyādabhisaṃbandhāttathā dhātūpasargayoḥ | ambhantarīkṛto bhaidaḥ padakāle prakāśate || aḍādīnāṃ vyavasthārthaṃ pṛthaktvena prakalpanam | dhātūpasargayoḥ śāstre dhātureva hi tāddaśaḥ|| kriyāviśeṣāḥ saṃghātauḥ prakramyante kkacittayoḥ | tathā hi saṃgrāmayateḥ sopasargādaṭo vidhiḥ||
analyzed: buddhi syāt abhisaṃbandhāt tathā dhātu upasargayoḥ bhaidaḥ pada kāle prakāśate aṭ ādīnām vyavasthā artham pṛthaktvena prakalpanam dhātu upasargayoḥ śāstre dhātuḥ eva hi kriyā viśeṣāḥ saṃghātauḥ prakramyante kkacid tayoḥ tathā hi saṃgrāmayateḥ sa upasargāt aṭaḥ vidhiḥ

original: ataḥ anukāmayate ityādau dhātoḥ prathamamupasargeṇa sādhanena vā saṃbandhe na doṣa iti| upasargāṇāṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇatve trayī gatir vācakatvaṃ, dyotakatvaṃ, sahābhidhāyakatvaṃ ca, yathocyate sa vācako viśeṣaṇāṃ saṃbhavāt dyotako'pi vā| śktyādhānāya dhatorvā sahakārī prayujyate||

original: tatra yadā vācakatvaṃ tadā dhātoḥ prathamamupasargeṇa saṃbandhaḥ, yathā pratiṣṭhate, nirākareti iti | yadā dyotakatvaṃ tadā sādhanena, yachā prapacati, nikarṣati iti | yadā sahābhidhāyakatvaṃ tadā dhātūpasargayostulyakālaṃ sādhanena saṃbandhaḥ, yathādhūte, adhyeti iti | taduktaṃ svādibhiḥ kaivasairyatra gamanādi na gamyate |

original: ucyate, kasmānna bhavati darśanīyāyā mātā darśanāyāmātā? atha matametat prāk samāsādyatra sāmānādhikaraṇyam, ihāpi na doṣo bhavati, na hi prāk samāsāt sāmānādhikaraṇyamatra vidyate |

original: tanna, bahutvābhāvāt, yābhyābhevātraiko dyvarthastābhyāmevāparo'pi | yadyevamanyevācakena śabdenānyasya vacanaṃ nopapadyate | evaṃ tarhi plakṣo'pi nyagroghaḥ, nyagrodhasya ca plakṣatvāt svaśabdenaivābhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti | kathaṃ punaḥ plakṣo'pi nyagroghaḥ, nyagrodho'pi plakṣaḥ syāt? yāvatā kāraṇāddravye śabdāsaṃniveśo bhavati |

original: yadi vā, matalliketyetat praśaṃsāvacanaṃ nyunādhikabhāvamanapekṣyapravartamānamanenaiva dharmeṇa sarvayogyaṃ sat aśva ityanena viśiṣṭāyāṃ yogyatāyāṃ niyamyate | tato yathā śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaścayaṃ mṛgaḥ sāraṅgaḥ śabalaiti vā, tathā aśvamatalliketyetadubhayarūpo'rtha ityubhayamubhayena saṃniveśyate | evaṃ kumārītallajakaḥ, goprakāṇḍaṃ, iti |

original: ata eva yatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasyāsaṃbhavaḥ, tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa eva bhavati, yathā vedyartha dakṣiṇaṃ meroḥ, svarārdhe, cūḍiḍḍatdhkārdhaṃ, paṇārdhe iti | na ca ardhādīnāmevaiṣa niyamaḥ, yato'nyatrāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyasya vivakṣā'vivakṣābabhyāmubhayathā tatpuruṣo bhavati, tadyathāgrahastaḥ, hastāgraṃ, talapādaḥ, pādatalaṃ iti ||
analyzed: atas eva yatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya asaṃbhavaḥ tatra ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ eva bhavati yathā vedyartha dakṣiṇam meroḥ svara ardhe paṇa ardhe iti na ca ardha ādīnām eva eṣa niyamaḥ yatas anyatra api sāmānādhikaraṇyasya vivakṣā avivakṣā babhyām ubhayathā tatpuruṣaḥ bhavati tat yathā agra hastaḥ hasta agram tala pādaḥ pāda talam iti

original: nanu ca, “cārthe dvandvaḥ” ityucyate, caśrcāvyayam tena samāsasyāvyayasaṃjñā prāpnoti, naiṣa deṣaḥ, pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñā kriyate, na ca samāsastatra paṭhyate | mā bhūdapāṭhe saṃjñā, tathā'pyubhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti, yaśrcehārtho'bhidhīyate, na tsaya liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogo'sti | nedaṃ vācanikam aliṅgatā, asamakhyatā ca |
analyzed: nanu ca ca arthe dvandvaḥ iti ucyate caḥ ca avyayam tena samāsasya avyaya saṃjñā prāpnoti na eṣa pāṭhena avyaya saṃjñā kriyate na ca samāsaḥ tatra paṭhyate mā bhūt apāṭhe saṃjñā tathā api ubhidheya vat liṅga vacanāni bhavanti yaḥ ca iha arthaḥ abhidhīyate na liṅga saṃkhyābhyām yogaḥ asti na idam vācanikam aliṅga tā asamakhya tā ca

original: kiṃ tarhi? svābhāvikametat | tadyathā śamānamīhamānānāmadhīyānānāṃ ca kecidarthena yujyante, apare na, na cedānīṃ kaścidarthavāniti kṛtvā sarvairarthavadbhiśśakyaṃ bhavitum, kaśrcidvā'narthaka iti sarvairanarthakaiḥ | tatra kimasmābhiḥ śakyaṃ kartum, yatprāk samāsāñcarthasya liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogo nāsti, samāre ca bhavati, svabhāvikametat |
analyzed: kim tarhi svābhāvikam etat tat yathā śamānam īhamānānām adhīyānānām ca kecid arthena yujyante apare na na ca idānīm kaścid arthavān iti kṛtvā sarvaiḥ arthavadbhiḥ śakyam bhavitum kaścid vā anarthakaḥ iti sarvaiḥ anarthakaiḥ tatra kim asmābhiḥ śakyam kartum yat prāk samāsān ca arthasya liṅga saṃkhyābhyām yogaḥ na asti samāre ca bhavati svabhāvikam etat

original: athavā, āśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhaviṣyanti, yathā guṇavacaneṣu | guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti | tadyathā, śuklaṃ vastraṃ, śuklā śāṭī, śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklau kambalau, śuklāḥ kambalaḥ iti | yadasau dravyaṃ śrito bhavati samāsastasya yalliṅgaṃ vacanaṃ ca tatsamāsasyāpi bhaviṣyati |
analyzed: athavā āśrayataḥ liṅga vacanāni bhaviṣyanti yathā guṇa vacaneṣu guṇa vacanānām hi śabdānām āśrayataḥ liṅga vacanāni bhavanti tat yathā śuklam vastram śuklā śāṭī śuklaḥ kambalaḥ śuklau kambalau śuklāḥ kambalaḥ iti yat asau dravyam śritaḥ bhavati samāsaḥ tasya yat liṅgam vacanam ca tat samāsasya api bhaviṣyati

original: atheha kasmānna bhavati yājñikaścāyaṃ vaiyākaraṇaśca, kaṭhaścāyaṃ bahvṛcaśca, aukthikaścayaṃ mīmāṃsakaśceti? śeṣa iti vartate, aśeṣatvānna bhaviṣyati | yadi śeṣa iiti vartate “upāsnnātaṃ sthūlasiktaṃ tūṣṇīṃgaṅgaṃ mahāhadam | droṇaṃ cedaśako gantuṃ mā tvā tāptāṃ kṛtākṛte||” ityetanna sidhyati | naiṣa doṣaḥ, anyaddhi kṛtamanyadakṛtam |
analyzed: atha iha kasmāt na bhavati yājñikaḥ ca ayam vaiyākaraṇaḥ ca kaṭhaḥ ca ayam bahvṛcaḥ ca aukthikaḥ ca ayam mīmāṃsakaḥ ca iti śeṣaḥ iti vartate aśeṣa tvāt na bhaviṣyati yadi śeṣaḥ i iti vartate upāsnnātam sthūla siktam tūṣṇīṃgaṅgam mahā hadam droṇam ced aśakaḥ gantum mā tvā tāptām kṛta akṛte iti etat na sidhyati na eṣa doṣaḥ anyat hi kṛtam anyat akṛtam

original: cārthe dvandvavacane asamāse'pi cārthasaṃprakyayādaniṣṭaṃ prāpneti “aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum | vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva dirmadī ||” “indrastvaṣṭā varūṇo vāyurādityaḥ” iti | naiṣa doṣaḥ, iha “ce dvandvaḥ” itīyatā siddham, kathaṃ punaśrce nāyaṃ vṛttiḥ syāt? śabdo hyeṣa, śabde'saṃbhavādarthe kāryaṃ vijñāsyate |
analyzed: ca arthe dvandva vacane a samāse pi ca artha saṃprakyayāt aniṣṭam prāpneti ahar ahar nayamānaḥ gām aśvam puruṣam paśum vaivasvataḥ na tṛpyati surāyāḥ iva dirmadī indraḥ tvaṣṭā varūṇaḥ vāyuḥ ādityaḥ iti na eṣa doṣaḥ iha ce dvandvaḥ iti iyatā siddham katham punar ṛce na ayam vṛttiḥ syāt śabdaḥ hi eṣa śabde saṃbhavāt arthe kāryam vijñāsyate

original: so'yamevaṃ siddhaṃ sati yadrathagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tasyaitatprayojanam, yathaivaṃ vijñāyeta cakṛte'rthe cārtha iti | kaḥ punaḥ cakṛto'rthaḥ? samūñcayaḥ, anvācayaḥ, itaretarayogaḥ, samāhāra iti | tatradvayoḥ sāpekṣatvāt samāso na bhavati, dvayostu bhavatīti pratipāditaṃ pustātā|
analyzed: saḥ uyam evam siddham sati yat ratha grahaṇam karoti tasya etat prayojanam yathā evam vijñāyeta cakṛta irthe ca arthaḥ iti kaḥ punar cakṛta ūrthaḥ samūñcayaḥ anvācayaḥ itaretara yogaḥ samāhāraḥ iti tatra dvayoḥ sāpekṣa tvāt samāsaḥ na bhavati dvayoḥ tu bhavati iti pratipāditam pustātā

original: nanu caivam, cakṛto'rthaśrcārtha iti paśre plakṣanyagrodhāvityatra plakṣaśrca nyagrodhaśrceti vigrahaḥ prāpnoti, yāvatā plakṣaśrca nyagrodhaśrcedapyukte gamyata etat plakṣo'pi nyagrodhasahāyaḥ, nyagrodho'pi plakṣasahāya iti| tatra ko doṣaḥ syāt? plakṣau ca nyagrodhau ceti yadaktaṃ tanna ghacate |

original: yugapadadhikaraṇavatacanāpradarśanamātraparametat, na tvayameva paramārthaḥ | evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe ekaśrca viṃśatiśrca ekaviṃśatiḥ, dvau ca viṃśatiśrca dvāviṃśatiriti dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti | kiṃ punarekaviṃśatirityādayo dvandvaḥ? bāḍham|

original: ekādhikā viṃśatiriti pakṣe hi saṃkhyāsvaro na prāpnoti, sa hi śatasahastramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāse mā bhūditi dvandvaḥ evābhyanujñāyate | yadyevamitaretarayogapakṣe dvivatanam, samāhārapakṣe napuṃsakatvaṃ prāpnoti | naivam, “liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvāt” iti samāhare'pi napiṃsakatvaṃ na bhavaṣyati |

original: atha dvādaśetyatrāpi samāhāraḥ kasamānna bhavati? ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeya eva vartante, ataḥ udbhatāvayavasamudāyatāyāmitaretarayoga eva prāpnoti, yathā “adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca” daśeme mārdaṅgikapāṇavikā iti || tadetat kṛttaddhitasamāsabhedādvibhaktāvayavaṃ tridhā prātipadikabhihitam | athāvibhāktāvayavanucyate |
analyzed: atha dvādaśa iti atra api samāhāraḥ kasamāt na bhavati ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeyaḥ eva vartante atas udbhata avayava samudāya tāyām itaretara yogaḥ eva prāpnoti yathā adhikaraṇa etāvat tve ca daśa ime mārdaṅgika pāṇavikāḥ iti tat etat kṛt taddhita samāsa bhedāt vibhakta avayavam tridhā prātipadika abhihitam atha avibhākta avayavan ucyate

original: tadapi tridhā nāmarūpaṃ, avyarūpaṃ, nipātarūpaṃ ca | tatrānapekṣitaśabdavyutpattatīni sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyīni ca nāmāni | tāni tridhaikārthāni, anekārthāni, ekānekārthāni ceti, tatra, ekārthāni yathā vṛkṣaḥ, kuṇm, kumārī, ḍiḍḍatdhtthaḥ, śuklaḥ, śīghraḥ, indraḥ, śukraḥ, purandaraḥ, koṣṭhaḥ, kusūlaḥ iti |

original: anekārthāni yathākṣāḥ, māṣāḥ, pādāḥ, avayaḥ, harayaḥ, gāvaḥ, bhūtayaḥ, puṇḍaḍḍatdhrūkaṃ, puṣkaraṃ, sāma, lalāma iti | ekānekārtāni yathā dastrauḥ, nāsatyau, puṣpavantau, ubhau, rodasī, rodasyai, dārāḥ, varṣāḥ, āpaḥ, vanaṃ, sonā, iti|

original: ataḥ kārakeṇaiva saṃkhyābhisaṃbadhyate, na kriyādibhiriti | tadevaṃ tiṅavācyatvena kartuḥ kartṛpadaṃ, bhāvakartṛpadaṃ, karmakartṛpadaṃ ceti yaduktaṃ, tadanupapannameveti| kartṛpadaṃ, karmapadaṃ, karaṇapadaṃ, saṃpradānapadaṃ, apādānapadaṃ, adhikaraṇapadañceti kārakarūpabhedāḥ |
analyzed: atas kārakeṇa eva saṃkhyā abhisaṃbadhyate na kriyā ādibhiḥ iti tat evam tiṅ avācya tvena kartuḥ kartṛ padam bhāva kartṛ padam karma kartṛ padam ca iti yat uktam tat anupapannam eva iti kartṛ padam karma padam karaṇa padam saṃpradāna padam apādāna padam adhikaraṇa padam ca iti kāraka rūpa bhedāḥ

original: tatra katrrādayaḥ kārakaprastāve'grataḥ prapañcayiṣyante, iha tu saṃbandhāvicchedāya leśata udāhiyante| teṣāṃ kartā tridhā śvatantro'svatantraḥ karmakartāceti | tatra kriyāyāṃ svecchayā yaḥ karaṇādikārakāṇi prayuṅkte natu taiḥ prayujyate saḥ svatantraḥ| sa dvidhā śvavibhaktivācyaḥ, paravibhaktivācyaśceti|
analyzed: tatra katru ādayaḥ prapañcayiṣyante iha tu saṃbandha a vicchedāya leśataḥ udāhiyante teṣām kartā tridhā karma kartā ca iti tatra kriyāyām sva icchayā yaḥ karaṇa ādi kārakāṇi prayuṅkte na tu taiḥ prayujyate saḥ svatantraḥ sa dvidhā śva vibhakti vācyaḥ para vibhakti vācyaḥ ca iti

original: tayossvavibhaktivācyo yathā mānabhaṅgapaṭunā suratecchāṃ tanvatā prathayatā ddaśi rāgam| lebhire sapadi bāvayatāntaryoṣitaḥ praṇayineva madena|| paravibhaktivācyo yathā cārutā vapurabhūṣayadāsāṃ tāmanūnanavayauvanayogaḥ| taṃ punarmakaraketanalakṣmīstāṃ mado dayitasaṅgamabhūṣaḥ|| yo'nyaprayuktaḥ kriyāsu vyāpriyate so'svatantraḥ |
analyzed: tayoḥ sva vibhakti vācyaḥ yathā māna bhaṅga paṭunā surata icchām tanvatā prathayatā ddaśi rāgam lebhire sapadi bāvayatā antar yoṣitaḥ praṇayinā iva madena para vibhakti vācyaḥ yathā cāru tā vapuḥ abhūṣayat āsām tām anūna nava yauvana yogaḥ tam punar makaraketana lakṣmīḥ tām madaḥ dayita saṅgama bhūṣaḥ yoni a prayuktaḥ kriyāsu vyāpriyate saḥ svatantraḥ

original: so'pi dvidhodbhatavyāpāro'nudbhūtavyāpāraśca| tayorudbhūtavyāpāro yathā guṇānuraktāmanuraktasādhanaḥ kulābhimānī kulajāṃ janādhipaḥ| paraistvadanyaḥ ka ivāpahārayenmanoramāmātmavadhūmiva śriyam|| anudbhūtavyāpāro yathā cittanirvṛti vidhāyi viviktaṃ manmatho madhumadaśśaśibhāsaḥ|
analyzed: saḥ api dvidhā udbhata vyāpāraḥ n udbhūta vyāpāraḥ ca tayoḥ udbhūta vyāpāraḥ yathā guṇa anuraktām anurakta sādhanaḥ kula abhimānī kula jām janādhipaḥ paraiḥ tvad anyaḥ kaḥ iva apahārayet manoramām ātma vadhūm iva śriyam an udbhūta vyāpāraḥ yathā citta nirvṛti vidhāyi viviktam manmathaḥ madhu madaḥ śaśi bhāsaḥ

original: saṅgataṃ ca dayitai ssama nayanti praima nyanti prema kāmapi bhuvaṃ pramadānām|| karmakartā'pi dvidhaiva | udriktakarmaṃśaḥ, anudriktakarmāṃśaśca| tayorudraktakarmāṃśo yathā tattaducchavasutapītabhaindavaṃ soḍuḍḍatdhmakṣamamiva prabhārasam| miktaṣaṭpadavirāvamañjanusā bhadyate kumudamānibandhanāt||
analyzed: ca dayitaiḥ nayanti praima nyanti prema kām api bhuvam pramadānām karma kartā api dvidhā eva udrikta karma aṃśaḥ an udrikta karmāṃśaḥ ca tayoḥ udrakta karmāṃśaḥ yathā tat tat ucchava suta pīta bhaindavam prabhā rasam mikta ṣaṭpada virāva mañjanusā bhadyate kumuda māni bandhanāt

original: anudriktakarmāṃśo yathodārakīrterudayaṃ dayāvataḥ praśāntabādhaṃ diśato'bhirakṣayā| svayaṃ pradugdhe'sya guṇairupasnutā vasūpamānasya vasūni medinī|| kartuḥ kriyayā'nanyārthayā yadāpyate tatkarma| tadapi tridhā nirvatryaṃ, vikāryaṃ, prāpyañca |
analyzed: an udrikta karma aṃśaḥ yathā udāra kīrteḥ udayam dayāvataḥ praśānta bādham svayam guṇaiḥ upasnutā vasu upamānasya vasūni medinī kartuḥ kriyayā ananyārthayā yat āpyate tat karma tat api tridhā vikāryam prāpyam ca

original: teṣu nirvaryaṃ dvidhā “yadasajjāyate sadvā janmanā tatprakaśyate||” tayoḥ prathamaṃ yathāyamāndolitaprauḍhacandanadrumapallavaḥ| utpādayati lokasya prītiṃ malayamārutaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ yathā santameva ciramaprakṛtatvādaprakāśitamadidyutadaṅge| vibhrāmo madhumadaḥ pramadānāṃ dhātulīnamupasarga ivārtham|| vikāryamapi dvidhā|
analyzed: teṣu nirvaryam dvidhā yat asat jāyate sat vā janmanā tat prakaśyate tayoḥ prathamam yathā ayam āndolita prauḍha candana druma pallavaḥ utpādayati lokasya prītim malaya mārutaḥ dvitīyam yathā santam eva ciram aprakṛta tvāt aprakāśitam adidyutat aṅge vibhrāmaḥ madhu madaḥ pramadānām dhātu līnam upasargaḥ iva artham vikāryam api dvidhā

original: prakṛtyucchedāt guṇāntarādhānañca | ta prathamaṃ yathā krodhaṃ prabho saṃhara saṃhareti yāvadgiraḥ khe marutāṃ caranti| tāvat sa bahniḥ bhavanetrajanmā bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ madanaṃ cakāra|| dvitīyaṃ yathā tāṃ pulomatanayālakocitaiḥ pāriḍātakusumaiḥ prasādhayan| nandane ciramayugmalocana ssaspṛhaṃ suravadhūbhiraikṣyata|| prāpyamapi dvidhaiva|
analyzed: prakṛti ucchedāt guṇa antara ādhānam ca prathamam yathā krodham prabho saṃhara saṃhara iti yāvat giraḥ khe marutām caranti tāvat sa bahniḥ bhava netra janmā bhasma avaśeṣam madanam cakāra dvitīyam yathā tām pulomatanayā alaka ucitaiḥ pāriḍāta kusumaiḥ prasādhayan nandane ciram ayugmalocanaḥ sa spṛham sura vadhūbhiḥ aikṣyata prāpyam api dvidhā eva

original: kathitamakathitañca| tatra yatkṛtyaktakhalarthādibhirabhidhīyate tatkathitaṃ, yattairnābhidhīyate tadakathitaṃ | tayorādyaṃ yathā nipīyamānastabakā śilīmukhairaśokayaṣṭiścalabālapallavā| viḍaḍḍatdhmbayantī daddaśe vadhūjanairamandaṣṭoṣṭakarāvadhūnanam|| dvitīyaṃ yathā tāmasmadarthe yuṣmābhiryācitavyo himācalaḥ|
analyzed: kathitam akathitam ca tatra yat kṛtya kta khal artha ādibhiḥ abhidhīyate tat kathitam yat taiḥ na abhidhīyate tat akathitam tayoḥ ādyam yathā nipīyamāna stabakā śilīmukhaiḥ aśoka yaṣṭiḥ cala bāla pallavā viḍaḍḍat dhmbayantī daddaśe vadhū janaiḥ amanda ṣṭa uṣṭa kara avadhūnanam dvitīyam yathā tām asmad arthe yuṣmābhiḥ yācitavyaḥ himācalaḥ

original: vikriyāyai na kalpante sambandhāssadanuṣṭhitāḥ|| kriyāsiddhai sādhakatamatvena yadavyavahitaṃ vyāpriyate tatkaraṇam| tadapi tridhā brāhmamābhyantaraṃ bāhyābhyantarañca | teṣu bāhyaṃ dvidhā vyavadhāyakamavyavadhāyakañca| tayorādyaṃ yathā dhūpoṣmaṇā tyājitamādrrabhāvaṃ keśāntamantaḥkusubhaṃ tadīyam|
analyzed: vikriyāyai na kalpante sambandhāḥ sat anuṣṭhitāḥ kriyā siddhai sādhakatama tvena yat avyavahitam vyāpriyate tat karaṇam tat api tridhā brāhmam ābhyantaram bāhya abhyantaram ca teṣu bāhyam dvidhā vyavadhāyakam avyavadhāyakam ca tayoḥ ādyam yathā dhūpa uṣmaṇā tyājitam ādrra bhāvam keśāntam antar kusubham tadīyam

original: paryakṣapatkācidudārabandhaṃ dūrvāvatā pāṇḍuḍḍatdhmadhūkadāmnā|| dvitīyaṃ yathā vaidarbhanirdiṣṭamasau kumāraḥ klṛptena sopānapathena mañcam| śilavibhaṅgau rmṛgarājaśāba stuṅgaṃ nagotsaṅgamivāruroha|| ābhyantaramapi dvidhā kartṛrbhinnamabhinnañca | tayorbhinnaṃ yathā śilāghanai rnākasadāmurasthalaiḥ bṛhanniveśaiśca vadhūpayodharaiḥ|
analyzed: paryakṣapat kācid udāra bandham dūrvāvatā dvitīyam yathā vaidarbha nirdiṣṭam asau kumāraḥ klṛptena sopāna pathena mañcam śila vibhaṅgauḥ mṛgarāja śābaḥ tuṅgam naga utsaṅgam iva āruroha ābhyantaram api dvidhā kartṛ bhinnam abhinnam ca tayoḥ bhinnam yathā śilā ghanaiḥ nākasadām ura sthalaiḥ bṛhat niveśaiḥ ca vadhū payodharaiḥ

original: taṭāntanītena vibhinnavīcinā ruṣeva bheje kaluṣatvamambhasā|| dvitīyaṃ yathā prayuktasatkāraviśeṣamātmanā namā paraṃ saṃpratipattumarhasi| yatasstāṃ sannatagātri saṅgataṃ manīṣibhi ssāptapadīnamucyate|| bāhyābhvantaramapi dvidhā bahirmukhamantarmupakhañca | tayorādyaṃ yathā gatayā punaḥ pratigavākṣagavaṃ dadhatī ratena bhṛśamutsukatām|
analyzed: taṭa anta nītena vibhinna vīcinā ruṣā iva bheje kaluṣa tvam ambhasā dvitīyam yathā prayukta satkāra viśeṣam ātmanā param saṃpratipattum arhasi yatas stām sannata gātri saṅga tam manīṣibhiḥ sāptapadīnam ucyate bāhya ābhu antaram api dvidhā bahis mukham antar mupa kham ca tayoḥ ādyam yathā gatayā punar pratigavākṣa gavam dadhatī ratena bhṛśam utsuka tām

original: muhurantarālabhavastagire ssavituśca yoṣidamimīta ddaśā|| dvitīyaṃ yathā bibhratau madhuratāmatimātraṃ rāgibhiryugapadeva papāte | ānanarmadhiraso vikasadbhi rnāsikābhirasitotpalagandhaḥ|| kriyākāryatvenāvadhīritaṃ karmaṇā kiyayā vā saṃyogaḥ yadanubhavati tatsaṃpradānam| titrtridhā dadātikarmavyāpyaṃ, karmamātravyāpyaṃ, kriyāvyāpyaṃ ceti|
analyzed: muhur antarāla bhava sta gireḥ ssavituḥ ca yoṣit amimīta ddaśā dvitīyam yathā bibhratau madhura tām atimātram rāgibhiḥ yugapad eva papāte ānana rmadhi rasaḥ vikasadbhiḥ nāsikābhiḥ asita utpala gandhaḥ kriyā kārya tvena avadhīritam karmaṇā kiyayā vā saṃyogaḥ yat anubhavati tat saṃpradānam titri tridhā dadāti karma vyāpyam karma mātra vyāpyam kriyā vyāpyam ca iti

original: teṣu dadātikarmavyāpyaṃ dvidhā śvatvasyā'nivṛttau nivṛttau ca | tayorādyaṃ yathā cumbanādalakacūrṇārūṣitaṃ śaṃkaropi nayanaṃ lalāṭajam| ucchavasatkamalagandhaye dadau pārvatīvadanagandhavāhine|| dvitīyaṃ yathā dātuṃ va prabhavasi māmanyasmai hartumeva vā dāsam| nā'haṃ puvanastathātvaṃ yathābi māṃ śaṅkase bhūru||
analyzed: teṣu dadāti karma vyāpyam dvidhā śva tvasya anivṛttau nivṛttau ca tayoḥ ādyam yathā cumbanāt alaka cūrṇa rūṣitam śaṃkaraḥ api nayanam lalāṭa jam dadau pārvatī vadana gandhavāhine dvitīyam yathā dātum mām anyasmai hartum eva vā dāsam na aham mām śaṅkase bhūru

original: kriyākarmavyāpyaṃ dvidhā dadātyarthaviṣayaṃ ca | tatra prathamaṃ yathā śrīmallatābhavanamoṣadhayaḥ pradīpā śśayyā navāti haricandanapallavāni| asminnatiśramanudaśca sarojavātārasmartuṃ diśanti na divassurasundarūbhyaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ yathā śaśaṃsa tasmai praṇipatya nandī śuśruṣayā śailasutāmupetām|
analyzed: kriyā karma vyāpyam dvidhā dadāti artha viṣayam ca tatra prathamam yathā śrīmat latā bhavanam oṣadhayaḥ pradīpā śśayyā haricandana pallavāni asmin ati śrama nudaḥ ca saroja vātāra smartum diśanti na divaḥ sura sundarūbhyaḥ dvitīyam yathā śaśaṃsa tasmai praṇipatya nandī śuśruṣayā śailasutām upetām

original: praveśayamāsa ca bharturenāṃ bhrūkṣepamātrānumatapraveśām|| kriyāvyāpyamapi dvidhaiva| pāribhāṣikamapāribhāṣikañca| tayoḥ prathamaṃ yathā na strajo rurucire lamaṇībhyaścandanāni virahe madirā vā| sādhaneṣvabhiraterupadhatte ramyatāṃ prayasamāgama eva|| dvitīyaṃ yathetthaṃ vithadhijñena purohitena prayuktaparāṇigrahaṇopacārau|
analyzed: praveśayamāsa ca bhartuḥ enām bhrū kṣepa mātra anumata praveśām kriyā vyāpyam api dvidhā eva pāribhāṣikam a pāribhāṣikam ca tayoḥ prathamam yathā na strajaḥ rurucire lamaṇībhyaḥ candanāni virahe madirāḥ vā sādhaneṣu abhirateḥ upadhatte ramya tām praya samāgamaḥ eva dvitīyam yathā ittham purohitena prayukta para āṇi grahaṇa upacārau

original: praṇematustau pitarau prajānāṃ padmāsanasthāya pitāmahāya|| tatra katrrā karmaṇā vā kriyājanyameva dhrauvyeṇa yadvigāhamavagāhate tadapādanam| tatrtridhā nirdiṣṭaviṣayamupāttaviṣayamapeśritakriyañca | teṣu nirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ yathojjhitaṃ anujjhataṃ ca| tayorādyaṃ yathā svedānuviddhādrranakhakṣatāṅke samdaṣṭabhūyiṣṭhaśikhākapole |
analyzed: praṇematuḥ tau pitarau prajānām padmāsana sthāya pitāmahāya tatra katrrā karmaṇā vā kriyā janyam eva dhrauvyeṇa yat vigāham avagāhate tat apādanam tatra tridhā nirdiṣṭa viṣayam upātta viṣayam apeśrita kriyam ca teṣu nirdiṣṭa viṣayam yathā ujjhitam anujjhatam ca tayoḥ ādyam yathā sveda anuviddha adrra nakha kṣata aṅke samdaṣṭa bhūyiṣṭha śikhā kapole

original: cyutaṃ na karṇādapi kāminīnāṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ sahāsā papāta|| dvitīyaṃ yathāuṣasātapabhayādapalīnaṃ vāsaracchavivirāmapaṭīyaḥ| sannipatya śanakairiva nimnādandhakāramudavāpa samāni|| upāttaviṣayamapi dvidhā| heyamupādeyañca| tayorādyaṃ yathā karau dhunānā navapallavākṛtī vṛthā kṛthā mānini māpariśramam|
analyzed: cyutam na karṇāt api kāminīnām śirīṣa puṣpam sa hāsā papāta dvitīyam yathā auṣasa ātapa bhayāt apalīnam vāsara chavi virāma paṭīyaḥ sannipatya śanakais iva nimnāt andhakāram udavāpa samāni upātta viṣayam api dvidhā heyam upādeyam ca tayoḥ ādyam yathā karau dhunānā nava pallava ākṛtī vṛthā kṛthāḥ mānini mā a pariśramam

original: upeyuṣī kalpalatābhiśaṅkayā kathaṃ nu vivasyati ṣaṭpadāvalī|| dvitīyaṃ yathātithiṃ nāma kākutsthāt putramāpa kumudvatī | paścimādyaminīyāmāt prasādamiva cetanā|| apeśrtakriyamapi dvidhaiva| sāmānyāpekṣaṃ viśeṣepekṣaṃ ca tayorādyaṃ yathā mā punastamabhisīsaramāgaskiriṇaṃ madavimohitacetāḥ|
analyzed: upeyuṣī kalpalatā abhiśaṅkayā katham nu vivasyati ṣaṭpada āvalī dvitīyam yathā atithim nāma kākutsthāt putram āpa kumudvatī paścimāt yaminī yāmāt prasādam iva cetanā dvidhā eva sāmānya apekṣam viśeṣa ipekṣam ca tayoḥ ādyam yathā mā punar tam abhisīsaram āgaskiriṇam mada vimohita cetāḥ

original: yoṣidityābhilalāṣa na hālāṃ dustyajaḥ khalu sukhādapi mānaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ yathā kuto bhavānadhvani citrakūṭāt ddaṣṭastvayā śrīlalitaprabhāvaḥ| kiṃ tena mugdhe madanotsave'smin kāmaṃ tvayā veśmani lekhayāmi|| katrrā karmaṃṇā vyavahitaṃ kriyādhāro'dhikaraṇam | tattridhā vaiṣayukaṃ, aupaśleṣikaṃ naimittikaṃ ca | teṣu vaiṣayikaṃ dvidhā |
analyzed: yoṣit ityā abhilalāṣa na hālām dustyajaḥ khalu sukhāt api mānaḥ dvitīyam yathā kutas bhavān adhvani citrakūṭāt ddaṣṭaḥ tvayā śrī lalita prabhāvaḥ kim tena mugdhe madana utsave asmin kāmam tvayā veśmani lekhayāmi katrrā karmaṃṇā vyavahitam kriyā ādhāra udhikaraṇam tat tridhā vaiṣayukam aupaśleṣikam naimittikam ca teṣu vaiṣayikam dvidhā

original: tayorādyaṃ yathā kadalīprakāṇḍaḍḍatdhruciroru tarau jaghanasthalīrisare mahatī| raśanākalāpaguṇena vadhū rmakaradhvadviradamākalayan|| dvitīyaṃ yathā vipadi dhairyamathābhyudaye kṣamā sadasi vākyapaṭunā yudhi vikramaḥ| yaśasi cābhiruciḥ vyasanaṃ śruteḥ prakṛtisiddhamidaṃ hi mahātmanām|| aupaśloṣikamapi dvidhaikadeśikamabhivyāpakaṃ ca|
analyzed: tayoḥ ādyam yathā tarau jaghana sthalī risare mahatī raśanā kalāpa guṇena vadhūḥ makara dhva dviradam ākalayan dvitīyam yathā vipadi dhairyam atha abhyudaye kṣamā sadasi vākya paṭunā yudhi vikramaḥ yaśasi ca abhiruciḥ vyasanam śruteḥ prakṛti siddham idam hi mahātmanām aupaśloṣikam api dvidhā eka deśikam abhivyāpakam ca

original: tayorādyaṃ yathā sparśabhāji vigadacchavicārau kalpite mṛgaddaśāṃ suratāya| sannatiṃ dadhati peturajastraṃ ddaṣṭayaḥ priyatame śayane ca|| dvitīyaṃ yathā rāgakāntanayaneṣu nitāntaṃ vidrumāruṇākapolataleṣu | sarvathā'pi daddaśe vanitānāṃ darpaṇeṣviva mukheṣu madaśrīḥ|| naimittikamapi dvidhaiva śuddhaṃ saṅkīrṇaṃ ca |
analyzed: tayoḥ ādyam yathā sparśa bhāji vigada chavi cārau kalpite mṛga daśām suratāya sannatim dadhati petuḥ ajastram ddaṣṭayaḥ priyatame śayane ca dvitīyam yathā rāga kānta nayaneṣu nitāntam vidruma aruṇā kapola taleṣu sarvathā api daddaśe vanitānām darpaṇeṣu iva mukheṣu mada śrīḥ naimittikam api dvidhā eva śuddham saṅkīrṇam ca

original: tayorādyaṃ yathā ka....edhūmaṃdhāre are abbuttaṇamaggiṇo samappihii| muhakamala cubbaṇāleha dhammi pāsaṃṭhiedi are|| dvitīyaṃ yathehādhītī pūrvaṃ dhṛtadharaṇibhāraḥ kamaṭharāḍaḍḍatdhpāṃnāthenāsmādgiraśitaśaraṇyena paṭhitāḥ| tataḥ prāptā dūrīkṛtatanatāpairjaladharairassatāṃ duḥkhopajñaṃ satatamukāropaniṣadaḥ||
analyzed: tayoḥ ādyam yathā are abbuttaṇa maggiṇaḥ samappihii muha kamala dhammi dhammi dvitīyam yathā iha adhītī pūrvam dhṛta dharaṇi bhāraḥ paṭhitāḥ tatas prāptāḥ dūrīkṛta tana tāpaiḥ jaladharaiḥ assatām duḥkha upajñam satatam ukāra upaniṣadaḥ

analyzed: anāśriteṣu tu vyāpāre nimittam hetuḥ iṣyate āśraya avadhi bhāvam tu lakṣaṇe lakṣaṇam viduḥ kkacid tu hetuḥ api lakṣaṇam jaṭābhiḥ tāpasaḥ iti ittham bhūta lakṣaṇam akṣṇā kāṇaḥ iti vikāra lakṣaṇam kapilā vidyuti utpāta lakṣaṇam goṣu dūhyamānāsu gataḥ iti bhāva lakṣaṇam pacan āste iti kriyā lakṣaṇam ca vyākhyātam iti ekārtha paraḥ pada samūhaḥ vākyam

original: tantridhā śaṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtamapabhraṃśaścā| brāhmaṇaṃ yathā śaṃyo manuṣyāṇāṃ rāgadvassamūḍho bhavati| tatrānyeṣāmadhipattiḥ sarveṣāṃ manuṣyakaiḥ kāmaissaṃpannamataḥ| sa manuṣyāṇāṃ parama ānandaḥ| ārṣe dvidhā| smṛtiḥ purāṇaṃ ca | tayosmṛtiryathā śūdraiva bhāryā śūdrasya sā ca svā ca viśaḥ smṛte| te ca svā caiva rājñastu tāśtaca svā cāgrajanmataḥ||
analyzed: tat tridhā śaṃskṛtam prākṛtam apabhraṃśaḥ ca brāhmaṇam yathā śaṃyaḥ manuṣyāṇām bhavati tatra anyeṣām adhipattiḥ sarveṣām manuṣyakaiḥ kāmaiḥ saṃpannam atas sa manuṣyāṇām paramaḥ ānandaḥ ārṣe dvidhā smṛtiḥ purāṇam ca tayoḥ smṛtiḥ yathā śūdrā eva bhāryā śūdrasya sā ca svā ca viśaḥ smṛte te ca svā ca eva rājñaḥ tu svā ca agrajanmataḥ

original: purāṇaṃ yathā hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo yāṃ yāṃ diśamudaikṣata | bhayabhrāntaissuraiścakre tasyai tasyai diśe namaḥ|| laukikaṃ dvividhaṃ, kāvyaṃ śāstraṃ ca | tayoḥ kāvyaṃ yathā kasya no kurute mugdhe pipāsākulitaṃ manaḥ| ayaṃ te vidrumacchāyo marumārga ivādharaḥ|| śāstraṃ yathā prākāmadhavalaṃ yasyāścakṣuḥ paryantapakṣmalam|
analyzed: purāṇam yathā hiraṇyakaśipuḥ daityaḥ yām yām diśam udaikṣata bhaya bhrāntaiḥ suraiḥ cakre tasyai tasyai diśe namaḥ laukikam dvividham kāvyam śāstram ca tayoḥ kāvyam yathā kasya no kurute mugdhe pipāsā ākulitam manaḥ ayam te vidruma chāyaḥ maru mārgaḥ iva adharaḥ śāstram yathā prākāma dhavalam yasyāḥ cakṣuḥ paryanta pakṣmalam

original: navanītopamaṃ tasyā bhavati smaramandiram|| prākṛtaṃ tridhā, sahajaṃ, lakṣitaṃ, śliṣṭaṃ ca| teṣu sahajaṃ dvidhā śaṃskṛtasamaṃ deśyaṃ ca| tayossaṃskṛtasamaṃ yathā sarale sāhasarāgaṃ parihara raṃbhoru muñca saṃrambham| virasaṃ virāyāsaṃ voḍhuṃ tava cittamasahaṃ me|| deśyaṃ yathā vippa api āpu āṇuṇāhaṃ ṣaḍaḍḍatdhrasamaṃ parihasanteī|
analyzed: navanīta upamam tasyāḥ bhavati smara mandiram prākṛtam tridhā sahajam lakṣitam śliṣṭam ca teṣu sahajam dvidhā śaṃskṛta samam deśyam ca tayoḥ saṃskṛta samam yathā sarale sāhasa rāgam parihara raṃbhā ūru muñca saṃrambham virasam virāyāsam voḍhum tava cittam asaham me deśyam yathā api ṣaḍaḍḍatdhra samam

original: vāsaara viṇaḍio visaṃ lalaṃsva ṇāvesi || lakṣitaṃ dvidhā, mahārāṣṭraṃ śaurasenaṃ ca| toyarmahārāṣṭraṃ yathā ṇamaha avaḍhḍhaatuṃgaṃ avisāriavitthaaṃ aṇoṇaagahiraṃ | appalahuaparisaṃhṇaṃ aṇāaparamanthapāaḍaṃ, mahumahaṇaṃ|| śaurasenaṃ yathā ........... phanamatha cana appakuvi akādhī caraṇakipaci apaṭi |
analyzed: vāsaara viṇaḍiaḥ visam lalaṃsva nāvesi lakṣitam dvidhā mahārāṣṭram śaurasenam ca toyar mahārāṣṭram yathā a vaḍhḍha a tuṃgam a visāria vitthaam a noṇa a gahiram appa lahua parisaṃhṇam anāa para mantha pāaḍam mahu mahaṇam śaurasenam yathā cana caraṇa kipaci a paṭi

original: pippaṃtasu nakhatappanesuṃ etāsatanutataraṃ rutaṃ|| māgadhaṃ yathā hadamāṇuśamaṃbhoyaṇaṃ kuṃbhaśahāśavaśāhiśacchidaṃ| aṇiśaṃa pibāmi śoṇidaṃ valiśaśadaṃ śamaleṇa bhoyadu|| apabhraṃśastridhā| uttamo madhyamaḥ kaniṣṭhaśca | teṣvāvantyalācaṭūyādiruttamaḥ|
analyzed: nakha tappa nesum rutam māgadham yathā pibāmi śoṇidam vali śaśadam śamaleṇa apabhraṃśaḥ tridhā uttamaḥ madhyamaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ ca teṣu āvantya lācaṭūya ādiḥ uttamaḥ

original: tatrāvantyoyathaikadū asaloṇī ala āharaṇasusaṃṭhavī acchi upasaṃpaṭaṃ vīvaukahimmalaṃ bhaṭṭaevaṭapi amaie| uṇajāṇaiḍaṃ, virahātuṇujūri aejjha harodāvaṇudiṇṇuvahiṇe viṇṇūri a e|| lāṭīyo yathā hirau haranta ho cerahoe bhujidanduhale jappiupaṇavva sacchile viloi augaṇe| eṃhūpiṇapiṇa gaṇatthaṇi saṃthahauvkapaṇu javcandāṇabhedijjai aharahodantapaṇā||
analyzed: tatra avantyaḥ yathā acchi upasaṃpaṭam lāṭīyaḥ yathā saṃtha hauvka paṇu aharahodanta paṇā

original: ābhīragaurjarādirmadhyamaḥ| tayorābhūro yathā laviyavphau bīududvaḍākau hahāṇa gacchasi putahomatthajabhu| jadahiḍāṃ ujaṃ me pi javi āāsi|| gaurjarā yathāva akhkho ñjī samudrutari siladuhi garukāṇi | mando hi e pilahi auujaṃparuñjaiteṃ aṇi|| kāśmīrapaurastyājiḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ|
analyzed: ābhīra gaurjara ādiḥ madhyamaḥ tayoḥ ābhūraḥ yathā gacchasi me pi gaurjarāḥ

original: tayoḥ kāśmīro yathā kaṃvali āla ekaṃ te kudicchaladantahi viṭhi suddhi emaṃ ivi ālasīlaṃti| sava aṃgāpidusarāsahi khavāci duṃ phalinantekī āāsaṇa aīdasi|| paurastyo yathā mahaṇāhi akuṭuṃbi sāmaindīhirerebhāu japihuri | viṇṇaujāntāṃ vavirivāmevkeredhūje vāsāṃ hāvāthi| āṃkhījaṇukaṇaāṃsahuṃkājāthitehātheñcita udūkarāe |
analyzed: tayoḥ kāśmīraḥ yathā te viṭhi suddhi suddhi paurastyaḥ yathā hāvāthi udūkarāe

original: vala ācchaiṇī jīva upātharūpasa aṃṇai bhavaṇahiṃ vāccharaṃ|| tadtat samastamapi vākyajātamākhyatopādherekādaśaprakāraṃ viprathate| tadyathaikākhyātamanekākhyātamāvṛttākhyātamanuvṛttākhyātaṃ vipariṇātākhyātamekārthākhyātaṃ samuñcitākhyātaṃ kṛdamihitākhyātamapekṣitākhyātamekāntarākhyātaṃ nirantarākhyātamiti |
analyzed: jīva bhavaṇahiṃ tat tat samastam api vākya jātam ākhyata upādheḥ ekādaśa prakāram viprathate tat yathā eka ākhyātam aneka ākhyātam āvṛtta ākhyātam anuvṛtta ākhyātam vipariṇāta ākhyātam ekārtha ākhyātam samuñcita ākhyātam kṛt amihita ākhyātam apekṣita ākhyātam eka antara ākhyātam nirantara ākhyātam iti

original: teṣvekākhyātaṃ yathā vāgarthāviva saṃpṛktau vāgarthapratipattaye | jagataḥ pitarau vande pārvatīparameśvarau|| anekākhyātaṃ yathā yadeva rocate mahyaṃ tadeva kurute priyā| iti vetti na jānāti tatpriyaṃ yatkaroti sā|| āvṛttākhyātaṃ yathā jayatyamalakaustubhassabakitāṃsapīṭho hari rjayanti mṛgalocanācaladapāṅgadṛṣṭikramāḥ|
analyzed: teṣu eka ākhyātam yathā vāc arthau iva saṃpṛktau vāc artha pratipattaye jagataḥ pitarau vande pārvatī parameśvarau aneka ākhyātam yathā yat eva rocate mahyam tat eva kurute priyāḥ iti vetti na jānāti tat priyam yat karoti sā āvṛtta ākhyātam yathā jayati amala kaustubhaḥ sa bakita aṃsapīṭhaḥ hariḥ jayanti mṛga locana acalat apāṅga dṛṣṭi kramāḥ

original: tato jayati mallikā tadanu sarvasaṃvedanā vināśakaraṇakṣamo jayati pañcamasya dhvaniḥ|| anuvṛttākhyātaṃ yathā caranti caturambhodhivelodyāneṣu dantinaḥ| cakravālādikuñceṣu kundabhāso guṇāśca te|| viparītākhyātaṃ yathā so'smiñjayati jīvātuḥ pañceṣoḥ pañcamadhvaniḥ | teca caitre vikīrṇevā takkilīkelayo'nilāḥ||
analyzed: tatas jayati mallikā tadanu sarva saṃvedanā vināśa karaṇa kṣamaḥ jayati pañcamasya dhvaniḥ anuvṛtta ākhyātam yathā caranti catur ambhodhi velā udyāneṣu dantinaḥ cakravāla ādi kuñceṣu kunda bhāsaḥ guṇāḥ ca te viparīta ākhyātam yathā saḥ usmin jayati jīvātuḥ pañca iṣoḥ pañcama dhvaniḥ te ca caitre vikīrṇā iva takkilīkelayaḥ nilāḥ

original: ekārthākhyātaṃ yathā vikasanti kadambāni sphuṭanti kuṭajaudgamāḥ| unmīlantica kandalyo dalanti kakubhānica|| samuñcitākhyātaṃ yathā tāmavātārayatpatnīṃ rathādavatatāra ca|| kṛdabhihitākhyātaṃ yathā tataḥkumudanā thena kāminīgaṇḍaḍḍatdhpāṃḍuḍḍatdhnā| netrānandena candreṇa māhendrī digasaṅkṛtā||
analyzed: eka artha ākhyātam yathā vikasanti kadambāni sphuṭanti kuṭaja odgamāḥ unmīlanti ca kandalyaḥ dalanti kakubhāni ca samuñcita ākhyātam yathā tām avātārayat patnīm rathāt avatatāra ca kṛt abhihita ākhyātam yathā tatas kumuda nāthena netra ānandena candreṇa māhendrī diś asaṅkṛtā

original: adhyahṛtākhyātaṃ yathā yaśca nimbaṃ paraśunā yaścainaṃ madhusarpiṣā| yaścainaṃ gandhamālyābhyāṃ sarvatra kaṭureva saḥ|| anapokṣitākhyātaṃ yathā kiyanmātraṃ jalaṃ vipra jānudadhnaṃ narādhipa | tathāpīyamavasthā te na hi sarve bhavādṛśāḥ|| ekāntarākhyātaṃ yathā tenādribandho vavṛdhe payodhistutoṣa rāmo mumude kapīndraḥ|
analyzed: adhyahṛta ākhyātam yathā yaḥ ca nimbam paraśunā yaḥ ca enam madhu sarpiṣā yaḥ ca enam gandha mālyābhyām sarvatra kaṭuḥ eva saḥ anapokṣita ākhyātam yathā kiyat mātram jalam vipra jānu dadhnam narādhipa tathā api iyam avasthā te na hi sarve bhavādṛśāḥ ekāntara ākhyātam yathā tena adribandhaḥ vavṛdhe payodhiḥ tutoṣa rāmaḥ mumude kapīndraḥ

original: tatrāsa śatrurdadṛśe suvelaḥ proce jalānto jahṛṣuḥ sudhāśāḥ|| nanu ca nirantarākhyātaṃ samuñcitākhyātamekārthākhyātamāvṛttākhyātamutyādayo vākyavikalpā nopapadyante, vākyakāro hi manyate| nāstyeva tiṅantayossaṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: tatra āsa śatruḥ dadṛśe suvelaḥ proce jala antaḥ jahṛṣuḥ sudhā āśāḥ nanu ca nirantara ākhyātam samuñcita ākhyātam ekārtha ākhyātam āvṛtta ākhyātam uti ādayaḥ vākya vikalpāḥ na upapadyante vākya kāraḥ hi manyate na asti eva tiṅ antayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ

original: tathāca “tiṅṅa tiṅaḥ” ityatrātiṅavacanamanarthakaṃ samānavākyadhikarādityatiṅvacanaṃ pratyācaṣṭe|nahyekatra vākye dve tiṅante sta iti, evaṃlaśraṇaṃ karoti, ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyam| tatrākhyātagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, nahyavyayakārakaviśeṣaṇapadāni nibandhanamantereṇāvapadaparigrahārtham|
analyzed: tathāca tiṅ tiṅaḥ iti atra atiṅa vacanam anarthakam samāna vākya adhikarāt iti atiṅ vacanam pratyācaṣṭe na hi ekatra vākye dve tiṅ ante staḥ iti karoti ākhyātam sa avyaya kāraka viśeṣaṇam vākyam tatra ākhyāta grahaṇam na kartavyam na hi avyaya kāraka viśeṣaṇa padāni nibandhanam antereṇa ava pada parigraha artham

original: yatraikamākhyātapadamavyayakārakaviśeṣaṇapadīni sannipatanti, tadvākyaṃ yathā syāt? anekākhyātapadaprayoge tu vākyasaṃjñā mābhīdityanāśritaṅkhyākhyātapadāṃśakānirāsātamekatiṅvākyamiti vacanāntaramārabhate |
analyzed: yatra ekam ākhyāta padam avyaya kāraka viśeṣaṇa padīni sannipatanti tat vākyam yathā syāt aneka ākhyāta pada prayoge tu vākya saṃjñā mā abhīt iti vacana antaram ārabhate

original: tatredaṃ vicāryate, kimekasmin vākye dvayostiṅantayossaṃbandha eva nāsti, uta satyāpi saṃbandhe dvitīyaṃ na prayujyate? ekatiṅvākyamiti pūrvācāryasamayādanu| kiñcidāha | satyapi tiṅantayossaṃbandhe tibhantāmāntritayuṣmadasmadādeśaplutādikāryavyavasthārthanyavasthārthamekatiṅvākyamiti pāribhāṣikameva vākyalakṣaṇaṃ kriyate|
analyzed: tatra idam vicāryate kim ekasmin vākye dvayoḥ tiṅ antayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ eva nā asti uta satyā api saṃbandhe dvitīyam na prayujyate eka tiṅ vākyam iti pūrva ācārya samayāt anu kiñcid āha sati api tiṅ antayoḥ saṃbandhe eka tiṅ vākyam iti pāribhāṣikam eva vākya lakṣaṇam kriyate

original: kiṃ kāraṇam? samānavākyārthat padādūttarayostiṅāmantritayornighātassmaryate| “yuṣmadasmado ṣaṣṭhīcaturthidvitīsthayorvaṃ nāvau” vādayaḥ ādeṣā vidhīyante | “vākyasya ṭeḥ plutaḥ utāttaḥ” iti vakyācāmantyasya plutaśśiṣyate iti | tañca tadopapadyate yadekatiṅāvākyamiti pāribhāṣikaṃ vāvayalakṣaṇaṃ kriyate|
analyzed: kim kāraṇam samāna vākya arthat padāt ū ttarayoḥ tiṅ āmantritayoḥ nighātaḥ smaryate yuṣmad asmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhī caturthi dvitī sthayoḥ vam na āvau vā ādayaḥ vidhīyante vākyasya ṭeḥ plutaḥ uta āttaḥ iti vakya ācām antyasya plutaḥ śiṣyate iti tat ca tadā upapadyate yat eka tiṅā vākyam iti pāribhāṣikam vā vaya lakṣaṇam kriyate

original: anythā “samarthaḥ padavidhi” riti padānāṃ parasparāsāmathrye vākyasya cāparisamāptai sarvathā na prāpnoti| tathāhi, nadyāstiṣṭhinti kūle vṛkṣasya lambate śākhāyāṃ, kaḥ priye mayi kopaḥ? kā subhaga priyā te? śālīnāṃ odanaṃ dāsyāmīti me mātā bravīti| āgaccha bho devadatta kugrāmaṃ gacchāvaḥ| grāmaṃ yadi yāsi re na māmapi pratīkṣasva |
analyzed: anythā samarthaḥ pada vidhiḥ riti padānām paraspara asāmathrye vākyasya ca aparisamāptaiḥ sarvathā na prāpnoti tathā hi nadyāḥ tiṣṭhinti kūle vṛkṣasya lambate śākhāyām kaḥ priye mayi kopaḥ kā subhaga priyā te śālīnām odanam dāsyāmi iti me mātā bravīti āgaccha bho devadatta ku grāmam gacchāvaḥ grāmam yadi yāsi re na mām api pratīkṣasva

original: atra tiṣṭhati | nākūlamabhisaṃbandhānna nadī, lambanena śākhā na vṛkṣaḥ, ka ityanena kopena priyā, ketyamanena tu priyā na subhagā te iita yuṣmadasmadarthena dānaṃ na śālayaḥ me ityasmadarthe na mātāvacanam| āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ yadi yāsi re ityetāvati vākyayoḥ parisamāptiḥ|
analyzed: atra tiṣṭhati na akūlam abhisaṃbandhāt na nadī lambanena śākhā na vṛkṣaḥ kaḥ iti anena kopena priyā kā iti amanena tu priyā na subhagā te yuṣmad asmad arthena dānam na śālayaḥ me iti asmad arthe na mātā vacanam āgaccha devadatta grāmam yadi yāsi re iti etāvati vākyayoḥ parisamāptiḥ

original: kiṃ tarhigacchāvo māmapi pratīkṣasveti tataśca nighātādikāryāṇāmaprāptiḥ| ekatiṅparasya tu padasamudāyasya vākyatve paraṃparayā yathākathañcidabhisaṃbandhe nighātayuṣmadasmādādeśā yujyante| “yukteyukte copasaṅkhyāna” miti yuktena vaktavyaṃ bhavita|
analyzed: kim tarhigacchāvaḥ mām api pratīkṣasva iti tatas ca nighāta ādi kāryāṇām aprāptiḥ eka tiṅ parasya tu pada samudāyasya vākya tve paraṃparayā yathā kathañcid abhisaṃbandhe nighāta yuṣmad asmāt ādeśāḥ yujyante yukteyukte ca upasaṅkhyānam iti yuktena vaktavyam bhavitavyam

original: eva sākāṃmakṣasā'yā padakadambakasya ekatiṅavacchedena vākyatvapratītau vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta iti vākyācāmantyasyodāttaḥ plutaḥ iti siddho bhavati| kaścittu brūte nāstyeva tiṅantayossaṃbandhaḥ| sa hi tiṅanteṣūpakalpyamānaḥ ṣoḍhaivāvakalpate|
