original: yadā vā sūtrapratiṣedhapakṣe svaviṣaya eva madhyamettamau tadā sarvathā gamyānetiśabdopasamahṛtasya bāhyārthasyaiva karmatvam | ehīti ca prahāsaviṣayasaṃbodhanārtha ākhyātasvarūpo nipātaḥ| ākhyātasvarūpāśca puruṣasaṃkhyāṃ ca vyabhicaranti| na hi bhavati tvamasti vyamastīti| kiñcāstirapi nipātaḥ, soḍhaṃ yathāstikṣīrā gauḥ |
analyzed: yadā vā sūtra pratiṣedha pakṣe sva viṣaye eva madhyama ittamau tadā sarvathā gamyān iti śabda upasamahṛtasya bāhya arthasya eva karma tvam ehi iti ca prahāsa viṣaya saṃbodhana arthaḥ ākhyāta svarūpaḥ nipātaḥ ākhyāta svarūpāḥ ca puruṣa saṃkhyām ca vyabhicaranti na hi bhavati tvam asti kiñca astiḥ api nipātaḥ soḍham yathā asti kṣīrā gauḥ

original: tatra hyākhyātamiti kṛtvoktaḥ subadhikāre'stikṣīrādivacanamiti, na cāvyaytavānnipāto'yamiti parihāraḥ| nanu ca saṅkhyāmabhicaran kathamekaśabdo bahūnāṃ prahāse bahutvaṃ brūyāt? naivam, bahubhirekaḥ prahasyate, naikena bahavaḥ, nahi bahuṣvekaṃ prahasatsu sūtrapratiṣedhapakṣe ehi manye rathena yāsyāmi |
analyzed: tatra hi ākhyātam iti kṛtvā uktaḥ sup adhika areḥ ti kṣīra ādi vacanam iti na ca avyaytavān nipātaḥ yam iti parihāraḥ nanu ca saṅkhyām abhicaran katham eka śabdaḥ bahūnām prahāse bahu tvam brūyāt na evam bahubhiḥ ekaḥ prahasyate na ekena bahavaḥ nahi bahuṣu ekam prahasatsu sūtra pratiṣedha pakṣe ehi manye rathena yāsyāmi

original: yadā vā sūtrapratiṣedhapakṣe astīti kathaṃ na satvabhūtorthassādhsādhyasādhanasaṃbandhamanubhavati| yo bhuṃkte sa gṛhyatāmityatrāpi vākyadvitayameva |
analyzed: yadā vā sūtra pratiṣedha pakṣe asti iti katham na yaḥ bhuṃkte sa gṛhyatām iti atra api vākya dvitayam eva

original: na cātra kriyayoḥ lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ kriyāyāḥ kārakopalakṣaṇatvāt yo bhuṃkte sa devadatta iti devadattasatvo lakṣaṇameko vākyārthaḥ, sa tathābhūto gṛhyatāmiti tasya grahaṇasaṃbandhaḥ, darśanamaparam|
analyzed: na ca atra kriyayoḥ lakṣya lakṣaṇa bhāvaḥ kriyāyāḥ kāraka upalakṣaṇa tvāt yaḥ bhuṃkte sa devadattaḥ iti devadatta satvaḥ lakṣaṇam ekaḥ vākya arthaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ gṛhyatām iti tasya grahaṇa saṃbandhaḥ darśanam aparam

original: na ca yathāsatvaṃ tadrūpābhidhāyitvena smaraṇāt kartṛprādhānyamabhidadhat kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ prati lakṣaṇatvamabhidhatte tathā kravanāmābhidhātuṃ śaknoti| tena hi sā kriyāsādhyatvātpracyāvya sādhanopasarjanabhāvanupanītā tatparāmṛṣṭaṃ devadattamupalakṣayati, sa tu tathābhūtaḥ krayāntareṇa saṃbadhyata iti|
analyzed: na ca yathā sattvam tad rūpa abhidhāyi tvena smaraṇāt kartṛ prādhānyam abhidadhat kriyāyāḥ kriyā antaram prati lakṣaṇa tvam abhidhatte tathā krava nāma abhidhātum śaknoti tena hi sā kriyā sādhya tvāt pracyāvya sādhana upasarjana bhāva anupanītā tat parāmṛṣṭam devadattam upalakṣayati sa tu tathābhūtaḥ kraya antareṇa saṃbadhyate iti

original: nahyekasyāḥ pravṛttessādhanopalakṣaṇamaparakriyāsaṃbandhaścopapanne bhavati| nanvidamevāsyāḥ kriyāntareṇānvitatvaṃ yadanyasyāssādhanamupalakṣayati| naivam, eṣā svasādhanalakṣaṇatvena pravartamānā yadadhīnodayā tadevopalakṣayet, nānyasaṃbandhāt|
analyzed: nahi ekasyāḥ pravṛtteḥ sādhana upalakṣaṇam apara kriyā saṃbandhaḥ ca upapanne bhavati nanu idam eva asyāḥ kriyā antareṇa anvita tvam yat anyasyāḥ sādhanam upalakṣayati na evam eṣā sva sādhana lakṣaṇa tvena pravartamānā yad adhīna udayā tat eva upalakṣayet na anya saṃbandhāt

original: nanu cā'syāḥ api devadatta eva sādhanaṃ sa cānayopalakṣitaḥ, tatkathaṃ bhinnavākyātā? naivam, bhavati nāma denadatto lakṣaṇatvamasyāḥ, kiṃtu na devadattatayopalakṣayati, apitu svasādhanatvena | tatassvasādhaka eva devadatte prathamato'nyaviśrāntiḥ, devadattasya ca tayaiva tadābhisaṃbandho'pyupeyaḥ|
analyzed: nanu ca asyāḥ api devadattaḥ eva sādhanam sa ca anayā upalakṣitaḥ tat katham bhinna vākyātā na evam bhavati nāma denadattaḥ lakṣaṇa tvam asyāḥ kiṃtu na devadatta tayā upalakṣayati apitu sva sādhana tvena tatas sva sādhake eva devadatte prathamatas nya viśrāntiḥ devadattasya ca tayā eva tadā abhisaṃbandhaḥ upi upeyaḥ

original: na hi yaugapadyena lakṣyamāṇatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ ca pratipadyeta, kriyāntare guṇabhāvaṃ ca virodhaprasaṅgāt| na ca bhujikriyāvācchinnasyetarakriyābhisaṃbandho'bhimataḥ samuñañciyamānakriyādvayapraṅgāt| yo bhuṃkte saḥ gṛhyatāmityekarasā pravṛttiḥ pratyāsatteḥ tanmātrabhitraṃ satraṃ, tasya tu punaritthaṃbhūta evārtha iti na tatra vākyabhedaḥ |
analyzed: na hi yaugapadyena lakṣyamāṇa tvam prādhānyam ca pratipadyeta kriyā antare guṇa bhāvam ca virodha prasaṅgāt na ca bhuji kriyā avācchinnasya itara kriyā abhisaṃbandhaḥ abhimataḥ yaḥ bhuṃkte saḥ gṛhyatām iti ekarasā pravṛttiḥ pratyāsatteḥ tad mātra bhitram satram tasya tu punar itthaṃbhūtaḥ eva arthaḥ iti na tatra vākya bhedaḥ

original: etena yo'dhīte sa pacatītyapi pratyuktam| sa svapityeṣa budhyate, sa udetītyayamastametītyatra tu sādhanatvānnatarāṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ| hantīti palāyata iti atratviti śabdo hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ dyotayannathrsaya svātantryaṃ karoti|
analyzed: etena yaḥ udhīte sa pacati iti api pratyuktam sa svapiti eṣa budhyate saḥ udeti iti ayam astam eti iti atra tu sādhana tvāt natarām lakṣya lakṣaṇa bhāvaḥ hanti iti palāyate iti atra tu iti śabdaḥ hetu hetumat bhāvam svātantryam karoti

original: dṛṣṭaṃ itiśabdo'rthasya svātantryamupajanayani “tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya” iita atra hi tasminnityadhikaraṇasya kartṛkarmasamavāyinyau kriye pratyupādhitvena pravartamānasyākāṃkṣā yata ādheyastatrasva ātmavanyavasthānābhāvāditi śabdenāsatyavacchede kāryayogo na syāt|
analyzed: iti śabdaḥ ūrthasya svātantryam upajanayani tasmin iti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya atra hi tasmin iti adhikaraṇasya kartṛ karma samavāyinyau kriye prati upādhi tvena pravartamānasya ākāṃkṣā yatas ādheyaḥ tatrasvaḥ ātmavani avasthāna abhāvāt iti śabdena asati avacchede kārya yogaḥ na syāt

original: tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasyetyukte tasmin ya ādheyo nirdiṣṭaṃ iti saṃpratyayassyāt, tasmāt saptamyarthanirdeśe pūrvasya kāryasya saṃpratyayārthamiti upādīyate evamihāpīti śabdo vā na tasya svātantryamupajanayati, yasmādayaṃ hanti tasmādayaṃ palāyata iti, evaṃ varṣatītyādāvapi yojanīyam, atra ca tiṅantayoriti
analyzed: tasmin iti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya iti ukte tasmin yaḥ ādheyaḥ nirdiṣṭam iti saṃpratyayaḥ syāt tasmāt saptamī artha nirdeśe pūrvasya kāryasya saṃpratyaya artham iti upādīyate evam iha api iti śabdaḥ vā na tasya svātantryam upajanayati yasmāt ayam hanti tasmāt ayam palāyate iti evam varṣati ityādau api yojanīyam atra ca tiṅ antayoḥ iti

original: śabdasāmathryāddhetuhetumadbhāvo'numīyate, na punaśśabdasanniveśīti| yāvadbhakte tato vrajatītyādau tu bhinnavākyatāyāmapi yāvat tataḥ pūrvamityādinipātasāmathryādavadhyavadhimadbhāvo gamyate, na punarākhyātaśabdasanniveśīti|
analyzed: śabda sāmathryāt hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ anumīyate na punar śabda sanniveśī iti yāvat bhakte tatas vrajati ityādau tu bhinna vākyatāyām api yāvat tatas pūrvam ityādi nipāta sāmathryāt avadhya vadhimat bhāvaḥ gamyate na punar ākhyāta śabda sanniveśī iti

original: saktan pibetyādāvapi saktan piba, dhānaḥ khādeti audanaṃ bhuṅkta iti viśeṣaṇavākyārthā itiśabdopasaṃhṛtā iti śbadasāmathryadeva tatsāmānyābhidhāyinā ayamabhyavaharatīti vākyāntaraṇocyante | pacati cāyaṃ paṭhati ceti vākyadvayameva, evaṃ bhikṣāmaṭa, gāṃ cānayeti|
analyzed: saktan piba ityādau api saktan piba dhānaḥ khāda iti audanam bhuṅkte iti viśeṣaṇa vākya arthāḥ itiśabda upasaṃhṛtāḥ iti tad sāmānya abhidhāyinā ayam abhyavaharati iti pacati ca ayam paṭhati ca iti vākya dvayam eva evam bhikṣām aṭa gām ca anayā iti

original: tadevaṃ kātyāyanamate nāstyevamākhyātayossaṃbandhaḥ, sūtrakārasya tu mate'stevākhyātayoḥ anekavākyātvenābhisaṃbandha iti | yadayaṃ samānavakyādhikāre tiṅantāduttarasya tiṅo nighātaṃ śāsti|
analyzed: tat evam kātyāyana mate na asti evam ākhyātayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ sūtrakārasya tu mateḥ aneka vākyātvena abhisaṃbandhaḥ iti yat ayam samāna vakya adhikāre tiṅ antāt uttarasya tiṅaḥ nighātam śāsti

original: abhijñāvacane lṛḍiḍḍatdhti smṛtyuktāvatītakāle'pi lṛṭaṃ smarati, yaditi yatprayoge tānniṣedhati vibhāṣā sākāṃkṣa ityākāṃkṣāyāṃ vibhāṣayābhyanujānāti, “nayadyanākāṃkṣye” iti nirākāṃkṣavākye ktvāṇamulau niṣidhya laḍādīnevānumanyate iti kā punaratropapattiḥ? ucyate ākhyātapadatulyadharmiṇo hi ktvāntasyāneksāpi dṛṣṭastiṅantena saha saṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: abhijñā vacane smṛti uktau atīta kāle pi lṛṭam smarati yat iti yat prayoge tān niṣedhati vibhāṣā sa ākāṃkṣaḥ iti ākāṃkṣāyām vibhāṣayā abhyanujānāti na yadi an ākāṃkṣye iti nirākāṃkṣa vākye ktvā ṇamulau niṣidhya laṭ ādīn eva anumanyate iti kā punar atra upapattiḥ ucyate ākhyāta pada tulya dharmiṇaḥ hi ktvā antasya dṛṣṭaḥ tiṅ antena saha saṃbandhaḥ

original: snnātvā pītvā bhiktvā vrajatīti, tathā pūrvaṃ snnāti bhukte pibati tu vrajati, iti | tatra yathaiva ktvāntasya tibhantenaikavākyatvaṃ tathā pūrvakālakriyābhidhāyināmākhyātānāṃ sarveṣāmapi kriyāviśeṣaṇakatvādbhavati| uktaśca yathā'nekamapi ktāntaṃtiṅantasya viśeṣakam| tathā tiṅantaṃ tatrāhuḥ tiṅantasya viśeṣakam||
analyzed: snnātvā pītvā bhiktvā vrajati iti tathā pūrvam snnāti bhukte pibati tu vrajati iti tatra yathā eva ktvā antasya tibh antena eka vākya tvam tathā pūrva kāla kriyā abhidhāyinām ākhyātānām sarveṣām api kriyā viśeṣaṇaka tvāt bhavati uktaḥ ca yathā anekam api kta antam tiṅ antasya viśeṣakam tathā tiṅ antam tatra āhuḥ tiṅ antasya viśeṣakam

original: cadurthaḥ kriyādyarthacaṭatuṣṭayaprakāśaḥ tatra prakṛtyādiśabdapratyayyāḥ kriyākālakārakapuṣopādhipradhānopaskārārthaprātipadikārthavṛttayarthapadārthavākyārtharūpā dvādaśa bhedāḥ | teṣu kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā, tāṃ dhātvarthaḥ ityāmananatti| dhātavaśca tredhāstyarthāḥ, bhavatyarthāḥ, karotyarthāśca |
analyzed: tatra prakṛti ādi śabda pratyayyāḥ dvādaśa bhedāḥ teṣu kārakāṇām pravṛtti viśeṣaḥ kriyā tām dhātvarthaḥ iti dhātavaḥ ca tredhā asti arthāḥ bhavati arthāḥ karoti arthāḥ ca

original: tatra yeṣāṃ kartāri udāsate te astyārthāḥ, yathāsti vidyate dhriyate tiṣṭhati āste vartate ityādi| yeṣāṃ vikurvate te bhavatyarthāḥ, yathā bhavati saṃjāyate vardhate dhriyate tiṣṭhati āste vartate ityādi| yeṣāṃ prayuñjate te karotyarthāḥ, yathā karoti vidhatte janayati nirvartayat sādhayati utpādayati|
analyzed: tatra yeṣām kartāri udāsate te astyārthāḥ yathā asti vidyate dhriyate tiṣṭhati āste vartate ityādi yeṣām vikurvate te bhavatyarthāḥ yathā bhavati saṃjāyate vardhate dhriyate tiṣṭhati āste vartate ityādi yeṣām prayuñjate te karotyarthāḥ yathā karoti vidhatte janayati nirvartayat sādhayati utpādayati

original: tatra astikarotibhavatīnāṃ sāmyāvāsthānānnirvikāramanādyantaṃ śabdabrahmetyācakṣate | tathaivaṃdhinekārthavācino bhavatinaivomiti vyapadiśanti| tasya yadā astitāheturavidyānibandhano'vidyānibandhano'vipariṇāmarūpaḥ prathamavikāro'stirudayate| tadā asternāstipratiyogitvādistityekamevaitadubhayathāpi prathāmayate|
analyzed: tatra asti karoti bhavatīnām sāmyau āsthānāt nirvikāram anādi antam śabdabrahma iti ācakṣate tathā evaṃdhinā eka artha vācinaḥ bhavatinā eva ūm iti vyapadiśanti tasya yadā astitā hetuḥ avidyā nibandhanaḥ uvidyā nibandhanaḥ uvipariṇāma rūpaḥ prathama vikāraḥ ustiḥ tadā asteḥ nāsti pratiyogi tva ādistiti ekam eva etat ubhayathā api prathāmayate

original: yannāsti tadbhavāmiti cāpekṣāyāṃ, tadbhāvato'sya bhavati nāma dvitīyavikāraḥ pariplavate| tato yadbhavati tasya tasya cānyat bhavato mithyābhiniveśānmithaḥ prayojyaprayojaktavaṃ saṃbhāvayatisaṃjñakaḥ tṛtīyavikāraṃkarotirityākhyāyate|
analyzed: yat na asti tat bhavām iti ca apekṣāyām tad bhāvataḥ usya bhavati nāma dvitīya vikāraḥ pariplavate tatas yat bhavati tasya tasya ca anyat bhavataḥ mithyā abhiniveśāt mithas prayojya prayojak tavam saṃbhāvayati saṃjñakaḥ tṛtīya vikāraṃkarotiḥ iti ākhyāyate

original: evaṃ cāsmitāpekṣābhiniveśaurdūraviprasṛtāmavidyāyāṃ eṣāmapi viśeṣaviśeṣato dūrīkṛtā vidyā, vidyati, janipacādayaḥ prādurbhavanti| tadāha, kṛbhvastayaḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ kriyāviśeṣavacanāḥ pacādaya iti | te'mī sarve'pi dhātvarthabhedāḥ saṃbhedate mithassaṅyānamativartante, na tu kṛbhvastirūpatām|
analyzed: evam ca asmitā apekṣā abhiniveśa ordūra viprasṛtām avidyāyām eṣām api viśeṣa viśeṣataḥ dūrīkṛtā vidyā vidyati jani paca ādayaḥ prādurbhavanti tat āha kṛbhvastayaḥ kriyā sāmānya vacanāḥ kriyā viśeṣa vacanāḥ paca ādayaḥ iti te amī sarve api dhātvartha bhedāḥ saṃbhedate mithas saṅyānam ativartante na tu kṛbhvasti rūpa tām

original: nanu ca dhātvarthaḥ kriyāḥ sa ca kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ, kārakeṣu ca svatantraḥ kartā, karturīpsitatamaṃ karma, sādhakatamaṃ karaṇaṃ, ādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ, karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānaṃ, dhruvamapāye'pādānaṃ, tebhyo'nyastadavivanakṣā vā śeṣaḥ, kakartuḥ prayojako heturiti katrādibhyo vyatiriktamarthāntaraṃ nopalabhyate yat kriyeti pratīyate
analyzed: nanu ca dhātvarthaḥ kriyāḥ sa ca kārakāṇām pravṛtti viśeṣaḥ kārakeṣu ca svatantraḥ kartā kartuḥ īpsitatamam karma sādhakatamam karaṇam ādhāra udhikaraṇam karmaṇā yam abhipraiti sa saṃpradānam dhruvam apāya apādānam tebhyonyaḥ tad avivanakṣāḥ vā śeṣaḥ ka kartuḥ prayojakaḥ hetuḥ iti katṛ ādibhyaḥ vyatiriktam artha antaram na upalabhyate yat kriyā iti pratīyate

original: ucyate asti kriyā kintu katrrā kintu katrrādibhyaḥ pṛthāgākhyātumaśakyaṃ, anāpannasatvabhāvāt| anirluṭhitadarbhavat yathā rbho'nāpanna, tvābhavaḥ kalalāvasthaāyāmāśayataḥ pṛthagākhyātuṃ na śakyate, tathā kriyā'pi sādhanebhyassādhyāvasthāyaṃ | tadyatā jayotiḥ prakāśate, labdo dhavanati iti|
analyzed: ucyate asti kriyā kintu katrrā kintu katrra ādibhyaḥ pṛthāk ākhyātum aśakyam anāpanna satva bhāvāt a nirluṭhita darbha vat yathā pṛthak ākhyātum na śakyate tathā kriyā api sādhanebhyaḥ sādhya avasthāyam tat yatā jayotiḥ prakāśate iti

original: khathaṃ tarhi asti jñāyate kārakasannidhāne'pi pacatīti prakhyopākhyayorbhāvābhāvābhyāṃ, iha khalu yatsannidāne yasya bāvābhāvau, tasya tato'nyaniīmittāpekṣitatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ |
analyzed: khatham tarhi asti jñāyate kāraka sannidhāne api pacati iti prakhyā upākhyayoḥ bhāva abhāvābhyām iha khalu yad sannidāne yasya bāva abhāvau tasya dṛṣṭam

original: yathā agnighaṭayossanndhāne bhavatāmabhavatāṃ ca tatsanniyogāpekṣitatvaṃ pākajānāṃ, katrrādi ca sannidhāne ca kadācidbhavatītyetadbhavati, kadācinna pacatīti dṛśyate, tena manyāmahe nūnamasti śaktiśaktimadbhayo'nyaśśaktirdharmo yadbhāāvādime prakhyopākhye pravartate, yadabhāvāñca na pravarteteti siddhamastitvaṃ kriyāyāḥ,
analyzed: yathā agni ghaṭayoḥ sanndhāne bhavatām abhavatām ca tad sanniyoga apekṣita tvam pāka jānām katrṛ ādi ca sannidhāne ca kadācid bhavati iti etat bhavati kadācid na pacati iti dṛśyate tena manyāmahe nūnam asti śakti śaktimat bhayonyaḥ śaktiḥ dharmaḥ yad bhāāvāt ime prakhyā upākhye pravartate yad abhāvāt ca na pravarteta iti siddham astitvam kriyāyāḥ

original: itaścāstikriyāsādhyamantareṇa sādhanānupapannaḥ | yañaṭhca sādhyaṃ sā kriyā | tadāha saṃhṛtya kārakairya eko'rtho|bhinirvatryate sā kriyā|
analyzed: itas ca asti kriyā sādhyam antareṇa sādhana anupapannaḥ sādhyam sā kriyā tat āha saṃhṛtya kārakaiḥ yaḥ sā kriyā

original: kriyānimittaṃ kārakamiti, tathā ca kriyāsu svecchayā kārakādīni yaḥ prayuṅkte, na tu taiḥ prayujyate sa kartā, kartuḥ kriyāyā'nyayā yadāpyate tatkarma, kriyāsiddhau sādhakatamatvena yadavyavahitaṃ vyāpriyate tatkaraṇaṃ, katrrā karmaṇā vā vyavahitaḥ kriyādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ, kriyākāryatvenāvadhāritaṃ karmaṇā seyogaṃ yadanubhavati tatsaṃpradānaṃ,
analyzed: kriyā nimittam kārakam iti tathā ca kriyāsu sva icchayā kāraka ādīni yaḥ prayuṅkte na tu taiḥ prayujyate sa kartā kartuḥ kriyāyāḥ anyayā yat āpyate tat karma kriyā siddhau sādhakatama tvena yat avyavahitam vyāpriyate tat karaṇam katrrā karmaṇā vā vyavahitaḥ kriyā ādhāra udhikaraṇam kriyā kārya tvena avadhāritam karmaṇā seyogam yat anubhavati tat saṃpradānam

original: katrrā karmaṇā vā kriyājanmeva dhrauvyena yadvibhāgāmavagāhate tadapādānam, śrūyamāṇakriyāpadopakriyākṛtaḥ kārakāṇāmakārakāṇāṃ ca saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ | sa śeṣaḥ kurvantamevājñāpradānādinā yaḥ kriyāyāṃ niyuṅkte, sa tatprayojako hetuḥ kartā ca bhavati|
analyzed: katrrā karmaṇā vā kriyā janma iva dhrauvyena yat vibhāgām avagāhate tat apādānam śrūyamāṇa kriyā pada upakriyā kṛtaḥ kārakāṇām akārakāṇām ca saṃbandha viśeṣaḥ sa śeṣaḥ kurvantam eva ājñā pradāna ādinā yaḥ kriyāyām niyuṅkte sa tad prayojakaḥ hetuḥ kartā ca bhavati

original: evaṃ ca yathā kāṣṭhādayo lākṣādikamapekṣamāṇā eva mithassaṃvandhayacogyatātāmunubhavanti tathā mithassaṃyogo viyogaśca na syāt| taduktaṃ yāvaddevadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyeti| astu nāma kriyā, kārakebhyastu tasyāḥ kathaṃ vyatirekaḥ? na ca bhavanto'pi kriyākārakayovryatirekaṃ na manyante |
analyzed: evam ca yathā kāṣṭha ādayaḥ lākṣā ādikam apekṣamāṇāḥ eva tathā mithas saṃyogaḥ viyogaḥ ca na syāt tat uktam yāvat devadattaḥ iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati sā nūnam kriyā iti astu nāma kriyā kārakebhyaḥ tu tasyāḥ katham vyatirekaḥ na ca bhavantaḥ api kriyā kārakayoḥ vyatirekam na manyante

original: tadyathā corasya rujati, corasyāmayati iti| ucyate vyatiriktaiva kārakebhyaḥ kriyā, anekasyaikavyapadeśanimittatvāt| iha yadyasyānekavyapadeśanimittaṃ tattebhyonyat| yathā vyakterjātiḥ kārakamityapadetadvayāpadeśanimittaṃ cānekasya katrrādeḥ kriyā, tasmāttatonyetyanugamyatvāt |
analyzed: tat yathā corasya rujati corasya āmayati iti ucyate vyatiriktā eva kārakebhyaḥ kriyā anekasya eka vyapadeśa nimitta tvāt iha yat yasya aneka vyapadeśa nimittam tat tebhyaḥ anyat yathā vyakteḥ jātiḥ kārakam ca anekasya katrṛ ādeḥ kriyā tasmāt tatonyā iti anugamya tvāt

original: iha yairyadanugamyate tattebhyo'nyat, yathā narebhyo rājābhigamyate'nugamyate ca | kriyākārakairatastato'nayeyam, janyatvenopalambhāt | yajjānyatayā yadupalabhyate tattato'nyate |
analyzed: iha yaiḥ yat anugamyate tat tebhyaḥ anyat yathā narebhyaḥ rājā abhigamyate inugamyate ca kriyā kārakaiḥ atas tatas nayeyam janya tvena upalambhāt yat jānya tayā yat upalabhyate tat tatas nyate

original: yathā pituḥ putra upalabhyate kriyākārakajanyakatvena tasmāttato'nyā upalabdhāvanupalabdheḥ, iha yasyopalabdhau yasyānupalabdhiḥ tattato'nyāthā, rūpādrasaḥ sūryasya copanagaterupalabdhiḥ tasyāstato'nyathā | asti cāsyāsau deśāntarabrāpteḥ, sā'pi dṛṣṭā tathāvāpaṣyātaḥ parāvṛtyā darśanāt | pramāṇāntaragrahyatvāt |
analyzed: yathā pituḥ putraḥ upalabhyate kriyā kāraka janyaka tvena tasmāt tatonyā upalabdhau anupalabdheḥ iha yasya upalabdhau yasya anupalabdhiḥ tat tatonyā athā rūpāt rasaḥ sūryasya upalabdhiḥ tasyāḥ tatonyathā asti ca asya asau deśa antara brāpteḥ sā api dṛṣṭā parāvṛtyāḥ darśanāt pramāṇa antara grahya tvāt

original: iha yadyasmātpramāṇāntareṇa gṛhyate tattato'nayat, yathā śarīrādātmā | pramāṇāntaragrāhyā ca sadāgatau gatiḥ, tasmāttato'nyā | bahuviviktatvenābhidhānāt, iha yadvahūbhyaḥ praviviktamekatvenābhidhīyate | ttateto'ncat, yathā tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ | abhidhīyate bahvāśritāpi pravivekaikatvena kriyā, yathā hrāhmaṇairāsyata iti tasmāttato'nyā|
analyzed: iha yat yasmāt pramāṇa antareṇa gṛhyate tat tatas nayat yathā śarīrāt ātmā pramāṇa antara grāhyā ca sadāgatau gatiḥ tasmāt tatonyā bahu vivikta tvena abhidhānāt iha yat vahūbhyaḥ praviviktam ekatvena abhidhīyate yathā tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ abhidhīyate bahu āśritā api praviveka ekatvena kriyā yathā hrāhmaṇaiḥ āsyate iti tasmāt tatonyā

original: anāvṛttāvāvṛtteḥ, ihayasminnavartamāne yadāvartate tattato'nyat yathā hastinokterjātiḥ kārakamityekatyāpadeśanimittaṃ cainekasya katrrādeḥ kriyā, tasmāttatonyetyanugamyatvāt | iha yairyadanugamyate tattebhyo'nyat, yathā narebhyo rājābhigamyate'nugamyate ca | kriyā kārakairatastato'nyeyam, jnayatvenopalambhāt |
analyzed: anāvṛttau āvṛtteḥ iha yasmin avartamāne yat āvartate tat tatonyat yathā hastinā ukteḥ jātiḥ kārakam iti ekatyā apadeśa nimittam katrṛ ādeḥ kriyā tasmāt tatonyā iti anugamya tvāt iha yaiḥ yat anugamyate tat tebhyaḥ nyat yathā narebhyaḥ rājā abhigamyate inugamyate ca kriyā kārakaiḥ atas tatonyā iyam ca kriyā kārakaiḥ atas tatonyā iyam

original: yajjanyatayā yadupalabhyate ttatato'nyat | yatha pituḥ putra upalabhyate kriyākārajanyatvena tasmāttato'nyā upalabdhāvanupalabdheḥ, iha yasyopalabdhau yasyānupalabdhiḥ tattato'nyathā, rūpādrasaḥ sūryasya copanagaterupalabdhas tasyāstato'nyathā | asti cāsyāsaudeśāntaraprapteḥ, sā'pi dṛṣṭā tathaivāpaśyataḥ parāvṛtya darśanāt |
analyzed: yat janya tayā yat upalabhyate pituḥ putraḥ upalabhyate kriyākāra janya tvena tasmāt tatonyā upalabdhau anupalabdheḥ iha yasya upalabdhau yasya anupalabdhiḥ tat tatonyathā rūpāt rasaḥ sūryasya upalabdhaḥ tasyāḥ tatonyathā asti ca asya asau deśa antara prapteḥ sā api dṛṣṭā tathā eva a paśyataḥ parāvṛtya darśanāt

original: pramāṇāntaragrāhyātvāt| iha yadyasmātpramāṇāntarema gṛhyate tattato'nyate, yathā śarīrādātmā | pramāṇāntaragrāhyā ca sadāgatau gatiḥ, tasmāttato'nyā | bahuviviktatvenābhidhānāt, iha yadbahubhyaḥ praviviktamekatvenābhidhīyate| tattato'nyat, yathā tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ |
analyzed: pramāṇa antara grāhya atvāt iha yat yasmāt pramāṇa antarā ima gṛhyate tat tatas nyate yathā śarīrāt ātmā pramāṇa antara grāhyā ca sadāgatau gatiḥ tasmāt tatas nyā bahu vivikta tvena abhidhānāt iha yat bahubhyaḥ praviviktam ekatvena abhidhīyate tat tatas nyat yathā tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ

original: abhidhīyate bahvāśritāpi pravivekaikatvena kriyā, yathā brāhmaṇairāsyata iti tasmāttato'nyā | anāvṛttāvāvṛtteḥ, ihayasminnānāvartamāne yadāvartate tattato'nyāt yathā hastino maśakaḥ |
analyzed: abhidhīyate bahu āśritā api praviveka ekatvena kriyā yathā brāhmaṇaiḥ āsyate iti tasmāt tatonyā anāvṛttau āvṛtteḥ iha yasmin na an āvartamāne yat āvartate tat tatonyāt yathā hastinaḥ maśakaḥ

original: āvartate cānāvartamāne kartatari kriyā pañcakṛtvaḥ pacatīti, tasmāttato'nyā, ihobhayorapi saṃśayanirṇayanimittatvāt, ihobhayossaṃśaye yasya yo nirṇayahetuśca puruṣasya calanādikriyā, tasmāttato'nyā |
analyzed: āvartate ca an āvartamāne kartatari kriyā pañca kṛtvas pacati iti tasmāt tatonyā iha ubhayoḥ api saṃśaya nirṇaya nimitta tvāt iha ubhayoḥ saṃśaye yasya yaḥ nirṇaya hetuḥ ca puruṣasya calana ādi kriyā tasmāt tatonyā

original: abhidhāyābhidhānāt, iha yadibhadhāyārthāntarā vivakṣāṃ antareṇa yadabhidhīyate tato'nyate, yathā gauraśvaḥ, abhidhīyate ca adhyetā adhīte gantā gacchatīti kārakamabhidhāya kriyā tasmāttato'nyā, paryāyāprasiddheḥ | iha yeṣāmeva paryāyaprasiddhiḥ, teṣāmeva ca tebhyo na bhedaḥ, yathā nirvartiriti|
analyzed: abhidhāya abhidhānāt iha vivakṣām antareṇa yat abhidhīyate tatas nyate yathā gauḥ aśvaḥ abhidhīyate ca adhyetā adhīte gantā gacchati iti kārakam abhidhāya kriyā tasmāt tatonyā paryāya aprasiddheḥ iha yeṣām eva paryāya prasiddhiḥ teṣām eva ca tebhyaḥ na bhedaḥ yathā nirvartiḥ iti

original: na ca pacannadhīte pacatyadhīta iti pacanūpacatyoḥ paryāyatvam| api pacannadhīta iti kartuḥ pacatīti kriyāyāḥ paryāyayogyatevaṃ, ato'sau tato'nyaḥ | abhinnaśabdābhithadhāne'pi viśeṣāṇāṃ liṅgavacanabhedāt |
analyzed: na ca pacan adhīte pacati adhīte iti pacanūpacatyoḥ paryāya tvam api pacan adhīte iti kartuḥ pacati iti kriyāyāḥ atas asau tatonyaḥ viśeṣāṇām liṅga vacana bhedāt

original: iha khalu kriyākatrrerabhinnaśabdābhidheyatve'pi tadviśeṣaṇānāṃ liṅgavacanabhedo dṛśyate, yathā śobhanaṃ pacati śobhanaṃ pacataḥ śobhanaṃ pacantīti sācā'rtho bhede bhinnaśabdopādāna eva dṛśyate| taṭaḥ, taṭī taṭaṃ, puṣyaḥ tārakā nakṣatraṃ, rasaḥ apaḥ jalam, dārāḥ kalatraṃ bhāryā, ityādiviśeṣaṇānām | na tūdāhṛtasadṛśeṣviti kriyā karturanyāḥ |
analyzed: iha khalu tad viśeṣaṇānām liṅga vacana bhedaḥ dṛśyate yathā śobhanam pacati śobhanam pacataḥ śobhanam pacanti iti sācā arthaḥ bhede bhinna śabda upādāne eva dṛśyate taṭaḥ taṭī taṭam puṣyaḥ tārakā nakṣatram rasaḥ apaḥ jalam dārāḥ kalatram bhāryāḥ ityādi viśeṣaṇānām na tu udāhṛta sadṛśeṣu iti kriyā kartuḥ anyāḥ

original: śabdāvṛttibhedeṣudvabhedāt | iṅa khalu kriyākārakayośśabdāvṛttibhede buddhibhedo dṛśyate, adhyetā paṭhati, paṭhati, gantā, gantā gacchatīti pūrvayovarvīpsottarayorābhūkṣṇayam| yasya ca yato buddhibhedastattato vyatiriktaṃ yathā mṛdahghadhevanermeghadhvaniḥ, ghaṭadibhyaḥ paṭādayaḥ iti kriyāyāḥ kārakebhyo vyatirekaḥ |
analyzed: śabda āvṛtti bhede iṅaḥ khalu kriyā kārakayoḥ śabda āvṛtti bhede buddhi bhedaḥ dṛśyate adhyetā paṭhati paṭhati gantā gantā gacchati iti yasya ca yatas buddhi bhedaḥ tat tatas vyatiriktam yathā mṛd ahgha dhevaneḥ megha dhvaniḥ ghaṭa dibhyaḥ paṭa ādayaḥ iti kriyāyāḥ kārakebhyaḥ vyatirekaḥ

original: siddhe cāsminnabhedadarśanaṃ bhedanavyatirekaścāvivekata eveti draṣṭavyaṃ dṛśyate ca | pratīpapravāhaśśabdaśarīrassaṃskārajñānasukhadiḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnarūpādibhinneṣu abhinnapratyayaḥ pravartate teṣvabhedenaiva tadanukūlo vyapadeśaḥ | corasya rujatītyatra tu rūksādhakasya kraturabhāvāllakāraḥ kartari vartamānā tāmeva rujātīti |
analyzed: siddhe ca asmin abheda darśanam bhedana vyatirekaḥ ca avivekataḥ eva iti draṣṭavyam dṛśyate ca pratīpa pravāhaḥ śabda śarīraḥ saṃskāra jñāna sukha diḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna rūpa ādi bhinneṣu abhinna pratyayaḥ pravartate teṣu abhedena eva tad anukūlaḥ vyapadeśaḥ corasya rujati iti atra tu rūk sādhakasya kratuḥ abhāvāt lakāraḥ kartari vartamānā tām eva rujāti iti

original: asyāyamarthaḥ corasya rūgutpadyata iti kṛtaḥ punariyaṃ kārakakriyayorviśeṣaḥ, tadekatra vīpsā anyatrābhīkṣṇamiti kriyāyā ekatvena vīpsānadhigamāt | bahūnāṃ hi kriyā guṇadravyaiḥ prayokturyugapadyvāptumicchā vīpsā, sā tvekatve kriyāyā nopapadyate iti | nanu ca kriyāyā ekatvaṃ nopapapadyate kālatrayeṇātyantavirodhinā yugapadabhisaṃbandhavyapadeśāt|
analyzed: asya ayam arthaḥ corasya rūc utpadyate iti kṛtaḥ punar iyam kāraka kriyayoḥ viśeṣaḥ tat ekatra vīpsā anyatra abhīkṣṇam iti kriyāyāḥ ekatvena vīpsā anadhigamāt bahūnām hi kriyā guṇa dravyaiḥ prayoktuḥ yugapad yuvāptum icchā vīpsā sā tu ekatve kriyāyāḥ na upapadyate iti nanu ca kriyāyāḥ ekatvam na upapapadyate kāla trayeṇa atyanta virodhinā yugapad abhisaṃbandha vyapadeśāt

original: iha khalu kriyāyā sā kasminnapi kāle kālatrayābhisaṃbandhahetuvryapadeśo dṛśyate, pacati devadattaḥ, apākṣīdyajñadattaḥ, pakṣayati viṣṇumitra iti| tañcaikatve na ghaṭate ityanekā kriyā bhedanibandhānā | ātiśayikatarabādipratyayayogāt | iha khalu kriyāyāḥ pacatitarāṃ pacatitamāmityātiśāyanikapratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: iha khalu sā kasmin api kāle kāla traya abhisaṃbandha hetu vyapadeśaḥ dṛśyate pacati devadattaḥ apākṣīt yajñadattaḥ pakṣayati viṣṇumitraḥ iti tat ca ekatve na ghaṭate iti anekā kriyā bheda nibandhānā ātiśayikatara pa ādi pratyaya yogāt iha khalu kriyāyāḥ pacatitarām pacatitamām iti ātiśāyanika pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ

original: sa ca dvayorbahūnāṃ ca prakarṣe siddha ityenekriyā ekena yugapadanekādhikaraṇasya nirdhāraṇāt| iha yadekaikasmin kāle anekādhārasthaṃ pṛthaktvenāvadhāryate tadanekaṃ, yathāṅgilūṣu nakhāni nirdhāryante | nirdhāryate cānekādhārakena yugapadnoṣu gatirityanekā kriyā | pūrvakāle'pi pratyayadarśanāt |
analyzed: sa ca dvayoḥ bahūnām ca prakarṣe siddhaḥ iti enekriyā ekena yugapad aneka adhikaraṇasya nirdhāraṇāt iha yat ekaikasmin kāle aneka ādhāra stham pṛthaktvena avadhāryate tat anekam yathā aṅgilūṣu nakhāni nirdhāryante nirdhāryate ca aneka ādhārakena yugapad noṣu gatiḥ iti anekā kriyā pūrva kāle api pratyaya darśanāt

original: iha dvayorekakartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrvanakāle ktvāpratyayo dṛśyate, yathā bhuktvā bhuṅkte, paktvā pacatīti dvitvaṃ caikatvaṃ pratyanīkamityanekakriyā, yugapallakṣyalakṣaśraṇayogāt | iha kriyāṇāmabhinnakālaṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇayogo dṛśyate | gavi duhyāmānāyāmapi dogdhi, tayaikatve'nupapannamityanekā kriyā pūrvakāle'pi pratyayadharśanāt |
analyzed: iha dvayoḥ eka kartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ ktvāpratyayaḥ dṛśyate yathā bhuktvā bhuṅkte paktvā pacati iti dvi tvam ca eka tvam pratyanīkam iti aneka kriyā yugapad lakṣya lakṣa śraṇa yogāt iha kriyāṇām abhinna kālam lakṣya lakṣaṇa yogaḥ dṛśyate gavi duhyāmānāyām api dogdhi tayā eka tvena upapannam iti anekā kriyā pūrva kāle api pratyaya dharśanāt

original: iha dvayorekakartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrvakāle ktvāpratyayo dṛśyate, yathā bhuktvā bhiṅkte, paktvā pacati hetugarbhaphalābhāvāt | iha khlavahetuphalayoḥ prasiddho bhedaḥ | sa ca kriyāsu dṛśyate odanaṃ, pacati, śākaṃ pacati, bhuñcāna odanaṃ bhuṅkta iti bedaścaikatvāvidhītyanekā kriyā kriyārthakriyopapadatumunādipratyayotpatteḥ |
analyzed: iha dvayoḥ eka kartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrva kāle ktvāpratyayaḥ dṛśyate yathā bhuktvā bhiṅkte paktvā pacati hetu garbha phala abhāvāt iha prasiddhaḥ bhedaḥ sa ca kriyāsu dṛśyate odanam pacati śākam pacati bhuñcānaḥ odanam bhuṅkte iti bedaḥ ca ekatva avidhi iti anekā kriyā kriyā artha kriyā upapada tumuna ādi pratyaya utpatteḥ

original: iha ye tu kriyārthāyayāmupapade tumunādayassmaryante, te ca bhoktuṃ gacchati, pākāya vrajati bhokṣyāmiti pacatiprabhṛtiṣu yathā bhinnadhātuvācyatve'pi dṛśyante, yathā gantuṃ gacti, bhojanāya bhuṅkte, pakṣyāmīti pacatīti| sacāyaṃ tadarthaphalabhāvenaikatva evopapadyata ityanekārthakriyābhihitānabhibitaśaktiprādurbhāvānmittatvāt |

original: iha dhātrrīṃ dhayati, dātreṇa dāti, dāśāya dāśate, bhīmādvibheti, āsate āste, śayane śete, sthāne tiṣṭhati, prāsāde prasīdatīti pratyayavibhaktyordarśanādabhihitānabhihitaśaktiprādurbhāva upalabhyate| sā cānaikyanimittaṃ kriyābedamantareṇa na saṅgacchata ityanekā kriyā bhāvābhidhāne'pi yantrādibhyo dvivacanabahuvacanopalabdhiḥ |

analyzed: te hi paryavasitāḥ sva rūpa tayā upasaṃhṛta kramāḥ eva sva śabdaiḥ upādīyante na sādhya abāvena pākam karoti ityādau hi sādhana viśeṣa nibandhanā avibhaktiḥ upalabhyate dvitīyā nivṛtti rūpam ca sādhanam upapadyate nanu evam asti vidyate tiṣṭhānti ādīnām api na kriyā tvam prasajet yāvatā na uha api kramaḥ upalabhyate na evam atra api kramasya pratīyamāna tvāt

original: tathāhi kālānipāti yadrūpaṃ tadastītyapadiśyate | paritastu paricchinnā bāva ityeva kathyate || evaṃ vidyate tiṣṭhātītyatrāpi draṣṭavyam, kālādhikāre caitaddhiśeṣato varṇayiṣyamāḥ | nāpi gaṇaśaḥ kramajanmatādhiśrayaṇādīnāmutapannamatra, pradhvaṃsitvādayaugapade samūhānupapatteḥ | tadabāve ca kathamiva bhinneṣu bhinnaśabdo vartatāṃ pacatīti |

original: ucyate, kramopajātāvayavavaparicchedaprāptasaṃskārāntaṃ hi yadā sakalaṃ kriyākalāpatteḥ kalayati, tadā pratyayaḥ parivartisamudāya ekakāryatvādāhitabhedaḥ pacatītyadiśabdavyapadeśaniṃmittaṃ bhavati| tathāhy odanādikāryakriyākalāpastirodhāya bhedamabhedena vyapadiśyate |
analyzed: ucyate krama upajāta avayavava pariccheda prāpta saṃskāra antam hi yadā sakalam kriyā kalā āpatteḥ kalayati tadā pratyayaḥ parivarti samudāyaḥ eka kārya tvāt āhita bhedaḥ pacati iti ādi śabda vyapadeśa niṃmittam bhavati tathā hi odana ādi kārya kriyā kalāpaḥ tirodhāya bhedam abhedena vyapadiśyate

original: na hiyupāttakriyāvayavārthapratyāyakaśśabdo yathābhūtamarthaṃ pratyayāyati, tataḥ kathamekasya vartamānakālatāṃ pratyayo'nurudhyeta? naitadasti, śabdaśaktiyo bhinnarūpāmabhinnamarthavyaktimupāttābhedāt darśayanti, yataḥ pūrvāparībhūtāvayasamudāyānurūpāḥ buddhiryathāvagṛhītaṃ samudāyākāramavayaveṣu pratyayasyeti te'vayavāḥ pratyayena
analyzed: na hi yupātta kriyā avayava artha pratyāyakaḥ śabdaḥ yathābhūtam artham pratyayāyati tatas katham ekasya vartamāna kāla tām pratyayaḥ anurudhyeta na etat asti śabda śaktiyaḥ bhinna rūpām abhinnam artha vyaktim upātta abhedāt darśayanti yatas buddhiḥ yathā avagṛhītam samudāya ākāram avayaveṣu pratyayasya iti pratyayena

original: samāropasamudāyānurūpāḥ pacatiśabdavācyāssantaḥ svarūpasannadhānāttaṃ vartamānādivyapadesamanubhūya pratyayaviseṣotpattinimittaṃ bhavanti | tathā hi, abhisamīhitaphalaḥ kriyāyaṃ phalopajananasādhanabhūtāyāṃ vartamānaḥ pumān samudāyamevādhāya cetasi tāsvavayavakriyāsu pravartate |
analyzed: samāropa samudāya anurūpāḥ pacati śabda vācyāḥ santaḥ sva rūpa sanna dhānāt tam vartamāna ādi vyapadesam anubhūya pratyaya viseṣa utpatti nimittam bhavanti tathā hi abhisamīhita phalaḥ kriyā ayam phala upajanana sādhana bhūtāyām vartamānaḥ pumān samudāyam eva ādhāya cetasi tāsu avayava kriyāsu pravartate

original: tato hyasya samudāyābhisandhisamutthāpitāḥ kriyābhāgāḥ samudāyasaṃpādanārthatvāt samudāyarūpeṇādhyavasīyante | tathā'thadhyavasitakriyārūpaistu tasya kriyā kṣaṇasya sannidhānādvartamānakālavihitaḥ pratyayaḥ prayujyate pacatīti |
analyzed: tatas hi asya samudāya abhisandhi samutthāpitāḥ kriyā bhāgāḥ samudāya saṃpādana artha tvāt samudāya rūpeṇa adhyavasīyante tathātha dhyavasita kriyā rūpaiḥ tu tasya kriyā kṣaṇasya sannidhānāt vartamāna kāla vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ prayujyate pacati iti

original: atra cotpannamātraprayuktatvāt srave kriyāvayavā vartamānā na saṃbhavantīti sphuṭamevāvasīyate, kintu pratyekaṃ samudāyiṣu samudāyādhyāsena prayujyate pacatīti | adhiśrayaṇādyavayavākrayāmudāyavacaneśaṣu pacādiṣu yasminnavayave'dhyāropya samudāyo'dhiśrayaṇādiḥ viklityantaḥ pratyāyyate, tatkālapratyayo'nuvartate |
analyzed: atra ca utpanna mātra prayukta tvāt srave kriyā avayavāḥ vartamānāḥ na saṃbhavanti iti sphuṭam eva avasīyate kintu pratyekam samudāyiṣu samudāya adhyāsena prayujyate pacati iti paca ādiṣu yasmin avayave idhi āropya samudāyaḥ dhiśrayaṇa ādiḥ vikliti antaḥ pratyāyyate tad kāla pratyayaḥ anuvartate

original: tatra yadā vartamānāvayave samudāyādhyāsastadā pacatīti bhavati| yadā tu bhūtabhaviṣyayossamūhoropaṇe tadā'pākṣāt pakṣyatīti | taduktaṃ samūhassa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedaṃ samūhiṣu | samāpyate tato bhede kālabedasya saṃbhavaḥ || samudāyasya ca samudāyiṣu pratyekaparisamāptau nidarśanaṃ, grāmo dagdhaḥ, paṭo dagdhaḥ, iti |
analyzed: tatra yadā vartamāna avayave samudāya adhyāsaḥ tadā pacati iti bhavati yadā tu bhūta bhaviṣyayoḥ samūhaḥ āropaṇe tadā apākṣāt pakṣyati iti tat uktam samūhaḥ sa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedam samūhiṣu samāpyate tatas bhede kāla bedasya saṃbhavaḥ samudāyasya ca samudāyiṣu pratyeka parisamāptau nidarśanam grāmaḥ dagdhaḥ paṭaḥ dagdhaḥ iti

original: yadi hyesminnaṃśe samudāyo na syāt, pāṇimātrasyāṅgulimātrakya vā caṇḍālatvavirahāt caṇḍālapāṇḍaḍḍatdhṅgulisparśenaivocyeta caṇḍālaspṛṣṭa iti | na cāṅgavikāreṇāṅghino vikṛtirlakṣyate, akṣṇā kāṇa iti |

original: taduktam, avayave hi spṛṣṭe samudāyo'pi spṛṣṭo bhavati, avayave hi kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasyāpi viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, yaśca samudāyaḥ so'vayavānna vyabhicarati | tasya viśeṣakaṃ yathā gossakthani kaṇṭhe'pi kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ goreva viśeṣakaṃ na gomaṇḍaḍḍatdhlasyeti |

original: tadevamukte kimuktaṃ bhavati upāttakramādhiśrayaṇādiviklityantānāmavayavānāṃ samudāyaḥ pacatikriyeti? tarhi, ciraṃ jīvatu bhavān bhavanaiva pratijñātā naiva kriyā pratyakṣeti | tasmādipāttakriyāṃ kriyāvayavāstadasya kriyāsaṅghātasya recidavayavā nivṛtāḥ, kecidanivṛttāḥ, kaścideva pratyupasthitaḥ |
analyzed: tat evam ukte kim uktam bhavati upātta krama adhiśrayaṇa ādi vikliti antānām avayavānām samudāyaḥ pacati kriyā iti tarhi ciram jīvatu bhavān bhavanā eva pratijñātā nā eva kriyā pratyakṣā iti tasmāt ipātta kriyām kriyā avayavāḥ tat asya kriyā saṅghātasya recit avayavāḥ nivṛtāḥ kecid anivṛttāḥ kaścid eva pratyupasthitaḥ

original: upasthitaviṣayāḥ cakṣiparādayaḥ, tato'tha kriyākalāpādayaḥ pratyakṣayituṃ cakṣurādibhirabhisaṃbandhāt na vyatītānāmatarūpasyāsataḥ kriyāvayavasya sadāsadānupātinā kakāraṇagrāmeṇa saṃbandho, na vā'nadhigatendriyasaṃbandhasya padārthasya darśanaparicchedyatā saṃbhavati | taduktaṃ kramātsadasatāṃ teṣāmātmano na samūhitāḥ |
analyzed: upasthita viṣayāḥ cakṣi para ādayaḥ kriyā kalāpa ādayaḥ pratyakṣayitum cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ abhisaṃbandhāt na vyatīta anāmata rūpasya asataḥ kriyā avayavasya sadā asat anupātinā ka kāraṇa grāmeṇa saṃbandhaḥ na vā anadhigata indriya saṃbandhasya padārthasya darśana paricchedya tā saṃbhavati tat uktam kramāt sat asatām teṣām ātmanaḥ na samūhitāḥ

original: sadvastaviśayairyānti saṃbandhaṃ cakṣurādibhiḥ || darśanābhimānaḥ kathamiti cet, yathā gauraśva ityevamanādiṣu padeṣu gakārādayo varṇabhāgāḥ kramarūpānanuvidhāyino vyaktāvupajane vā prāptayaugadyāsaṅgātarūpeṇa na pāryānte'vadhārayituṃ, indriyāyattayā budhdyā tasyāḥ pratyupasthitākṣarāvasāyaśakteḥ pūrvottarabhāgayorasaṃsparśāt |
analyzed: sat vasta viśayaiḥ yānti saṃbandham cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ darśana abhimānaḥ katham iti ced yathā gauḥ aśvaḥ iti evam anādiṣu padeṣu gakāra ādayaḥ varṇa bhāgāḥ krama rūpa an anuvidhāyinaḥ vyaktau upajane vā na indriya āyattayā budhdyā tasyāḥ pratyupasthita akṣara avasāya śakteḥ pūrva uttara bhāgayoḥ asaṃsparśāt

original: samabhihitāvayavaparicchedaprāpitātiśayāstu buddhayaḥ svānurūpaṃ saṃskāraparaṃparāmante samālocitaviśeṣavarṇabhāgāmupajanayanti tasyāmutkīrṇabuddhimiva tatpadaṃ samudāyātmanā nirūpyate | tadāha yathā gauriti saṅghātassarvonendiyagocaraḥ | bhāgaśastūpalabdhasya boddhau rūpaṃ nirūpyate ||
analyzed: samabhihita avayava pariccheda prāpita atiśayāḥ tu buddhayaḥ sva anurūpam saṃskāra paraṃparām ante samālocita viśeṣa varṇa bhāgām upajanayanti tasyām utkīrṇa buddhim iva tat padam samudāya ātmanā nirūpyate tat āha yathā gauḥ iti saṅghātaḥ sarvaḥ na indiya gocaraḥ bhāgaśas tu upalabdhasya boddhau rūpam nirūpyate

original: kālpanikastu yugapadnrahaṇābhimānaḥ pratyakṣabhramanibandhanam| yathā'lātasya viddhaviśvaśate | deśe nairantaryā na parivṛttirūpamapi rāmeṇāvadhārayannayanāvasitakālabhedo yugapatsakaladeśavyāpi paricchinnadhyavasyati, caṃkramiti yathā kramavantaḥ kriyābāgāḥ krameṇaivāvasitā laghutaraṃ parivartitvātadanavadhṛtakālabhedairyugapadevādhyanasīyante,
analyzed: kālpanikaḥ tu pratyakṣa bhrama nibandhanam yathā alātasya viddha viśva śate deśe nairantaryā na parivṛtti rūpam api rāmeṇa avadhārayan nayana avasita kāla bhedaḥ yugapad sakala deśa vyāpi paricchinna dhyavasyati caṃkram iti yathā kramavantaḥ kriyā bāgāḥ krameṇa eva avasitāḥ laghutaram parivartitvā a tad anavadhṛta kāla bhedaiḥ yugapad eva adhyanasīyante

original: yathā'dhyavasāyaṃ ca darśanābhimānamutrādayantaḥ pratyakṣavyavahāraṃ vartayati | yaduktam indriyairanyathāprāptau bhedāṃśopanipātibhiḥ | alātacakravadrūpaṃ kriyāṇāṃ parivartitam || apratyakṣaiva tu kriyā | yadāha mahābhāṣyakāraḥ kriyāṇāmevamatyantāparidṛṣṭā aśakyā nidarśayituṃ, yathā garbho nirluṭhitasyāsāvanumānagāmyati |
analyzed: yathā adhyavasāyam ca pratyakṣa vyavahāram vartayati yat uktam indriyaiḥ anyathā prāptau bheda aṃśa upanipātibhiḥ alāta cakra vat rūpam kriyāṇām parivartitam apratyakṣā eva tu kriyā yat āha mahābhāṣyakāraḥ kriyāṇām evam atyanta aparidṛṣṭāḥ aśakyāḥ nidarśayitum yathā garbhaḥ nirluṭhitasya asau anumāna gāmī ati

original: nanu pratyakṣapravṛttau saṃbandhagrahaṇābhāvāt kathaṃ kriyāviṣeye'numānaṃ vartate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, dhātuvācyasya samūhasya yugapadasannidhānātpratyakṣatvam | ekākasya tu lakṣaṇasya pratyakṣatve buddhyā saṅkayya paṭacatīti prayujyate, yadāpyekasmin kṣaṇe pacatīti prayogastadā tatra samūhāropaṇam | yadāha pūrvottarairyadā bhāgaissamavasthāpitakramaḥ |
analyzed: nanu pratyakṣa pravṛttau saṃbandha grahaṇa abhāvāt katham kriyā viṣeya inumānam vartate na eṣa doṣaḥ dhātu vācyasya samūhasya yugapad asannidhānāt pratyakṣa tvam ekākasya tu lakṣaṇasya pratyakṣa tve buddhyā saṅkayya paṭacati iti prayujyate yadā api ekasmin kṣaṇe pacati iti prayogaḥ tadā tatra samūha āropaṇam yat āha pūrva uttaraiḥ yadā bhāgaiḥ samavasthāpita kramaḥ

original: ekassopyasadadhyāsādākhyātairabhidhīyate || yaścāpakarṣaparyantamanuprāptaḥ pratīyate | tatraikasmin kriyāśabdaḥ kevalena prayujyate || na tvevamindriyairabhisaṃbandhāt sarūpasannidhānāya vartamānāvyapatadeśāñca kathamapratyakṣatve kriyāyām? ucyate, neha vastavartho nurūpyate, apitu śabdārthaḥ |
analyzed: ekaḥ saḥ upi asat adhyāsāt ākhyātaiḥ abhidhīyate yaḥ ca apakarṣa paryantam anuprāptaḥ pratīyate tatra ekasmin kriyā śabdaḥ kevalena prayujyate na tu evam indriyaiḥ abhisaṃbandhāt sarūpa sannidhānāya vartamāna avyapata deśāt ca katham apratyakṣa tve kriyāyām ucyate na iha apitu śabda arthaḥ

original: tatra canvavyatirekābhyāṃ yaḥ kaprakṛtyratho'vasthāpyate, yā kriyāvacanasya dhātusaṃjñā, nāsau śakyā sākṣādupalabdhum | thatra hi ācāryāṇāṃ madabhedaḥ, eke manyante’dhiśraṇādīmanāṃ samudāyo buddhyā nigṛhītaḥ, ekatvena sa pacatītyādīnāṃ vācya iti |
analyzed: tatra canu avyatirekābhyām yaḥ yā kriyā vacanasya dhātu saṃjñā na asau śakyā sākṣāt upalabdhum hi ācāryāṇām samudāyaḥ buddhyā nigṛhītaḥ eka tvena sa pacati ityādīnām vācyaḥ iti

original: na ca samudāyaṃ pacatīti prayuñjānaḥ pratyekamadhiśrayaṇājiṣu pratyasyati, pratyayāśca na samudāya ityevaṃ rūpaṃ pratyasyanti | nāpyayaṃ cāyaṃ ceti saṃbandhino buddhyāvgṛhṇāti |
analyzed: na ca samudāyam pacati iti prayuñjānaḥ pratyekam adhiśrayaṇa ājiṣu pratyasyati pratyayāḥ ca na samudāyaḥ iti evam rūpam pratyasyanti na api ayam ca ayam ca iti saṃbandhinaḥ buddhyau gṛhṇāti

original: kiṃ tahryāśritakramanirūpamiva pratyekamavayaveṣu pratyasya pacatīti prayuṅakte, tadā tasyaiva samīhitaṃ bhavati, adhiśrayaṇādyanupūrvā phalamodajanādi nirvartayitavyamiti | yathā prathamakhriyāsaṃbhāge pacirityevādhyavasyāti nādhiśrayaṇamiti |
analyzed: kim tahrī āśrita krama nirūpam iva pratyekam avayaveṣu pratyasya pacati iti prayuṅakte tadā tasya eva samīhitam bhavati adhiśrayaṇa ādi anupūrvā phalam odajana ādi nirvartayitavyam iti yathā prathama khriyā saṃbhāge paciḥ iti eva adhyavasyāti na adhiśrayaṇam iti

original: itharathā hyevaṃ prayogastasyādhiśrayatīti yadācādhiśrayaṇe nirvṛttenāgate vā bhūtabhaviṣyatkālābhidhāyinaṃ śabdaṃ prayuṅkte, tadā samudāyarūpapratyāsenaiva tamavayavabuddhyā nigṛhya prayuṅkte apākṣīte pakṣyatīti | na tvadhiśrayaṇarūpeṇa, anyathā hyevaṃ prayogassyāt adhyāśiṣyatīti |
analyzed: itharathā hi evam prayogaḥ tasya adhiśrayati iti yadā ca adhiśrayaṇe nirvṛttena āgate vā bhūta bhaviṣyat kāla abhidhāyinam śabdam prayuṅkte tadā samudāya rūpa pratyāsena eva tam avayava buddhyā nigṛhya prayuṅkte apākṣīte pakṣyati iti na tu adhiśrayaṇa rūpeṇa anyathā hi evam prayogaḥ syāt adhyāśiṣyati iti

original: evāmāpanepi ca ghaṭane vā samūhini samudāyarūpāprāptyā dhātutvādeva vyapadeśāt | pacatyapākṣīt pakṣyatīti, evaṃ bhūtāścārthātmā'dhikṛtassādhanatantrasādhyāvasthaḥ śabdena prakrānto'śakya upalabdhuṃ, yathā gauriti gakāraukāravisarjanīyā evopalabhyante |
analyzed: eva a māpane api ca ghaṭane vā samūhini samudāya rūpa aprāptyā dhātu tvāt eva vyapadeśāt pacati apākṣīt pakṣyati iti evam bhūtāḥ ca artha ātma adhikṛtaḥ sādhana tantra sādhya avasthaḥ śabdena prakrāntaḥ śakyaḥ upalabdhum yathā gauḥ iti gakāra okāra visarjanīyāḥ eva upalabhyante

original: samudāyastu buddhinigrrāhya eva, tathā pacatītyādiṣvevādhiśrayatītyavayavādiṣu avaya eva hastaprasaraṇasthālīvinyāsādayo'śabdavācya pratyakṣā eva| yāvadapakarṣaparyantāprāptā kriyeti sāpi nāpratyaste kramarūpe samudāye ākhyātaśabdevanābhidhīyate |
analyzed: samudāyaḥ tu buddhi nigrrāhyaḥ eva tathā pacati ityādiṣu eva adhiśrayati iti avayava ādiṣu avayaḥ eva pratyakṣāḥ eva yāvat apakarṣa paryantā aprāptā kriyā iti sā api na apratyaste krama rūpe samudāye ākhyāta śabdā ivanā abhidhīyate

original: apakarṣaparyantā cetkramarūpeṇa nā'vagṛhṇādīti avācaka evākhyātaśabdāḥ yathā ślokaśabdaṃ prayuñjano bhādyaṃ padaṃ padarūpeṇāvagṛhṇāti na tadā ślokassamuñcāryata iti prayuṅkte | yadā tvāśritottaraprabandhamavagṛhṇāti tadā ślokaśabdaṃ prayuṅkte | evaṃ kṛtvā niruktetyuktaṃ pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyāyate nācaṣṭā iti |
analyzed: apakarṣa paryantā ced krama rūpeṇa na avagṛhṇāti iti avācakaḥ eva ākhyāta śabdāḥ yathā śloka śabdam prayuñjanaḥ bhādyam padam pada rūpeṇa avagṛhṇāti na tadā ślokaḥ samuñcāryate iti prayuṅkte yadā tu āśrita uttara prabandham avagṛhṇāti tadā śloka śabdam prayuṅkte evam kṛtvā niruktā iti uktam bhāvam ākhyāyate na ācaṣṭā iti

original: anyeṣāṃ darśanaṃ yadvicaṭanaṃ taṇḍuḍḍatdhlāvayavānāṃ taṇḍiḍḍatdhlāvayavebhyo vibhāgāḥ, yadanantaraṃ mā bhavādayo niṣpadyante | tadyadā'dhiśrayādiṣu pratyastarūpaṃ bhavati tāda'khyānenābhidhīyate |
analyzed: anyeṣām darśanam yat vicaṭanam taṇḍuḍḍatdhla avayavānām taṇḍiḍḍatdhla avayavebhyaḥ vibhāgāḥ yat anantaram mā bhava ādayaḥ niṣpadyante tat yadā adhiśraya ādiṣu pratyasta rūpam bhavati tādakhyānena abhidhīyate

original: tatra yadajupalabhyate'dhiśrayaṇaṃ tadaśabdavācyaṃ, kārakanirākāṃkṣaṃ yacchabdenābhidhīyate tadaniṣpannaṃ, sādhanatantramapratyakṣaṃ niṣepannāniṣpannayoścaikāntyātmāyattau pacatyādiśabadaprayogaḥ | sa cāyamevaṃrūpo'rthātmā guṇākriyāṇāṃ paurvāparyātmanāṃ pūrvo na paraśca pūrvāparībhūte vyapadiśyate |
analyzed: tatra yat a c upalabhyate dhi śrayaṇam tat aśabda vācyam kāraka nirākāṃkṣam yat śabdena abhidhīyate tat aniṣpannam sādhana tantram apratyakṣam ca ekānti ātma āyattau pacati ādi śabada prayogaḥ sa ca ayam evaṃrūpaḥ ṛtha ātmā guṇa akriyāṇām paurvāparya ātmanām pūrvaḥ na paraḥ ca pūrva aparībhūte vyapadiśyate

original: anye tu vicaṭanamevādhiśrayaṇādirūpaṃ parratipannāḥ, na rūpaśūvanyādhiśrayaṇādīn pratyastavicaṭanarūpāmanāhuśca kaḥ punaḥ paceḥ pradhānārthaḥ yo'sau? ? taṇḍuḍḍatdhlānāṃ viklittiḥ? athāvā yadabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ praṣaṇamadhyeṣaṇaṃ vā sarvaḥ pacyartha iti sarvasminnapi darśane yathā bhūtākhyatāśabdo na kriyā prakramyate |
analyzed: anye tu vicaṭanam eva adhiśrayaṇa ādi rūpam na rūpa śūvanya adhiśrayaṇa ādīn pratyasta vicaṭana rūpām anāhuḥ ca kaḥ punar paceḥ pradhāna arthaḥ yā asau viklittiḥ athāvā yat abhisaṃdhi pūrvakam praṣaṇam adhyeṣaṇam vā sarvaḥ paci arthaḥ iti sarvasmin api darśane yathā bhūta ākhya tā śabdaḥ na kriyā prakramyate

original: tathābhūtāyāssiddhamapratyakṣamiti phalenaiva samdhigamo yuktaṃ kathamiti cet, iha sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kadācitpacatītyetadbhanati, kadācinna bhavati, yasminnimitte sannihite pacatītyetadbhavati | sā nūnaṃ kriyāyāṃ devadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati |
analyzed: tathābhūtāyāḥ siddham apratyakṣam iti phalena eva samdhigamaḥ yuktam katham iti ced iha sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kadācid pacati iti etat bhanati kadācid na bhavati yasmin nimitte sannihite pacati iti etat bhavati sā nūnam kriyāyām devadattaḥ iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati

original: sā nūnaṃ kriyeti dvitīyahetumatyā so'pyartha iti cennaivam, iha kasyacideṣā buddhiḥ syāt, asatyevā'sminnimitte pacatyādibuddhayaḥ pravartante, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikādiśaṣviti tadanena nirvartayati |
analyzed: sā nūnam kriyā iti dvitīya hetumatyā saḥ api arthaḥ iti ced na evam iha kasyacid eṣā buddhiḥ syāt asati eva asmin nimitte pacati ādi buddhayaḥ pravartante yathā mṛgatṛṣṇika ādi śaṣu iti tat anena nirvartayati

original: mṛgatṛṣṇikādibhyo hi tṛptimalāpakarṣaṇa dharmāpanodanādi na phalaṃ nivartate, asarvagatayā hi devadattapācaliputrayorgamanakriyāntaranairantaryeṇāvasthānarūpaṃ phalamipalabhyate | athavā etadayaṃ pratipadyeta, śaktikṛtāḥ pacatyādayo viśeṣāḥ satpratyāśca syuḥ, na krayākṛtā iti |
analyzed: mṛgatṛṣṇika ādibhyaḥ hi dharma apanodana ādi na phalam nivartate asarvagatayā hi devadatta pācali putrayoḥ gamana kriyā antara nairantaryeṇa avasthāna rūpam phalam ipalabhyate athavā etat ayam pratipadyeta śakti kṛtāḥ pacati ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ sat pratyāḥ ca syuḥ na krayākṛtāḥ iti

original: tadanena nirvartayati, yāvāṃ devadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭalipatre bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyeti | yadi hyete śaktikṛtāssyuḥ śaktyānantarameva pācaliputreṇa prāptissayāt | naca bhavati tasamāt śaktikṛte nānyena dharmeṇa, , yasya phalaṃ deśāntaraprāptiriti | kriyāmanye tu manyante kkacidapyanapāśritām | sā nāvārthāvabālasatve pravṛttiranapāyinī ||
analyzed: tat anena nirvartayati yāvām devadattaḥ iha bhūtvā pāṭalipatre bhavati sā nūnam kriyā iti yadi hi ete śakti kṛtāḥ syuḥ śaktyā anantaram eva pācaliputreṇa prāptiḥ sayāt na ca bhavati śakti kṛte na anyena dharmeṇa yasya phalam deśa antara prāptiḥ iti kriyām anye tu manyante kkacid api anapāśritām sā pravṛttiḥ anapāyinī

original: sāmānyābhūtā dhātvarthaissā punaḥ pravibhajyate | tato vyāpārarūpeṇa sādhye prayavatiṣṭhate || prakṛtissādhanānāṃ sā prathamāntamakārakam | śaktirekādhikaraṇe strotovadapakarṣati || apūrvaṃ kāsaśaktiṃ vā kriyāyāḥ kālameva vā | tamekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kecidāhuḥ kathañcana ||
analyzed: sāmānya abhūtā dhātvarthaiḥ sā punar pravibhajyate tatas vyāpāra rūpeṇa sādhye prakṛtiḥ sādhanānām sā prathama antam akārakam śaktiḥ eka adhikaraṇe strotaḥ vat apakarṣati apūrvam kāsa śaktim vā kriyāyāḥ kālam eva vā tam ekam lakṣaṇam kecid āhuḥ kathañcana

original: sā tu yathā asti bhavati kakarotītyādikriyāvacchede bhedābhinnā'pi bhinneva prakāśate, tathā kramarūpoparādānānnityameva kālasaṃbandhobhūtabhūtabhaviṣyadādivyapadeśamāsādayati | kaḥ punarayaṃ kālo nāma? kriyaiva kriyāntarāvadhṛtaparimāṇavyavacchinnā vā kriyāparicchinnahetuḥ kālaḥ, kathaṃ punaḥ kriyāyaiva kriyāparicchittiḥ? śrayatām |
analyzed: sā tu yathā asti bhavati kakaroti ityādi kriyā avacchede bheda abhinnā api bhinnā iva prakāśate tathā krama rūpa upara ādānāt nityam eva kāla saṃbandhaḥ bhūta bhūta bhaviṣyat ādi vyapadeśam āsādayati kaḥ punar ayam kālaḥ nāma kriyā eva kriyā antara avadhṛta parimāṇa vyavacchinnā vā kriyā paricchinna hetuḥ kālaḥ katham punar kriyāya eva kriyā paricchittiḥ śrayatām

original: iha tu kriyāḥ kāścitkriyāntaraiḥ kaiścidvuddhyaiva parimīyante | yathārkādīnāṃ gatayaḥ yathā ca godohādayaḥ, tathā'smādādivyāpārāḥ | yathā puruṣāyuṣādayastatrāvadhṛtaparimāṇābiritarāḥ paricchidyante, yathā divasaṃ gacchati, varṣaśataṃ jīva, odanapārakamāste, godohaṃ svapiti |
analyzed: iha tu kriyāḥ kāścid kriyā antaraiḥ kaiścid vuddhyā eva parimīyante yathā arka ādīnām gatayaḥ yathā ca godoha ādayaḥ tathā asmādādi vyāpārāḥ yathā puruṣa āyuṣa ādayaḥ tatra avadhṛta parimāṇa abiḥ itarāḥ paricchidyante yathā divasam gacchati varṣa śatam jīvaḥ odana pārakam āste godoham svapiti

original: tatra paricchedakālavayavahāraṃ vartayanti, yathā saviturudayādirastamayaparyantaḥ kriyāprabandho divasaḥ, sa evastamayādiḥ punarudayāvasāno niśā, sarvākakarṣāṇāṃ sakṛtparivṛttirahorātraḥ, kalābirindorāpyāyanaṃ parikṣayo vā pakṣaḥ, candrasya sakalaṃnakṣatrātikramomāsaḥ, sūryācandramasorgativibhāgādekāhorarātrakṣaya ṛtuḥ, raverdakṣiṇata uttarate vā
analyzed: tatra pariccheda kāla vayavahāram vartayanti yathā savituḥ udaya ādiḥ astamaya paryantaḥ kriyā prabandhaḥ divasaḥ saḥ eva stamaya ādiḥ punar udaya avasānaḥ niśā sarva ākakarṣāṇām sakṛt parivṛttiḥ ahorātraḥ kalā abiḥ indoḥ āpyāyanam parikṣayaḥ vā pakṣaḥ candrasya sakalam nakṣatra atikramaḥ umāsaḥ sūryācandramasoḥ gati vibhāgāt eka ahorarātra kṣayaḥ ṛtuḥ raveḥ dakṣiṇatas uttarate vā

original: gamanamayanaṃ, vṛhaspaterekṛrātryatikramassaṃvatsara iti | tena coktānuktaṃ kriyā kālo'vācchidyate | yathā divā divaḥ, divaso niśācāhorātraḥ, pañcadaśāhorātraḥ pakṣaḥ, pakṣadvayaṃ māsaḥ, māsadvayamṛtuḥ, ṛtutrayamayanaṃ, ayanadvayaṃ saṃvatsaraḥ, pañca saṃvatsārā yugam |
analyzed: gamanam ayanam vṛhaspateḥ īkṛ rātri atikramaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ iti tena ca ukta anuktam kriyā yathā divā divaḥ divasaḥ niśā ca ahorātraḥ pañcadaśā ahorātraḥ pakṣaḥ pakṣa dvayam māsaḥ māsa dvayam ṛtuḥ ṛtu trayam ayanam ayana dvayam saṃvatsaraḥ pañca saṃvatsārāḥ yugam

original: yugāni dvādaśā kalapaḥ, kalpaśatāni dvādaśa mahākalpaḥ, mahākalpaṣṭiścaturyugaṃ, caturyugāni dvisaptatirmanvantaram, manvancarāṇi caturdaśa brahmadivasaḥ, tāvatyeva tanniśā pralayaḥ, tanmānena varṣaśatānte brahmaṇo'pavargo mahāpralayaḥ |
analyzed: yugāni dvādaśā kalapaḥ kalpa śatāni dvādaśa mahākalpaḥ mahākalpa ṣṭiḥ caturyugam caturyugāni dvisaptatiḥ manvantaram manvancarāṇi caturdaśa brahma divasaḥ tāvatī eva tad niśā pralayaḥ tad mānena varṣa śata ante brahmaṇā upavargaḥ mahāpralayaḥ

original: yathā vā sūryasya bhagaṇabhogo varṣe, rāśibhogo māsaḥ, māsātriṃśāṃśo dinaṃ, dinaṣṭyaṃṣā kalā, kalāṣaṣṭyaṃśā vikalā, vikalāṣaṣṭyaṃśaḥ tatpareti | tatra yathā rajatānyadhikaraṇagauravamavadhṛtaparimāṇadravyāntarasaṃbandhasamutkīrṇaparekhastulādaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ | rekhāsu sūtrāvasthānaphalaśaḥ karṣaśobhā paricchinatti |
analyzed: yathā vā sūryasya bhagaṇa bhogaḥ varṣe rāśi bhogaḥ māsaḥ māsā triṃśa aṃśaḥ dinam dinaṣṭi aṃṣā kalā kalā ṣaṣṭi aṃśā vikalā vikalā ṣaṣṭi aṃśaḥ tatparā iti tatra yathā rajatāni adhikaraṇa gauravam avadhṛta parimāṇa dravya antara saṃbandha samutkīrṇa parekhaḥ tulā daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ rekhāsu sūtra avasthāna phalaśas karṣa śobhā paricchinatti

original: tathā kāladinādīnvayavasthānavaśena bhāgaśaḥ kālāntaraṃ paricchinatti | parimāṇāṃ parimimīte kriyāniyamaiḥ kākalāvacchedaniyamaḥ yathā parimāṇo svavaṣṭubdhapradeśo kmalakṣaṇaḥ, paśyamasaṃpāto niṃṣaḥ, ityatkṣeṇe iyannimeṣo vā nāḍiḍḍatdhkā, dvināḍiḍḍatdhko muhurtaḥ, pādonacaturmuhūrto yāmaḥ, yāmāṣṭakamahorātraḥ iti |
analyzed: tathā kāla dina ādīn vayava sthāna vaśena bhāgaśas kāla antaram paricchinatti parimāṇām parimimīte kriyā niyamaiḥ kākalā avaccheda niyamaḥ yathā

original: buddhyanavacchedena vā kālaparicchedaḥ, yathārkasya udāyāvidūratā pratyūṣaḥ, puruśabhrūpradeśatā dīrghatā pūrvahṇaḥ, tapamā madhyāhnaḥ, parāvṛtyā darśanamaparahṇaḥ, astamayāsannatābhisandhiḥ sandhyeti |
analyzed: buddhi anavacchedena vā kāla paricchedaḥ yathā arkasya udāya avidūra tā pratyūṣaḥ puru śabhrū pradeśa tā dīrgha tā pūrvahṇaḥ tapamā madhyāhnaḥ parāvṛtyāḥ darśanam aparahṇaḥ astamaya āsanna tā abhisandhiḥ sandhyā iti

original: rotreḥ prārambho niśāmukhaṃ, niśāmukhādrātresturyaṃśaḥ, ardharātramubhayato niśāṣṭamo niśīthaḥ, niśīthāttāvanmātramapararātraḥ, parato niśāvaseṣaḥ prabhaitamiti kriyāviśeṣaiḥ kālaviśeṣāvagamaḥ | tathāhi śayāne śerate rātrai divā jāgrati jāgrati | jagatpradīpe padmāni kalatrāṇīva bhartari || ratāntakālakāntastrīdṛgvilāsaikasākṣiṇī |
analyzed: rotreḥ prārambhaḥ niśāmukham niśāmukhāt rātreḥ turyaṃśaḥ ardharātram ubhayatas niśā aṣṭamaḥ niśīthaḥ niśīthāt tāvanmātram apararātraḥ paratas niśāvaseṣaḥ prabhā etam iti kriyā viśeṣaiḥ kāla viśeṣa avagamaḥ tathā hi śayāne śerate rātrai divā jāgrati jāgrati jagat pradīpe padmāni kalatrāṇi iva bhartari rata anta kāla kānta strīdṛś vilāsa eka sākṣiṇī

original: niśā nīlotpalānīkenimīlati nimīlate || cañcvagracimbitātāmracūtāṃkurakagadambakaiḥ | kathyate kokilaireva madhurmadhurakūjitaiḥ || divākarakārālatapātanirdagdhavīrūdhaḥ | mārgāssamallikāmodā bhāvigrīṣmasya śaṃsaniḥ || śikhaṇḍiḍḍatdhmaṇḍaḍḍatdhlārabdhacaṇḍaḍḍatdhvaḍaḍḍatdhvaḍaḍḍatdhmbaraiḥ | prāvṛḍākhyayate medhamedurairmedinūdharaiḥ ||
analyzed: niśā nīlotpala anīke nimīlati nimīlate cañcu agra cimbita ātāmra cūta aṃkuraka gadambakaiḥ kathyate kokilaiḥ eva madhuḥ madhura kūjitaiḥ divākara kārālata pāta nirdagdha vīrūdhaḥ mārgāḥ sa mallikā āmodāḥ bhāvi grīṣmasya śaṃsaniḥ prāvṛṣ ākhyayate medha meduraiḥ medinūdharaiḥ

original: mailikākāranistāri tārānikaracitritam | śaratpiśunatāṃ yāti yāmunāmbhonibhaṃ nabhaḥ || āyāmiyāminobhogasaphalābhogavibhramāḥ | hemantamabhinandanti soṣmāṇastarūṇīstanāḥ || āskandavadalatkundakalikotkaradanturāḥ | vadanti śiśiraṃ vātāstuṣārakaṇakarkaśāḥ ||
analyzed: mailikā ākāra nistāri tārā nikara citritam śarad piśuna tām yāti yāmuna ambhaḥ nibham nabhaḥ āyāmi yāminaḥ bhoga sa phala ābhoga vibhramāḥ hemantam abhinandanti sa ūṣmāṇaḥ tarūṇī stanāḥ āskanda vat alat kunda kalikā utkara danturāḥ vadanti śiśiram vātāḥ tuṣāra kaṇa karkaśāḥ

original: sa ca tadviśiṣṭā kārakaviśeṣamupatiṣṭhate | yadāha guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānaṃ pratipadyate | pradhānasyopakāritve tathā bhūyasi vartate || kalābhiḥ pṛthagarthābhiḥ pravibhaktaṃ svabhāvataḥ | kecidbūnusaṃdhānalakṣaṇatatvaṃ pracakṣate || sattālakṣaṇamanye tu kṣaṇarūpaṃ tathā'pare | devatāvastuśaktyātmasvarūpamapare viduḥ ||
analyzed: sa ca tad viśiṣṭā kāraka viśeṣam upatiṣṭhate yat āha guṇaḥ kṛta ātma saṃskāraḥ pradhānam pratipadyate pradhānasya upakāri tve tathā bhūyasi vartate kalābhiḥ pṛthak arthābhiḥ pravibhaktam svabhāvataḥ kecid būnu saṃdhāna lakṣaṇa tatvam pracakṣate sattā lakṣaṇam anye tu kṣaṇa rūpam tathā apare devatā vastu śakti ātma svarūpam apare viduḥ

original: tamasya lokayantrasya sūtradhāraṃ pracakṣate | pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ vṛttiryā tasya śāśvatī || tayā vibhajyamāno'sau labhate kramarūpatām | tṛṇarājasya yā vṛddhistavācisārasya vā dadhat || cirakṣiprādibhede ca kālakatvaṃ vikalpate | vyatikme'pi mātrāṇāṃ na tasyāsti vyatikramaḥ || niyantṛgatibhedena mārgabhedo'sti kaścana |
analyzed: tam asya loka yantrasya sūtradhāram pracakṣate pratibandha abhyanujñābhyām vṛttiḥ yā tasya śāśvatī tayā vibhajyamānā asau labhate krama rūpa tām tṛṇarājasya yā vṛddhiḥ tava āci sārasya vā dadhat cira kṣipra ādi bhede ca kālaka tvam vikalpate mātrāṇām na tasya asti vyatikramaḥ niyantṛ gati bhedena mārga bhedaḥ usti kaścana

original: dūrāntikavyavasthāvanamadhvādikaraṇaṃ yathā || cirakṣipravyavasthānaṃ kālādhikaraṇaṃ tathā | kriyopādhissa yā bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānatā || parāvaravibhāgārthaṃ sā śaktiḥ pratipādyate | bhūtānāṃ caiva yadrūpaṃ rūpaṃ yadbhāvināmapi || sudurdarśa ivādarśe kāla evopalabhyate | kriyābhedyathaikasmastakṣādyākhyā pravartate ||
analyzed: dūra antika vyavasthāvanam adhva ādi karaṇam yathā cira kṣipra vyavasthānam kāla adhikaraṇam tathā kriyā upādhiḥ sa yā bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamāna tā parāvara vibhāga artham sā śaktiḥ pratipādyate bhūtānām ca eva yat rūpam rūpam yat bhāvinām api su durdarśaḥ iva ādarśe kālaḥ eva upalabhyate kriyā bhedī yathā ekasmaḥ takṣa ādi ākhyā pravartate

original: kriyābhedāttathaikasmin nṛtvākhyācopajāyacate | viseṣṭamapi dhattaṃ tamupādāyāvakalpate || kālaḥ kālavidāmekaḥ kālādipravibhaktaye | tṛṇaparṇalatādīni yathā stroto'vakarṣati || pravartayati kālo'pi mātrā mātrāvatāṃ yathā | prārambhāveśaniṣṭhāsu sthitivipratipattiṣu || sāmyotkarṣeṣu nimittaṃ kāla iṣyate |
analyzed: kriyā bhedāt tathā ekasmin dhattam tam upādāya avakalpate kālaḥ kāla vidām ekaḥ kāla ādi pravibhaktaye tṛṇa parṇa latā ādīni yathā pravartayati kālaḥ api mātrā mātrāvatām yathā prārambha āveśa niṣṭhāsu sthiti vipratipattiṣu sāmya utkarṣeṣu nimittam kālaḥ iṣyate

original: saṃsargiṇāṃ tu ye bhedā viśeṣāstasya te matāḥ || saṃbhinnastaivyavasthānāṃ kālo bhedāya kalpate | prativyavasthaṃ kālasya vyāpāro na vyavasthitaḥ || kālo vā viśvarūpātmā vyāpārā iti kathyate | kriyāvacchedahetuṃ vā kriyāvacchedyameva vā || kālātmānamanāśritya vyavahartuṃ na śakyate | tasya vyaktasvarūpasya vyavahāre kriyākṛtāḥ ||
analyzed: saṃsargiṇām tu ye bhedāḥ viśeṣāḥ tasya te matāḥ saṃbhinnaḥ kālaḥ bhedāya kalpate prati vyavastham kālasya vyāpāraḥ na vyavasthitaḥ kālaḥ vā viśvarūpa ātmā vyāpārāḥ iti kathyate kriyā avaccheda hetum vā kriyā avacchedyam eva vā kāla ātmānam an āśritya vyavahartum na śakyate tasya vyakta svarūpasya vyavahāre kriyā kṛtāḥ

original: bhūtādayo mahābhedā yān loko nātivartate || ke punaste yān bhūta upādhau luṅādiviṣayānudahariṣyāmaḥ | tadetat dravyātmanaḥ kriyātmano vā kriyāparicchedinaḥ kālasya svarūpamabhihitam |
analyzed: bhūta ādayaḥ mahā bhedāḥ yān lokaḥ na ativartate ke punar te yān bhūte upādhau tat etat dravya ātmanaḥ kriyā ātmanaḥ vā kriyā paricchedinaḥ kālasya svarūpam abhihitam

original: athāparamaparimeyātmano devatādirūpasya svaśaktinimittaviśaavapravṛttiparicchedyasya tasya paricchedino vā kriyāhetiśaktayāyatanabhūtadravyarūpapariṇataṃ nivṛttaṃ vā, na samastanivṛttasaṃgrahānugrahādinityavanaimittikādirūpaṃ, svarūpamasti |
analyzed: atha aparam aparimeya ātmanaḥ devatā ādi rūpasya sva śakti nimitta viśaava pravṛtti paricchedyasya tasya paricchedinaḥ vā kriyā heti śaktayā āyatana bhūta dravya rūpa pariṇatam nivṛttam vā na samasta nivṛtta saṃgraha anugraha ādi nitya va naimittika ādi rūpam sva rūpam asti

original: tatpurastāt pratipāditaṃ, agrataśca viśeṣataḥ pratipādayiṣyata iti neha pratanyate, saṃbandhāvacchedārthaṃ tu leśato abhidhīyata iti | tatprabhedāddravyarūpo'pi kālaścatirdhā nityo, naimittikaḥ, svābhāviko, vaiparāmarśika iti | teṣu nityaśśaśvatiko vaikalpikaḥ naiyogikaśca tridhā | naimittiko'pi audyogikaḥ aupayogikaḥ prāyogikaśceti trividhaḥ |
analyzed: tat purastāt pratipāditam agratas ca viśeṣataḥ pratipādayiṣyate iti na iha pratanyate saṃbandha avaccheda artham tu leśataḥ abhidhīyate iti tad prabhedāt dravya rūpaḥ api kālaḥ ca tirdhā nityaḥ naimittikaḥ svābhāvikaḥ vaiparāmarśikaḥ iti teṣu nityaḥ śaśvatikaḥ vaikalpikaḥ naiyogikaḥ ca tridhā naimittikaḥ api audyogikaḥ aupayogikaḥ prāyogikaḥ ca iti trividhaḥ

original: evaṃ svābhāviko'pi āgantukaḥ naisargikaḥ sāmasargika iti tridhā | vaiparāmarśiko'pi saṅkīrṇaḥ prakīrṇo viprakūrṇa iti tridhaiva | teṣu kṣaṇanimeṣanāḍiḍḍatdhkāmuḍūḍḍatdhrtapraharāhorātrasvapaśśāśvatika, ayaṃ hi śaśvatpravartamāno nāvadhiviśeṣamapekṣate | yathā kṣaṇe nimeṣe nāḍyāṃ vā muhūrte prahare'hni vā |
analyzed: evam svābhāvikaḥ api āgantukaḥ naisargikaḥ sāmasargikaḥ iti tridhā vaiparāmarśikaḥ api saṅkīrṇaḥ prakīrṇaḥ viprakūrṇaḥ iti tridhā eva teṣu ayam hi śaśvat pravartamānaḥ na avadhi viśeṣam apekṣate yathā kṣaṇe nimeṣe nāḍyām vā muhūrte prahara ihni vā

original: gate tvameṣyasītyukte rurodha pathikaṃ priyā || dinārātripakṣamāsatrvayanarūpo vaikalpikaḥ | ayaṃ hi sūryodayādiviśṣṭamadhimapekṣamāṇo vikalpāya prabhavati | yathā dināni rātrayaḥ pakṣamāsāvṛturathāyanam | jarā vai yadyadaṅgānāṃ tattatpremṇo rasāyanam || saṃvatsarayugakalpamanvantarapralayamahāpralayarūpo naiyogikaḥ |
analyzed: gate tvam eṣyasi iti ukte rurodha pathikam priyā dinā rātri pakṣa māsa tru ayana rūpaḥ vaikalpikaḥ ayam hi sūrya udaya ādi viśṣṭam adhim apekṣamāṇaḥ vikalpāya prabhavati yathā dināni rātrayaḥ pakṣa māsau ṛtuḥ atha ayanam jarā vai yat yat aṅgānām tat tat premṇaḥ rasāyanam saṃvatsara yuga kalpa manvantara pralaya mahāpralaya rūpaḥ naiyogikaḥ

original: ayaṃ hi vṛhaspatitārāyaṇamuramathanabrahmaṇāṃ rājyādivṛttiviśeṣṭamevāvadhimapekṣamāṇāḥ prāṇino viśiṣṭāsu pravṛttiṣu niyuṅkte | yathā saṃvatsarairyugaiḥ kalpairmanubhiḥ pralayaiḥ kṣayaiḥ | hīyate hi jagatsarvamekaḥ kāmo na hīyate || te'mī śāśvatikavaikalpikanaiyogikāstrayo'pi kālabhedā nityā ucyante, nityarūpeṇaivānivāritapravṛttitvāt |
analyzed: ayam hi vṛhaspati tārāyaṇa mura mathana brahmaṇām rājya ādi vṛtti viśeṣṭam evā avadhim apekṣamāṇāḥ prāṇinaḥ viśiṣṭāsu pravṛttiṣu niyuṅkte yathā saṃvatsaraiḥ yugaiḥ kalpaiḥ manubhiḥ pralayaiḥ kṣayaiḥ hīyate hi jagat sarvam ekaḥ kāmaḥ na hīyate te imī śāśvatika vaikalpika naiyogikāḥ trayaḥ api kāla bhedāḥ nityāḥ ucyante nitya rūpeṇa eva a nivārita pravṛtti tvāt

original: prātaḥpratyūṣapāhṇamadhyāhnasandhyārūpa audyogikaḥ | ayaṃ hyupekṣitahavirbhāgapaurvāparyāvadhiḥ prāṇināṃ prabodhotthānasnanabhojanaprasādhanavihārāderudyogasya nimittaṃ bhavati | yathā prātaḥ pratyūṣayorasnāti bhuṅkte sandhyāparāhṇayoḥ | prāhṇamadhyāhnayoryūnāṃ śate manasi manmathaḥ ||
analyzed: prātar pratyūṣa pāhṇa madhyāhna sandhyā rūpaḥ audyogikaḥ ayam hi upekṣita haviḥ bhāga paurvāparya avadhiḥ prāṇinām prabodha utthāna snana bhojana prasādhana vihāra ādeḥ udyogasya nimittam bhavati yathā prātar pratyūṣayoḥ a snāti bhuṅkte sandhyā parāhṇayoḥ prāhṇa madhyāhnayoḥ yūnām śate manasi manmathaḥ

original: ayaṃ hyapekṣitaparātrivibhāgapaurvāparyāvadhiḥ kāmināṃ dūtīsaṃpreṣaṇaprekṣānidrāsukhamadhupānābhisaraṇāderupabhogasya nimittaṃ bhavati | yathā niśāmukhe pradoṣe ca niśīthāpararātrayoḥ | indoḥ prakāśe nāśe vā suptaḥ kāmo vibudhyate || śaraddhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmarūpaḥ prāyogikaḥ |
analyzed: ayam hi apekṣita para ātri vibhāga paurvāparya avadhiḥ kāminām dūtī saṃpreṣaṇa prekṣā nidrā sukha madhu pāna abhisaraṇa ādeḥ upabhogasya nimittam bhavati yathā niśā mukhe pradoṣe ca niśītha apararātrayoḥ indoḥ prakāśe nāśe vā suptaḥ kāmaḥ vibudhyate śarad hemanta śiśira vasanta grīṣma rūpaḥ prāyogikaḥ

original: ayaṃ hyapekṣitasaṃvatsaraviṣupaurvāparyāvādhiṃ prāṇināṃ kāmakṛtacittevaikṛtānāṃ prayoganimittaṃ bhavati | yathā śaraddhemantayoranyadanyadvarṣāvasantayoḥ | himartugriṣmayoranyatkāmāvasthā pravartate || te'mī trayo'pyaudyogikaupayogikaprāyogikāḥ kālabhedāḥ naimittikāḥ, nityatvepyeśāmudyogādernimittātvāt |
analyzed: ayam hi apekṣita saṃvatsara viṣu paurvāparya avādhim prāṇinām kāmakṛta citta ivaikṛtānām prayoga nimittam bhavati yathā śarad hemantayoḥ anyat anyat varṣā vasantayoḥ hima ṛtu griṣmayoḥ anyat kāma avasthā pravartate te imī trayaḥ api audyogika aupayogika prāyogikāḥ kāla bhedāḥ naimittikāḥ nitya tve pi īśām udyoga ādeḥ nimitta ātvāt

original: madapramādābhyudayotsavavyasanaparihārābhirūpa āgantukaḥ | sa hi viśiṣṭakriyopanipātādikamavadhimapekṣamāṇaḥ prāṇināṃ madapramadādirūpeṇaivāgacchati | yathā madapramadaharṣeṣu vyasaneṣūtsaveṣu ca | parihāseṣu ca prāyaḥ kāmassāmānyamarhati || bālyakaumārayauvamanamaigdhyamādhyasthyaprāgalbhyādirūpo naisarhikaḥ |

original: tadyathākarmakāḥ, antaḥkarmakāḥ, arthānatarakarmakāḥ, avivatritakarmakāḥ, prasiddhakarmakāḥ, dvikarmakāḥ, prasiddhakartṛkāḥ, bhāvakartṛkāḥ, karmakartṛkāḥ, kartṛsthakriyāḥ, karmasthakriyāḥ, ubhasthakriyāśceti | te cāparispandasaparispandabhedāt pratyekaṃ dvidhā bhūtvā catirviṃśatirjāyante |

original: tatra svabhāvatostiḥ tadudāsīnakartṛkatvādaparispandaḥ |karotiḥ prayuñcānakartṛkatvātsaparispandaḥ | bhavatiḥ vikurvāṇakartṛkatvātsaparispandāparispanda iti sthitam | ato'styarthāśca nyagbhavatayo nyagastayaścākarmakā bhavanti | teṣu pūrve aparisampandā yāta bhidyate, svadate, vartate, prīyate iti |

original: uttare saparispanadāḥ yathā jāyate, vivardhate, spharatīti | ta eva nyakkarotayo'ntaḥ karmakāḥ, teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā jīvati, mriyate, putrīyate, prāṇitīti | uttare saparispandāḥ yatā nṛtyāti, śvasiti, vāṣpāyate, roditīti | astikarotyarthāḥ karotibhavatvarthāścārthaāntarakarmakāḥ |

original: teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā tarati kāṣṭhaṃ, tarati vipadaṃ viparyasti matiṃ, viparyasyati hastamiti | uttare saparispandāḥyathā vahati bhāraṃ, patati parṇam, patatyadhvānamiti | ata evanutkarotayo'pi vivakṣitakarmakāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā śaṃjñā saṃjñinyabhiniviśate, buddhistattvamabhiniviśate, tīrthe upavasati, trirātramupavasatīti |
analyzed: teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā tarati kāṣṭham tarati vipadam viparyasti matim viparyasyati hastam iti uttare sa parispandāḥ yathā vahati bhāram patati parṇam patati adhvānam iti atas vivakṣita karmakāḥ teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā śaṃjñā saṃjñinī abhiniviśate buddhiḥ tattvam abhiniviśate tīrthe upavasati tri rātram upavasati iti

original: teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathārhati pūjāṃ, jānāti varṇe, paśyati rūpaṃ, śṛṇoti śabdamiti | uttare saparismapandāḥ yathā gacchati grāmaṃ, ārohayatyāśvamiti | nyagbhavatyutkarotayo nyagastyutkarotayo vā karmasthākriyāḥ | teśu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā dunoti śatruṃ, dhinoti mitraṃ, madayati suhṛdaṃ, sukhayati sakhāyamiti |

original: uttare saparispandāḥ yathā pacatyodanaṃ, bhinatti kusūlaṃ, saṃkṣṇute ślakṣṇayate vā śastraṃ, takṣṇoti vā ubhayasthakriyāḥ |teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā labhate pūjāṃ, prāpnoti dharmaṃ | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā bhuṅkta odanaṃ, adhīte svādhyāyaṃ, tapyate tapaḥ, sādhayati svargāmiti |

original: nanu ca, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt, bhavedapi bhavet, syādipi syāditi naitānavastibhavatyarthāvapi tu sākṣādastibhavatī | tau cānupahitakriyābhidhāyakāviti nopādhībhavitumarhataḥ | ucyate, asabhuvi, bhūsattāyāmiti dhātupāṭhādanuprayogavarjamārdhadhātuke'sterbhūvidhānātsaṅkaraḥ eveti vijñāyate | evamapi kārotyarthānupraveśo durupapādaḥ |

original: so'pi kartṛtvānvayathānupapatterupapadyate | nanu ca, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīdītyayaṃ laṭ prayoga eva | astigacchāmo vayamiti ca astiprayogo'pi bhāvakartṛkeṣu dṛśyate | naivam, nāsmābhirastibhavatī bhāvakartṛkāvucyete | api tu astibhavati kartāro'styādayaḥ pacatyādayayaśca | te hi rujātyādivadupadhirā apyastau kartāro bhavanti |

original: etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ rūjādīnāṃ kartṛtvaṃ tatpareṇaiva lakāreṇocyate | pacādīnāṃ ca bhavatyastipareṇeti, yathā ca dhātvarthaḥ kriyoṣādhirevaṃ kālepi | yaduktaṃ kiyāpādhiśca saṃbhūtabhāviṣyadvartamānatāḥ | parāparavibhāgārthāssaśaktiḥ pratipadyate || sa bhūtādibhedāddhādaśādhā |

original: tadyātā bhūtaḥ, bhūtānadyamaॉtanaḥ, bhaviṣyat, bhaviṣyadanadyatanaḥ, vartamānaḥ, vartamānānadyatanaḥ, parokṣaḥ, atapannaḥ, avyaktaḥ, saṅkīrṇaḥ, prakīrṇaḥ, viprakīrṇa iti | luṅādiviṣaśayo'ṣyatītamātraṃ bhūtaḥ, sa ṣoḍhā bhūtaḥ, prakarṣabhūtaḥ, bhūtānadyatanaḥ, abhimānādyatanaḥ, prabandhādyatanaḥ, sāmīpyādyatanaḥ iti |

original: teṣvanirdhāritaviśeṣo bhūto yathākarṣīt, niṣasāda, uvāsa, śuśrāva, apakta, paktavāniti | śabdāntarāvagataprakarṣādanavekṣitānadyatanaparokṣādipratyayaḥ prakarṣabhūtaḥ yathāvātsuriha purā cchātrāḥ | vivakṣitānyāvadhirbhūtānadyatanaḥ, yathānyāmagāmaghoṣāt |

original: rātriśeṣo jāgaraṇasaṃtatāvabhimānānadyatanaḥ, yathāmutrāvātsam, kaॉsakalāṃ rātriṃ jāgaritaḥ, rātrerabhāttavādadyatanamina kālaṃ manyate| avivakṣitakriyāvirāmaḥ prabandhādyatanaḥ |yathā yāvajjīvaṃ bhṛṣamannamadāt | vivakṣitakriyānantaryaḥ sāmūpyādyatanaḥ sāmītyādyatanaḥ | yathā yeyaṃ gatā paurṇamāsī asyāmupādhyāyo'gnīnādadhīta |
analyzed: rātri śeṣaḥ jāgaraṇa saṃtatau abhimānān adyatanaḥ yathā amutra avātsam kālam manyate avivakṣita kriyā virāmaḥ prabandha adyatanaḥ yathā yāvajjīvam bhṛṣam annam adāt vivakṣita kriyā ānantaryaḥ sāmūpya adyatanaḥ sāmītya adyatanaḥ yathā yā iyam gatā paurṇamāsī asyām upādhyāyaḥ ognīn ādadhīta

original: atrānantarayornā'nadyatanavat kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoriti smaryate | evaṃ laṅnimittamavidyamānādyatano bhūtādyatanaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā śāmānyānadyatanaḥ, viśeṣānadyatanaḥ, abhijñānadyatinaḥ, prasiddhāparokṣaḥ, praśnāparokṣaḥ, haśaśvadaparokṣa iti | teṣvavivakṣitaparokṣatvādiḥ sāmānyānadyatanaḥ | yathā yāvajjīvaṃ bhūśamannamadāt |

analyzed: sāmīpye yathā kadā grāmam gamiṣyasi eṣa gacchāmi gacchantam eva mām viddhi evam bhūta anupraveśe api bhūta sāmīpye yathā kadā grāmāt āgataḥ usi eṣaḥ āgacchami āgacchantam eva mām viddhi pṛṣṭā prativacane yathā ayi bhoḥ kaṭam akārṣīḥ kaṭam devadatta nanu karomi ayam nu karomi iti bhaviṣyataḥ bhūta anupraveśe bhūtasya bhaviṣyat anupraveśām viprakīrṇaḥ

original: atha kathaṃ nityapravṛttasya vartamānaprāptāvapi tasthuḥ sthāsyanti girayaḥ, mārge kūpo'bhūt, kūpo bhaviṣyatīti bhūtabhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaḥ prayogo bhavati | ucyate | hehayādiveśeṣu ye rājāno babhuvuḥ teṣāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ tāsāmatītatvat tatsambandhavivakṣāyāṃ bhūtakālaviṣayaṃ pratyayaṃ prayuṅkte, hehayarājye'pi parvatā ityanena tasthuriti |
analyzed: atha katham nitya pravṛttasya vartamāna prāptau api tasthuḥ sthāsyanti girayaḥ mārge kūpaḥ bhūt kūpaḥ bhaviṣyati iti bhūta bhaviṣyat kāla viṣayaḥ prayogaḥ bhavati ucyate hehaya ādi veśeṣu ye rājānaḥ babhuvuḥ teṣām yāḥ kriyāḥ tāsām atīta tvat tad sambandha vivakṣāyām bhūta kāla viṣayam pratyayam prayuṅkte hehaya rājye api parvatāḥ iti anena tasthuḥ iti

original: tathā āgāmimanvantareṣu ye rājāno bhaviṣyanti teṣāṃ yāḥ kriyāstāsāṃ bhaviṣyatvāttatsambandhavivakṣayāṃ bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaṃ pratyayaṃ prayuṅkte | yadā balirindro bhaviṣyati tadāpītthameva parvatāḥ sthāsyantīti | evaṃ kūpasyāpi bhūtabhaviṣyaddarśanakriyāsambandhāt abhūdabhaviṣyatīti kriyābhisambandho na virudhyata iti |

original: upagraho'pi prakṛtyarthopādhireva | kaḥ punarasau parasmaipadātmanepadobhayapināmātmanepadaparasmaipadayoganimittamarthaviśeṣaḥ | taduktam | ya ātmanepadādbhedaḥ kkacidarthasya gamyate | parasmaipadato vāpi manyante tamupagraham || yathā nāthati nāthate, śapati śapate, āhvayati āhvayate, pratijānāti pratijānīta iti |

original: atrāśiṣi nāthaḥ, śapa upālambhane, spardhāyāmāḍaḍḍatdhḥ, sampratibhyāmanādhyāne, jñā ātmanepadaṃ, śeṣe parasmaipadamityarthabhedāḥ | evaṃ miṇḍo bhīṣayate, kuñcikayainaṃ bhāyayati, jaṭilo vismapayate, matyainaṃ vismāpayati | śyeno vartikāmullāpayate, kastvāmullāpayati, saṃpravadante grāmyāḥ, saṃprapadanti śakunaya iti |
analyzed: atra āśiṣi nāthaḥ śapaḥ upālambhane spardhāyām āḍaṭ ḍatdhḥ sam pratibhyām an ādhyāne jñā ātmanepadam śeṣe parasmaipadam iti artha bhedāḥ evam miṇḍaḥ bhīṣayate kuñcikayā enam bhāyayati jaṭilaḥ vismapayate matyā enam vismāpayati śyenaḥ vartikām ullāpayate kaḥ tvām ullāpayati saṃpravadante grāmyāḥ saṃprapadanti śakunayaḥ iti

original: atra bhīsmyorhecatubhaye, liyaḥ sammānanaśālimīkaraṇayośca, vyaktavācāṃ samuñcāraṇe, vada ātmanepadaṃ, śeṣe parasmaipadamityarthabhedaḥ | evamanayadapyūhanīyam | nanu ca, “ya ātmanepadāt bhedaḥ kkacidarthasya gamyata” ityatra kkacidnrahaṇaṃ kimartham? ucyate |
analyzed: atra bhī smyoḥ he catu bhaye liyaḥ sammānana śālimīkaraṇayoḥ ca vyakta vācām samuñcāraṇe vade ātmanepadam śeṣe parasmaipadam iti artha bhedaḥ evam anayat api ūhanīyam nanu ca yaḥ ātmanepadāt bhedaḥ kkacid arthasya gamyate iti atra kimartham ucyate

original: parasmaipadātmanepadobhayapadananāmātmanepadapasasmaipadobhayapadayogaḥ ṣaṭ prakāro bhavati | prakṛtinimittaḥ, prakṛtyarthanimittaḥ, pratyayanimittaḥ, pratyayārthanimittaḥ, upaskāranimittaḥ, upaskārārthanimittaśca | tatrārthanimitteṣu yathāyogamarthāvagatihetutvaṃ vidyate, śeṣeṣu tu na vidyate | kkacidnrahaṇena jñāpayati |
analyzed: ṣaṣ prakāraḥ bhavati prakṛti nimittaḥ prakṛti artha nimittaḥ pratyaya nimittaḥ pratyaya artha nimittaḥ upaskāra nimittaḥ upaskāra artha nimittaḥ ca tatra artha nimitteṣu yathāyogam artha avagati hetu tvam vidyate śeṣeṣu tu na vidyate jñāpayati

original: tatrātmanepadayogaḥ prakṛtanimitto yathānudāttaṅita ātmanepadam, jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ, edhate cyavate susmūrṣate didṛkṣata, iti | prakṛtyarthanimitto yathā prakāśanastheyākhyayośca, bhujo'navane, gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhate, karmavyatīhāre tiṣṭhate bhuṅkte gandhāyate vyatilunīta iti |
analyzed: tatra ātmanepada yogaḥ prakṛta nimittaḥ yathā anudātta ṅ itaḥ ātmanepadam jñā śru smṛ dṛśām sanaḥ edhate cyavate susmūrṣate didṛkṣate iti prakṛti artha nimittaḥ yathā prakāśana stheya ākhyayoḥ ca bhujaḥ navane gṛdhi vañcyoḥ pralambhate karma vyatīhāre tiṣṭhate bhuṅkte gandhāyate vyatilunīte iti

original: pratyayanimitto yathā vipārabhyāṃ jeḥ, samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ, samastṛtīyāyuktāt, mithyopapadātkṛño'bhyāse, vijayate parājayate, saṃtiṣṭhate avatiṣṭhate pratiṣṭhate vitiṣṭhate, aśvenasañcarate, padaṃ mithyākārayati |

original: upaskārārthanimitto yathā veḥ pādaviharaṇe, āṅojyetirudbhamane, upāṅ mantrakaraṇe, dāṇaścasāceñcatuthryarte, vikramate vājī, ākramate jyotaḥ, sāvitryupatiṣṭhate, dāsyā saṃyacchata iti | prakṛtinimittaḥ parasmaipayoge yathā śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam, bhavati vyatihasanti, vyatiharanti, parasparasya vyati |
analyzed: upaskāra artha nimittaḥ yathā veḥ pāda viharaṇe āṅaḥ jyetiḥ udbhamane upāṅ mantra karaṇe vikramate vājī ākramate jyotaḥ sāvitrī upatiṣṭhate dāsyā saṃyacchate iti prakṛti nimittaḥ parasmaipa yoge yathā śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam bhavati vyatihasanti vyatiharanti parasparasya vyatihāraḥ

original: pratyayārthanimitto yathā kuṣirajauḥ prācāṃ śyan, parasmaipadaṃ ca, śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam | rajyati vastraṃ svayameva, kuṣyati pādassvayameva, rajyate vastram, kuṣyate pādamiti, upaskāranimitto yathānuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ | itaretarānyonyopapadāñca, anukaroti parākaroti, itaretasya vyatilunanti, anyonyasya vyatilunantīti |
analyzed: pratyaya artha nimittaḥ yathā kuṣi rajauḥ prācām śyan parasmaipadam ca śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam rajyati vastram svayam eva kuṣyati pādaḥ svayam eva rajyate vastram kuṣyate pādam iti upaskāra nimittaḥ yathā anu parābhyām kṛñaḥ itaretara anyonya upapadān ca anukaroti parākaroti itaretasya vyatilunanti anyonyasya vyatilunanti iti

original: upaskārārthanimitto yathā śamo'kūjane, āṅodo'nāsyaviharaṇe, udo'nūdhrvakarmaṇi, prāderajādyantarādyujerayajñapātreṣu, saṃkrīḍaḍḍatdhnti śakaṭāḥ, vyāghro mukhaṃ vyādadāta, āsanāduttiṣṭhati, yajñapātrāṇi prayunaktīti | ubhayapadayogaprakṛtinimitto yathā vākyaṣaḥ, anupasargādvā, lohitāyati lohitāyate, krāmati kramata iti |
analyzed: upaskāra artha nimittaḥ yathā śama ukūjane āṅ uda ūna āsya viharaṇe uda ūna ūdhrva karmaṇi pra ādeḥ a c ādi antarāt yujeḥ a yajña pātreṣu saṃkrīḍat ḍatdhnti śakaṭāḥ vyāghraḥ mukham vyādadāte āsanāt uttiṣṭhati yajña pātrāṇi prayunakti iti ubhaya pada yoga prakṛti nimittaḥ yathā vākyaṣaḥ an upasargāt vā lohitāyati lohitāyate krāmati kramate iti

original: prakṛtyarthanimitto yathā vibhāṣākarmakāt vibhāṣā vipralāpe, uparamiti uparamate, saṃpravadanti mauhūrtāḥ saṃpravadante mauhūrtā iti | pratyayārthanimitto yatā rajāyati rajyate, kuṣyati kuṣyate, kuṣirajauḥ prācāṃ śyan, parasmaipadaṃ ca karmakartari, iti | upaskāranimitto yathopasargādasyātyūhyorvā, udasyati udasyate, samūhati samūhata iti |
analyzed: prakṛti artha nimittaḥ yathā vibhāṣā akarmakāt vibhāṣā vipralāpe uparamiti uparamate saṃpravadanti mauhūrtāḥ saṃpravadante mauhūrtāḥ iti pratyaya artha nimittaḥ yatā rajāyati rajyate kuṣyati kuṣyate kuṣi rajauḥ prācām śyan parasmaipadam ca karma kartari iti upaskāra nimittaḥ yathā upasargāt asya atiūhyoḥ vā udasyati udasyate samūhati samūhate iti

original: upaskārārthanimitto yathā vā lupsāyām, vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne, bhikṣuko brāhmaṇākulamupatiṣṭhati upatiṣṭhate, brāhmaṇassvaṃ yajñaṃ yajati, yajata iti | evamanye'pi hetulakṣaṇābhīkṣṇyabhṛśārthagarhākauṭilyasākalyapūrvakālatādathryādayaḥ prakṛtyarthopādhiviśeṣā veditavyātaḥ |
analyzed: upaskāra artha nimittaḥ yathā vā lupsāyām vibhāṣā upapadena pratīyamāne bhikṣukaḥ brāhmaṇā kulam upatiṣṭhati upatiṣṭhate brāhmaṇaḥ svam yajñam yajati yajate iti evam anye api hetu lakṣaṇa ābhīkṣṇya bhṛśa artha garhā kauṭilya sākalya pūrva kāla tādathrya ādayaḥ prakṛti artha upādhi viśeṣāḥ veditavyā atas

original: sa tridhā dhātvarthaḥ prātipadikārthaśśoṣaśca | tatra dhātvarthastridhā | bhāvaḥ kriyā kārakañca | teṣu bhāvo dvidhā śattvabhūto'sattvabhūtaśca | tayorliṅgaṅkhyāyogi satvabhūtaḥ yathāvacanaṃ vacanaṃ pratiyasannidhāvanavalokanameva vilokanam | avayavāvaraṇaṃ ca yadaṃśukavyakareṇa tadaṅgasamarpaṇam ||

original: aliṅgasaṅkhyo'sattvabhūto yathāpi prasannena maharṣiṇā tvaṃ samyagvinīyānumato samyagvinīyānumato gṛhāya | kālohyayaṃ saṃkramituṃ dvitīyaṃ sarvopakārakṣamamāśrayaṃ te || kriyā dvidhā śuddhā saṅkīrṇā ca | tayoḥ kārakāsaṃpṛktā śuddhā yathā pallavomitisāmyasapakṣaṃ daṣṭavatyadharabimbamabhīṣṭe | paryakūji sarujeva taruṇyāstāralolavalayena kareṇa ||
