original: sākākṣaṃ yathā paṭamivācarati paṭīyati kambanam, prāsādamivācarati prāsādīyati kuṭīm | nirākāṃkṣā yathā putramicchati putrīyati, pucchamudasyatyutpucchayata iti | ubhayasambandhinī dvidhā, kriyākārakasambandhinī kārakakriyāsambandhinī ca | tayoḥ prathamā yathā pacantaṃ prayuṅkte pācayati devadattaḥ, adīyānaṃ puyuṅkte adhyāpayati kārīṣo'gniḥ |
analyzed: sākākṣam yathā paṭam iva ācarati paṭīyati kambanam prāsādam iva ācarati prāsādīyati kuṭīm nirākāṃkṣā yathā putram icchati putrīyati puccham udasyati utpucchayate iti ubhaya sambandhinī dvidhā kriyā kāraka sambandhinī kāraka kriyā sambandhinī ca tayoḥ prathamā yathā pacantam prayuṅkte pācayati devadattaḥ adīyānam adhyāpayati kārīṣa ugniḥ

original: dvitīyā yathā kaṃsavadhamāṣṭe kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, ārātrivivāsamācaṣṭe rātriṃ vivāsayati | dravyamapi tridhā, viśeṣyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavahitañca | teṣu viśeṣyaṃ dvidhā, sāpekṣamanapekṣañca | sāpekṣaṃ yathā yuṣmākamayaṃ yauṣmāko gauḥ, vatsebhyo hito vatsīyo godhuk | anapekṣaṃ yathā vasiṣṭhasyāpatyaṃ vāsiṣṭhaḥ, pṛthivyā īśvaraḥ pārthivaḥ |
analyzed: dvitīyā yathā kaṃsa vadham āṣṭe kaṃsam ghātayati ā rātri vivāsam ācaṣṭe rātrim vivāsayati dravyam api tridhā viśeṣyam viśeṣaṇam vyavahitam ca teṣu viśeṣyam dvidhā sāpekṣam anapekṣam ca sāpekṣam yathā yuṣmākam ayam yauṣmākaḥ gauḥ vatsebhyaḥ hitaḥ vatsīyaḥ go dhuk anapekṣam yathā vasiṣṭhasya apatyam vāsiṣṭhaḥ pṛthivyāḥ īśvaraḥ pārthivaḥ

original: viśeṣaṇaṃ dvidhā, dharminiṣṭhaṃ dharmaniṣṭhaṃ yathā gāvo'sya santīti gomān, prāsādo'sya syātprāsādīyaṃ dāru | dharmaniṣṭhaṃ yathāstīti matirasyāstikaḥ, nāstīti matirasya nāstika iti | vyavahitaṃ dvidhā, viśeṣyarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇarūpaṃ ca | viśeṣaṇarūpaṃyathā dvimayamudaśvinyavānāṃ dvamayā yavāḥ udaścitaḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇam dvidhā dharmi niṣṭham dharma niṣṭham yathā gāvaḥ asya santi iti gomān prāsādaḥ usya syāt prāsādīyam dāru dharma niṣṭham yathā asti iti matiḥ asya āstikaḥ na asti iti matiḥ asya nāstikaḥ iti vyavahitam dvidhā viśeṣya rūpam viśeṣaṇa rūpam ca viśeṣaṇa rūpam yathā dvi mayam udaśvin yavānām dvi mayāḥ yavāḥ udaścitaḥ

original: viśeṣaṇarūpaṃ yathā pañcamo māso'sya jātasya pañcamī bālakaḥ, ṣaṣṭhaṃ rūpagranthagrahaṇamasya ṣaṭko vaṭuḥ | guṇo'pi tridhā, āśritaḥ pravṛttinimittamupādhiṣcaṭa | teṣaavāśrito dvidhā, abhinnarūpo bhinnarūpaśca | tayorabhinnarūpe yathā bhikṣāṇāṃ samūho bhekṣam, kākolūkasya vairaṃ kākolūkikā |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa rūpam yathā pañcamaḥ māsaḥ asya jātasya pañcamī bālakaḥ ṣaṣṭham rūpa grantha grahaṇam asya ṣaṭkaḥ vaṭuḥ guṇaḥ api tridhā āśritaḥ pravṛtti nimittam upādhiḥ caṭa dvidhā abhinna rūpaḥ bhinna rūpaḥ ca tayoḥ abhinna rūpe yathā bhikṣāṇām samūhaḥ bhekṣam kāka ulūkasya vairam kāka ulūkikā

original: bhinnarūpo yathartvijāṃ karmāÐtvajyaṃ, pīlūnāṃ pākaḥ pīlukaṇa iti | pravṛttinimittaṃ dvidhā, anuñjakamananurañjakaṃ ca | tatrānurañjakaṃ jātyādi yathā brāhmaṇasya bhāvaḥ brāhmaṇyaṃ, ṛḍorbhāvaḥ ārjavamiti | anunurañjakaṃ saṃbandhādi, yathā daṇḍiḍḍatdhno bāvo daṇḍiḍḍatdhtvam, pācakasya bhāvaḥ pācakateti | prakṛtyartapratyayārthayorviseṣaṇamupādhiḥ |
analyzed: bhinna rūpaḥ yathā ṛtvijām karmāñtvajyam pīlūnām pākaḥ pīlu kaṇaḥ iti pravṛtti nimittam dvidhā anuñjakam ananurañjakam ca tatra anurañjakam jāti ādi yathā brāhmaṇasya bhāvaḥ brāhmaṇyam bhāvaḥ ārjavam iti anunurañjakam saṃbandha ādi yathā bāvaḥ daṇḍiḍḍatdhnaḥ bāvaḥ daṇḍiḍḍatdhtvam pācakasya bhāvaḥ pācaka tā iti prakṛti arta pratyaya arthayoḥ viseṣaṇam upādhiḥ

original: sa dvidhā, vyastassamastaśca | vyastaḥ prakṛtyarthe yathā śivo devatā'sceti śevaṃ, lavaṇaṃ paṣyamasyeti | sāvaṇikaḥ | pratyayārthe yathā gārgikayā ślāghate, kāṭhikayā'dhikṣipati | atra devatāpayaṇyaślāghādhikṣepā upādhayaḥ | samasto yatā daṇḍāḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ krīḍāyāṃ dāṇḍā |
analyzed: sa dvidhā vyastaḥ samastaḥ ca vyastaḥ prakṛti arthe yathā śivaḥ devatāḥ ca iti śevam lavaṇam paṣyam asya iti sāvaṇikaḥ pratyaya arthe yathā gārgikayā ślāghate kāṭhikayā adhikṣipati atra devatā āpayaṇya ślāghā adhikṣepāḥ upādhayaḥ samastaḥ yatāḥ daṇḍāḥ praharaṇam asyām krīḍāyām dāṇḍā

original: atra daṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdāt tadasyāmityadhikaraṇe pratyayo vihito daṇḍaḍḍatdhsthaṃ praharaṇatvaṃ, adhikaraṇatvaṃ ca krīḍātvaṃ pratyāyati | evaṃ hyogodohasya vikāro haiyaṅgavīnaṃ navanītam | atra hyogośabdādvikāre pratyayo vihitaḥ, prakṛtyarthopādhiṃ dohaṃ pratyayārthopādhiṃ ca saṃjñāṃ pratyāyatīti |
analyzed: atra daṇḍaḍḍatdh śabdāt tat asyām iti adhikaraṇe pratyayaḥ vihitaḥ daṇḍaḍḍatdh stham praharaṇa tvam adhikaraṇa tvam ca krīḍā tvam pratyāyati evam hi ogodohasya vikāraḥ haiyaṅgavīnam navanītam atra hi ogo śabdāt vikāre pratyayaḥ vihitaḥ prakṛti artha upādhim doham pratyaya artha upādhim ca saṃjñām pratyāyati iti

original: kārakaṃ tridhā, sakriyaṃ bhinnakriyamabhinnakriyaṃ ca | teṣu sakriyaṃ tridhā, kartṛrūpaṃ karmarūpamanusyūtañca | kartṛrūpaṃ dvidhā, kriyāviśeṣasthaṃ kārakaviśeṣasthaṃ ca |
analyzed: kārakam tridhā sa kriyam bhinna kriyam abhinna kriyam ca teṣu sa kriyam tridhā kartṛ rūpam karma rūpam anusyūtam ca kartṛ rūpam dvidhā kriyā viśeṣa stham kāraka viśeṣa stham ca

original: tayoḥ kriyāviśeṣasthaṃ yathā susnātaṃ pṛcchati sausnātikaḥ, evaṃ saukhaśāyanikaḥ, prabhūtamāha prābhūmāha prabhūtikaḥ, evaṃ māśabdikaḥ, pratīpaṃ vartate prātīpikaḥ, pratikūlaṃ carati prātikūlika iti |
analyzed: tayoḥ kriyā viśeṣa stham yathā susnātam pṛcchati sausnātikaḥ evam saukhaśāyanikaḥ prabhūtam āha prābhūm āha prabhūtikaḥ evam māśabdikaḥ pratīpam vartate prātīpikaḥ pratikūlam carati prātikūlikaḥ iti

original: kārakaviśeṣasthaṃ yathā vyākaraṇaṃ vettyadhīte vā vaiyākaṇaḥ, samāṃ samāṃ vijāyate samāṃsamīnā, akṣairdīvyatyākṣikaḥ, saṃtāpāya prabhavati sāntāpikaḥ, puturāgataṃ pitryaṃ, samānodare śayitaḥ sodarya iti | karmarūpaṃ dvidhā, sajātīyasthamasajātīyasthaṃ ca |
analyzed: kāraka viśeṣa stham yathā vyākaraṇam vetti adhīte vā vaiyākaṇaḥ samām samām vijāyate sa māṃsa mīnāḥ akṣaiḥ dīvyati ākṣikaḥ saṃtāpāya prabhavati sāntāpikaḥ putuḥ āgatam pitryam samāna udare śayitaḥ sodaryaḥ iti karma rūpam dvidhā sajātīya stham asajātīya stham ca

original: sajātīyasthaṃ yathāyanaṃ neyaḥ āyānayīnaḥ śāraḥ, māsaṃ bhṛto māsiko bhṛtyaḥ, varṣamadhīṣṭo vārṣiko upādhyāyaḥ, pakṣaṃ lakṣaḥ pākṣiko nibandhaḥ, ṣaṇmāsaṃ krītaḥ ṣāṇmāsiko dāsaḥ, saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtassaṃvatsariko'bhyāsa iti |
analyzed: sajātīya stham yathāyanam neyaḥ āyāna yīnaḥ śāraḥ māsam bhṛtaḥ māsikaḥ bhṛtyaḥ varṣam adhīṣṭaḥ vārṣikaḥ upādhyāyaḥ pakṣam lakṣaḥ pākṣikaḥ nibandhaḥ ṣaṣ māsam krītaḥ ṣāṇmāsikaḥ dāsaḥ saṃvatsaram kṛtaḥ saṃvatsarikaḥ abhyāsaḥ iti

original: asajātīyasthaṃ yathā vāmadevena dṛṣṭaṃ vāmadevyaṃ sāma, lākṣayā raktaṃ vastraṃ lākṣikaṃ, devāya deyaṃ daivyaṃ haviḥ, tantrādacirāpahṛtaḥ tantrakaḥ paṭaḥ, dvāre niyukto dauvārikaḥ pumān, caturdaśyāṃ dṛśyate cāturdaśyaṃ rakṣa iti | arthāntarānubandhanamanusyūtam | taddvidhā, kriyānusyūtaṃ kārakānusyūtaṃ ca |
analyzed: asajātīya stham yathā vāmadevena dṛṣṭam vāmadevyam sāma lākṣayā raktam vastram lākṣikam devāya deyam daivyam haviḥ tantrāt acira apahṛtaḥ tantrakaḥ paṭaḥ dvāre niyuktaḥ dauvārikaḥ pumān caturdaśyām dṛśyate cāturdaśyam rakṣaḥ iti artha antara anubandhanam anusyūtam tat dvidhā kriyā anusyūtam kāraka anusyūtam ca

original: tayoḥ kriyānusyūtaṃ yathā śītānveṣaṇamadhikṛtya kṛto granthaḥ sītānveṣaṇīyaḥ, evaṃ kirātārjunīyaḥ, vākyapadīyaḥ, pauṣī paurṇamāsī asminmāse bhavati pauṣaḥ, evamāgrahāyaṇikaḥ aśvatthika iti |
analyzed: tayoḥ kriyā anusyūtam yathā śīta anveṣaṇam adhikṛtya kṛtaḥ granthaḥ sītānveṣaṇīyaḥ evam kirātārjunīyaḥ vākyapadīyaḥ pauṣī paurṇamāsī asmin māse bhavati pauṣaḥ evam āgrahāyaṇikaḥ aśvatthikaḥ iti

original: kārakānusyūtaṃ yathā tittiriṇā proktaṃ vedaṃ vidantyadhīyate vā taittiriyāśchātrāḥ, evaṃ vāratantavīyāḥ, egaleyinaḥ, aitareyiṇaḥ, tathā pārāśariṇo bhikṣavaḥ, śailālino naṭāḥ | bhinnakriyaṃ tridhā, lakṣitakriyamapekṣitakriyamanumatākriyaṃ ca | teṣu lakṣitakriyaṃ dvidhā, kartṛsthaṃ karmasthaṃ ca |
analyzed: kāraka anusyūtam yathā tittiriṇā proktam vedam vidanti adhīyate vā taittiriyāḥ chātrāḥ evam vāratantavīyāḥ egaleyinaḥ aitareyiṇaḥ tathā pārāśariṇaḥ bhikṣavaḥ śailālinaḥ naṭāḥ bhinna kriyam tridhā lakṣita kriyam apekṣita kriyam anumata akriyam ca teṣu lakṣita kriyam dvidhā kartṛ stham karma stham ca

original: tayoḥ kartṛsthaṃ yathā mudnā bhavantayasmānmaudnīnaṃ kṣetram, daṇḍiḍḍatdhnaḥ santyasyāṃ daṇḍiḍḍatdhmatī śālā | karmasthaṃ yatā śrāddhamanena bhuktaṃ śrāddhikaḥ, agrabhojanamasmai dīyate āgrabhojanikaḥ, padamasmin dṛśyaṃ padyaḥ kardama iti | apekṣitakriyaṃ dvidhā, vyahitamavyavahitaṃ ca |
analyzed: tayoḥ kartṛ stham yathā mudnāḥ santi asyām daṇḍiḍḍatdhmatī śālā karma stham yatā śrāddham anena bhuktam śrāddhikaḥ agra bhojanam asmai dīyate āgrabhojanikaḥ padam asmin dṛśyam padyaḥ kardamaḥ iti apekṣita kriyam dvidhā vyahitam avyavahitam ca

original: tayovryavahitaṃ yathā grāmādāgacchati, brāhmaṇāya dadāti, paryaṅke śeta iti | avyavahitaṃ yathā kaṭaṃ karoti, dātreṇa lunāti, devadattenāsyata iti | anuśaktakriyaṃ dvidhā, tulyādhikaraṇamatulyādhikaraṇaṃ ca | tayostusalyādhikaraṇaṃ yathā śuklibhavati, unmanīsyāt, bhasmasātsaṃpadyata iti |
analyzed: yathā grāmāt āgacchati brāhmaṇāya dadāti paryaṅke śete iti avyavahitam yathā kaṭam karoti dātreṇa lunāti devadattena āsyate iti anuśakta kriyam dvidhā tulya adhikaraṇam atulya adhikaraṇam ca tayoḥ tusalya adhikaraṇam yathā śuklī bhavati unmanī syāt bhasmasāt saṃpadyate iti

original: atulyādhikaraṇaṃ yathā paṭapaṭākaroti, devatrāgacchati, devatrāgacchati, manuṣyatrāvasatīti | abhinnakriyaṃ tridhā, tiṅabhidheyaṃ kṛdabhidheyaṃ taddhitābhidheyaṃ ca | tatra tiṅabhidheyaṃ dvidhā kartṛrūpaṃ karmatarūpaṃ ca | tayoḥ kartṛrūpaṃ yathā pacati devadattaḥ, dugdhe gauḥ, corasyarujati roga iti |
analyzed: atulya adhikaraṇam yathā devatrā āgacchati devatrā āgacchati manuṣyatra āvasati iti abhinna kriyam tridhā tiṅ abhidheyam kṛt abhidheyam taddhita abhidheyam ca tatra tiṅ abhidheyam dvidhā kartṛ rūpam ca tayoḥ kartṛ rūpam yathā pacati devadattaḥ dugdhe gauḥ corasi arujati rogaḥ iti

original: karmarūpaṃ yathā pacyate odanaḥ, bhidyate kusūlaḥ, uṣṭrāsikā āsyanta iti | kṛdabhidheyaṃ dvidhā, viśeṣyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ca | tayorviṣyaṃ yathā dātraṃ, prāsādaḥ, kumbhakāra
analyzed: karma rūpam yathā pacyate odanaḥ bhidyate kusūlaḥ uṣṭra asikāḥ āsyante iti kṛt abhidheyam dvidhā viśeṣyam viśeṣaṇam ca tayoḥ viṣyam yathā dātram prāsādaḥ kumbhakāra

original: iti | viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā kartavyaṃ, pācakaḥ, subodhamiti | taddhitābhideyaṃ dvidhā sāpekṣakriyamanepekṣitakriyaṃ ca | tayossāpekṣakriyaṃ yatheṣṭī yajñe, parigaṇitī yājñikye, āmnātī chandasi, adhītī vyākaraṇe, kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti |
analyzed: iti viśeṣaṇam yathā kartavyam pācakaḥ su bodham iti taddhita abhideyam dvidhā sāpekṣa kriyam anepekṣita kriyam ca tayoḥ sāpekṣa kriyam yathā iṣṭī yajñe parigaṇitī yājñikye āmnātī chandasi adhītī vyākaraṇe kṛtapūrvī kaṭam iti

original: anekṣakriyaṃ yatā pākevana nirvṛttaṃ pākim, sekena nirvṛttaṃ sekimaṃ, kuṭṭena kuṭṭimaṃ, karaṇena kṛtrimaṃ, śyenapāko'syāṃ tilapāko'syāṃ tilapāko'syāṃ kriyāyāṃ śyainaṃpātā tailaṃ pāteti | prakṛtipratyayobhayadvārakaṃ padārthaviśeṣaṇamupaskārārthaḥ | sa tridā, prakṛtidvārakaḥ, pratyayadvārakaḥ, ubhayadvārakaśca |
analyzed: anekṣa kriyam yatā nirvṛttam pākim sekena nirvṛttam sekimam kuṭṭena kuṭṭimam karaṇena kṛtrimam śyenapākosyām tilapākosyām tilapākosyām kriyāyām tailam pātā iti prakṛti pratyaya ubhaya dvārakam padārtha viśeṣaṇam upaskāra arthaḥ sa tridā prakṛti dvārakaḥ pratyaya dvārakaḥ ubhaya dvārakaḥ ca

original: teṣu prakṛtidvārakaḥ ṣoḍhā, lopāgamasavarṇavikārādeśapratyāpattyapapadopaskārabhedāt | teṣu rañjerṇau mṛgaramaṇena lopa ityādi | lopopaskārārthaḥ yathā dhṛtahetirapyadhṛtajihmagatiścaritairmumīnadharayan gurubhaiḥ | rajāyāñcakāra virajaḥ sa mṛgān kimiveśate ramayituṃ na guṇāḥ ||
analyzed: teṣu prakṛti dvārakaḥ ṣoḍhā lopa āgama savarṇa vikāra ādeśa pratyāpatti apapada upaskāra bhedāt teṣu rañjā īrṇau mṛga ramaṇena lopaḥ ityādi lopa upaskāra arthaḥ yathā dhṛta hetiḥ api adhṛta jihma gatiḥ caritaiḥ mumīn adharayan guru bhaiḥ rajāyāñcakāra virajaḥ sa mṛgān kim iva īśate ramayitum na guṇāḥ

original: aśvavṛṣayormaithunecchāyāmityādirāgamopaskārārthaḥ yathānekayugajīvinyāstrotā yasyastrayodaśī | sā kṣīrakaṇkaṃ vatsaṃ vṛṣasyantī na lajjitā || veśca svano bhojane mūrdhanya ityādivarṇavikāropaskārārthaḥ yathā glānicchekṣutprabodhāya pītvā raktaṃ riṣṭaṃ jhāṣitājīrṇaśeṣaḥ | svāduṅkāraṃ māṃsakhaṇḍopadaṃśaṃ kroṣṭā ḍiḍḍatdhmbhaṃ vyāṇvaṇadvyasvanañca ||
analyzed: aśva vṛṣayoḥ maithuna icchāyām ityādiḥ āgama upaskāra arthaḥ yathā aneka yuga jīvinyāḥ trotā sā kṣīra kaṇkam vatsam vṛṣasyantī na lajjitā veḥ ca svanaḥ bhojane mūrdhanyaḥ iti ādi varṇa vikāra upaskāra arthaḥ yathā glāni chekṣudh prabodhāya pītvā raktam riṣṭam svāduṅkāram māṃsa khaṇḍa upadaṃśam kroṣṭā ḍiḍḍatdhmbham ca

original: mātarmātacputre ślāghya ityādirādeśopaskārārthaḥ yathā gaurī mā tasya tasyaitāḥ kārtikeyasya kīrtayaḥ | kīrtitāsu na kītryante yāsu kasyāpi kīrtayaḥ || ākhyāvātkṛtastadācaṣṭe, kṛllukprakṛtipratyāpattiḥ, prakṛtivañca kārakamityādipratyayā pattyupaskārārthaḥ, yathā śailairbanthayati sma vānarahṛtairvālmīkirambhonidhim |
analyzed: mātar mātar putre ślāghyaḥ ityādiḥ ādeśa upaskāra arthaḥ yathā gaurī mā tasya tasya etāḥ kārtikeyasya kīrtayaḥ kīrtitāsu na yāsu kasya api kīrtayaḥ ākhyāvāt kṛtaḥ tat ācaṣṭe kṛt luk prakṛti pratyāpattiḥ prakṛtivat ca kārakam ityādi pratyaya āpatti upaskāra arthaḥ yathā śailaiḥ banthayati sma vānara hṛtaiḥ vālmīkiḥ ambhonidhim

original: nivṛttaparḍaḍḍatdhnyajalābhiṣekā praphullakāśā vasudheva reje || karmaviśeṣaṇaṃ yathāśokanirbhaÐtsatapadmarāgamākṛṣṭahemadyutikararṇikāram | muktākalāpītakṛtasindhavāraṃ vasantapuruṣpābharaṇaṃ vahantī || karaṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā mukhena sā padmāsugandhinā niśi pravepamānādharapatraśobhinā | tuṣāravṛṣṭikṣacapadmasampadāṃ sarocasantānamivākarodapām ||

original: saṃpradānaviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā tasmai himādreḥ prayatāṃ tanūjāṃ yatātmane rocayituṃ yatasva | yoṣutsu tadvīryaniṣekabhūmissaiva kṣametyātmabhunopadiṣṭam || apādanaviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā visṛṣṭarāgādadhārānnivartitasstavāṅgarāgārūṇitāñca kandukāt | kuśāṃkurādānaparikṣatāṃguliḥ kṛto'kṣasūtrapraṇayī tayā karaḥ || adhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā anuprayogārthaśśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: saṃpradāna viśeṣaṇam yathā tasmai himādreḥ prayatām tanūjām yata ātmane rocayitum yatasva yoṣutsu tad vīrya niṣeka bhūmiḥ sā eva kṣamā iti ātmabhunā upadiṣṭam a pādana viśeṣaṇam yathā visṛṣṭa rāgāt adhārāt nivartitaḥ stava aṅga rāga ārūṇitāt ca kandukāt kuśa aṃkura ādāna parikṣata aṃguliḥ kṛta ukṣasūtra praṇayī tayā karaḥ adhikaraṇa viśeṣaṇam yathā anuprayoga arthaḥ śeṣaḥ

original: sa ṣoḍhā, liḍaḍḍatdhnuprayogārthaḥ, lojanuprayogārthaḥ, kṛjanuprayogārthaḥ, yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaḥ, adhikānuprayogārthaḥ, dvirvacanānuprayogārthaḥ iti | siḍaḍḍatdhnuprayogārtho yathā na laṅghāyāmāsa mahājanānāṃ śirāṃsi nāvoddhatimājagāma | aceṣṭatāṣṭāpadabhūmireṇuḥ khurāhato yatsadṛśaṃ garimṇaḥ ||

original: lojanuprayogārtho yathā purīmavaskanda lunīhi nandanaṃ muṣāṇa ratnāni harāmarāṅganāḥ | nigṛhya cakre namucidviṣā balī ya itthamasvāsthyamahardivaṃ duvaḥ || kṛdanuprayogārtho yathā salīlamāsaktalātāntabhūṣaṇaṃ samāsajantyā kusumāvataṃsakam | stanopapīḍaṃ, nunude nitāmbinā dhanena kaścijjaghanena kācana ||

original: rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti snāmiviśeṣasambandhopahitabhedaḥ puruṣortho'vagamyate rājapuruṣa iti | na cāpadārtharūpabhedapradhānasyādhātuṃ tadanavahūyamānasvārthamevopasarjanapadamiti | kimucyate jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti? evaṃ manyate padasya svākiśayapratirapattau svādhīnatvaṃ, tasya tyāgāt svārthāpahānam |

original: yadi copasarjanapadaṃ na svārthena pradhānasyopakuryāt, svarūpamevāsyahīyate | yataḥ paropakāritākāraṇakamvopasarajatvaṃ prayogavaiyathrya copasarjanasya, prasajyate | pradhānasyottarapadenaiva pratītatvāt | na cānarthakāṇaṃ pareṇa sambandho ghaṭate, sāmāthryanibandhanā samāsasaṃjñā ca nopapadyate | tasmānna sakalārthaparityāgaḥ |

original: kiṃ tarhi viśeṣaṇatayā svapadepadhīyamānarūpātiśayapratipattiyogyatāmātrasyapahīyate | nanu ca parityaktaseṣārthamapi upasarjanapadarthaviśeṣābhidhāyinassamudāyasya varṇavadaṅgabhāvamāpatsyate? naivam, evaṃ hi rratīyamānaḥ pradhānārthorayogī padārthaḥ parityakto bhāvī |

original: na ca piratyaktasvārthabhya upasarḍaḍḍatdhnapadebhyaḥ pradhānaviśeṣo viśeṣaṇavisaśeṣyāvacchinnaḥ samudāyo vā pratīyate | na cāpratīyamānaśśabdārtho nyāyyaḥ kalpayitumiti yatkiñcidetate | yadyapi cāyaṃ samudāyaḥ evāvyapadeśyapūrvāparabhāgo bhāgabhedānuyāta ivāsīyamānaḥ saṃbandhī padārthadvayopahitabhedaṃ hyarthamabhidhatte |
analyzed: na ca piḥ atyakta svārthabhyaḥ pradhāna viśeṣaḥ samudāyaḥ vā pratīyate na ca apratīyamānaḥ śabda arthaḥ nyāyyaḥ kalpayitum iti yat kiñcid etate yadi api ca ayam samudāyaḥ eva a vyapadeśya pūrva apara bhāgaḥ bhāga bheda anuyātaḥ iva āsīyamānaḥ saṃbandhī padārtha dvaya upahita bhedam hi artham abhidhatte

original: tathāpi tadadhigamopāyaḥ pūrvottaravibhāgadarśanam | tatra ca vṛttau samarthādhi kāraḥ kriyate samarthanāmabhedo bhedassaṃsargo vā | iha rājña iktayukte sarvasvaṃ prasaktam | puruṣa ityekta sarvaḥ svāmī praśaktaḥ | ihedānīṃ rājapuruṣamāyetyukte rājapuruṣaṃ nivartayati anyebhyaḥ svāmibhyaḥ |

original: puruṣo'pi rājānamanyebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ evametasminnubhayato 'vacchenne yadi jahāti kāmaṃ jahātu | na jātu cit puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ bhaviṣyati | nanu ca puruṣa ityukte na strītyetāvatā saṃpratyayena bhavitavyam | satyamevametat | yadā tu puruṣa ākāraviśeṣāddravyāntarasambandhādvā svātantryeṇa nijrñāta upalabdhaṃ tatpratyetaducyate |

original: ihedānīṃ rājā puruṣaṃ nivartayati anyebhyaḥ svāmibhyaḥ | tatra yo'sau bhedastatsāmathryaṃ tannimittā ca vṛttiḥ bhedanimittayāṃ ca vṛttauḥ satyāṃ vṛttyabhimukhasya bhedamupajanayya svārtho nivartate | yasyāpi na nivartate puruṣasya so'pi svāminaṃ bhinatti |

original: evametayodrvayo ranyonyakṛptau satyāmubhayato vyavacchedena nijrñāte puruṣaviśeṣe samudāyārthe cānyasminna prādurbhūte yadi rājārtho nivartate kāmaṃ nivartatām | prāktu vṛtterakṛtārthasya nivṛttau vṛttireva na syāt | vṛttinimittā ca nivṛttiḥ | tasmādadoṣaḥ | apara āha puruṣa eva hi rājapuruṣo brāhmaṇādipuruśca |
analyzed: evam etayoḥ rvayoḥ anyonya kṛptau satyām ubhayatas vyavacchedena nijrñāte puruṣa viśeṣe samudāya arthe ca anyasmin na prādurbhūte yadi rāja arthaḥ nivartate kāmam nivartatām prāk tu vṛtteḥ akṛtārthasya nivṛttau vṛttiḥ eva na syāt vṛtti nimittā ca nivṛttiḥ tasmāt adoṣaḥ aparaḥ āha puruṣaḥ eva hi rāja puruṣaḥ brāhmaṇa ādi puruḥ ca

original: tatra rājā svāmyantaranivṛttimātraṃ karoti | na tvasau rājārthameva nivartayati | svāmyantaranivṛttau tu kṛtāyāṃ puraṣa eva rājapuruṣārthamāheti | athānyamataṃ nāvasthitārthaparityāgena śabdo'rthāntaraṃ upādatte | na hyapauruṣeyasaṃbandhopahitanivośamārthāstyuktuṃ tāthārthamapi naiva yogakṣemamapahūtuṃ kṣamante |
analyzed: tatra rājā svāmi antara nivṛtti mātram karoti na tu asau rāja artham eva nivartayati svāmi antara nivṛttau tu kṛtāyām eva rāja puruṣa artham āha iti atha anya matam na avasthita artha parityāgena śabda ūrtha antaram upādatte na hi apauruṣeya saṃbandha upahita nivā ūśama arthā asti uktum tāthārtham api nā eva yogakṣemam apahūtum kṣamante

original: na hi jalamanalasaṃsparśopacīyamānasparśātiśayamapyātmīyaṃ snehaṃ jahāti |nimittaviśaeṣasannidhānopapādite punareṣāmarthāntarabhidhānasāmathryakāmacārastasmādabhyuñcaya evārthāntarasya vṛttāvupasarjanapadānāṃ pradhānopakārātiśayaḥ | pradhānopakārastu svāmiviśeṣāvacchedaḥ puruṣārthasya | sa cāparityāgenaiva svārthasya kartuṃ śakyate |
analyzed: na hi jalam anala saṃsparśa upacīyamāna sparśa atiśayam api ātmīyam sneham jahāti nimitta viśaeṣa sannidhāna upapādite punar eṣām artha antar abhidhāna sāmathrya kāmacāraḥ tasmāt abhyuñcayaḥ eva artha antarasya vṛttau upasarjana padānām pradhāna upakāra atiśayaḥ pradhāna upakāraḥ tu svāmi viśeṣa avacchedaḥ puruṣa arthasya sa ca aparityāgena eva sva arthasya kartum śakyate

original: na hyatyantamapākīrṇasvārthaṃ śabdarūpātiśayamarthāntare niveśayituṃ śaknoti | paॉrūpātiśayaniveśanāyāṃ padārthanipabandhanatvādanaṅāgīkṛtasvārthani ca yānyupasarjanapadāni pradhānārthaniveśīni tamevārthaṃ śabdāntareṇa pratipādayanti | na tairatiśayaḥ pradhānasya pratipādito bhavati | tataśca rājapuruṣamānayetyukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti |

original: aupagavamānayeti cāpatyamātrasyeti | tadavadhāryāmāhe, athavā punarastvajahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ | yuktaṃ punaḥ yadajahatsvārthā nāma vṛttissyāt? bāḍhaṃ yuktaṃ, evaṃ dṛśyate loke bhikṣiko'yaṃ dvitīyāṃ bhikṣāmāsādya pūrvāṃ bhikṣā na jahāti, sañcayāyaiva yatate | nanu coktamubhayorvidyamāsvārthayoḥ dvayordvivacanamiti dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti |
analyzed: aupagavam ānaya iti ca apatya mātrasya iti tat avadhārya āmāhe athavā punar astu ajahat svārthā vṛttiḥ yuktam punar yat ajahat svārthā nāma vṛttiḥ syāt bāḍham yuktam evam dṛśyate loke bhikṣikaḥ yam dvitīyām bhikṣām āsādya pūrvām bhikṣāḥ na jahāti sañcayāya eva yatate nanu ca uktam ubhayoḥ dvayoḥ dvivacanam iti dvivacanam prāpnoti

original: kasayāḥ punardvinavacanaṃ prāpnoti? prathamāyāḥ | na prathamāsamartho rājā | ṣaṣṭhyāstarhi prāpnoti | na ṣaṣṭhīsamarthaḥ puruṣaḥ | prathamāyā eva tarhi prāpnoti | nanu coktaṃ na prathamāsamartho rājābhihitaḥ, so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthassaṃpannaḥ | tatra prātipadikārthe prathame prathame prathamāyā eva dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti |

original: tatra yathā dhavakhadirāviti padārthāntaropacaye saṅkhyabhedopajanakādekavacanaṃ pravartate tadvidihāpi rājapuruṣa iti puruṣaśabdāddvivacanaṃ prāpnoti | naivam, ghavakhadirāvityavayavārthasamavetassaṅkhyāviśaeṣaḥ, tato'vayavātparasyā vibhakteḥ kāraṇam | iha tu eka ekapuruṣārthastadekavacanameva puruṣaśabde nyāyyaḥ |
analyzed: tatra yathā dhava khadirau iti padārtha antara upacaye saṅkhya bheda upajanakāt ekavacanam pravartate tadvid iha api rāja puruṣaḥ iti puruṣa śabdāt dvivacanam prāpnoti na evam ghava khadirau iti avayava artha samavetaḥ saṅkhyā viśaeṣaḥ tatas vayavāt parasyāḥ vibhakteḥ kāraṇam iha tu ekaḥ eka puruṣa arthaḥ tat eka vacanam eva puruṣa śabde nyāyyaḥ

original: tadyathā katamaddevattagṛhaṃ, yatrāyaṃ kāka iti | atra hi na kākalakṣaṇopalakṣaṇadvārema pravṛtto devadattagṛhaśabdaḥ kākārthamābhidhatte | uparate vā kākasaṃbandhe tadvyavacchinnavastuniveśitāṃ jahāti | evaṃ jātyupalakṣaṇadvāreṇa vyaktau pravartamānaśśabdo jātiṃ ca nābhidhīsyati | tadvyavacchinnagovyaktiviniveśaṃ ca na hāsyati |

original: etenākṛtirapi, śabdenānabhidhīyamānaiva vyaktimupalakṣayatīti lakṣyate | tadyāthā kataratsuvarṇaṃ, ya eṣa rucakaḥ, svastiko vardhamānaka iti | na hyatra rucakādyākāradvāreṇa pravṛttassuvarṇaśabdorucakādyākāramabhidhatte | uparateṣu rucakādyākāreṣu tadvyavacchinnasvarṇārthaparatāṃ parityajati | taduktam adhruveṇa nimittena devadattagṛhaṃ yathā |
analyzed: etena ākṛtiḥ api śabdena anabhidhīyamānā eva vyaktim upalakṣayati iti lakṣyate tat yāthā katarat suvarṇam yaḥ eṣa rucakaḥ svastikaḥ vardhamānakaḥ iti na hi atra rucaka ādi ākāra dvāreṇa pravṛttaḥ suvarṇa śabdaḥ ṛucaka ādi ākāram abhidhatte uparateṣu rucaka ādi ākāreṣu tad vyavacchinna svarṇa artha para tām parityajati tat uktam adhruveṇa nimittena devadatta gṛham yathā

original: gṛhītaṃ gṛhaśabdena śuddhamevābhidhīyate || suvarṇādi yathā yuktaṃ svairākārairupādhibhiḥ | ruṭakādyabhidhānānāṃ śuddhameveti vācyatām || tathopalakṣaṇe jātāvākṛtau vā samāśrite | vyaktayo yānti śabdānāṃ śuddhā evābhidheyatām || etena yaduktaṃ vyaktyabhaidhānapakṣe srave śabdāḥ sarvārthā bhaveyuriti tadapi nirastaṃ bhavati |

original: tathāhi, yathā cakṣirādiśabdānāmaseṣarūpādiprakāśanasāmathrya nalikādisuṣiravatrmani yuktaṃ darśanasya tadavakāśāvasthitarūpabhedoparuddhatayā viṣayāntareṣu na viprakriryate tathā jātyākṛtibhyāmavaruddhaviṣayā gavādiśabdanāmabhidhānaśaktirnāśvādiṣvatiprasajyata iti | uktaṃ ca, ārāraiśca vyacchedātsārvāthryamarudhyate |

original: yathāva cakṣurādīnāṃ sāmathryaṃ nalikādibhiḥ || yañcoktaṃ yathāvādibhirādarśairabhiktāścandrādaya eva candrādiśabdairabhidhīyante | yathā cendriyabhedagrahaṇamantareṇāpi rūpākārādiviṣyajñānabhedo bhavati, tathā vyaktibhirupavyāñcitā jātayaeva gavādiśabdairabhidhīyante | vyaktigrahaṇe ca dupavyañjanā jātigrrahīṣyati | tadapi na samyak |

original: yadā tāvatpratibimbamudakādiṣu bhāvāntaramevopajāyata iti darśanaṃ, tadā tu rūpabhedānupātinaḥ śabdāḥ kimiti udasādīnupādadīran | yato nodakādastadānīṃ candrādīnāmuvyañjanamapi tu rupajananakāraṇam, na ca kāryavacanāt śabdāḥ kāraṇasaṃsparśamanubhavanti |

original: yadā tu darśanavilpavaḥ sa dādṛśa iti pratipattiṃ, tadā dūrotsāritāvakāśo vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvaḥ | yadā tarhi jalādyādarśapratighātāt parāvṛtte cakṣuṣi svaktrañjandrādayo'pi dṛśyanta iti darśanaṃ tadaitadupapatsyate | tadāhyudarakādivat sannihitamupavyañjanaṃ rūpabhedena jātimabhivyaktarūpabhedāṃ darśayati | tadeva ca śabdo'bhidhatte |
analyzed: yadā tu sa dādṛśe iti pratipattim tadā dūra utsārita avakāśaḥ vyaṅgya vyañjaka bhāvaḥ yadā tarhi jala ādi ādarśa pratighātāt parāvṛtte cakṣuṣi dṛśyante iti darśanam tadā etat upapatsyate tadā hi udaraka ādi vat sannihitam upavyañjanam rūpa bhedena jātim abhivyakta rūpa bhedām darśayati tat eva ca śabdaḥ abhidhatte

original: etadapyavyabhicaritopavyañjanāyatdarśanajātayaḥ kathaṃ vinopavyañjanaiḥ pratīyanta iti paryunuyogenāticaturaśraṃ, candrādīnāmanyathāpi darśanopapatteḥ | evaṃ jātibhedapratipattāvapi yathā darśanādīndriyāyattodayāḥ nīlādyarthāvasāyāḥ kāraṇabhedamanurivartante | naivam, jātiparicchedāḥ vyaktirūpapratibandhotpādāḥ, yena tadbhedamanuvidadhyuḥ |

original: tataśca gotvādayo'pi parasparato na vyāvarteran | saṃvedyamānabhedaśca padārthaḥ kathamakasmādeka iti śraddhīyate? vyaktareva pārdathatvaṃ tasmādabhyupagamyatām | tathā ca buddhistatraiva śrutaśabdasya jāyate || yeṣāmartheṃṣu sāmānyaṃ na saṃbhavati taiḥpunaḥ | ucyate kevalā vyaktirākāśādipadairiva ||
analyzed: tatas ca go tva ādayaḥ api parasparataḥ na vyāvarteran saṃvedyamāna bhedaḥ ca padārthaḥ katham akasmāt ekaḥ iti śraddhīyate vyaktar eva pārdatha tvam tasmāt abhyupagamyatām tathā ca buddhiḥ tatra eva śruta śabdasya jāyate yeṣām artheṣu sāmānyam na saṃbhavati taiḥ punar ucyate kevalā vyaktiḥ ākāśa ādi padaiḥ iva

original: evaṃ ḍiḍḍatdhtthādiśabdānāṃ saṃjñātvaviditātmānām | abhidheyasya sāmānyaśūnyatvādvyaktivācyatā || yepunaḥ kalpitānekabedavṛttiṃ pracakṣate | vācyaṃ tatrāpi sāmānyamatīva grāhayanti te || na hi ḍiḍḍatdhtthatvasāmānyaṃ dṛśyate gaganatvavat | kalpanāyāśca nābhūmiḥ kācidasti vipaścitām || iti || ākṛtireva padārtha iti vindhvāsimatagandhīyāḥ |
analyzed: evam ḍiḍḍatdhttha ādi śabdānām saṃjñā tva vidita ātmānām abhidheyasya sāmānya śūnya tvāt vyakti vācya tā ye punar kalpita aneka beda vṛttim pracakṣate vācyam tatra api sāmānyam atīva grāhayanti te na hi ḍiḍḍatdhttha tva sāmānyam dṛśyate gagana tva vat kalpanāyāḥ ca na abhūmiḥ kācid asti vipaścitām iti ākṛtiḥ eva padārthaḥ iti vindhvāsimatagandhīyāḥ

original: tatrākṛtipadeneha saṃsthānamabhidhīyate | loke śāstre ca dṛṣṭatvānna jātirjaimunīyanavat || loke yathā yatrākṛtistatra guṇā vasantīti | śāstre yathākṛtigrahaṇā jātirliṅgānāṃ ca na sarvabhāk || iti || ubhayatrāpi cākṛtiśabdenāvayavasanniviśeṣa ucyate | vṛddhāśca vyavaharanto yatrārthe yatpadaṃ prayuñjate sa tasyārtho bhavati |
analyzed: tatra ākṛti padena iha saṃsthānam abhidhīyate loke śāstre ca dṛṣṭa tvāt na jātiḥ jaimunīyana vat loke yathā yatra ākṛtiḥ tatra guṇāḥ vasanti iti śāstre yathā ākṛti grahaṇā jātiḥ liṅgānām ca na sarva bhāj iti ubhayatra api ca ākṛti śabdena avayava sanni viśeṣaḥ ucyate vṛddhāḥ ca vyavaharantaḥ yatra arthe yat padam prayuñjate sa tasya arthaḥ bhavati

original: tatra yadeṣa gośabdaḥ sāsnādimati prayujyate na kesarādimati tadayamāsādharaṇasanniveśaviṣayatāṃ dyotayati| pratyakṣaviṣaye ca gorityādipadaṃ prayujyate | pratyakṣaṃ cākṛtiviṣayam | aśvapiṇḍaḍḍatdhsanniveśāddhi vilakṣaṇo gopiṇjasanniveśa indriyeṇa pratīyate | tatkṛtameva vastīnāmitaretaravailakṣaṇyāt |

original: itīyaṃ leśatastāvannāmnāṃ vṛttirudāhṛtā || ākhyātānāṃ tu vācyorthaḥ purastādupavarṇitaḥ | upasarganipātānāṃ nāmnāmiva vibhāgataḥ || prayogapratipattibhyāmaneko'rtho'vagamyate | upasargavaśāddhāturarthānataravilāsakṛt || vihārāhārasaṃhāraprahāraparihāravat | anvayavayatirekābhyāṃ tadartho'bhyavagamyate || tadāgame tatpratītistadabhāve tadagrahāt |
analyzed: iti iyam leśataḥ tāvat nāmnām vṛttiḥ udāhṛtā ākhyātānām tu vācya ūrthaḥ purastāt upavarṇitaḥ upasarga nipātānām nāmnām iva vibhāgataḥ prayoga pratipattibhyām anekaḥ ūrthaḥ avagamyate upasarga vaśāt dhātuḥ artha anatara vilāsa kṛt vihāra āhāra saṃhāra prahāra parihāra vat tad arthaḥ abhyavagamyate tad āgame tad pratītiḥ tad abhāve tad agrahāt

original: ayamāsya padāsyārtha iti kiṃ cintitena vā || yo'rthaḥ pratīyate yasmātsa tasyārtha iti sthitiḥ || vākyārthastridhā, bhāvanā vidhiḥ pratibhā ca | tatrānyotpādānukūlo bhavantaṃ prayuñjānaḥ puruṣavyāpāraḥ karotyartho bhāvanetyucyate | anavacchinnaścānuṣṭhātumaśakya iti sānnidhyātsamānapadopāttaṃ dhātvarthamavacchedakatvenāpekṣate |
analyzed: ayam āsya pada asya arthaḥ iti kim cintitena vā yaḥ ṛthaḥ pratīyate yasmāt sa tasya arthaḥ iti sthitiḥ vākya arthaḥ tridhā bhāvanā vidhiḥ pratibhā ca tatra anya utpāda anukūlaḥ bhavantam prayuñjānaḥ puruṣa vyāpāraḥ karoti arthaḥ bhāvanā iti ucyate anavacchinnaḥ ca anuṣṭhātum aśakyaḥ iti sānnidhyāt samāna pada upāttam dhātvartham avacchedaka tvena apekṣate

original: sa caidanaṃ pacatītyādau samānapadopāttatve'pyayogyatvena sādhyatvātpracyutaḥ karaṇāṃśe'bhinivisamānaḥ pradhānakriyāmodanaphalikāṃ niṣpādayati | karaṇaṃ ca kevalamasādhakatvāt kkacidapi kriyāṃ na niṣpādayadupabdham | atatsatsādhakatamatvasiddhaye kāṣṭhādītikartavyatānupraveśaḥ | phalānupraveśastu taduddeśenaiva bhāvanāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ |
analyzed: sa ca edanam pacati ityādau samāna pada upātta tve pi ayogya tvena sādhya tvāt pracyutaḥ karaṇa aṃśa abhinivisamānaḥ pradhāna kriyām odanaphalikām niṣpādayati karaṇam ca kevalam asādhaka tvāt kkacid api kriyām na niṣpādayat upabdham a tad sat sādhakatama tva siddhaye kāṣṭha ādi itikartavyatā anupraveśaḥ phala anupraveśaḥ tu tad uddeśena eva bhāvanāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ

original: ataḥ phalakaraṇetikartavyatāvacchedāt kiṃ kena kathamityapekṣiṇī tryaṃśapirapūrṇā bhāvanā bhavati | tatra devadattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ pacatītyādauca audanaṃ phalaṃ, pākaḥ karaṇaṃ, kāṣṭhādikārakacakramitikartavyatā, iti | taduktam audane sādhyamāne hi pākaḥ karaṇamiṣyate | sthālyagnicillikāṣṭhānāmitikartavyatā matā ||
analyzed: atas phala karaṇa itikartavya tā avacchedāt kim kena katham iti apekṣiṇī bhāvanā bhavati tatra devadattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyām odanam pacati ityādau ca audanam phalam pākaḥ karaṇam kāṣṭha ādi kāraka cakram itikartavya tā iti tat uktam audane sādhyamāne hi pākaḥ karaṇam iṣyate sthālī agni cilli kāṣṭhānām itikartavya tā matā

original: sa ca prayatnaparispandādaudāsīnyapratyupalakṣyamāṇaḥ puruṣavyāpāraḥ karotyartho bhāvanā | kathaṃ tarhi kāṣṭhānāṃ karaṇatvaṃ? dhātvarthasya kriyātvāt | bhāvanāyāṃ tu dhātvarthasya karaṇatvāt karaṇavibhaktyupādāne ca pradhānāntareṇa sambandhāyogāt |
analyzed: sa ca prayatna parispandāt audāsīnya pratyupalakṣyamāṇaḥ puruṣa vyāpāraḥ karoti arthaḥ bhāvanā katham tarhi kāṣṭhānām karaṇa tvam dhātvarthasya kriyā tvāt bhāvanāyām tu dhātvarthasya karaṇa tvāt karaṇa vibhakti upādāne ca pradhāna antareṇa sambandha ayogāt

original: ucyate, bhāvanāsaṃbandhāddhātvartho'pi pūrvāparībhūto bhavanātmāvagamyata iti tadapekṣayā kāṣṭhānāṃ karaṇatvam | ataḥ sthitametat tryaṃśaparipūrṇā bhāvanā vākyārtha iti | pravṛttinivṛttyorvidhāyako'rthavādādibhirupakriyamāṇo liṅloṭvyādivācyaḥ śabdavyāpāro vidhiḥ | tena hi bhāvanāyāṃ puruṣaḥ pravatryate nivṛtryate vā |
analyzed: ucyate bhāvanā saṃbandhāt dhātvarthaḥ api pūrvāparībhūtaḥ bhavana ātmā avagamyate iti tad apekṣayā kāṣṭhānām karaṇa tvam atas sthitam etat tri aṃśa paripūrṇā bhāvanā vākya arthaḥ iti pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ vidhāyakaḥ ūrtha vāda ādibhiḥ upakriyamāṇaḥ śabda vyāpāraḥ vidhiḥ tena hi bhāvanāyām puruṣaḥ nivṛtryate vā

original: yathā yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhuyāt, brāhmaṇaṃ na hanyāt, prauṣānanubrūhi, māpabhāṣasva, hoturaṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ, surā na pātavyā, pitaro vandanīyāḥ, guravo nāmamānyāḥ, śivaṃ te bhūyāt, mā tva śyena udvadhīditi | sa ca sarvavākyānāmarthaḥ sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ vidhīniṣedhayoreva paryavasyati |
analyzed: yathā yāvajjīvam agnihotram juhuyāt brāhmaṇam na hanyāt prauṣān anubrūhi mā apabhāṣasva hotuḥ aṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ surā na pātavyā pitaraḥ vandanīyāḥ guravaḥ nāma mānyāḥ śivam te bhūyāt mā śyenaḥ udvadhīt iti sa ca sarva vākyānām arthaḥ sarvam hi vākyam vidhi niṣedhayoḥ eva paryavasyati

original: yatrāpi ca liṅādayo na śrūyante tatrāpi vidhinisedhaparatayā sarvavākyānāṃ vākyaśeṣabhūtāste'vagamyante | tadyatheha deśe subhikṣamityukte'treva sthātavyamasyāṃdho vartata ityukte, ihaiva bhoktavyaṃ sacoraḥ panthā ityukte, na gantavyaṃ grāhāḥ sarityasyāmityukte na snnātavyamiti pratīyate | kiñca mahākāvyairipa rāmāyaṇādibhiridameva vyutpādyate|
analyzed: yatra api ca liṅ ādayaḥ na śrūyante tatra api vidhi nisedha para tayā sarva vākyānām vākyaśeṣa bhūtāḥ te iva gamyante tat yathā iha deśe subhikṣam iti ukte itra iva sthātavyam asya andhaḥ vartate iti ukte iha eva bhoktavyam sa coraḥ panthāḥ iti ukte na gantavyam grāhāḥ sariti asyām iti ukte na snnātavyam iti pratīyate kiñca mahākāvyaiḥ ipa rāmāyaṇa ādibhiḥ idam eva vyutpādyate

original: rāmasya piturājñāṃ pālayato vananivāsino'pi tathāvidho'bhyudayaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | rāvaṇasya paradārānabhilaṣyatastrailokyavijayino'pi tathāvidha ucchedaḥ | tasmātpiturājñāṃ pālayet | paradārānnābhilaṣyet | rāmavadvarteta na rāvaṇavaditi | nanvākhyātavācyatvena bhāvanaiva vidhirityuktaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: rāmasya pituḥ ājñām pālayataḥ vana nivāsinaḥ api tathāvidhaḥ abhyudayaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ rāvaṇasya para dārān abhilaṣyataḥ trailokya vijayinaḥ upi tathāvidhaḥ ucchedaḥ tasmāt pituḥ ājñām pālayet para dārān na abhilaṣyet rāma vat varteta na rāvaṇa vat iti nanu ākhyāta vācya tvena bhāvanā eva vidhiḥ iti uktam bhavati

original: kathaṃ ca tatraiva tasya pravartaktavaṃ, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt? tanna, śabdārthabhedena bhāvanāyā dvaividhyāt | taduktam abhidhābāvanāmāhuranyāmeva liṅādayaḥ | arthātmā bhāvanātvanyā sravākhyāteṣu gamyate || tatra śabdabhāvanā preraṇātmikā śabdasyābhidheyā vidheyā ca | taduktam abhidhatte, karoti ceti |
analyzed: katham ca tatra eva tasya pravartak tavam sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt tat na śabda artha bhedena bhāvanāyāḥ dvaividhyāt tat uktam abhidhā bāvanām āhuḥ anyām eva liṅ ādayaḥ artha ātmā bhāvanā tu anyā srava ākhyāteṣu gamyate tatra śabda bhāvanā preraṇa ātmikā śabdasya abhidheyā vidheyā ca tat uktam abhidhatte karoti ca iti

original: sātvarthabhāvanāṃśadvayaviṣayā vana phalāṃśaviṣayā| taduktaṃ phalāṃśe bhāvanāyāśca pratyayo na vidhāyakaḥ | abhidadhyuḥ svaśaktyāhi vidhimātraṃ liṅādayaḥ ||
analyzed: sātvartha bhāvanā aṃśa dvaya viṣayā phala aṃśa viṣayā tat uktam phala aṃśe bhāvanāyāḥ ca pratyayaḥ na vidhāyakaḥ abhidadhyuḥ sva śaktyā hi vidhi mātram liṅ ādayaḥ

original: tasyāśca kiṃ kena kathamityapekṣāyāmarthabhāvanāviṣayā puruṣapravṛttiḥ, preraṇājñānaṃ karaṇāṃśaḥ, artha vādādaya itikartavyatāṃśa iti tryaṃśaparipūrṇatvam, sā ca phalakaraṇayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvamajñātaṃ gamayantī gamakatvātapramāṇaṃ bhavati | nanu ca vidhilakṣaṇametāvadapravṛttapravartanaṃ, ajñātajñāpanaṃ hyevaṃ sarvo'pi hi vidhirbhavet |
analyzed: tasyāḥ ca kim kena katham iti apekṣāyām artha bhāvanā viṣayā puruṣa pravṛttiḥ preraṇā jñānam karaṇa aṃśaḥ artha vāda ādayaḥ itikartavya tā aṃśaḥ iti tri aṃśa paripūrṇa tvam sā ca phala karaṇayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvam ajñātam gamayantī gamaka tvāt apramāṇam bhavati nanu ca vidhi lakṣaṇam etāvat apravṛtta pravartanam ajñāta jñāpanam hi evam sarvaḥ api hi vidhiḥ bhavet

original: tathāhi sādhyasādhanasambandhaḥ sarvākhyāteṣu vidyate | sravavākyeṣu cākhyātaṃ tenākāṅkṣā nivartanāt || na ca sādhyasādhanabhāvāvagamamantareṇa pravartakatvaṃ na sidhyatīti sādhyasādhanabāvavagatiravaśyakalpanīyā | preraṇājñānajanakatvenaivāsya pravartakatvāt kimityasau niṣphale vyāpāre pravartata iti cedvidhīta eveti brūmaḥ |
analyzed: tathā hi sādhya sādhana sambandhaḥ sarva ākhyāteṣu vidyate srava vākyeṣu ca ākhyātam tena ākāṅkṣā nivartanāt na ca sādhya sādhana bhāva avagamam antareṇa pravartaka tvam na sidhyati iti sādhya sādhana bāva avagatiḥ avaśya kalpanīyā preraṇā jñāna janaka tvena eva asya pravartaka tvāt kim iti asau niṣphale vyāpāre pravartate iti ced vidhīte eva iti brūmaḥ

original: sahi saphale niṣphale vā vyāpāre puruṣaṃ pravartayati, evaṃ yañjapuruṣeṣvapravartamānaṣu aprāmāṇyaṃ tadaparihāryameva | kalpite hi phale vaiṣayikasukhadveṣiṇo vītarāgā na pravartante | pravṛddhatararāgāstu na nivartante iti | ucyate yajeta svargakāma ityādau vidhirbhāvanāyāṃ puruṣaṃ pravartayeti | bhāvyaniśaṣṭhasvabhāvako vyāpāro bhāvanā |
analyzed: sa hi saphale niṣphale vā vyāpāre puruṣam pravartayati evam aprāmāṇyam tat aparihāryam eva kalpite hi phale vaiṣayika sukha dveṣiṇaḥ vīta rāgāḥ na pravartante pravṛddhatara rāgāḥ tu na nivartante iti ucyate yajeta svarga kāmaḥ ityādau vidhiḥ bhāvanāyām puruṣam pravartaya iti vyāpāraḥ bhāvanā

original: sā casādhyādisvarūpaparityaktā nirupapattikaiva syāt | sādhyatvaṃ ca samānapadopādānasannidhinaśāddhātvarthasyāhosvidiṣyamāṇatayā kāmipadopāttasya svargādeḥ syāditi saṃśaye yogyatvātsvargasyaiva, na dhātvarthasyeti | tadaktaṃ vidhāvanāśrite sādhyaḥ puruṣārtho na labhyate | śrutasvargādibādhena dhātvarthaḥ sādhyatāṃ vrajet ||
analyzed: sā ca sādhya ādi svarūpa parityaktā nirupapattikā eva syāt sādhya tvam ca āhosvit iṣyamāṇatayā kāmi pada upāttasya svarga ādeḥ syāt iti saṃśaye yogya tvāt svargasya eva na dhātvarthasya iti tat aktam vidhau anāśrite sādhyaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ na labhyate śruta svarga ādi bādhena dhātvarthaḥ sādhya tām vrajet

original: vidhau kṛtamatikramya svargādeḥ sādyateṣyate | tatsādhanasya dharmatvamevaṃ sati ca gamyate || dharmehyadṛṣṭaviṣaye codanaiva pramāṇam |codanaiva hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ vārthamavagamayituṃ śaknoti | nānyātkiñcanendriyamiti |
analyzed: vidhau kṛtam atikramya svarga ādeḥ sādyate iṣyate tad sādhanasya dharma tvam evam sati ca gamyate codanā eva pramāṇam codanā eva hi bhūtam bhavantam bhaviṣyantam sūkṣmam vyavahitam vā artham avagamayitum śaknoti na anyāt kiñcana indriyam iti

original: etenāpauruṣeyatvena yathārthapratipādakāptapraṇītatvena vā nirastadoṣāṃśasya bādhakapratyayarahitasya vaidikasya ca vākyasyautsargikaṃ prāmāṇyamuktaṃ bhavatīti vidhirvākyārtha iti |
analyzed: etena apauruṣeya tvena yathā artha pratipādaka āpta praṇīta tvena vā nirasta doṣa aṃśasya bādhaka pratyaya rahitasya vaidikasya ca vākyasya autsargikam prāmāṇyam uktam bhavati iti vidhiḥ vākya arthaḥ iti

original: svaṃ svamarthamabhidhāyoparateṣu padeṣu padārthapratipattyanantaramupajāyamānā idaṃ taditi vyapadeśyānupadeśasiddhā hitāhitaprāptiparihārahetuḥ pravṛttyanukūlā buddhiḥ pratibhā |
analyzed: svam svam artham abhidhāya uparateṣu padeṣu padārtha pratipatti anantaram upajāyamānā idam tat iti vyapadeśya anupadeśa siddhā hita ahita prāpti parihāra hetuḥ pravṛtti anukūlā buddhiḥ pratibhā

original: tathāhi, padanibandhānānāṃ padāvayavanibandhānānāṃ cārthapratyavabhāsamātrāṇāṃ avicchedena pravṛttau pratyavabhāsā pravṛttiphalaprasavā'numeyābhinnajātīyaiva pritabhā pratyātmaṃ vivartate | yathā madyaviṣarasādiṣu bhinnānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pūrvamadṛṣṭāśasaṃrgāt prāptaparipākānāṃ madamaraṇasuvarṇādirarthakriyā dṛśyate |
analyzed: tathā hi pada nibandhānānām pada avayava nibandhānānām ca artha pratyavabhāsa mātrāṇām avicchedena pravṛttau pratyavabhāsā pravṛtti phala prasava anumeyā abhinna jātīyā eva prita bhā pratyātmam vivartate yathā madya viṣa rasa ādiṣu bhinnānām dravyāṇām pūrvam adṛṣṭa āśa saṃrgāt prāpta paripākānām mada maraṇa suvarṇa ādiḥ arthakriyā dṛśyate

original: tathā pratirapadaṃ bhinnānāṃ śabdānāmuccāyamānā dṛśyate | ayaṃ cāsyā bhāvānādibhyo viśeṣaḥ | yāvatkimatra mayā kathitaṃ pratipannamartharūpaṃ vā pareṇa kathamanusandhīyata iti na vicāryate, tāvadanākhyeyenopāyena pūrvottarānusandhānameṣāṃ prakalpayati |
analyzed: tathā pratiḥ a padam bhinnānām śabdānām uccāyamānā dṛśyate ayam ca asyāḥ bhāva anādibhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ yāvat kim atra mayā kathitam pratipannam artha rūpam vā pareṇa katham anusandhīyate iti na vicāryate tāvat anākhyeyena upāyena pūrva uttara anusandhānam eṣām prakalpayati

original: pratyakṣānumānaviṣaye'pi yāvatpūrvāparapratyamarśaḥ śabdollekhavān sarvapramāṇāni pramāṇatāṃ labhante | pratibhālocano hi loka iti kartavyatāsu pravartate |
analyzed: pratyakṣa anumāna viṣaye api yāvat pūrva apara pratyamarśaḥ śabda ullekhavān sarva pramāṇāni pramāṇa tām labhante pratibhā locanaḥ hi lokaḥ iti kartavyatāsu pravartate

original: nanu ca na pratibhā vākyārtho yato bālānāṃ stanyapānādiṣu, haṃsānāṃ kṣīravivecane, jantvādīnāṃ kulāyādikaraṇe, jātamātraṇāmeva ca paśumṛgasarūsṛpādīmanāmudakasantareṇe, suptānāṃ ca prabodhādau, kumāryaśca śvo me bhrātā āgamiṣyatīti jñāne, syabhāvato vākyaśravaṇamantareṇāpi pratibhopajāyamānā dṛśyate |

original: tadevamadikṛtatvena svargakāmasya karmami sambandhāt svargayāgayośca sādhyasādhanabāvāvagamamantareṇādhikārasyānurvāhādavaśyaṃ kriyāyāṃ sādhanatvaṃ svasyaiva sādhyatvamubhyupagantavyam | ataśca kriyāyāḥ phalaṃ prati guṇabhāvādaprādhānyamaprādhānyāñca na vākyārthatvam | taduktaṃ “karmāṇyapi hi dajaiminiḥ phalārthatvā” diti |
analyzed: tat evam adi kṛta tvena svarga kāmasya karmami sambandhāt svarga yāgayoḥ ca sādhya sādhana bāva avagamam antareṇa adhikārasya anurvāhāt avaśyam kriyāyām sādhana tvam svasya eva sādhya tvam ubhyupagantavyam atas ca kriyāyāḥ phalam prati guṇa bhāvāt aprādhānyam aprādhānyāt ca na vākya artha tvam tat uktam karmāṇi api hi phala artha tvāt iti

original: kā ceyaṃ kriyā? vākyartha ityucyate, ya eṣa yādādirbhāvārthā dhātuvācya, uta pratyayārthaḥ, kaścidatiriktā iti | tatra bhāvārthasya kāmyamānasādhanatvādaprādhānyumuktemeva | pratyayārthastu kāmyamānabhāvārthagatasādhyasādhanasambandhāparityāgenaiva vākyārthatāṃ pratipadyate | tasmānna kriyāmātraparyavasāyī vākyārtha iti |
analyzed: kā ca iyam kriyā vākyarthaḥ iti ucyate yaḥ eṣa yādādiḥ bhāva arthā dhātu vācyaḥ uta pratyaya arthaḥ kaścid atiriktā iti tatra bhāva arthasya kāmyamāna sādhana tvāt pratyaya arthaḥ tu kāmyamāna bhāvārtha gata sādhya sādhana sambandha a parityāgena eva vākya artha tām pratipadyate tasmāt na kriyā mātra paryavasāyī vākya arthaḥ iti

original: kimidānīṃ phalasyaiva vākyārthātvaṃ pracakṣmahe | taddhipradhānaṃ sādhyaṃ ca tadartho hyakhilaḥ śramaḥ || naivam, yathā kriyāyāḥ phalārthatvādaprādhānyaṃ evaṃ phalasyāpi puruṣārthatvāt | nahi svargaḥ svatantra eva sattāṃ labhatāmiti puruṣo yatate | apitu svopabhogyatayainamabhilaṣati, tadāha “phalaṃ ca puruṣārthatvāt” |
analyzed: kim idānīm phalasya eva pracakṣmahe tat hi pradhānam sādhyam ca tad arthaḥ hi akhilaḥ śramaḥ na evam yathā kriyāyāḥ phala artha tvāt aprādhānyam evam phalasya api puruṣa artha tvāt nahi svargaḥ svatantraḥ eva sattām labhatām iti puruṣaḥ yatate apitu sva upabhogya tayā enam abhilaṣati tat āha phalam ca puruṣa artha tvāt

original: tarhi, puruṣa eva vākyārtho bhavatu | naivaṃ, yajamānasaṃmitaudumbarī bhavatīti tasyāpi kriyāṅgatvāt | tadāha, puruṣaśca karmārthatvāditi | hantaivaṃ kriyā phalārthā, phalaṃ puruṣārtheṃ, puruṣaḥ kriyārtha iti cakrake patitāḥ kasya patitāḥ kasya prādhānyaṃ śiṣmaḥ |
analyzed: tarhi puruṣaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ bhavatu na evam yajamāna saṃmitā audumbarī bhavati iti tasya api kriyā aṅga tvāt tat āha puruṣaḥ ca karma artha tvāt iti hanta evam kriyā phala arthā phalam puruṣa artha iṃ puruṣaḥ kriyā arthaḥ iti cakrake patitāḥ kasya patitāḥ kasya prādhānyam śiṣmaḥ

original: ucyeta, puruṣastāvanna vākyārthaḥ pādarthānāṃ mithaḥ saṃsarge'pi avyayakārakaviśeṣaṇārthopagṛhītasyākhyātārthasyaiva prādhānyena vākyārthatvāt | nanu cākhyāte'pi yajetetyevamādau kartaryaiva lakāraḥ |
analyzed: ucyeta puruṣaḥ tāvat na vākya arthaḥ pādarthānām mithas saṃsarge pi avyaya kāraka viśeṣaṇa artha upagṛhītasya ākhyāta arthasya eva prādhānyena vākya artha tvāt nanu ca ākhyāte api yajeta iti evamādau kartaryā eva lakāraḥ

original: maivam, yo'yaṃ lakāro nāma siddhaṃ hi sādhyāyopādīyata iti pratyayārtho'pi kartā prakṛtirthe kriyāyāmeva nyagbhavati, phalamapi na vākyārthaḥ siddhāsiddhavikalpānupapatteḥ | siddhasya tāvatphalasyābhidhānameva nāsti, kāmyamānatvena nirdeśāt | sādhyamānatvapakṣe tu sākṣāttatsiddhyavedanāt | vyāpā raeva tanniṣṭho vākyārthaṃ iti yujyate ||
analyzed: mā evam yaḥ uyam lakāraḥ nāma siddham hi sādhyāya upādīyate iti pratyaya arthaḥ api kartā prakṛti ṛthe kriyāyām eva nyagbhavati phalam api na vākya arthaḥ siddha asiddha vikalpa anupapatteḥ siddhasya tāvat phalasya abhidhānam eva nā asti kāmyamāna tvena nirdeśāt sādhyamāna tva pakṣe tu sākṣāt tad siddhi avedanāt vyāpāḥ ra eva tad niṣṭhaḥ vākya artham iti yujyate

original: ataeva hi vākyārthaṃ bhāvanāṃ pratijānate | yathocitaphalāmaṃśatrayasambandhabandhurāḥ || bhāvyaniṣṭho hi bhāvakavyāpāro bhāvaneti | saiṣa dvādaśabhedo'rthaḥ kriyādiḥ prakprakīrtitaḥ | vācyo viśeṣyaḥ śabdasya pratyāyyohyabhyupeyate ||
analyzed: ataeva hi vākya artham bhāvanām pratijānate yathā ucita phalām aṃśa traya sambandha bandhurāḥ bhāvya niṣṭhaḥ hi bhāvaka vyāpāraḥ bhāvanā iti sā eṣa dvādaśa bhedaḥ ūrthaḥ kriyā ādiḥ vācyaḥ viśeṣyaḥ śabdasya pratyāyyaḥ hi abhyupeyate

original: nacaitadvācyaṃ, vākyasyaiva pratyayakatavaṃ na padānāṃ, yato yathā guḍaḍḍatdhśabdo guḍaḍḍatdhdravyamabhidhatte tathā pratyāyayatyapi tadavinābhāvimādhuryaṃ, yadi vā padānyeva saṃhatyārthamabhidadhati vākye || ākhyātaśabdo vākyapadasaṅghāto vākyamityapi darśanāni vidyante | kriyādayaśca padārtha evāntarbhavanti |
analyzed: na ca etat vācyam vākyasya eva pratyaya katavam na padānām yatas yathā guḍaḥ ḍatdh śabdaḥ guḍaḥ ḍatdh dravyam abhidhatte tathā pratyāyayati api tat avinābhāvi mādhuryam yadi vā padāni eva saṃhatya artham abhidadhati vākye ākhyāta śabdaḥ vākya pada saṅghātaḥ vākyam iti api darśanāni vidyante kriyā ādayaḥ ca padārthe eva antarbhavanti

original: tathāhi, dhātvarthaḥ kriyā, tāṃ kālo viśinaṣṭi, pratyayārthaḥ, kārakaṃ tatpuruṣo viśeṣayita | tasyobhayasyāpyupādhayo'pyavacchedakā bhavanti, sambhūya prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ brūtaḥ | yaṃ taṃ pradhānamāmananti sa bhedābhedābhyāmupaskārārthaviśiṣṭaprātirikārthavyapadeśaṃ labhate |
analyzed: tathā hi dhātvarthaḥ kriyā tām kālaḥ viśinaṣṭi pratyaya arthaḥ kārakam tatpuruṣaḥ tasya ubhayasya api upādhayaḥ api avacchedakāḥ bhavanti sambhūya prakṛti pratyayau pratyaya artham brūtaḥ yam tam pradhānam āmananti sa bheda abhedābhyām upaskāra artha viśiṣṭa prātirika artha vyapadeśam labhate

original: tasya śaktisaṅkhyābhivyakteye vibhaktistadantaṃ padaṃ padānāmapadānāṃ ca sāmathrye vṛttiḥ, vṛttānāmapi ca kṛttaddhitasamāsānāṃ punaḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ subutpatteḥ padasaṃjñeteni vākyaṃ punarakhaṇḍaḍḍatdhvākyārthapakṣe vācakamapi bhavati | tatra śabdasyārthābhidhānasāmathryaṃ vācakatā | sā trīdhā, mukhyā, gauṇī, lakṣaṇā ca |
analyzed: tasya śakti saṅkhyā abhivyakteye vibhaktiḥ tad antam padam padānām apadānām ca sāmathrye vṛttiḥ vṛttānām api ca kṛt taddhita samāsānām punar prātipadika saṃjñāyām sup utpatteḥ vākyam punar vācakam api bhavati tatra śabdasya artha abhidhāna sāmathryam vācaka tā sā trīdhā mukhyā gauṇī lakṣaṇā ca

original: yathā gaurgacchati, gaurvāhīkaḥ, goṣu nivasatīti | āsāṃ ca viśeṣān viśeṣemāgrato vakṣyāmaḥ | teṣu hi prabuddheṣu prabuddhāprabuddhaiḥ prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyopadeśavṛddhavyavahārebhyo'dhigateṣu saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhabalena śabdastaṭastha eva gotvamarthaṃ pratyāyayati | tadāhur prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyātpratīyate |
analyzed: yathā gauḥ gacchati gauḥ vāhīkaḥ goṣu nivasati iti āsām ca viśeṣān viśeṣema agratas vakṣyāmaḥ teṣu hi prabuddheṣu prabuddha aprabuddhaiḥ prasiddha pada sāmānādhikaraṇya upadeśa vṛddha vyavahārebhyaḥ adhigateṣu saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandha balena śabdaḥ taṭasthaḥ eva go tvam artham pratyāyayati tat āhuḥ prasiddha pada sāmānādhikaraṇyāt pratīyate

original: aprasiddhāpadasyārtha ścūte rauti piko yathā || tathaihi rauti yaścūte pikaḥ sa iti niścayaḥ | upadeśādyathārtho'yaṃ pavasākhyāḥ prakāśate || vyavahārāttu śabadārthasambandhastripramāṇakaḥ | vṛddhaśabdābhidheyāni pratyakṣṇātrā paśyati || śrotuśca pratipannatvamanumānena ceṣṭāyā | anyāthānupapattau ca vettiśaktidvayāśrayām || iti ||
analyzed: aprasiddha apadasya arthaḥ cūte rauti pikaḥ yathā tathā ehi rauti yaḥ cūte pikaḥ saḥ iti niścayaḥ upadeśāt yathārthaḥ yam pavasa ākhyāḥ prakāśate vyavahārāt tu śabada artha sambandhaḥ tri pramāṇakaḥ vṛddha śabda abhidheyāni pratyakṣṇā atrā paśyati śrotuḥ ca pratipanna tvam anumānena ceṣṭāyāḥ anya atha anupapattau ca vetti śakti dvaya āśrayām iti

original: svāvacchedena viśiṣṭajñānakatā viśeṣaṇatvam | tatrtridhā, bhedakamanuraḍhjakamupalakṣake ca | yathā viśvajitā yajeta, śvetaṃ chāgamalabheta, lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracarantīti | na ca gotvādayaḥ kadācidapi śabdānuvedhavandhyabodhāviṣayatāṃ pratipadyante |
analyzed: sva avacchedena viśiṣṭa jñānaka tā viśeṣaṇa tvam tatra tridhā bhedakam anuraḍhjakam upalakṣake ca yathā viśvajitā yajeta śvetam chāgam alabheta lohita uṣṇīṣāḥ ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti iti na ca go tva ādayaḥ kadācid api śabda anuvedha vandhya bodha aviṣaya tām pratipadyante

original: tathāhi, “āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīt” ityādau yathā jātiguṇakriyāvcachinnaviṣayānavabhāsini savikalpake, tathā nirvikalpake vijñāne śabdaviśiṣṭa evārthaḥ pirasphurati | tadāha na so'sti pratyayo loke yaśśabdānugamādṛte | anuviddhamiva jñānaṃ sarvaṃ śabdena gamyate || nacaitadvācyaṃ, astītyālocanājñānaṃ prathamaṃ nirvikalpakam |
analyzed: tathā hi ā ayam gauḥ pṛśniḥ akramīt ityādau yathā jāti guṇa kriyā avcachinna viṣaya anavabhāsini savikalpake tathā nirvikalpake vijñāne śabda viśiṣṭaḥ eva arthaḥ tat āha na saḥ asti pratyayaḥ loke yaḥ śabda anugamāt ṛte anuviddham iva jñānam sarvam śabdena gamyate na ca etat vācyam asti iti ālocanā jñānam prathamam nirvikalpakam

original: bālamūkādivijñānasadṛśaṃ śuddhavastujam || yato bālādayo janmāntarānubhavopajanitanānāsaṃskārajātayo jātyāhyullekhenaiva taṃtamarthaṃ pratiyanti | tathāhi, tadaharjāyamānasyāpi bālakasya purato vidagdhavanitāḥ pradīpaṃ na prasthāpayanti karkaṭonmā bhaviṣyatīti |
analyzed: bāla mūka ādi vijñāna sadṛśam śuddha vastu jam yatas bāla ādayaḥ janmāntara anubhava upajanita nānā saṃskāra jātayaḥ jātyā ahi ullekhena eva taṃ tam artham pratiyanti tathā hi tad ahar jāyamānasya api bālakasya puratas vidagdha vanitāḥ pradīpam na prasthāpayanti karkaṭa unmā bhaviṣyati iti

original: atha tathātvātathātvayossithatiṃ prati hetutvātpratyayākatvaṃ kathaṃ punaratathābhūtamarthaṃ śabdastathā pratyāyayati? śabdaktimāhātmyāt | śabdaśakyupajanitā hi buddhayaḥ svabījaparipākavaśādākāraviśeṣavatya upajāyamānāḥ satyapi vastuno'bhede bhedamupadarśayanti | tadyāthā rāhoḥ śiraḥ, śilāputrakasya śarīramiti |
analyzed: atha tathātva atathātvayoḥ sithatim prati hetu tvāt pratyayākatvam katham punar atathābhūtam artham śabdaḥ tathā pratyāyayati śabda akti māhātmyāt śabda śaki upajanitāḥ hi buddhayaḥ sva bīja paripāka vaśāt ākāra viśeṣavatyaḥ upajāyamānāḥ sati api vastunaḥ bhede bhedam upadarśayanti tat yāthā rāhoḥ śiraḥ śilāputrakasya śarīram iti

original: taduktaṃ māyondrajālaprakhayo'yaṃ pravibhāgaḥ prakalpyate | śabdaśaktimahimnaiva nirvibhāge'pi vastuni || anye tvāhuḥ “na vastuno'dhikaṃ rūpaṃ na śabdasyādhikārthatā |śabdaḥ śabdāntaropādheradhikārthaḥ pratīyate ||” tadyathā, puruṣa itipuraṣamātraṃ, rājña iti śabdanātarasannidhesatu saeva viśiṣṭaḥ pratīye puruṣaviśoṣo'yaṃ rājapuruṣa iti |
analyzed: tat uktam māyā undrajāla prakhayaḥ yam pravibhāgaḥ prakalpyate śabda śakti mahimnā eva nirvibhāge api vastuni anye tu āhuḥ na vastunā udhikam rūpam na śabdasya adhika artha tā śabdaḥ śabda antara upādheḥ adhika arthaḥ pratīyate tat yathā puruṣaḥ rājñaḥ iti sa eva viśiṣṭaḥ pratīye puruṣa viśoṣaḥ yam rāja puruṣaḥ iti

original: evaṃ bhavatīpacatītyādāvapi pacatīti kriyāmātrapratītiḥ, bhavatīti tu padopādhiḥ kartṛśaktiprayuktā pratīyate | apare tu manyaneta, kaॉsakalavikalpollekhavirahite'pi vastuni śabdāḥ svamahimnaiva nānāvidhabudhdyutpattikāraṇībhūtāḥ sanniveśayanti, yadvaśādibhinnarūpamapi vastvanyathācāvabhāsata iti |
analyzed: evam bhavatī pacati ityādau api pacati iti kriyā mātra pratītiḥ bhavati iti tu pada upādhiḥ kartṛ śakti prayuktā pratīyate apare tu vastuni śabdāḥ sva mahimnā eva nānāvidha budhdi utpatti kāraṇī bhūtāḥ san niveśayanti yat vaśa ādi bhinna rūpam api vastu anyathā ca avabhāsate iti

original: tathāhi, kathakaḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayatītyukte kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭa iti pratīyate | yadātvindraḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti prayogastadā kaṃsaghnaṃ tamupendraṃ indraḥ prayuṅkta iti | anye tu kathakaḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayītyatrāpi prayojakaṃ vyāpāraṃ bruvate, | yataḥ “śabdopahitarūpāstān buddherviṣayatāṃ gatān |
analyzed: tathā hi kathakaḥ kaṃsam ghātayati iti ukte kaṃsa vadham ācaṣṭe iti pratīyate yadā tu indraḥ kaṃsam ghātayati iti prayogaḥ tadā kaṃsa ghnam tam upendram indraḥ prayuṅkte iti anye tu kathakaḥ kaṃsam ghātayi iti atra api prayojakam vyāpāram bruvate yatas śabda upahita rūpāḥ tān buddheḥ viṣaya tām gatān

original: pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn sādhanatvena manyate ||” teṣāṃ cotepatteḥ prabhūtyāvināśāt sa vṛddhirācakṣāṇaḥ parānapi tathaiva pratyāyayati | tathā vaktāro bhavanti gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ, kiṃ gatena, hataḥ kaṃsa iti | athāpareṣāṃ darśanaṃ, vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāśśabdayonayaḥ | teṣāmanyonyasambandho nārthaṃ śabdāḥ spṛśantyapi ||
analyzed: pratyakṣam iva kaṃsa ādīn sādhana tvena manyate teṣām ca utepatteḥ prabhūtyāḥ avināśāt sa vṛddhiḥ ācakṣāṇaḥ parān api tathā eva pratyāyayati tathā vaktāraḥ bhavanti gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ kim gatena hataḥ kaṃsaḥ iti atha apareṣām darśanam vikalpa yonayaḥ śabdāḥ vikalpāḥ śabda yonayaḥ teṣām anyonya sambandhaḥ na artham śabdāḥ spṛśanti api

original: tadyathā guṇānurāgamikṣeṇa yaśasā cava sarpatā |digvadhūnāṃ mukhe jātamakasmādardhakuṅktumam || atrārdhakuṅktumetyukte saurabhādiguṇānvitā | yaśo'nurāgayorvarmapraklṛptiravagamyate || vadhūśabdena tu diśāṃ nāyikātvaṃ pratīyate | na ca sambandhagandho'pi vāstavasteṣu vidyate || tadupajñaṃ caiṣa laikikaḥpravadaḥ |
analyzed: tat yathā guṇa anurāgam ikṣeṇa yaśasā sarpatā diś vadhūnām mukhe jātam akasmāt ardha kuṅktumam atra ardha kuṅktumā iti ukte saurabha ādi guṇa anvitā yaśaḥ anurāgayoḥ varma praklṛptiḥ avagamyate vadhū śabdena tu diśām nāyikā tvam pratīyate na ca sambandha gandhaḥ api vāstavaḥ teṣu vidyate tad upajñam ca eṣa laikikaḥ pravadaḥ

original: atahaṭṭhaevi tahatahasaṃṭhievvahiaammi jāṇivetasei | atthavisese sā jaai viaukaigoarā vāṇi || bhavatu nāmaśabdasya vācakatvamakṣe'pi pakṣānupraveśādrathātathātve'pi tathā pratyāyakatvam | viśeṣaṇapakṣe tu kathamivaitadupapadyate? viśeṣaṇena hi pradhānānuyāyinā bhavitavyam | pradhānena tvavicalitasvārthena |
analyzed: attha visese sā attha visese sā vāṇi bhavatu nāma śabdasya vācaka tvam akṣe pi pakṣa anupraveśāt ratha atathātve api tathā pratyāyaka tvam viśeṣaṇa pakṣe tu katham iva etat upapadyate viśeṣaṇena hi pradhāna anuyāyinā bhavitavyam pradhānena tu avicalita svārthena

original: naivaṃ, viśeṣaṇamapi śabdo'nurañcakatvenārthamadhyāsīmaḥ kutaścidupādheranyathāvabhāsamānaḥ svāśrayamapyanyathāvabhāsayati |tadyathā magadheṣu stanau pīnau kaliṅgeṣvakṣiṇī śubhe | bābūpralambāvaṅkeṣu vaṅgeṣu caraṇai mṛdū || iti ||
analyzed: na evam viśeṣaṇam api sva āśrayam api anyathā avabhāsayati tat yathā magadheṣu stanau pīnau kaliṅgeṣu akṣiṇī śubhe bābū pralambau aṅkeṣu vaṅgeṣu caraṇaiḥ mṛdū iti

original: atra stanādiyo jātiśabdāḥ savyatvadakṣiṇatvajātidvayaikārthasamavāyopādherekatvayogino'pi dvitvenāvabhāsamānāḥ svāśrānapi tathaivāvabhāsayanti | etena vyaktau padārthe bahunāmapi dvitvānabhāso vyākhyātaḥ | tadyathā daityādhipaprāṇamuṣāṃ nakhānāmupeyuṣā bhūṣaṇatāṃ kṣatena | prakāśakārkaśya guṇai dadhānāḥ stanau taruṇyaḥ parivavrurenam ||

original: kārakeṣvaṣyapyakārakavivakṣā yathā mātuḥ smarati, sarpiṣo jānīte, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt | naite sukhasya jānanti yena vatsyanti nandane || iti | atra karmādiṣu śeṣatvena vivakṣiteṣu sambandhamātre ṣaṣṭhī na karmakaraṇakartṛṣvapi kārakavibhaktiriti | akārakeṣu kārakavivakṣā yathā bhavati, pacati, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt |
analyzed: kārakeṣu aṣi api akāraka vivakṣā yathā mātuḥ smarati sarpiṣaḥ jānīte na māṣāṇām aśnīyāt na ete sukhasya jānanti yena vatsyanti nandane iti atra karma ādiṣu śeṣa tvena vivakṣiteṣu sambandha mātre ṣaṣṭhī na karma karaṇa kartṛṣu api kāraka vibhaktiḥ iti akārakeṣu kāraka vivakṣā yathā bhavati pacati bhavati pakṣyati bhavati apākṣīt

original: astigacchāmo vayamiti | tathā smarasi kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ | ehi manye na yāsyāsi, paśya mṛgo dhāvati, iha paśyamāmaḥ, karmaṇi dvivacanabahuvacanānyudāhriyanta iti | kriyāyāmapi kārakavivakṣā yathā corasya rūjati, corarasyamayita, ceraṃ jvayati, coraṃ saṃtāpayatīti |
analyzed: vayam iti tathā smarasi kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ ehi manye na yāsyāsi paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iha paśyamāmaḥ karmaṇi dvivacana bahuvacanāni udāhriyante iti kriyāyām api kāraka vivakṣā yathā corasya rūjati ceram jvayati coram saṃtāpayati iti

original: atra rujārthānāṃ yathā corasya rujati, corasyāmayati, coraṃ jvarayati, tacoraṃ saṃtāpayatīti | atra rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmaḍaḍḍatdhjvarisantāpyoriti bhāvasyaiva kartṛtvam | akriyāyāṃ kriyāvivakṣā yathā nīlati vanam, śvetate prāsādaḥ || viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvadhrya svayaṃ dhetetumasāmpratam || iti ||
analyzed: atra rujā arthānām yathā corasya rujati corasya āmayati coram jvarayati saṃtāpayati iti atra rujā arthānām bhāva vacanānām aḍaḍḍatdhjvari santāpyoḥ iti bhāvasya eva kartṛ tvam akriyāyām kriyā vivakṣā yathā svayam iti

original: kriyāyāṃ kriyāntataravivakṣā yathaisitumicchiti, kamituṃ kāmayate, bhavedapi bhavet, sāyadapi syāditi | kārake'pi kriyāvivakṣā yathā draṣṭuṃ cakṣuḥ, yoddhuṃ dhaniḥ, gantumanāḥ gantukāma iti | atra kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade tumun bhāvauktaḥ | sa cakṣurādīnāṃ kriyāvivakṣāmantareṇa na sidhyatīti |
analyzed: kriyāyām kriyā antatara vivakṣā yathā esitum icchiti kamitum kāmayate bhavet api bhavet sāyat api syāt iti kārake api kriyā vivakṣā yathā draṣṭum cakṣuḥ yoddhum dhaniḥ gantu manāḥ gantu kāmaḥ iti atra kriyāyām kriyā arthāyām upapade tumun bhāva uktaḥ sa cakṣuḥ ādīnām kriyā vivakṣām antareṇa na sidhyati iti

original: asambandhe sambandhavivakṣā yathā rāṭopamuvīṃmaniśaṃ nadanto yaiḥ plāvayiṣyanti samantato|mī | tānyokadeśānnibhṛtaṃ payodherambhāṃsi meghānpibato dadarśa || acetaneṣu caintayavivakṣā yathā nadīkūlaṃ pipatiṣati, aśmā lunodhimicchati | .....vivakṣā yathāśvārohaḥ pipatiṣati | pradhāne guṇavivakṣā yathā balākāyāḥ śauklyam, kākasya kāṣṇryamiti |
analyzed: asambandhe sambandha vivakṣā yathā nadantaḥ yaiḥ plāvayiṣyanti tāni oka deśāt nibhṛtam payodheḥ ambhāṃsi meghān pibataḥ dadarśa acetaneṣu caintayā vivakṣā yathā nadī kūlam pipatiṣati aśmā lunodhim icchati vivakṣā yathā aśva ārohaḥ pipatiṣati pradhāne guṇa vivakṣā yathā balākāyāḥ śauklyam kākasya kāṣṇryam iti

original: guṇe pradhānavivakṣā yathā madhuro rasa āpyāyayati, āmlo dīpayatīti | avayave samudāyavivakṣā yathā grāmo dagdhaḥ, paṭo gagdhaḥ, akṣṇā kāṇaḥ, pādena svañca iti |
analyzed: guṇe pradhāna vivakṣā yathā madhuraḥ rasaḥ āpyāyayati āmlaḥ dīpayati iti avayave samudāya vivakṣā yathā grāmaḥ dagdhaḥ paṭaḥ gagdhaḥ akṣṇā kāṇaḥ pādena svañcaḥ iti

original: samudāye avayavavivakṣā yathā dordaṇḍaḍḍatdhcaṇḍiḍḍatdhmamātrāropaṇīye dhanuṣi sati padātilave lakṣmaṇena prabhurāryaḥ māmapi tasyaiva sugṛrahītanāmno devasya bhṛtyaparamāmuṃ vikukṣināmānamavadhārayatu bhavatīti | abede bhedavivakṣā yathā paṭubhāṣī bhavān paṭurāsīt | paṭutaraḥ eṣaḥ | anya evāsītsampannaḥ, rāhoḥ śiraḥ, śilāputrasakasya śarīramiti |
analyzed: samudāye avayava vivakṣā yathā dhanuṣi sati padāti lave lakṣmaṇena prabhuḥ āryaḥ mām api tasya eva su gṛrahīta nāmnaḥ devasya bhṛtya parama amum vikukṣi nāmānam avadhārayatu bhavati iti abede bheda vivakṣā yathā paṭu bhāṣī bhavān paṭuḥ āsīt paṭutaraḥ eṣaḥ anyaḥ eva āsīt sampannaḥ rāhoḥ śiraḥ śilāputrasakasya śarīram iti

original: bhede'pyabhedavivakṣā yathā tāneva śālīnaśnīmo ye madhurāyāṃ, tāneva śāṭakānācchādayāmo ye pāṭhaliputra iti | asato vivakṣā yathā samudraḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdhkā, vindhyo vardhaitakamiti | sato'pyavivakṣā yathānudarā kanyā, alomikā ejaketi | sadalatorvivakṣā yathā tadidamapamedhodayaṃ varṣaṃ, socchvāsaṃ maraṇamiti |
analyzed: bhede api abheda vivakṣā yathā tān eva śālīn aśnīmaḥ ye madhurāyām tān eva śāṭakān ācchādayāmaḥ ye pāṭhali putre iti asataḥ vivakṣā yathā samudraḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdhkāḥ vindhyaḥ vardhaitakam iti sataḥ upi avivakṣā yathā anudarā kanyā alomikā ejakā iti sat alatoḥ vivakṣā yathā tat idam apamedha udayam varṣam sa ucchvāsam maraṇam iti

original: sadasatoravivakṣā yathā śelādhirājatanayā na yayau na tasthāviti || stutyā nindāvivakṣā yathā guṇānāmeva daurātmyāddhuri dhuryo niyujyate | asañjātakiṇaskandhaḥ sukhaṃsvapitigaurgalī || nindayā kastutivivakṣā yathā capalo nirdayāścāsau janaḥ kiṃ tena me sakhi |
analyzed: sat asatoḥ avivakṣā yathā śela adhirāja tanayā na yayau na tasthau iti stutyā nindā vivakṣā yathā guṇānām eva daurātmyāt dhuri dhuryaḥ niyujyate a sañjāta kiṇa skandhaḥ sukham svapiti gauḥ galī nindayā yathā capalaḥ nirdayāḥ ca asau janaḥ kim tena me sakhi

original: āgaḥ pramārjanāyaiva cāṭavo yena śikṣitāḥ ||vidhinā niṣedhavivakṣā yathā gaccha gacchasi cetkānta panthānaḥ santu te śivāḥ | mamāpi janma tatraiva bhūyādyatra gato bhavān || niṣedhena vidhivivakṣā yathā māgaccha pramadāpriya priyāśatairbhūyastvamukto mayā bālā prāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā prāptanotyavasthāntaram |
analyzed: āgaḥ pramārjanāya eva ca aṭavaḥ yena śikṣitāḥ vidhinā niṣedha vivakṣā yathā gaccha gacchasi ced kānta panthānaḥ santu te śivāḥ mama api janma tatra eva bhūyāt yatra gataḥ bhavān niṣedhena vidhi vivakṣā yathā mā āgaccha pramadā priya priyā śataiḥ bhūyas tvam uktaḥ mayā bālā prāṅgaṇam āgatena bhavatā

original: kiñcāsyāḥ kucabhārapīḍaḍḍatdhnaparairyatnaprabandhairapi truṭyatkañcukajākairanudinaṃ nissūtramasmadgṛham || evamiyamanekadhā vivakṣā viprathate tadeṣa lokikavādaḥ |(“apāre kāvyasaṃsāre”iti pāṭhānataram)asminnapāre saṃsāre kavirekaḥ prajāpatiḥ | yathāsmai rocate viśvanaṃ tathedaṃ parivartate ||
analyzed: kiñca asyāḥ kuca bhāra pīḍaḍḍatdhna paraiḥ yatna prabandhaiḥ api truṭyat kañcuka jākaiḥ anudinam nissūtram asmad gṛham evam iyam anekadhā vivakṣā viprathate tat eṣa lokika vādaḥ apāre kāvya saṃsāre iti pāṭha anataram asmin apāre saṃsāre kaviḥ ekaḥ prajāpatiḥ yathā asmai rocate tathā idam parivartate

original: api ca ṭhiamaṭhṭhiaṃbadīsai a ṭhiaṃpijahaṭhṭhiaṃvapaḍiḍḍatdhbhāi | jahasaṃcaṭṭiaṃbavajasai sukaīṇaimāopaaīo || kiñca kkacitsvalpe'pyarthe pracuravanaireva racanā kkacidvastu spharaṃ katipayadairpitarasam | yathā vācyaṃ śabdāḥ kkacidapi tulāyāmiva dhṛtā stribhiḥ klapairevaṃ kavivṛṣabhasandarbhaniyamaḥ ||
analyzed: api ca kiñca kkacid svalpe pi arthe pracura vanaiḥ eva racanā kkacid vastu spharam katipaya daiḥ pita rasam yathā vācyam śabdāḥ kkacid api tulāyām iva dhṛtāḥ klapaiḥ evam kavi vṛṣabha sandarbha niyamaḥ

original: vivakṣā lokavyavahāre kāvyanyavahāre ca sumatibhirunnīyamānā tridhā vikhaayāte, kākkādivyaṅgyā, prakaraṇādivyaṅgyā, abhinayādivyaṅgyā ca | tatra kākuḥ svaro viccheda iti kākkādayaḥ | teṣu bhinnakaṇṭhadhvanidhīraiḥ kākurityābhidhīyate | sā tridhā niyatapratibandhā, aniyatapratibandhā, aprativandhā ca |
analyzed: vivakṣā lokavyavahāre kāvya anyavahāre ca sumatibhiḥ unnīyamānā tridhā kākkā ādi vyaṅgyā prakaraṇa ādi vyaṅgyā abhinaya ādi vyaṅgyā ca tatra kākuḥ svaraḥ vicchedaḥ iti kākkā ādayaḥ teṣu bhinna kaṇṭha dhvani dhīraiḥ kākuḥ ityā abhidhīyate sā tridhā niyata pratibandhā aniyata pratibandhā aprativandhā ca

original: tāsu niyatapratibandhā dvidhā, sākāṅkṣā nirākāṅkṣā ca | tayorvākyāntarāpekṣiyaṇī sākāṅkṣā | sā tridhākṣepagaparbhā, paśnagarbhā, vitarkagarbhā ca | vakyāntarabhāvinī nirākāṅkṣā | sāpi tridhā, vidhirūpā uttararūpā nirṇayarūpā ca | tadeva vākyaṃ kākuviśeṣṇa sākāṅkṣaṃ, tadeva kākkantareṇa vanirākāṅkṣām |
analyzed: tāsu niyata pratibandhā dvidhā sākāṅkṣā nirākāṅkṣā ca tayoḥ sākāṅkṣā sā tridhā ākṣepa gaparbhā paśna garbhā vitarka garbhā ca vakya antara bhāvinī nirākāṅkṣā sā api tridhā vidhi rūpā uttara rūpā nirṇaya rūpā ca tat eva vākyam sākāṅkṣam tat eva kāk antareṇa

original: tatrākṣepagarbhā yathā yadi me vallabhā dūtī tadāhamapi vallabhā | yadi tasyāḥ priyā vācastanmamāpi priyapriyā || iyameva nirdiṣṭurvidhirūpā | praśnagarbhā yathā gataḥ sa kālo yatrāsīnmuktānāṃ janmavalliṣu | vartante sāmprate tāsāṃ hetavaḥ śuktisampuṭāḥ ||
analyzed: tatra ākṣepa garbhā yathā yadi me vallabhā dūtī tadā aham api vallabhā yadi tasyāḥ priyāḥ vācaḥ tat mama api priya priyā iyam eva nirdiṣṭuḥ vidhi rūpā praśna garbhā yathā gataḥ sa kālaḥ yatra āsīt muktānām janma valliṣu vartante sāmprate tāsām hetavaḥ śukti sampuṭāḥ

original: iyamevopadeṣṭuruttararūpā |vinavajaladharaḥ sannaddho'yaṃ na dhṛṣṭaniśācaraḥ siradhanuridaṃ dūrākṛṣṭaṃ na tasya śarāsanam | ayamapi paṭurdhārāsāro na bāṇaparamparā kanakanikaṣasnigdhā vidyutpriyā na mamorvaśī || iyamevopadeṣṭurnirmayarūpā | evamanyā api sarvakṣitibhṛtāṃ nātha dṛṣṭa sarvāṅgasundarī | rāmā ramye vanānte'sminmayā virahitā tvayā ||
analyzed: iyam eva upadeṣṭuḥ uttara rūpā vinava jaladharaḥ sannaddhaḥ yam na dhṛṣṭa niśācaraḥ siradhanuḥ idam dūra ākṛṣṭam na tasya śarāsanam ayam api paṭuḥ dhārā sāraḥ na bāṇa paramparā kanaka nikaṣa snigdhā vidyut priyā na mama urvaśī iyam eva upadeṣṭuḥ nirmaya rūpā evam anyā api sarva kṣitibhṛtām nātha dṛṣṭa sarva aṅga sundarī rāmā ramye vana ante smin mayā virahitā tvayā

original: ityādayo draṣṭavyāḥ | tā imāstisro'pi niyatapratibandhā | aniyatapratibandhā punaranantāḥ | tāsvabhyupagamānunayakākuryathā yuṣmacchāsanalaṅghanāṃhasi mayā magnena nāma sthitaṃ prāptānāmavigarhaṇāṃ sthitimatāṃ madhye'nujānāmapi | krodhollālitaśoṇitāruṇagadasyocchindataḥ kauravānadyaikaṃ divasaṃ mamāsi na gururnāhaṃ vidheyastava ||
analyzed: ityādayaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ tāḥ imāḥ tisraḥ api niyata pratibandhā aniyata pratibandhā punar anantāḥ tāsu abhyupagama anunaya kākuḥ yathā yuṣmad śāsana laṅghana aṃhasi mayā magnena nāma sthitam prāptānām avigarhaṇām sthitimatām madhyenujānām api krodha ullālita śoṇita aruṇa gadasya ucchindataḥ kauravān adya ekam divasam mama asi na guruḥ na aham vidheyaḥ tava

original: abhyanujñopahāsakākuryathā mathnāmi kauravaśataṃ samare na kopādduśśānasya rudhiraṃ na pibāmyurastaḥ | sañjīrṇayāmi gadayā na suyodhanoru sandha karotu bhavatāṃ nṛpatiḥ paṇena || viṣānnādyākṣepakākuryathā lākṣāgṛhānalaviṣānnāsabhāpraveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vittanicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya |
analyzed: abhyanujñā upahāsa kākuḥ yathā mathnāmi kaurava śatam samare na kopāt duśśānasya rudhiram na pibāmi urastaḥ sañjīrṇayāmi gadayā na suyodhana ūru sandha karotu bhavatām nṛpatiḥ paṇena viṣa annādya ākṣepa kākuḥ yathā lākṣāgṛha anala viṣa anna āsabhā praveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vitta nicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya

original: ākṛtya pāṇḍaḍḍatdhvavadhūparidhānakeśān svasthā bhavantu mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ || evamanyā api śalyamapi sphuradantaṃ soḍhuṃ śakyeta hālahaladigdham | dhīrairna punarakāraṇakupitakhalālīkadurvacanam || ityādayo draṣṭavyāḥ || apratibandhā tu ekaguṇā dviguṇā triguṇā ca |
analyzed: ākṛtya svasthāḥ bhavantu mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ evam anyāḥ api śalyam api sphurat antam soḍhum śakyeta hālahala digdham dhīraiḥ na punar akāraṇa kupita khala alīka durvacanam ityādayaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ apratibandhā tu ekaguṇā dviguṇā triguṇā ca

original: tatraikaguṇā yathā bhrukuṭirāracitā gatamagrato hṛtamathānanamuktamasādhu vā | iyamapi prabhutā kriyate balādakupitopi hi yatkupito janaḥ || dviguṇā yathā kiṃ kirātena yañcakre samākṛṣya śilīmukhān | śilīmukhān samākṛṣya kiṃ kirātaḥ karoti tat ||
analyzed: tatra ekaguṇā yathā bhrukuṭiḥ āracitā gatam agratas hṛtam atha ānanam uktam asādhu vā iyam api prabhu tā kriyate balāt akupitaḥ api hi yat kupitaḥ janaḥ dviguṇā yathā kim kirātena yat cakre samākṛṣya śilīmukhān śilīmukhān samākṛṣya kim kirātaḥ karoti tat

original: triguṇā yathā seyaṃ paśyati no kuraṅgakavadhūtrasteyamudvīkṣate tasyāḥ pāṇirayaṃ na mārutacalaḥ patrākṛtiḥ pallavaḥ | tāraṃ roditi saiva naiṣa marūtā veṇuḥ samāpūryate seyaṃ māmabhibhāṣate priyatamā no kokilaḥ kūjati || caturguṇā khalvapi yathocyatāṃ sa vacanīyamaśeṣaṃ neśvare puruṣātā sakhi sādhvī |

original: ānayainamanunīya kathaṃ vā vipriyāṇi janayannanuyeyaḥ || kiṃ gatena nahi yuktamupaituṃ kaḥ priye subhagamānini mānaḥ | yoṣitāmiti kathāsu samataiḥ kāmibhirbahurasā dhṛtirūhe || sakhyā vā nāyikāyā vā sakhīnāyakayoratha | bhūyasīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ vā vāci kākuriha sthitā || evamanyā api ko'himityādayo draṣṭavyāḥ |
analyzed: ānaya enam anunīya katham vā vipriyāṇi janayan anuyeyaḥ kim gatena nahi yuktam upaitum kaḥ priye subhaga mānini mānaḥ yoṣitām iti kathāsu samataiḥ kāmibhiḥ bahu rasā dhṛtiḥ ūhe sakhyāḥ vā nāyikāyāḥ vā sakhī nāyakayoḥ atha bhūyasīnām sakhīnām vā vāci kākuḥ iha sthitā evam anyāḥ api kaḥ him ityādayaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ

original: svarāsbhidhā plutādayaḥ, udāttādayaḥ, pragṛhyādayaśca te ṣu plutādayo yathā subhrutvaṃ kupitetyapāstamaśanaṃ tyaktāḥ kathā yoṣitāṃ dūrādeva vivarjitāḥ surabhayaḥ sraggandhadhūpādayaḥ | kopaṃ rāgiṇi muñca mayyavanate dṛṣṭe prasīdādhunā sarvaṃ tvadvirahādbhavanti dayite sarvā mamāndhā diśaḥ ||

original: tatra prakaraṇādyāthā saindhavaḥ sāmānyena lavaṇe'śve puruṣe ca vartamānaḥ bhojanādiprakaramavaśādarthaviśeṣapratipattinimittaṃ bhavati | devo varṣatītyarthāt devaśabdo meghamabhidhatte, rāmalakṣmaṇāviti lakṣmamaliṅgādrāmaśabdo dāśarathau vartate | puṇḍaḍḍatdhrīkamukhītyaucityātpuṇḍaḍḍatdhrīkaśabdaḥ kamalamāha |

original: amarāvatyāṃ haririti hariśabdo deśataḥ śatakratuṃ brūte | rātrau pataṅgaṃ paśyati, atra kālataḥ pataṅgaśabdaḥ śalabhamabhidhatta iti | evamanye'pi | tadyāthā bhavatu viditaṃ śabdā vakturvivakṣitasūcakāḥ smarati ca yataḥ kānte kāntāṃ haṭhātpariṭumbati | nanana mamamāmāṃ mā sprākṣīrniṣedhaparaṃ vaco bhavati śithile mānagranthau tadeva vidhāyakam ||

original: iti || abhinayo'padeśo nirdeśaḥ saṃjñā iṅgitamākāra ityabhinayādayaḥ | teṣvabhinayo yathaiddahamettatthaṇiā eddahamettehi acchivattehiṃ | eddahamettāvatthā eddahamettehidiaehiṃ || apadeśo yathetaḥ sa daityaḥ prāptaśrīrneta evārhati kṣayam | viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvadhrya svayaṃ chettumasāmpratam ||

original: tatra vyupasargasya kriyāviśeṣaṇārthavācakatvādyena yena viśeṣeṇa prathamānurāgānantare mānānantare karuṇānantare ca kāntayā saha miśrībhāvaḥ sādhvasotkampaḥ seṣryākaṣāyaṃ sautsukyarabhasaṃ saharṣavismayaṃ ca jāyate | sa sarva uddiṣṭo bhavati | so'yaṃ vimiśrapadena sambhogaścanurvidho'pyākṣiptaḥ | kāntāpadena punarasya catasro'vasthāpyante |
analyzed: tatra vyupasargasya kriyā viśeṣaṇa artha vācaka tvāt yena yena viśeṣeṇa prathama anurāga anantare māna anantare karuṇā anantare ca kāntayā saha miśrībhāvaḥ sādhvasa utkampaḥ sa iṣryā kaṣāyam sa autsukya rabhasam sa harṣa vismayam ca jāyate sa sarvaḥ uddiṣṭaḥ bhavati saḥ yam vimiśra padena sambhogaḥ canurvidhaḥ upya ākṣiptaḥ kāntā padena punar asya catasraḥ uvasthāpyante

original: tatra yadā kāntāśabdaḥ strīparyāyastadā nāmāpi strīti saṃhlādi vikarotyeva mānasam | iti saṃbhogasyādyāvasthā sattāsaṃjñikā pratīyate | yadātu kāntāśabdo manojñāparyāyastādā “kiṃ purdarśanaṃ tasyā vilāsollasitabhruvaḥ” iti nyāyātsambhogasya dvitīyāvasthā janmasaṃjñikā pratīyate |
analyzed: tatra yadā kāntā śabdaḥ strī paryāyaḥ tadā nāma api strī iti saṃhlādi vikaroti eva mānasam iti saṃbhogasya ādyā avasthā sattā saṃjñikā pratīyate yadā tu kāntā śabdaḥ manojñā paryāyaḥ tādā kim pur darśanam tasyāḥ vilāsa ullasita bhruvaḥ iti nyāyāt sambhogasya dvitīyā avasthā janma saṃjñikā pratīyate

original: yadā punaḥ kāntāśabdo vṛṣasyantīparyāyastadā punarapi sulabhaṃ tapo'nurāgī yuvagijanaḥ khalu nāpyate'nurūpaḥ | iti nyāyātsambhogasya tṛtīyānasthānubandhasaṃjñikā pratīyate | yadeva rocate mahyaṃ tadeva kurute priyā | iti vetti na jānāti tatpriyaṃ yatkaroti sā || iti nyāyātsambhogasya turīyāvasthā prakarṣasaṃjñikā prītayate |
analyzed: yadā punar kāntā śabdaḥ vṛṣasyantī paryāyaḥ tadā punar api sulabham tapaḥ anurāgī yuvagi janaḥ khalu na api atenurūpaḥ iti nyāyāt sambhogasya tṛtīyā anasthā anubandha saṃjñikā pratīyate yat eva rocate mahyam tat eva kurute priyā iti vetti na jānāti tat priyam yat karoti sā iti nyāyāt sambhogasya turīyā avasthā prakarṣa saṃjñikā prītayate

original: so'yaṃ caturbhedaścaturavasthaśca viprasambhaḥ | sambhogaścāgrato viśeṣeṇa varṇayitumupakrānto diṅbhātreṇātra sūcita iti tātparyam || athātra viśeṣādhikārinirṇāyakaviśeṣāṇāṃ kā vārtā? kāntāvimiścavapiṣa itsaya tantreṇa vyākhyānāntare te'pi sūcitā eva |
analyzed: saḥ oyam catur bhedaḥ catur avasthaḥ ca vipra sambhaḥ sambhogaḥ ca agratas viśeṣeṇa varṇayitum upakrāntaḥ diś bhātreṇa atra sūcitaḥ iti tātparyam atha atra viśeṣa adhikāri nirṇāyaka viśeṣāṇām kā vārtā tantreṇa vyākhyāna antare te api sūcitāḥ eva

original: tatra hi bhagavato vipurvupralambhamaṃmbhogayoḥ kṛtasāhāyyakamiva kāntāvimiśravapuṣaḥ puruṣān striyaśca pātviti vyakhyā bhavati | vimiśraśabdena ca seyogina iva viyogino'pyucyante, vyupasargasya kriyāviśeṣa iva kriyāvaiparītye'pyupalambhāt |
analyzed: tatra hi bhagavataḥ kṛta sāhāyyakam iva kāntā vimiśra vapuṣaḥ puruṣān striyaḥ ca pātu iti vyakhyā bhavati vimiśra śabdena ca seyoginaḥ iva viyoginaḥ api ucyante vyupasargasya kriyā viśeṣaḥ iva kriyā vaiparītye pi upalambhāt

original: tadyāthā vibhakto viyuktāśca śṛṅgārādhikāraṇa ubhaye'pi nāyakaviśeṣāḥ puruṣāḥ kāntairavimiśravapuṣo yoṣitaḥ saṃyuktā vuyuktāśca śṛṅgārādhikāriṇa ubhaye'pi nāyakaviśeṣāḥ pratīyante | vapuśśabdena punariha purārerapi viśeṣaṇapakṣe yauvanapallavitalāvaṇyalakṣmīkaṃ samagrātmaguṇasampadāśrayaḥ śarīramucyate |
analyzed: tat yāthā vibhaktaḥ viyuktāḥ ca śṛṅgāra adhikāraṇaḥ ubhaye api nāyaka viśeṣāḥ puruṣāḥ kāntaiḥ avimiśra vapuṣaḥ yoṣitaḥ saṃyuktāḥ śṛṅgāra adhikāriṇaḥ ubhaye api nāyaka viśeṣāḥ pratīyante vapuḥ śabdena punar iha purāreḥ api viśeṣaṇa pakṣe yauvana pallavita lāvaṇya lakṣmīkam samagra ātma guṇa sampad āśrayaḥ śarīram ucyate

original: na tu devādikartṛvatsṛṣṭisaṃhārakādi vapurhi sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoriva kāntāvapi dṛśyate | tadyathā gobhi rvapāvānvapuṣṭaṃ mānāmāpsaro viśeṣa, iti | tatrācchinnamekhalamityādīni kāntāvimiśravapuṣa iti samāsapadāntargatayorvibhaktisaṃyuktikriyayorgamakatvādviśeṣaṇāni bhavanti | yathā kartumanāḥ kaṭaṃ, gantukāmo grāmamiti ||
analyzed: na tu deva ādi kartṛ vat sṛṣṭi saṃhāraka ādi vapuḥ hi sṛṣṭi saṃhārayoḥ iva kāntau api dṛśyate tat yathā gobhiḥ vapāvān vapuṣṭam mā nāmā apsaraḥ viśeṣaḥ iti tatra ācchinna mekhalam ityādīni kāntā vimiśra vapuṣaḥ iti samāsa pada antargatayoḥ vibhakti saṃyukti kriyayoḥ gamaka tvāt viśeṣaṇāni bhavanti yathā kartu manāḥ kaṭam gantu kāmaḥ grāmam iti

original: atha sambhogapakṣe acchinnamekhalamityādīni kathaṃ sambandhante? ucyate | evaṃ nāmarāgāndhatayā kāntabhiḥ saha te saṃyuktāḥ yena mekhalācchedamāliṅganaṃ cumbanamālokanaṃ ca paramānandamagnāḥ kartuṃ na parārayanti, tadyathā priyayā striyā pariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaramiti, yathā ca dhanyāḥ stha yāḥ kathayatha priyasaṅgame'pi
analyzed: atha sambhoga pakṣe acchinna mekhalam ityādīni katham sambandhante ucyate evam nāma rāga andha tayā kāntabhiḥ saha te saṃyuktāḥ yena mekhalā ācchedam āliṅganam cumbanam ālokanam ca parama ānanda magnāḥ kartum na parārayanti tat yathā priyayā striyā pariṣvaktaḥ na bāhyam kiñcana veda na antaram iti yathā ca dhanyāḥ stha yāḥ kathayatha priya saṅgame pi

original: visrabdhacāṭukaśatāni ratāntareṣu | norvīṃ prati praṇihite tu kare priyeṇa sakhyaḥ śapāmi yadi kiñcidapi smarāmi || evamayaṃ prathamaślokaṃ | padāntayeva saṃhatyārthamabhidadhati vākyamiti pakṣe vyākhyāyate | athākhaṇḍhavākyārthapakṣe vyākhyāyate | tathāhyevamiha padānāmanvayo bhavati, pātu kiṃ? viśvam | kutaḥ? apāyebhyaḥ | kiṃ tat? vapuḥ |
analyzed: visrabdha cāṭuka śatāni rata antareṣu nā urvīm prati praṇihite tu kare priyeṇa sakhyaḥ śapāmi yadi kiñcid api smarāmi evam ayam prathama ślokam pada antayā iva saṃhatya artham abhidadhati vākyam iti pakṣe vyākhyāyate atha akhaṇḍha vākya artha pakṣe vyākhyāyate tathā hi evam iha padānām anvayaḥ bhavati pātu kim viśvam kutas apāyebhyaḥ kim tat vapuḥ

original: kasya? purāreḥ kīdṛśasya? kāntāvimiśravapiṣaḥ | kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ? acchinnamekhalaṃ, alabdhadṛḍhopagūḍhaṃ, aprāptacumbanaṃ, avīkṣitavaktrakānti | kathamutprekṣyamāṇaṃ? kṛtavipralambhasambhogasakhyamiveti |
analyzed: kasya purāreḥ kīdṛśasya kāntā vimiśra vapiṣaḥ kim viśiṣṭam acchinna mekhalam alabdha dṛḍha upagūḍham aprāpta cumbanam avīkṣita vaktra kānti katham utprekṣyamāṇam kṛta vipralambha sambhoga sakhyam iva iti

original: atra cāyamacchinnaśabdo bahuvīhiśca samāso'dhyāhiyamāṇapadadvayā dvādaśapadā nāndī padāviśleṣaviśeṣoktigarbha utprekṣāvāṃścāśīralaṅkāro maṅgalārthaḥ | te'mī catvāro’pi maṅgalārthāḥ śāstrādau prayuktāḥ kartuḥ śroturadhyeturadhyāpayutuśca maṅgamāvahanti |

original: yadāha maṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāvi maṅgalāntāni ca śāstrāṇyavyāhataprasarāṇi āyuṣmacchrotṛkāṇi ca bhavanti | nanu ca neha viśvamapāyebhya iti karmāpādāpadayoḥ śravaṇamasti |

original: tatkathamiveyaṃ dvādaśapadā nāndīti? ucyate, pātvitī śrutipadametat śruteścānekapadanibandhana ekaśabdaviṣayo vidhyādirarthaḥ sa cānyathānupapadyamānaḥ svasiddhaye karmakaraṇakatrradhikaraṇādikaṃ yadāścānekapadanibandhana ekaśabdaviśaṣayo vidhyādirarthaḥ, cānyathānupapadyamānaḥ svasiddhaye karmakaraṇakatrradhikaraṇādikaṃ yadākṣipati sa
analyzed: tat katham iva iyam dvādaśa padā nāndī iti ucyate pātu iti śruti padam etat śruteḥ ca aneka pada nibandhanaḥ eka śabda viṣayaḥ vidhi ādiḥ arthaḥ sa ca anyathā anupapadyamānaḥ sva siddhaye karma karaṇa katrḥ adhikaraṇa ādikam yadā ca aneka pada nibandhanaḥ eka śabda viśaṣayaḥ vidhi ādiḥ arthaḥ ca anyathā anupapadyamānaḥ sva siddhaye karma karaṇa katrḥ adhikaraṇa ādikam yadā ākṣipati sa eva aneka pada nibandhanaḥ eka śabda viśaṣayaḥ vidhi

original: ihatu yathāṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhṇamupanayīta, tamadhyāpayediti vacanāt svādhyāyo'dhyetavya ityatra dvijenācāryādityanupāttamapyavaśyameva sannidhīyate, tathehāpyapāyanirharaṇarūpatvātpātvarthasya sthite'pīśvarakartṛkasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoriva viśvaviṣayatvādapāyebhyo viśvamiti padadvayamanupādīyamānamapi niyamena sannidhīyate ||

original: nanu cāśarīriṇe maheśvasya viśvotpattisthitipralayakāramatvābhyupagame'pi kathamivocyeta vapuḥ pātviti | aśarīriṇo'pi vaiśvarūpyeṇa tadupapatteḥ | sahyevaṃ tattvavidbhiḥ stūyate mūlajālamadhibhoktṛcetanā śaktayastvadabhibhoktṛsaṃhatiḥ | jñānametadadhināyakavrajastvatsmṛtau yugapadeva bhāsate ||
analyzed: nanu ca aśarīriṇe maheśvasya viśva utpatti sthiti pralaya kārama tva abhyupagame api katham iva ucyeta vapuḥ pātu iti aśarīriṇaḥ api vaiśvarūpyeṇa tad upapatteḥ sahi evam tattva vidbhiḥ stūyate mūla jālam adhibhoktṛ cetanā śaktayaḥ tvad abhibhoktṛ saṃhatiḥ jñānam etat adhināyaka vrajaḥ tvad smṛtau yugapad eva bhāsate

original: ata eva kāntavimiśravapuṣa iti purārerviśeṣaṇaṃ tantreṇānyathā vyātakṣate | tadyathā kaṃ pānīyamante'syā iti kāntā pṛthvī, kaṃ sukhamanteṣvāsāmiti kāntā āpaḥ | ko vāyurante asyeti kāntovahniḥ | kaṃ toyamantariti kānto vāyuḥ |

original: kaṃ brahma ante'syeti kāntamākāśam, kāntirdīptistadatiśayavān kāntaḥ sūryaḥ, kāntiḥ kamanīyakaṃ tadatiśayavāṃścandramāḥ, kāntirvāllabhyaṃ tadatiśayavān kānta ātmeti kāntaśabdenāṣṭāpi bhagavato mūrtaya ucyante | tā avantītyevaṃ śīlābhavograbhīmādayo mūrtipatayaḥ kāntavinaḥ | miśraśabdaḥ pūjāvacanaḥ |
analyzed: kam brahma anta isya iti kāntam ākāśam kāntiḥ dīptiḥ tad atiśayavān kāntaḥ sūryaḥ kāntiḥ kamanīyakam tad atiśayavān candramāḥ kāntiḥ vāllabhyam tad atiśayavān kāntaḥ ātmā iti kānta śabdena aṣṭa api bhagavataḥ mūrtayaḥ ucyante tāḥ avanti iti evam śīla ābhava ugra bhīma ādayaḥ mūrti patayaḥ miśra śabdaḥ pūjā vacanaḥ

original: tenaiṣāṃ praśasāvacanaiścetyārthamiśrādivat samāsaḥ | tataḥ kāntāvimiśraṃ vapuryasyeti | bahuvrīhau vaiśvarūpyasiddhervikṣitārthasiddhiḥ || athātrācchinnamekhalamityādīnāṃ kathamanvayaḥ? tānyapi vapuṣo viśeṣaṇāni bhavanti | tatrācchinnamekhalamityanena paramucyate | mekhalā hi jaghanaparikṣepasūtram, tadaparicchinnaṃ yasyeti |
analyzed: tena eṣām praśasā vacanaiḥ ca ityārtha miśra ādi vat samāsaḥ tatas kāntā vimiśram vapuḥ yasya iti bahuvrīhau vaiśvarūpya siddheḥ vikṣita artha siddhiḥ atha atra ācchinna mekhalam ityādīnām katham anvayaḥ tāni api vapuṣaḥ viśeṣaṇāni bhavanti tatra ācchinna mekhalam iti anena param ucyate mekhalā hi jaghana parikṣepa sūtram tat aparicchinnam yasya iti

original: tadyathā gaurayaṃ śakaṭaṃ gotaro'yaṃ yaḥ śakaṭaṃ sīraṃ ca | gauriyaṃ yā samāṃ samāṃ vijāyate gotareyaṃ yā samāṃ samīcīnā jīvavatsā ca | dṛśyate hi jātivācinastajjatīyeṣvapi guṇābhidhāyitvam | saṅgrāmeṣu caratyeṣa puruṣaḥ puruṣo yathā | nāma yasyābhinandanti dviṣo'pi sapumānpumān || iti || yadyevaṃ candraguḍādibhyaḥ kalpabādayo'pi na syu |
