original: naivaṃ teṣāmīṣadasamāptāvva vidhānāt | tarhi kṛtakalpaṃ bhuktakalpamiti ktāntebhyaḥ nacāsti sambhavo yadbhūtaṃ ca syādasamāptaṃ ca, āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavañceti vacanādbhaviṣyati || || pravibhāgaḥ || pade vākye prabandhe vā'sautāvataḥ śabdasyāyamartho'sminnarthe cāyametāvacchabda iti śabdārthayormithaḥ sambandhitayā pṛthaktvenāvadhāraṇaṃ pravibhāgaḥ |
analyzed: na evam teṣām īṣat asamāptau vā vidhānāt tarhi kṛta kalpam bhukta kalpam iti kta antebhyaḥ na ca asti sambhavaḥ yat bhūtam ca syāt asamāptam ca āśaṃsāyām bhūtavat ca iti vacanāt bhaviṣyati pravibhāgaḥ pade vākye prabandhe vā asau tāvataḥ śabdasya ayam arthaḥ asmin arthe ca ayam etāvat śabdaḥ iti śabda arthayoḥ mithas sambandhi tayā pṛthaktvena avadhāraṇam pravibhāgaḥ

original: sa dvividho'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ iha khalpatyantasaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ padārthānāṃ pravibhāge'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ nānyo hetirasti |
analyzed: sa dvividhaḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām iha khalu atyanta saṃsṛṣṭānām padārthānām pravibhāga invaya vyatirekābhyām na anyaḥ hetiḥ asti

original: yathā loke badhiro'pi cakṣuṣā na lokayati, satyapi śrotre upahatacakṣurnālokayatirūpamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ cakṣuśśrotrasannidhāneṃ rūpālokanaṃ cakṣuṣa eva vyavasthāpyate na śrokṣasya, tathā śabdaśāstre'pi, subanteṣu tiṅanteṣu ca padeṣvatyantasaṃsṛṣṭā arthātmānaḥ śabdāśca prakṛtipratyayādayo mithassambandhitvenānvayavyatirekābhyāmeva
analyzed: yathā loke badhiraḥ api cakṣuṣā na lokayati sati api śrotre upahata cakṣuḥ na ālokayati rūpam iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām cakṣuḥ śrotra sannidhāne rūpa ālokanam cakṣuṣaḥ eva vyavasthāpyate na śrokṣasya tathā śabda śāstre api sup anteṣu tiṅ anteṣu ca padeṣu atyanta saṃsṛṣṭāḥ artha ātmānaḥ śabdāḥ ca prakṛti pratyaya ādayaḥ mithas sambandhi tvena anvaya vyatirekābhyām eva

original: pravibhajyanate | tatrāvasthitasyānuvṛttiranvayaḥ, tadviparyayo vyatirekaḥ, sa dvividho janmahānibhyām | tadyathā vṛkṣa ityakte kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate vṛkṣa ityakārāntaḥ sakāraśca pratyayaḥ, artho'pi kaścidgamyate śākhādimattvamektvaṃ ca | ṛkṣa ityukte kaścicchabdo hīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayī |
analyzed: tatra avasthitasya anuvṛttiḥ anvayaḥ tad viparyayaḥ vyatirekaḥ sa dvividhaḥ janma hānibhyām tat yathā vṛkṣaḥ iti akte kaścid śabdaḥ śrūyate vṛkṣaḥ iti akāra antaḥ sakāraḥ ca pratyayaḥ arthaḥ api kaścid gamyate śākhā ādimat tvam ektvam ca ṛkṣaḥ iti ukte kaścid śabdaḥ hīyate kaścid upajāyate kaścid anvayī

original: vṛkṣaśabdo hīyate ṛkṣaśabda upajāyate sakāro'nvayī, artho'pi kaściddhīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścinvayī, śākhādimattvaṃ hīyate saṭādimattvamupajāyate ekatvamanvayīti | vṛkṣāvityukte sakāro hīyate aukāraḥ upajāyate vṛkṣaśabdo'nvayī | arthe'pyekatvaṃ hīyate dvitvamupajāyate śākhādimattvamanvayīti |
analyzed: vṛkṣa śabdaḥ hīyate ṛkṣa śabdaḥ upajāyate sakāraḥ anvayī arthaḥ upi kaścid hīyate kaścid upajāyate kaścid vayī śākhā ādimat tvam hīyate saṭā ādimat tvam upajāyate ekatvam anvayi iti vṛkṣau iti ukte sakāraḥ hīyate aukāraḥ upajāyate vṛkṣa śabdaḥ anvayī arthe api ekatvam hīyate dvitvam upajāyate śākhā ādimat tvam anvayi iti

original: tiṅanteṣu śalvapi pacatītyukte kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate paca iti cakārābtaḥ atiśabdaḥ pratyayaḥ artho'pi kaścidgamyate viklittiḥ kartṛtvaṃ ca, paṭhatītyukte kaścicchabdo hīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayīti | pacchabdo hīyate paṭhaśabda upajāyate atiśabdo'nvayī |
analyzed: tiṅ anteṣu śalu api pacati iti ukte kaścid śabdaḥ śrūyate paca iti cakāra abtaḥ atiśabdaḥ pratyayaḥ arthaḥ api kaścid gamyate viklittiḥ kartṛ tvam ca paṭhati iti ukte kaścid śabdaḥ hīyate kaścid upajāyate kaścid anvayī iti pacchabdaḥ hīyate paṭha śabdaḥ upajāyate atiśabdaḥ anvayī

original: artho'pi kaściddhīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayī, viklittirhiyate paṭhikriyopajāyate kartṛtvamanvayī | pacyata ityukte atiśabdo hīyateyaśabda upajāyate pacchabdo'nvayī, artho'pi kartṛtvaṃ hīyate karmatvamupajāyate viklittiranvayinīti | te manyāmahe yaśśabdo hīyate tasyāsāvartho'nvayīti |
analyzed: arthaḥ upi kaścid hīyate kaścid upajāyate kaścid anvayī viklittiḥ hiyate paṭhi kriyā upajāyate kartṛ tvam anvayī pacyate iti ukte atiśabdaḥ hīyate iyat śabdaḥ upajāyate pacchabdaḥ anvayī arthaḥ upi kartṛ tvam hīyate karma tvam upajāyate viklittiḥ anvayinī iti te manyāmahe yaḥ śabdaḥ hīyate tasya asau arthaḥ anvayī iti

original: evaṃ vākye'pi gāmānayetyukte kevacicchabdaḥ śrūyate gāmiti dvitīyāntaḥ ānayeti ca loḍaḍḍatdhntaḥ, artho'pi kaścidgamayate sāsnādimān karmatvamāpannaḥ ānayeti kriyārthatvavidhitvamāpannaḥ, athāśvamānayetyukte gavārtho hīyate aśvārtha upajāyate ānayeti kriyārthatvavidhitvamāpannaḥ, athāśvamānayetyukte gavārtho hīyate aśvārtha upajāyate
analyzed: evam vākye api gām ānaya iti ukte kevacid śabdaḥ śrūyate gām iti dvitīyā antaḥ ānaya iti ca arthaḥ upi kaścid gamayate sāsnādimān karma tvam āpannaḥ ānaya iti kriyā artha tva vidhi tvam āpannaḥ atha aśvam ānaya iti ukte gavā arthaḥ hīyate aśva arthaḥ upajāyate ānaya iti kriyā artha tva vidhi tvam āpannaḥ atha aśvam ānaya iti ukte gavā arthaḥ hīyate aśva arthaḥ upajāyate

original: ānayanārtho'nvayī, gāṃbadhānetyukte ānayanārtho hīyate bandhanārtha upajāyate gavārtho'nvayī | evaṃ gaurānīyatāmaśva ānīyatāṃ gaurbadhyatāmaśvo badhyatāmityādiṣu karmakartṛtvayorhānirūpaḍaḍḍatdhniścābhyuhyāḥ | etena prabandho'pi vyākhyātaḥ | kaścidāha, mārīco rāmeṇa hataḥ | kaścidāha, lakṣmaṇeneti |
analyzed: ānayana arthaḥ anvayī gām badhāna iti ukte ānayana arthaḥ hīyate bandhana arthaḥ upajāyate gavārthaḥ anvayī evam gauḥ ānīyatām aśvaḥ ānīyatām gauḥ badhyatām aśvaḥ badhyatām ityādiṣu karma kartṛ tvayoḥ hāni rūpa ḍaḍḍatdhniḥ ca abhyuhyāḥ etena prabandhaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ kaścid āha mārīcaḥ rāmeṇa hataḥ kaścid āha lakṣmaṇena iti

original: tatra mārīcamṛgāghāte rāmo hīyatelakṣmaṇa upajāyate lakṣmaṇo vā hīyate rāma upajāyate, rāmāyaṇaṃ punaranvayīti || nanu ca vṛkṣaṛkṣa iti vakāro hīyate ṛ upajāyate vā, pacati paṭhatīti cakāro hīyate ṭhakāra upajāyata iti vaktavye kimarthamucyate vṛkṣaśabdo hīyate ṛkṣaśabda upajāyate, pacchabdo hīyate paṭhaśabda upajāyata iti? śabdasyārthavattā
analyzed: tatra mārīca mṛga āghāte rāmaḥ hīyate lakṣmaṇaḥ upajāyate lakṣmaṇaḥ vā hīyate rāmaḥ upajāyate rāmāyaṇam punaranvayi iti nanu ca vṛkṣa ṛkṣaḥ iti vakāraḥ hīyate ṛ upajāyate vā pacati paṭhati iti cakāraḥ hīyate ṭhakāraḥ upajāyate iti vaktavye kimartham ucyate vṛkṣa śabdaḥ hīyate ṛkṣa śabdaḥ upajāyate pacchabdaḥ hīyate paṭha śabdaḥ upajāyate iti śabdasya arthavat tā

original: yathāsyāt na varṇānam | kiṃ punarna varṇāḥ śabdaḥ? bāḍham | arthāvasānaprasavanimittaṃ śabda ityabhihitaṃ purastāt || nanvevamapi vṛkṣādīnāmarthavattā nopapadyate, kiṃ kāraṇam? kevalenāvacanāt | na hi vṛkṣādinā kevalena kaścidartho gamyate kiṃ tarhi sa pratyayakena |
analyzed: yathā asyāt na kim punar na varṇāḥ śabdaḥ bāḍham artha avasāna prasava nimittam śabdaḥ iti abhihitam purastāt nanu evam api vṛkṣa ādīnām arthavat tā na upapadyate kim kāraṇam kevalena avacanāt na hi vṛkṣa ādinā kevalena kaścid arthaḥ gamyate kim tarhi sa pratyayakena

original: kimuktaṃ bhavati, pacatyādiṣvarthavattāsahacaritā kevalavacanatā dṛṣṭā varṇeṣu cānarthakyasahacaritaṃ kevalāvacanatvam | na caite pacatyādivaddṛśyante, tasmādvarṇavaddhṛkṣādīnāmarthavattā nopapadyata iti | sapratyayasyopapadyata iti cainnaivam, iha yadyasya nimittatvenopādīyate sa tasmastena pravartitavyam |
analyzed: kim uktam bhavati pacati ādiṣu arthavat tā sahacaritā kevala vacana tā dṛṣṭā varṇeṣu ca ānarthakya sahacaritam na ca ete pacati ādi vat dṛśyante tasmāt varṇa vat hṛkṣa ādīnām arthavat tā na upapadyate iti sa pratyayasya upapadyate iti cainna evam iha yat yasya nimitta tvena upādīyate sa tasmas tena pravartitavyam

original: arthavattā ca prātipadikasaṃjñāyā nimittam | sāca dvidhā laukikī pāribhāṣikīti ca | tayorloki viditā laukīkī, kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, sattvapradhānāni nāmānīti | śāstre vyavahārārthā pāribhāṣikī | dādhādhvadāp, taraptamapaugha iti | tatra laukīki tāvadarthopalabdhigamyā, yeṣāṃ ca prātipadikasaṃjñā vidhīyate tena kadācitkevalā upalabhyante |
analyzed: arthavat tā ca prātipadika saṃjñāyāḥ nimittam sā ca dvidhā laukikī pāribhāṣikī iti ca tayoḥ loki viditā laukīkī kriyā pradhānam ākhyātam sattva pradhānāni nāmāni iti śāstre vyavahāra arthā pāribhāṣikī iti tatra laukīki tāvat artha upalabdhi gamyā yeṣām ca prātipadika saṃjñā vidhīyate tena kadācid kevalāḥ upalabhyante

original: pāribhāṣīkī tu paribhāṣayā bhavatyarthavacchabdarūpaṃ tañca prātipadikasaṃjñamiti | evaṃ ca śabdatvāviśeṣādvarṇānāmapi prasajyate | iyaṃ ca paribhāṣā na pravartate arthavahgrahaṇe nānārthakasyeti, tadevamarthavattāyā nimittasyabhāve prātipadikasaṃjñā na pravartate, tadapravṛttau tu kathaṃ pratyayotpattiriti? naivam |
analyzed: pāribhāṣīkī tu paribhāṣayā bhavati arthavat śabda rūpam tat ca prātipadika saṃjñam iti evam ca śabda tva aviśeṣāt varṇānām api prasajyate iyam ca paribhāṣā na pravartate arthavat grahaṇe nānārthakasya iti tat evam arthavat tāyāḥ nimittasya bhāve prātipadika saṃjñā na pravartate tad apravṛttau tu katham pratyaya utpattiḥ iti na evam

original: pratyayena nityasambandhāt kevalasyāprayogaḥ, nityasambandhāvetāvartho prakṛtiḥ pratyaya iti, ato nityasambandhāt kevalasya prayogo na bhaviṣyati || nanu ca bhavānāmrānpṛṣṭaḥ kovidārānācaṣṭe, arthavattā nopapadyate kevalenāvacanāditi pṛṣṭaḥ kevalasyāprayoge hetumāha nābhiprāyāparijñānāt ||

original: na hi ya evaikatvasaṃbandhī sa dvitvādisaṃbandhī, yovā prātipadikatvenārthamātrapravṛttiḥ svaśaktyantarasambandhī na bhavitumarhati | na khalu śabdaḥ kaścidattarakālamarthāntaraṃ parityajatyupādatte vā | taduktam “yasya śabdasya na vibhāgo'sti kuto'rthasya bhaviṣyati? vibhāgauḥ prakiyā kriyābhedamaviddhānapratipadyate | “ evametat |

original: kintu trividhaḥ śabdo nirvatryo'nvākhyeyaḥ pratipādakaśca | teṣvadharmaheturapabhraṃśo nirvatryaḥ | dhramaheturlokavedayoḥ prayorgauhā'nvākhyeyaḥ | prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgakalpanayā tatsvarūpāvabodhakṛtpratipādakaḥ | tadarthamanvayavyatirekāvavidyamānāvapi vyavasthārthaṃ kalpitau śāstrārthavyavahāranibandhanaṃ sampadyate |
analyzed: kintu trividhaḥ śabdaḥ nirvatryaḥ nvākhyeyaḥ pratipādakaḥ ca teṣu adharma hetuḥ apabhraṃśaḥ nirvatryaḥ dhrama hetuḥ loka vedayoḥ prayoḥ gauhā anvākhyeyaḥ prakṛti pratyaya ādi vibhāga kalpanayā tad svarūpa avabodha kṛt pratipādakaḥ tad artham anvaya vyatirekau avidyamānau api vyavasthā artham kalpitau śāstra artha vyavahāra nibandhanam sampadyate

original: śāstravyavahārohyarthavatprātipadikaṃ kriyāvacano dhāturityādiranāśritayoranvayavyatirekayorasikara eva | tadāha bhāgauranarthakaurbhinnāḥ pacatītyevamādayaḥ | anvayavyatirekau tu vyahāranibandhanam || iti || abhidhā ca vivakṣā ca tātparyaṃ ca vibhāgavat | catasraḥ kevalā hyotāśśabdasambandhaśaktayaḥ ||
analyzed: śāstra vyavahāraḥ hi arthavat prātipadikam kriyā vacanaḥ dhātuḥ ityādiḥ anāśritayoḥ anvaya vyatirekayoḥ asikaraḥ eva tat āha bhāgauḥ anarthakauḥ bhinnāḥ pacati iti evamādayaḥ anvaya vyatirekau tu iti abhidhā ca vivakṣā ca tātparyam ca vibhāgavat catasraḥ kevalāḥ śabda sambandha śaktayaḥ

original: yāpekṣā yañca sāmathryamanvayo yaśca tairmithaḥ | aikāthryaṃ yañca tāstasya sasahāyasya śaktayaḥ || uktāścātasraḥ prathamāḥ krameṇa kramādathānyāḥ prakaṭīkriyante | akhaṇḍaḍḍatdhvākyārthavivecakānāṃ śabdārthasaṃvitpariśuddhihetoḥ || iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevaviracite śṛṅgāraprakāśe kevalaśabdasambandhaśaktiprakāśo nāma saptamaḥ prakāśaḥ
analyzed: yā apekṣā yat ca sāmathryam anvayaḥ yaḥ ca taiḥ mithas aikāthryam yat ca tāḥ tasya sa sahāyasya śaktayaḥ uktāḥ ca atasraḥ prathamāḥ krameṇa kramāt atha anyāḥ prakaṭīkriyante śabda artha saṃvid pariśuddhi hetoḥ iti mahā rāja adhirāja śrī bhojadeva viracite śṛṅgāraprakāśe kevalaśabdasambandhaśaktiprakāśaḥ nāma saptamaḥ prakāśaḥ

original: aṣṭamaḥ sāpekṣaśabdaśabdaśaktiprakāśaḥ

tatrodbhūtasambandhavyatirekāṇāṃ padārthānāmittaretaratpratyākāṅkṣā vyapekṣā | sā ca sanniheti yogye ca bhavati | tadyathā devo varṣatīti varṣaṇakriyākartāramantareṇābhavantī sannihitaṃ yogyaṃ ca devamapekṣate | yatra tu sannihitasya na yogyatā tatra vyavahitamapi yogyamevāpekṣyate |
analyzed: tatra udbhūta sambandha vyatirekāṇām padārthānām ittaretarat prati ākāṅkṣā vyapekṣā sā ca sannihā iti yogye ca bhavati tat yathā devaḥ varṣati iti varṣaṇa kriyā kartāram antareṇa abhavantī sannihitam yogyam ca devam apekṣate yatra tu sannihitasya na yogyatā tatra vyavahitam api yogyam eva apekṣyate

original: yathā praviṣaśapiṇḍīmityatra na praveśanakriyāmapyayogyāyāṃ piṇḍyāmasambhavantī vyavahitamapi yogyaṃ gṛhādikamapekṣate | piṇḍīmityetadapi karmapadaṃ praviśetyasminnasambhavadyogyameva bhakṣayetyādikriyāpadamapekṣata iti | seyaṃ vyapekṣā saṃkṣepataḥ padārthānāṃ tredhā sambhavaty ābhidhānikī, naiyāyikī | naiṣadhikī ca |
analyzed: yathā praviṣa śapiṇḍīm iti atra na praveśana kriyām api ayogyāyām piṇḍyām asambhavantī vyavahitam api yogyam gṛha ādikam apekṣate piṇḍīm iti etat api karma padam praviśa iti asmin asambhavat yogyam eva bhakṣaya ityādi kriyā padam apekṣate iti sā iyam vyapekṣā saṃkṣepataḥ padārthānām tredhā sambhavati ābhidhānikī naiyāyikī naiṣadhikī ca

original: tatra śrutisamāropavākyavikalpasamuñcayātideśādibhirabhidhīyamānā ābhidhānikī | ūhaviparyayavipariṇamādhyāhāravākyaviśevyavahitaklapanādibhirupalpyamānā naiyāyikī | vacanāmambhavavirodhakṛtārthaparisaṅkhyāvadhāraṇādibhiniṣidhyamānā naiṣadhikī |
analyzed: tatra śruti samāropa vākya vikalpa samuñcaya atideśa ādibhiḥ abhidhīyamānā ābhidhānikī ūha viparyaya vipariṇama adhyāhāra vākya viśe vyavahita klapana ādibhiḥ upalpyamānā naiyāyikī vacana amambhava virodha kṛtārtha parisaṅkhyā avadhāraṇa ādibhiḥ niṣidhyamānā naiṣadhikī

original: tāsvābhidhānikī tāvadyatra dvayoḥ sādhamryārthamāvṛttyā vibhaktiśrutibhedena ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyanirdeśaḥ sā śrutyābhidhānikī | yathāṅgenāṅgāṃ pratanu tanunā gāḍhataptena taptaṃ | sāstreṇāstradravamaviralotkaṣṭhamukaṇṭhitena | uṣṇocchvāsaṃ samadhikatarocchvāsinā dūravatīṃ saṅkalpaistairviśati vidhīnā vairaṇā ruddhamārgaḥ ||
analyzed: tāsu ābhidhānikī tāvat yatra dvayoḥ sādhamrya artham āvṛttyā vibhakti śruti bhedena ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya nirdeśaḥ sā śrutyā ābhidhānikī yathā aṅgena aṅgām pratanu tanunā gāḍha taptena taptam sa astreṇa astra dravam avirala utkaṣṭham ukaṇṭhitena uṣṇa ucchvāsam samadhikatara ucchvāsinā dūravatīm saṅkalpaiḥ taiḥ viśati vidhīnā ruddha mārgaḥ

original: yatrāpi sādhamryārthādeva dvayostantreṇa ca vibhaktyabhedena ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayogaḥ, sā ca śrutyābhidhānikī | yathā daivādapatramacchāyaṃ phalārthibhirasevitam |sānujaṃ śākhinamiva dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ riroda sā || yatra padena vākyena vā saṃjñārtho vidhīyate sā samākhyābhidhānikī |
analyzed: yatra api sādhamrya arthāt eva dvayoḥ tantreṇa ca vibhakti abhedena ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya yogaḥ sā ca śrutyā ābhidhānikī yathā daivāt apatram acchāyam phala arthibhiḥ asevitam sa anujam śākhinam iva dṛṣṭvā rāmam riroda sā yatra padena vākyena vā saṃjñā arthaḥ vidhīyate sā samākhyā ābhidhānikī

original: sā padena yathāsau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatānāmagādhasattvo magadhapratiṣṭhaḥ | rājā prajārañjanalabdhavarṇaḥ parantapo nāma yathārthanām |. vākyena yathā sañcaṃ dhannādhannā jātaiā kesaveṇa giridharaṇe | gurubhārapāvaḍeḍḍatdhṇa via ajjuaacchaṃ ciraṃ diṭhṭhā ||
analyzed: sā padena yathā asau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇa āgatānām agādha sattvaḥ magadha pratiṣṭhaḥ rājā prajā rañjana labdha varṇaḥ parantapaḥ nāma yathā artha nām vākyena yathā kesaveṇa giri dharaṇe via ciram diṭhṭhā

original: yatra vyapekṣotthāpakāvākyamabhidhāya tadupapādakamabhidhīyate, upapādakaṃ vābhidhāya vyapekṣotthāpakaṃ sā vākyābhidhīnikī | tayorādyā yathā sāuppannīgoṭī ḍainavasvikavi ....... ti | bhuḍḍḍatdhḍaḍḍatdhpcalli isomarahajāsunanalaśśaikaṃṭhi || dvitīyā yathā vāṇidhamoḍiañcaruṇākhao dāreeṃ tu na diṭhṭha | māeṇajahukemalaḍollāhia ivaiṭhṭha ||
analyzed: yatra vyapekṣā utthāpakāḥ vākyam abhidhāya tat upapādakam abhidhīyate upapādakam vā abhidhāya vyapekṣā utthāpakam sā vākya ābhidhīnikī tayoḥ ādyā yathā ti dvitīyā yathā tu na tu na tu na tu

original: vaikalpikatābhidhānaprabhavā vikalpābhidhīnikī yathāṃburukhoñciasamuddutaresiladuhiḍoggarukāṇi | tahimohipatayīokalahiojevariñca ite vaaṇi || samuñcayakābhidhānaprabhavā samuñcayābhidhānikī | yathā hia ikhukkaigoḍaḍḍatdhrī gaaṇe huḍiḍḍatdhkka imohu | vāsarattapavāsa achaṃ hasamāsaṃ kaḍuehu ||
analyzed: vaikalpikatā abhidhāna prabhavā vikalpa ābhidhīnikī yathā ite samuñcayaka abhidhāna prabhavā samuñcaya abhidhānikī yathā

original: sāmānyaviśeṣātideśaprāptadharmāṇaṃ yatrāgrataḥ paścādvābhidhānaṃ sātideśābhidhānikī | tatra sāmānyātideśaprāptadharmābhidhānamagrato yathā hia iti ricchivahi samuhalacchaigahiakaḍaḍḍatdhvaccha | pahiahaekajiśoraḍīnaṃ caubhaṭṭaaraccha || evaṃ paścādapi draṣṭhavyam |
analyzed: sāmānya viśeṣa atideśa prāpta dharmāṇam yatra agratas paścāt vā abhidhānam sā atideśa ābhidhānikī tatra sāmānya atideśa prāpta dharma abhidhānam agratas yathā hia iti evam paścāt api draṣṭhavyam

original: viśeṣātideśaprāptadharmābhidhānaṃ paścādyāthā mahilattāṇaṇivyāhi uaekalavijjappiāi | ṇehakka uviavira hunamme vidaṭṭaṇajāi || ādigrahaṇādyatraikamabhidhānaḥ prasaṅgenānyadapyabhidhatte sā prasaṅgābhidhānikī | sāpi dvidhā padato vākyataśca | tayorādyā yathā sāvasaloṇīgoraḍī ..... ahomaḍuḍḍatdhrai soo |
analyzed: viśeṣa atideśa prāpta dharma abhidhānam paścāt yā athā ādi grahaṇāt yatra ekam abhidhānaḥ prasaṅgena anyat api abhidhatte sā prasaṅgābhidhānikī sā api dvidhā padataḥ vākyataḥ ca tayoḥ ādyā yathā

original: tikkhaappapalovvaṇaeviraḍuḍḍatdhdikaḍi, akasāo || atra rūpaṃ varṇanprasaṅgataḥ ṣaḍraḍḍatdhsānabhimatānabhimatatvaṃ ca teṣāṃ nirdiśati | dvītīyā yathā pratyagronmeṣajihmā kṣamamanabhimukhī ratvadīpaprabhāṇā mātmavyāpāraguvīṃ janitajalalavā jṛmbhaṇaiḥ sāṅgabhaṅgauḥ |
analyzed: atra rūpam varṇan prasaṅgataḥ ca teṣām nirdiśati dvītīyā yathā pratyagra unmeṣa jihmā kṣamam anabhimukhī mā ātma vyāpāra guvīm janita jala lavā jṛmbhaṇaiḥ sa aṅga bhaṅgauḥ

original: nāgāṅkaṃ moktumiccho śayanamuphamācakravālopadhānaṃ nidrācchedābhitāmrā ciramavatu haredrdaṣṭirākekarā vaḥ || atra mudrārākṣase cāṇakyena kaumudīmahotsave niṣaddhe rākṣasayukte vaitālikaḥ prabhāte maṅgalāni paṭhan śaradavatāro vartate iti candraguptasyāguptamāvedayati | atha naiyāyikī |
analyzed: nāga aṅkam moktum iccho śayanam ā cakravāla upadhānam nidrā cheda abhitāmrā ciram avatu vaḥ atra mudrārākṣase cāṇakyena kaumudīmahotsave niṣaddhe rākṣasa yukte vaitālikaḥ prabhāte maṅgalāni paṭhan śarad avatāraḥ vartate iti candraguptasya aguptam āvedayati atha naiyāyikī

original: yatra pūrvoktameva vākyamarthāntare vakratarādibhirūhayitvā niveśyate tāmūhanaiyāyikīmāmananti | tadyathā kālidāsaḥ “kiṃ kuntaleśvaraḥ karotīti” vikramādityena pṛṣṭa uktavān | asakalahasitatvātkṣālitānīva kāntyā mukulitanayanatvādvyaktakarṇotpalāni | pibati madhusugandhīnyānanāni priyāṇāṃ tvayi vinihitabhāraḥ kuntalānāmadhīśaḥ ||
analyzed: yatra pūrva uktam eva vākyam arthāntare vakratara ādibhiḥ ūhayitvā niveśyate tām ūha naiyāyikīm āmananti tat yathā kālidāsaḥ kim kuntaleśvaraḥ karoti iti vikramādityena pṛṣṭaḥ uktavān a sakala hasita tvāt kṣālitāni iva kāntyā mukulita nayana tvāt vyakta karṇa utpalāni pibati madhu sugandhīni ānanāni priyāṇām tvayi vinihita bhāraḥ kuntalānām adhīśaḥ

original: idamevohayitvā vikramādatyaḥ pratyuvāca pibatu madhusugandhānyānanāni priyāṇāṃ mayi vinihitabhāraḥ kuntalānāmadhīśaḥ || yatra pāṭhakrameṇa saṃbandhānupapattāvarthakrameṇa viparyasya padāni yojyante sā viparyayanaiyāyikī | yathā svayaṃviśīrṣadrumaparṇavṛttitā parā kahi kāṣṭhā tapasastayā punaḥ |
analyzed: idam evā ūhayitvā vikramādatyaḥ pratyuvāca pibatu madhu sugandhāni ānanāni priyāṇām mayi vinihita bhāraḥ kuntalānām adhīśaḥ yatra pāṭha krameṇa saṃbandha anupapattau artha krameṇa viparyasya padāni yojyante sā viparyaya naiyāyikī yathā svayam viśīrṣa druma parṇa vṛtti tā parā kāṣṭhā tapasaḥ tayā punar

original: tadapyavākīrṇamataḥ priyaṃvadāṃ vadantyaparṇāmiti tāṃ purāvidaḥ || atrātastāṃ prayiṃvadāmaparṇāṃ vadanti purāvida iti paryāyeṇa padāni yojyante, yatra tulyārthapadaprayoge vibhaktivipāriṇāmena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoryojayante sā vipariṇāmanaiyāyikī | yathā dantojjavalāsu vimalopalamekhalāntāssadratnacitrakaṭakāsu bṛhannitambāḥ |
analyzed: tat api avākīrṇam atas priyaṃvadām vadanti aparṇām iti tām purāvidaḥ atra atas tām prayiṃvadām aparṇām vadanti purāvidaḥ iti paryāyeṇa padāni yojyante yatra tulya artha pada prayoge vibhakti vipāriṇāmena viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ yojayante sā vipariṇāma naiyāyikī yathā bṛhat nitambāḥ

original: asmin bhajanti ghanakomalagaṇḍaḍḍatdhśailā nāryo'nurūpamadhivāsamadhityakāsu || atra saptamayantīni prathamāntatāni ca viśeṣaṇāni nārīradhityakāśca vibhaktivipariṇāmato viśeṣayanti | etena vacanavibhaktipariṇāmo liṅgavipariṇāmaśca vyākhyātaḥ | tayorādyo yathā hastasthitākhaṇḍiḍḍatdhtakraśālinaṃ dvijendrakāntaṃ śritavakṣasaṃ śriyā |
analyzed: asmin bhajanti ghana komala gaṇḍaḍḍatdhśailāḥ nāryaḥ anurūpam adhivāsam adhityakāsu atra ca viśeṣaṇāni nārīḥ adhityakāḥ ca vibhakti vipariṇāmataḥ viśeṣayanti etena vacana vibhakti pariṇāmaḥ liṅga vipariṇāmaḥ ca vyākhyātaḥ tayoḥ ādyaḥ yathā dvijendra kāntam śrita vakṣasam śriyā

original: satyānuraktaṃ narakasya jiṣṇavo guṇairnṛpāḥ śāÐṅgaṇamanvayāsiṣuḥ || dvitīyā yathā rociṣṇukāñcanacayāṃśupiśaṅgitāśā vaṃśadhvajairjaladasaṃhatimullikhantyaḥ | bhūbharturātanirantarasanniviṣṭāḥ pādā ivābhibabhurāvalayo rathānām || yatrākāṅkṣānivṛttaye'rthāntaramadhyāhriyate, sādhyāhāranaiyāyikī | yathā na dānena na mānena na śāṭhyena na sevayā |
analyzed: satya anuraktam narakasya jiṣṇavaḥ guṇaiḥ nṛpāḥ śāÐṅgaṇam anvayāsiṣuḥ dvitīyā yathā rociṣṇu kāñcana caya aṃśu piśaṅgita āśāḥ vaṃśa dhvajaiḥ jalada saṃhatim ullikhantyaḥ bhūbhartuḥ āta nirantara sanniviṣṭāḥ pādāḥ iva abhibabhuḥ āvalayaḥ rathānām yatra ākāṅkṣā nivṛttayā irtha antaram adhyāhriyate sā adhyāhāra naiyāyikī yathā na dānena na mānena na śāṭhyena na sevayā

original: na śastreṇa na śāstreṇa sarvathā kimapi striyaḥ|| atra laśībhantītyādiradhyāhāraḥ | yatra liṅādesaśrutau vidhirniṣedho vā sarvavākyānāṃ vidhīniṣedhaparatve na prakalpyate sā vākyaśeṣanaiyāyikī | yathā tadetatkākatālīyaṃ tadedatvā ghuṇākṣaram | yadanātmavatāmāyuryañcānītimatāṃ śriyaḥ || tasmādātmavatā rājye taṃ niśamya pratiṣṭhitam |
analyzed: na śastreṇa na śāstreṇa sarvathā kim api striyaḥ atra laśībhanti ityādiḥ adhyāhāraḥ yatra vidhiḥ niṣedhaḥ vā sarva vākyānām na prakalpyate sā vākyaśeṣa naiyāyikī yathā tat etat kākatālīyam ghuṇākṣaram yat anātmavatām āyuḥ yat ca anītimatām śriyaḥ tasmāt ātmavatā rājye tam niśamya pratiṣṭhitam

original: pūrvaṃ pradhūpito sājñāṃ dṛdaye| hṛdayegnirivotthitaḥ || atrāgnerniśamānākriyāsambhavāt pūrvakālatvāyege taṃ niśamyapi rājñāṃ rajatāmiti vayutpattikālārtho vyavahito vyavapeśryate| tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate | taṃ rājye pratiṣṭhitaṃ niśamya rājābhimāna mudvahatāṃ hṛdaye'gnirinotthita iti | etena guṇakalpanā naiyāyikyapi vyākhyātā |

original: evaṃ padānyapi parasparāpekṣīṇi saṃhatya kāryaṃ kariṣyanti | na ca parasparasyārthamabhidhāsyanti vākyānyapi prakaramapatitānyenameva | taduktaṃ prakṛtipratyayau yaddhadapekṣete parasparam | padaṃ padāntaraṃ tadvadvākyaṃ vākyāntaraṃ tathā || iti | ayameva ca pakṣaḥ śreyān | saṃhatyakāritvaṃ padārthānāṃ saṅkīrṇānāñca |
analyzed: evam padāni api paraspara apekṣīṇi saṃhatya kāryam kariṣyanti na ca parasparasya artham abhidhāsyanti vākyāni api prakaram apatitāni enam eva tat uktam prakṛti pratyayau yat hat apekṣete parasparam padam pada antaram tadvat vākyam vākya antaram tathā iti ayam eva ca pakṣaḥ śreyān saṃhatya kāri tvam padārthānām saṅkīrṇānām ca

original: nirapekṣaprayoge yā sakalā kalpanā bhavet | tadanvitabhidhāne tu padāntamanarthakam || saṃhatyakāripakṣe tu doṣo naikopi yujyate | tenāyamupagantavyo mārgo vigatakaṇṭakaḥ || abhidhītrī matā śaktiḥ padānāṃ svārthāniṣṭhatā | teṣāṃ tātparyaśaktistu saṃsargāvagamāvadhiḥ || tenānvitābhidhānaṃ hi nāsmābhiriha mṛṣyate |
analyzed: nirapekṣa prayoge yā sakalā kalpanā bhavet tad anvita abhidhāne tu pada antam anarthakam saṃhatya kāri pakṣe tu doṣaḥ na ekaḥ api yujyate tena ayam upagantavyaḥ mārgaḥ vigata kaṇṭakaḥ abhidhītrī matā śaktiḥ padānām svārtha aniṣṭha tā teṣām tātparya śaktiḥ tu saṃsarga avagama avadhiḥ tena anvita abhidhānam hi na asmābhiḥ iha mṛṣyate

original: anvitapratipattistu bāḍhamabhyupagamyate || saṃhatyakāritvāñcā padānāṃ na svārtha eva tātparyārthamuñcāraṇaṃ, apitu pradhānakāryameva kartum | taduktaṃ vākyārthamitaye teṣāṃ pravṛttau nāntarīyakam | pāke jvālena kāṣṭhānāṃ padārthapratipādanam || tasmānnānvitābhidhānaṃ nāpyabhihitānāmanvayaḥ | kinti yathopanyāstapakṣa eva śreyāniti |
analyzed: anvita pratipattiḥ tu bāḍham abhyupagamyate padānām na svārthe eva tātparya artham uñcāraṇam apitu pradhāna kāryam eva kartum tat uktam vākya artha mitaye teṣām pravṛttau nāntarīyakam pāke jvālena kāṣṭhānām padārtha pratipādanam tasmāt na anvita abhidhānam na api abhihitānām anvayaḥ yathā upanyāsta pakṣaḥ eva śreyān iti

original: tadevamākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatāvantaḥ padārthaścatuṣprakāramanvayamanubhavanto vākyārthībhavanti | nanu cāyogyatāyāmapyanvayo dṛśyate, bhavati paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti | nahi sādhyaikasvabhāvāyāḥ sādhyatvaṃ sādhananvaṃ ca yujyata iti | naivam, sādhyatvenaiva sādhanatvāt | kriyābhyupapattirūpeṇa bhavanasvabhāvā sādhyasvabhāvenaiva kramarūpā |
analyzed: tat evam ākāṅkṣā sannidhi yogyatāvantaḥ padārthaḥ catuṣprakāram anvayam anubhavantaḥ vākya arthībhavanti nanu ca ayogyatāyām api anvayaḥ dṛśyate bhavati paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti nahi sādhya eka svabhāvāyāḥ sādhya tvam sādhana nvam ca yujyate iti na evam sādhya tvena eva sādhana tvāt kriyā abhyupapatti rūpeṇa bhavana svabhāvā sādhya svabhāvena eva krama rūpā

original: yadeva cāsyā anidantānirdeśyamapariniṣṭhitaṃ bhavanaṃ sādhyaikarūpaṃ tenaivaiṣātra sādhyabāvaṃ ca pratipadyata iti siddhātāvabhāsaḥ kuta iti cet? kartaryutpanno lakārastāṃ siddhatvenāvabhāsayati | yathā corasya rujatīti | dhātvartha eva rogalakṣaṇaḥ, katrrantarāśravaṇāt sādhyarūpeṇaiva kartṛbhāvamanubhavatsiddhatayāvabhāsate |
analyzed: yat eva ca asyāḥ bhavanam sādhya ekarūpam tena eva eṣā atra sādhya bāvam ca pratipadyate iti siddhāta avabhāsaḥ kutas iti ced kartari utpannaḥ lakāraḥ tām siddhatvena avabhāsayati yathā corasya rujati iti dhātvarthaḥ eva roga lakṣaṇaḥ katrḥ antara aśravaṇāt sādhya rūpeṇa eva kartṛ bhāvam anubhavat siddhatayā avabhāsate

original: yadi vā padasya na padarapamevādhikārthatā kintarhi vākyarūpāt? tadyathā puruṣa iti padakāle puruṣo vyatiriktā ucyate | yadā tu rājñaḥ puruṣa iti viśeṣaṇasannidhiyogyastadāṣasya vyatireko bhavati, puruṣaviśeṣo'yaṃ rājapuruṣa iti| evaṃ pacatīti naitasmātpadarūpādevādhikārthatvam |
analyzed: yadi vā padasya na kin tarhi vākya rūpāt tat yathā puruṣaḥ iti pada kāle puruṣaḥ vyatiriktāḥ ucyate yadā tu rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti viśeṣaṇa sannidhi yogyaḥ vyatirekaḥ bhavati puruṣa viśeṣaḥ yam rāja puruṣaḥ iti evam pacati iti na etasmāt pada rūpāt eva adhika artha tvam

original: yadā tu bhavatīti padāntarasannidhiḥ tadā vākyakāle puruṣasyeva vyatireka upajāyata iti | yadi vā na kadācidaparā tadatirekiṇī bhavanakriyā, kaścidaparo vā kartā virodhaheturasti | apitu saiva vyapadeśivadbhāvanyāyena kriyārūpatāṃ bhavitṛtvaṃ ca darśayantī cakāsti |
analyzed: yadā tu bhavati iti pada antara sannidhiḥ tadā vākya kāle puruṣasya iva vyatirekaḥ upajāyate iti yadi vā na kadācid aparā tad atirekiṇī bhavana kriyā kaścid aparaḥ vā kartā virodha hetuḥ asti apitu sā eva vyapadeśivat bhāva nyāyena kriyā rūpatām bhavitṛ tvam ca darśayantī cakāsti

original: api caikasyāpyarthasya viṣayabhedena dvidharmatvaṃ dṛśyate yathā rājñaḥ puruṣasya putra iti puruṣaḥ, śeṣī ca bhavati śeṣaśceti rājānaṃ pratiśeṣī | avicalitasvārthaputrārthāntaraṃ vicalitasvārthaḥ śeṣatvamāpadyate | evaṃ bhavati pacatītyatra bhavato'kartṛtvaṃ sādhyatvaṃ ca bhaviṣyati |
analyzed: api ca ekasya api arthasya viṣaya bhedena dvi dharma tvam dṛśyate yathā rājñaḥ puruṣasya putraḥ iti puruṣaḥ śeṣī ca bhavati śeṣaḥ ca iti rājānam pratiśeṣī avicalita sva artha putra artha antaram vicalita sva arthaḥ śeṣa tvam āpadyate evam bhavati pacati iti atra sādhya tvam ca bhaviṣyati

original: paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra ca mṛgo kartari sādhyabhāvaṃ prādhānyaṃ cājahatsaraṇaṃ dṛśāvaṅgatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ ca gamiṣyatīti | atavāyamarthaḥ sādhanamayaṃ sādhyamiti pusiddhamātrametat | yathā pade ayaṃ prakṛtyartho'yaṃ pratyayārtha iti eka evāsāvartho viśeṣṭo vā khaṇḍa, eva pratīyate | yathā muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati carcayatīti |
analyzed: paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra ca kartari sādhya bhāvam prādhānyam ca ajahat saraṇam dṛśau aṅga tvam sādhana tvam ca gamiṣyati iti atava ayam arthaḥ sādhanam ayam sādhyam iti pusiddha mātram etat yathā pade ayam prakṛti arthaḥ yam pratyaya arthaḥ iti ekaḥ eva asau arthaḥ viśeṣṭaḥ vā khaṇḍaḥ eva pratīyate yathā muṇḍaḥ ḍatdhyati carcayati iti

original: atra muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati māṇavakamiti miṇḍiḍḍatdhḥ keśacchedanavacanaḥ | asya tu vyutpattiḥ muṇḍaṃ, karotīti | karotiṃ sāmānyapravṛttaṃ viśeṣe muṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdo'vasthāpayati | karotiviśeṣo'yaṃ yasmiṇṇijitpadyate na karotimātram | evaṃ carcāṃ karoti carcayatīti |
analyzed: atra muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati māṇavakam iti miṇḍiḍḍatdhḥ keśa chedana vacanaḥ asya tu vyutpattiḥ muṇḍam karoti iti karotim sāmānya pravṛttam viśeṣe muṇḍaḍḍatdh śabdaḥ vasthāpayati karoti viśeṣaḥ yam na karoti mātram evam carcām karoti carcayati iti

original: ataḥ kecinmuṇḍiḍḍatdhcarcādīṃścirādiṣu paṭhanti miṇḍaḍḍatdhkeśakhaṇḍaḍḍatdhneṣu muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati carcayatīti | evaṃ paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti | idamatra sādhanapadamidaṃ sādhyamityutprekṣaiṣā | idaṃ tvarthasatatvam| nātra saraṇaṃ, na darśanaṃ, na mṛgaḥ | kintarhi mṛgakartṛko dṛśikarmā saraṇaviśeṣo'yaṃ khaṇḍo vākyārthaṃ iti |
analyzed: atas kecid muṇḍiḍḍatdhcarcā ādīn cira ādiṣu paṭhanti miṇḍaḍḍatdhkeśa khaṇḍaḍḍatdhneṣu muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati carcayati iti evam paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti idam atra sādhana padam idam sādhyam iti utprekṣā eṣā idam tu artha sata tvam na atra saraṇam na darśanam na mṛgaḥ kin tarhi mṛga kartṛkaḥ dṛśi karmā saraṇa viśeṣaḥ yam khaṇḍaḥ vākya artham iti

original: etena putramicchati putrīyatītyīdayo'pi vyākhyātāḥ | vyapekṣāvatāṃ samarthānāmanvitārthānāṃ ca padārthānāṃ tilataṇḍuḍḍatdhlavat kṣīranīravat pāṃsasūkavañca yadavibhāgarūpeṇa bhavanaṃ sa ekārthībhāvaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ caitatsamastaṃ vyastaṃ ca | tena sāpekṣāsamarthasamāsadīnāmupasaṅgrahaḥ |
analyzed: etena putram icchati vyākhyātāḥ vyapekṣāvatām samarthānām anvita arthānām ca padārthānām yat avibhāga rūpeṇa bhavanam saḥ ekārthībhāvaḥ lakṣaṇam ca etat samastam vyastam ca tena sa apekṣā samartha samāsa dīnām upasaṅgrahaḥ

original: kaḥ puranasya vyapekṣāto bhedaḥ? ucyate, vyapekṣāyāṃ saṅkhyāviśeṣe vyaktābhidhānamupasarjanaviśeṣaṇaṃ cayogaḥ kramāniyamo vyavadhānaṃ yatheṣṭamanyamekavadbhāvaḥ ekaśeṣaḥ | anekavidhānāmaikyamekavidhānaṃ cānaikyamiti | tadyāthā vyapekṣāyāṃ saṅkhyaviśeṣaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, rājño puruṣaḥ, rājñāṃ vā puruṣaḥ | ekārthībhāve tu tadabhāvo rājapuruṣaḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ puranasya vyapekṣātaḥ bhedaḥ ucyate vyapekṣāyām saṅkhyā viśeṣe vyakta abhidhānam upasarjana viśeṣaṇam ca yogaḥ krama aniyamaḥ vyavadhānam yathā iṣṭam anyam eka vat bhāvaḥ ekaśeṣaḥ anekavidhānām aikyam eka vidhānam ca anaikyam iti tat yāthā vyapekṣāyām saṅkhya viśeṣaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ rājñām vā puruṣaḥ ekārthībhāve tu tad abhāvaḥ rāja puruṣaḥ

original: vyapekṣāyāṃ vyaktibhidhānaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, ekārthībhāve tu rājapuruṣa ityatra loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ vibhaktilopoveti nābhidhānavyaktiḥ vyapekṣāyāmupasarjanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ, ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ | ekārthībhāve tadabhāvaḥ, rājapuruṣaḥ | vyapekṣāyāṃ ca yogaḥ, rājñaḥ puruṣo brāhmaṇasya ca |
analyzed: vyapekṣāyām vyakti abhidhānam rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ekārthībhāve tu rāja puruṣaḥ iti atra loṇ madhyamapuruṣa ekavacanam vibhakti lopaḥ vā iti na abhidhāna vyaktiḥ vyapekṣāyām upasarjanasya viśeṣaṇam ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ekārthībhāve tad abhāvaḥ rāja puruṣaḥ vyapekṣāyām ca yogaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ brāhmaṇasya ca

original: ekārthībhāve tu rājapuruṣaḥ, vyapekṣāyāṃ kramāniyamo rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ rājñaḥ | ekārthībhāve tu rājapuruṣoyamityeva | vyapekṣāyāṃ yatheṣṭamanyareṇābhisambandhaḥ, rājñaḥ puruṣo bhāryā veti | ekārthībhāve tu niyamataḥ puruṣeṇaiva sambandho na bhāryayā | vyapekṣāyāṃ śabdāntaraprayogo dadhnopasiktaṃ pariglāno'dhyayanāya |
analyzed: ekārthībhāve tu rāja puruṣaḥ vyapekṣāyām krama aniyamaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ rājñaḥ ekārthībhāve tu rāja puruṣaḥ ūyam iti eva vyapekṣāyām yatheṣṭam anyareṇa abhisambandhaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ bhāryā vā iti ekārthībhāve tu niyamataḥ puruṣeṇa eva sambandhaḥ na bhāryayā vyapekṣāyām śabda antara prayogaḥ dadhnā upasiktam pariglāna udhyayanāya

original: ekārthībhāve tu naivam, dadhyodanaṃ paryadhyayana iti | ekārthībhāne aikapadyaṃ yathātmānā tṛtīyaḥ kaṇṭhe kāla iti | aikaśabdhaṃ yathā pitarau bhrātarāviti | aikasvaryaṃ yathā citraguḥ, brāhmaṇakambala iti | ekavibhaktitvaṃ yathā nīlotpalaṃ, rājapuriṣa iti | ekavadbhāvo yathā gavāśvaṃ, plakṣanyagrodha iti |
analyzed: ekārthībhāve tu na evam dadhyodanam paryadhyayane iti ekārthībhāne aikapadyam yathā ātmānā tṛtīyaḥ kaṇṭhe kālaḥ iti aikaśabdham yathā pitarau bhrātarau iti aikasvaryam yathā citraguḥ brāhmaṇa kambalaḥ iti eka vibhakti tvam yathā nīlotpalam rāja puriṣaḥ iti ekavat bhāvaḥ yathā gavāśvam plakṣa nyagrodhaḥ iti

original: ekaśeṣo yathākṣā vṛkṣā iti |anekavidhānāmaikyaṃ yathā putramicchatyātmanaḥ putrīyati, muṇḍaṃ, karoti muṇḍaḍḍatdhyatīti | ekavidhānāmanaikyaṃ yathā kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭe kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, puṣyacandrayogaṃ jānāti puṣyeṇa candraṃ yojayatīti | vyapekṣāyāṃ tu naivamiti |
analyzed: eka śeṣaḥ yathā akṣāḥ vṛkṣāḥ iti anekavidhānām aikyam yathā putram icchati ātmanaḥ putrīyati muṇḍam karoti ekavidhānām anaikyam yathā kaṃsa vadham ācaṣṭe kaṃsam ghātayati puṣya candra yogam jānāti puṣyeṇa candram yojayati iti vyapekṣāyām tu na evam iti

original: so'yamekārthībhāvo vyapekṣāvailakṣaṇyena viprathamānassamānassamāsataddhitākhyādiṣu triṣu tridhā vikhyāyate, vākyatulyārthaḥ vākyādhikārthaḥ vākyānyārtha iti | vākyatulyārtho yathā vīraḥ puruṣo vīrapuruṣaḥ, kaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ kaṣṭaśrita iti |
analyzed: saḥ ayam ekārthībhāvaḥ vyapekṣā vailakṣaṇyena viprathamānaḥ samānaḥ samāsa taddhita ākhyā ādiṣu triṣu tridhā vikhyāyate vākya tulya arthaḥ vākya adhika arthaḥ vākya anya arthaḥ iti vākya tulya arthaḥ yathā vīraḥ puruṣaḥ vīra puruṣaḥ kaṣṭam śritaḥ kaṣṭa śritaḥ iti

original: vākyādhikārtho yathā guḍeḍḍatdhna miśrā dhānāḥ guḍaḍḍatdhdhānāḥ, śaṅkulayākṛtaḥ khaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ śaṅkulakhaṇḍa, iti | vākyānyārtho yathā kuśaṃ lātīti kuśalaḥ, prakṛṣṭo pravīṇaḥ | athāyaṃ triprakāro'pyanekadhā bhidyate |
analyzed: vākya adhika arthaḥ yathā miśrāḥ dhānāḥ guḍaḍḍatdhdhānāḥ śaṅkulayākṛtaḥ khaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ śaṅkula khaṇḍaḥ iti vākya anya arthaḥ yathā kuśam lāti iti kuśalaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ pravīṇaḥ atha ayam tri prakāraḥ api anekadhā bhidyate

original: tadyathā nityasamāsaḥ, nityāsamāsaḥ, asamarthasamāsaḥ, aluksamāsaḥ, sāpekṣasamāsaḥ, nirapekṣasamāsaḥ, pūrvapadapradhānaḥ, uttarapadapradhānaḥ, ubhayapadapradhānaḥ, anayapadapradhānaḥ, anyathopasarjanaḥ, tiṅsamāsaḥ, prātipadikasamāsaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, prādisamāsaḥ, nañsamāsaḥ, ekadeśisamāsaḥ, sāmānayasamāsaḥ, viśeṣasamāsaḥ, samānādhikaraṇaḥ,
analyzed: tat yathā nitya samāsaḥ nitya asamāsaḥ asamartha samāsaḥ aluksamāsaḥ sāpekṣa samāsaḥ nirapekṣa samāsaḥ pūrva pada pradhānaḥ uttara pada pradhānaḥ ubhaya pada pradhānaḥ anaya pada pradhānaḥ anyathā upasarjanaḥ tiṅ samāsaḥ prātipadika samāsaḥ upapada samāsaḥ prādi samāsaḥ nañ samāsaḥ eka deśi samāsaḥ sāmānaya samāsaḥ viśeṣa samāsaḥ samāna adhikaraṇaḥ

original: bhinnadhikaraṇaḥ, upamānasamāsaḥ, upameyasamāsa iti | teṣu nityasamāso yathā lobitaśāliḥ, gaurakharaḥ, uddālapuṣpabhañjikā, dantalekhaka iti | nityāsamāso yathākiñcitkurvāṇaḥ, amāṣaṃ haramāṇa, agādhamutsṛptāḥ, chātrāṇāṃ pañcam iti | asamarthasamāso yathāsūryaṃpaśyā rājadārāḥ, apunargeyāḥ ślokāḥ, aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ, alavaṇabhojī bhikṣuriti |
analyzed: bhinna adhikaraṇaḥ upamāna samāsaḥ upameya samāsaḥ iti teṣu nitya samāsaḥ yathā lobita śāliḥ gaura kharaḥ uddāla puṣpa bhañjikā dantalekhakaḥ iti nitya asamāsaḥ yathā kiñcitkurvāṇaḥ a māṣam haramāṇa agādham utsṛptāḥ chātrāṇām pañcam iti asamartha samāsaḥ yathā sūryaṃpaśyāḥ rāja dārāḥ apunar geyāḥ ślokāḥ a śrāddha bhojī brāhmaṇaḥ a lavaṇa bhojī bhikṣuḥ iti

original: aluksamāso yathā stokānmuktaḥ, ātmanā tṛtīyaḥ, paśyato haraḥ, kaṇṭhe kāla iti | sāpekṣasamāso yathā yajñadattasya bhrātṛbhāryā, viṣṇumitrasya gurukulam, cūtasya phalarasaḥ, priyāyāḥ stasparśa iti |
analyzed: aluk samāsaḥ yathā stokāt muktaḥ ātmanā tṛtīyaḥ paśyataḥ haraḥ kaṇṭhe kālaḥ iti sāpekṣa samāsaḥ yathā yajñadattasya bhrātṛ bhāryā viṣṇumitrasya guru kulam cūtasya phala rasaḥ priyāyāḥ iti

original: nanu ya ete bhedasādṛśyādhyāsitāḥ padārthaste nāntareṇa deśakālakriyādisampāditaṃ virodhaṃ bhavitumarhantīti sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiḥ | naivam, yadyapyupamānamupameyaṃ ca paramārthato bhinnaṃ tathāpyupamānaśabdā gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśrityopameye vartamānāstayorbhedaṃ tirodadhati |

original: tathā hi, yadā vyāghrādayaḥ śauryādyatiśayanibandhanamupamānopameyasambandhamanubhūya tataḥ upamānopameyasambandhādyāropitā bhedā upameye vartante vyāghrasadṛśo'yaṃ vyāghra iti, tadā puruṣādiśritibhirabhinnādhikaraṇāḥ samasyanta iti kiṃ punarupamānopameyapratipattinibandhanebhya eva śabdebhyaḥ sādṛśyapratipattiḥ? uta tebhyaścānyebyaśceti |

original: kiñcāto yadi tebhya eva puruṣaṃ vyāghraṃ ca vīkṣasvetyatrāpi syāt | iva prayogavaiyathryaṃ ca | atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ puruṣo vyāghra ivetyeva syāt, na puruṣavyaghra iti | yathecchasi tathāstu | astu tāvatprathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | nanu coktaṃ puruṣaṃ vyāghraṃ ca vīkṣasvetyatrāpi sādṛśyapratipattiḥ syāt |

original: iha hi puruṣavyāghrayorvīkṣamakriyāsamaveśamātraṃ vivakṣitam | na sādṛśam | nanu vivakṣāto'pi sādṛśyapratipattāvivādaśabdopādānamanarthakam | yatra mukhyavṛttivyatikrameṇa gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśrityopamānaśabdā upameyaviśeṣeṣu prayujyante tatraiva ivādiśabdavikalāḥ sādṛśyaṃ gamayanti |
analyzed: iha hi puruṣa vyāghrayoḥ vīkṣam akriyā samaveśa mātram vivakṣitam na sādṛśam nanu vivakṣātaḥ api sādṛśya pratipattau vivāda śabda upādānam anarthakam yatra mukhya vṛtti vyatikrameṇa gauṇīm vṛttim āśritya upamāna śabdāḥ upameya viśeṣeṣu prayujyante tatra eva iva ādi śabda vikalāḥ sādṛśyam gamayanti

original: yathā kaścadavyāghraṃ puruṣaṃ vyāghra ityāha, tena manyāmahe vyāghrasadṛśo'yaṃ puruṣa iti | tataśca vyāghradharmāṇāṃ śauryabalavatvādīnāṃ vāyaghraśabdātpuruṣe pratipattirbhaviṣyati |
analyzed: yathā kaścana avyāghram puruṣam vyāghraḥ iti āha tena manyāmahe vyāghra sadṛśaḥ yam puruṣaḥ iti tatas ca vyāghra dharmāṇām śaurya balava tva ādīnām vā ayaghra śabdāt puruṣe pratipattiḥ bhaviṣyati

original: yadā punarupamānopameyaśabdāmukhyārthapratipattaye vivakṣitopamānopameyabhāveṣu vākyeṣu svarūpābhedādaśaktāḥ sādṛśyamavagamayutuṃ, tadā'pekṣante dvitīyamivādiśabdaprayogamiti kiṃ punarihodāharaṇaṃ śastrīva śyāmā śastrīśyāmeti | nanu ca cātra śyāmāśabdopāttasya dharmasyopamānopameyostulyatāvadyotanāyevaśabdaḥ prayujyate |
analyzed: yadā punar upamāna upameya śabda amukhya artha pratipattaye vivakṣita upamāna upameya bhāveṣu vākyeṣu sva rūpa abhedāt aśaktāḥ sādṛśyam avagama yutum tadā apekṣante dvitīyam iva ādi śabda prayogam iti kim punar iha udāharaṇam śastrī iva śyāmā śastrī śyāmā iti nanu ca ca atra śyāmā śabda upāttasya dharmasya upamāna upameyoḥ tulya tā avadyotanāya iva śabdaḥ prayujyate

original: vyāghra iva puruṣa ityatra tu sāmānyaprayogābhāvāt kasya puruṣavyāghrayossādhāraṇyamivaśabdenāvadyotyata iti? ucyate, śabdaḥ kkcidabhidhāvṛttayā arthaṃ bodhayati | yathā guṇḍāśabdo guḍaḍḍatdhdravyaṃ, kkacidgamakavṛttyā, yathā guḍaḍḍatdhdravyāvinābāvimādhuryaṃ |
analyzed: vyāghraḥ iva puruṣaḥ iti atra tu sāmānya prayoga abhāvāt kasya puruṣa vyāghrayoḥ sādhāraṇyam iva śabdena avadyotyate iti ucyate śabdaḥ kkcid abhidhā vṛttayā artham bodhayati yathā guṇḍā śabdaḥ guḍaḍḍatdh dravyam kkacid gamaka vṛttyā yathā guḍaḍḍatdh dravya avinābāvi mādhuryam

original: evamiha vyāghraśabdena vyāghrāvinābhāviśairyadikaṃ gamitaṃ tasya vyāghrapuruṣayossādṛśyasiddhyarthamubhayādhikaraṇatāvadyotanamivena kriyata iti | etena śastrīśyamāmetyapi vyākhyātam | atrāpyanupāttamapi devadatteti gamyate | kka punarayaṃ śyāmāśabdo vartate śastryāmityāha | kena tarhīdānīṃ devattato gamyate? samāsena |
analyzed: evam iha vyāghra śabdena vyāghra avinābhāvi śairya dikam gamitam tasya vyāghra puruṣayoḥ sādṛśya siddhi artham ubhaya adhikaraṇa tā avadyotanam ivena kriyate iti etena śastrī śyamāmā iti api vyākhyātam atra api anupāttam api devadatta iti gamyate kka punar ayam śyāmā śabdaḥ vartate śastryām iti āha kena tarhi idānīm devattataḥ gamyate samāsena

original: yadāhopamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ samasyante sāmānatvaṃ ca sādhāraṇye sati syāt | tattu devadattamantareṇa nopapadyata iti | yadyevaṃ śastrīśyāmo devadatta iti na siddhāti | upasarjanasyeti hasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati yadi tarhi upasarjanānyevejātīyakānyapi bhavanti| tattirikalmāṣīkumbhakapālalohinītyanupasarjanalakṣamaīkāro na prāpnoti |
analyzed: yat āha upamānāni sāmānya vacanaiḥ samasyante sāmāna tvam ca sādhāraṇye sati syāt tat tu devadattam antareṇa na upapadyate iti yadi evam śastrī śyāmaḥ devadattaḥ iti na upasarjanasya iti hasva tvam bhaviṣyati yadi tarhi upasarjanāni eva ijātīyakāni api bhavanti na prāpnoti

original: evaṃ tarhi śastryāmeva śastrīśabdo vartate | śyāmāśabdastu devadattāyām | evamapi guṇo nirdiṣṭo bhavati | bahavaśca śastryāṃ guṇāḥ sūkṣmā ślākṣṇā tīkṣṇā pṛthuḥ śyāmeti | anirdiśyamānasyāpi guṇasya bhavati loke sampratyayaḥ | tadyathā candramukhī devadatteti | bahavaścandre guṇāḥ, yā cāsau priyadarśanatā sā gamyate |
analyzed: evam tarhi śastryām eva śastrī śabdaḥ vartate śyāmā śabdaḥ tu devadattāyām evam api guṇaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ bhavati bahavaḥ ca śastryām guṇāḥ sūkṣmā ślākṣṇā tīkṣṇā pṛthuḥ śyāmā iti a nirdiśyamānasya api guṇasya bhavati loke sampratyayaḥ tat yathā candra mukhī devadattā iti bahavaḥ candre guṇāḥ yā ca asau priya darśana tā sā gamyate

original: yathā ca vyāghro'yaṃ puruṣaiti bahuṣvapi vyāghraguṇeṣu śauryaṃ balavattā vā pratīyata iti | evamapi samānādhikaraṇeneti vartate | vyadhikaraṇatvātsamāso na prāpnoti | kiṃ hi vacanānna bhavati | yadyapi tāvadvacanātsamāsaḥ syāt | mṛgīva capalā mṛgacapaleti samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti | evaṃ tarhitasyāmevobhayaṃ vartate |
analyzed: yathā ca vyāghraḥ yam puruṣa eti bahuṣu api vyāghra guṇeṣu śauryam balavat tā vā pratīyate iti evam api samāna adhikaraṇena iti vartate vyadhikaraṇa tvāt samāsaḥ na prāpnoti kim hi vacanāt na bhavati yadi api tāvat vacanāt samāsaḥ syāt mṛgī iva capalā mṛga capalā iti samāna adhikaraṇa lakṣaṇaḥ puṃvat bhāvaḥ na prāpnoti evam tarhi tasyām eva ubhayam vartate

original: etañcātra yuktaṃ yattasyāmevobhayaṃ vartate, itarathā hi bahvapekṣyaṃ syāt | yadā tāvadevaṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate tadā śastrīśyāmā, evaṃ devadatteti tadā śyāmeti śastrāpekṣyaṃ syāt | yadā śastrīśyamā cāsau śyāmā ca śastrīśyāmeti tadā na kiñcidapekṣyate, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bhavati |
analyzed: etat ca atra yuktam yat tasyām eva ubhayam vartate itarathā hi bahu apekṣyam syāt yadā tāvat evam vigrahaḥ kriyate tadā śastrī śyāmā evam devadatta iti tadā śyāmā iti śastra apekṣyam syāt yadā śastrī śyamā ca asau śyāmā ca śastrī śyāmā iti tadā na kiñcid apekṣyate sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca bhavati

original: nanvevaṃ sati śastrīśabdasya devadattāyāṃ pravṛttinimittamanirdihaṃ bhavati pratīyamānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet kiṃ taditi pṛcchāmi | yadi śyāmatvameva? śyāmeti śabdasyoktārthatvādaprayogaḥ prāpnoti | nahi guṇavṛttyā pratipāditeṣu guṇeṣu tadabhidhānāya guṇavacanaḥ prayujyate, na hi bhavati puruṣo'yaṃ vyādhraśūra iti |
analyzed: nanu evam sati śastrī śabdasya devadattāyām pravṛtti nimittam anirdiham bhavati pratīyamānam bhaviṣyati iti ced kim tat iti pṛcchāmi yadi śyāma tvam eva śyāmā iti śabdasya ukta artha tvāt aprayogaḥ prāpnoti nahi guṇa vṛttyā pratipāditeṣu guṇeṣu tad abhidhānāya guṇa vacanaḥ prayujyate na hi bhavati puruṣaḥ yam vyādhra śūraḥ iti

original: etenaikapragaॉghaṭṭakopanibandhānāṃ subhāṣitānāṃ samūhaḥ saṅghātaḥ | anekapradhaṭṭakopanibaddhānāṃ tu kośa ityapi vyākyātam | nāgarartīdyānacandrārkodayārṇavavarṇanādayastu saṅghātarūpā eva prabandhāntaḥ pātino vākyasamūhāḥ prakaraṇavyapadeśabhājau'vāntaravākyātāṃ labhante | tadarthāścaikārthībhāvamanubhavanti |
analyzed: etena eka praga ghaṭṭaka upanibandhānām subhāṣitānām samūhaḥ saṅghātaḥ aneka pradhaṭṭaka upanibaddhānām tu kośaḥ iti api vyākyātam nāgara ṛtī dyāna candra arka udaya arṇava varṇana ādayaḥ tu saṅghāta rūpāḥ eva prabandha antar pātinaḥ vākya samūhāḥ prakaraṇa vyapadeśa bhājā auvāntaravākyātām labhante tad arthāḥ ca ekārthībhāvam anubhavanti

original: yastu tairūpakriyāmāṇo mahāvākyārthaḥ sargabandhādāvakhyāyikādau mukhapratimukhagarbhavimarśanirvahaṇākhyaiḥ pañcasandhibhirupakṣepaparikarādibhiścatuṣṣaṣṭhisandhyaṅgairaṅgaṣoḍaḍḍatdhśakarūpabhāratyādirūpavṛtticatuṣṭayena ca yatoyogamupakṛtaḥ kṛtānyonyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ subhadrāharamaṃ jānakīrahamamityādinā mahāvākyārtharūpeṇa prathate sa
analyzed: yaḥ tu mahāvākya arthaḥ sargabandha ādau akhyāyikā ādau mukha pratimukha garbha vimarśa nirvahaṇa ākhyaiḥ pañca sandhibhiḥ upakṣepa parikara ādibhiḥ catuḥṣaṣṭhi sandhi aṅgaiḥ aṅga ṣoḍaḍḍatdhśaka rūpa bhāratī ādi rūpa vṛtti catuṣṭayena ca yatas yogam upakṛtaḥ kṛta anyonya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ subhadrā haramam jānakī rahamam ityādinā mahāvākya artha rūpeṇa prathate saḥ

original: prabandhaikārthībhāvo'pari ityākhyāyate | yastu tadrūparāmāyaṇādiprabandhārthānāmavadhāraṇenopahitasaṃskārasya rāmavadvartitavyaṃ na rāvaṇādivadityādividhiniṣedhapratibhāviśeṣa upajāyate, sa samastaviśvavyāpī caturvargaikahetuḥ paro mahāvākyaikārtho'rthamūtrya vipariṇatamanādinidhanamakhaṇḍaṃ, śabdabrahmetyucyate |
analyzed: prabandha ekārthībhāva upari iti ākhyāyate yaḥ tu tad rūpa rāmāyaṇa ādi prabandha arthānām avadhāraṇena upahita saṃskārasya rāma vat vartitavyam na rāvaṇa ādi vat ityādi vidhi niṣedha pratibhā viśeṣaḥ upajāyate sa samasta viśva vyāpī caturvarga eka hetuḥ paraḥ vipariṇatam anādinidhanam akhaṇḍam śabdabrahma iti ucyate

original: akhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ saiṣa vākyārthaḥ śabdabrāhmeti gīyate | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || idamādyaṃ padasthāne siddhisopānaparvaṇām | iyaṃ sā mokṣyamāṇānāmajihmā rājapaddhatiḥ || uktāścatastro punaścatastraḥ śabdārthasambandhabhidāḥ krameṇa | yatastra evātha vacoviśeṣe niṣeduṣīstāḥ parikīrtayāmaḥ ||
analyzed: sa eṣa vākya arthaḥ śabdabrāhmā iti gīyate śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahma adhigacchati idam ādyam pada sthāne siddhi sopāna parvaṇām iyam sā mokṣyamāṇānām ajihmā rāja paddhatiḥ uktāḥ catastraḥ punar catastraḥ śabda artha sambandha bhidāḥ krameṇa eva atha vacaḥ viśeṣe niṣeduṣīḥ tāḥ parikīrtayāmaḥ

original: iti mahārājadhirāḥ śrī bhojadevaviracite śrṛṅgāraprakāśe sopekṣaśabdaśaktiprakāśo nāma aṣṭamaprakāśaḥ
analyzed: iti śrī bhojadeva viracite śrṛṅgāraprakāśe sopekṣaśabdaśaktiprakāśaḥ nāma aṣṭama prakāśaḥ

original: ḍadṛdadyatdadvaḍḍha sāma dānādisampannaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ bruvate budhāḥ || yathā ratnāvalyām, vasubhūtir devi, sthāne devīśabdamudvahasi| yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, bhīmaḥ kvāsau dhārtarāṣṭrasakhā puṇyajanāpaśado yenāryasya mahānayaṃ cittavibhramaḥ kṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇo nigṛhītaḥ sa durātmā nakuleneti| punarvākyaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ yathoktākṣepadarśanam ||
analyzed: sāma dāna ādi sampannam bhūṣaṇam bruvate budhāḥ yathā ratnāvalyām vasubhūtiḥ devi sthāne devī śabdam udvahasi yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre bhīmaḥ kva asau dhārtarāṣṭra sakhā puṇyajana apaśadaḥ yena āryasya mahān ayam citta vibhramaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ nigṛhītaḥ sa durātmā nakulena iti punar vākyam tu vijñeyam yathā ukta ākṣepa darśanam

original: yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, bābhravyo devi, idānīṃ saphanalapariśramo'smi saṃvṛtta iti| yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, yudhiṣṭhiro bhagavan, kiṃ nāma cārvākeṇa rakṣasā vayaṃ vipralabdhāḥ? kṛṣṇo’tha kim| iti| varapradānasamprāptiḥ kāvyasaṃhāra iṣyate ||
analyzed: yathā ratnāvalyām bābhravyaḥ devi idānīm sa phanala pariśramaḥ asmi saṃvṛttaḥ iti yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhagavan kim nāma cārvākeṇa rakṣasā vayam vipralabdhāḥ kṛṣṇa utha kim iti vara pradāna samprāptiḥ kāvya saṃhāraḥ iṣyate

original: yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, yaugandharāyaṇo deva, taducyatāṃ kiṃ te bhūyaḥ priyamupakaromi? rājā kimataḥparamapi priyamasti| yataḥ, nīto vikramabāhurātmasamatāṃ prāpteyamurvītale sāraṃ sāgarikā tathā ca bhuvanaprāptyekahetuḥ priyā| devī prītimupāgatā ca bhaginīlābhājjitāḥ kosalāḥ kiṃ nāsti tvayi satyamātyavṛṣabhe yasmai vidheyaṃ spṛhām || iti|
analyzed: yathā ratnāvalyām yaugandharāyaṇaḥ deva tat ucyatām kim te bhūyas priyam upakaromi rājā kim atas param api priyam asti yatas nītaḥ vikramabāhuḥ ātma sama tām prāptā iyam urvī tale sāram sāgarikā tathā ca bhuvana prāpti eka hetuḥ priyā devī prītim upāgatā ca bhaginī lābhāt jitāḥ kosalāḥ kim nā asti tvayi sati amātya vṛṣabhe yasmai vidheyam spṛhām iti

original: yathā veṇīsaṃhāre, kṛṣṇaḥ tatkathaya mahārāja, kimasmattaḥ priyamicchasi? yudhiṣṭhiro na khalvataḥparamabhyarthayituṃ kṣamaḥ| paśyatu devaḥ| krodhāndhaiḥ sakalaṃ hataṃ ripukulaṃ pañcā'kṣatāste vayaṃ pāñcālyā mama durnayopajanitastīrṇo nikārārṇavaḥ|
analyzed: yathā veṇīsaṃhāre kṛṣṇaḥ tat kathaya mahā rāja kim asmattaḥ priyam icchasi yudhiṣṭhiraḥ na khalu atas param abhyarthayitum kṣamaḥ paśyatu devaḥ krodha andhaiḥ sakalam hatam ripu kulam pañca akṣatāḥ te vayam pāñcālyāḥ mama durnaya upajanitaḥ tīrṇaḥ nikāra arṇavaḥ

original: tvaṃ devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sukṛtinaṃna sāmādṛto bhāṣase kiṃ nāmānyadataḥ paraṃ bhagavato yāce prasannādaham || iti| nṛpadevādiśaktiśca praśastirabhidhīyate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, rājā tathāpīdamastu| urvīmuddāmasasyāṃ janayatu visṛjanvāsavo vṛṣṭimiṣṭāṃ iṣṭaisnaiviṣṭānāṃ vidadhatu vidhivatprīṇanaṃ vipramukhyāḥ|
analyzed: tvam devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sāma ādṛtaḥ bhāṣase kim nāma anyat atas param bhagavataḥ yāce prasannāt aham iti nṛpa deva ādi śaktiḥ ca praśastiḥ abhidhīyate yathā ratnāvalyām rājā tathā api idam astu urvīm uddāma sasyām janayatu visṛjan vāsavaḥ vṛṣṭim iṣṭām vidadhatu vidhivat prīṇanam vipra mukhyāḥ

original: ākalpāntaṃ ca bhūyātsamupacitasukhassaṅgamassajjanānāṃ niśśeṣaṃ yāntu śānta piśunajanagiro durjayā vajralepāḥ || yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, yudhiṣṭhiras tathāpi prītataraścedbhagavāṃstadidamastu| akṛpaṇamatiḥ kāmaṃ jīvyājjajaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ bhavatu bhagavanbhaktidrvaitaṃ vinā puruṣottame|
analyzed: ā kalpa antam ca bhūyāt samupacita sukhaḥ saṅgamaḥ sat janānām niśśeṣam yāntu śānta piśuna jana giraḥ durjayāḥ vajra lepāḥ yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ tathā api prītataraḥ ced bhagavān tat idam astu a kṛpaṇa matiḥ kāmam jīvyāt jajaḥ puruṣa āyuṣam bhavatu bhagavan bhakti drvaitam vinā puruṣottame

original: dayitabhuvano vidvadbandhurguṇeṣu viṃśeṣavi tsatatasukṛtī bhūyādbhūpaḥ prasādhitamaṇḍaḍḍatdhlaḥ || lakṣaṇāni catuṣṣaṣṭiriti yatprāgudīritam| nāṭakādessphuṭaṃ lakṣma tadidānīṃ vivicyate || bhūṣaṇākṣarasaṅghātau śobhodāharaṇe tathā| hetusaṃśayadṛṣṭāntāḥ prāptirośaya eva ca || nidaśrnaṃ niruktaṃ ca sandhiścāsi viśeṣaṇam|
analyzed: dayita bhuvanaḥ vidvat bandhuḥ guṇeṣu viṃśeṣa vi tsatata sukṛtī bhūyāt bhūpaḥ lakṣaṇāni catuṣṣaṣṭiḥ iti yat prāk udīritam nāṭaka ādeḥ sphuṭam lakṣma tat idānīm vivicyate bhūṣaṇa akṣara saṅghātau śobhā udāharaṇe tathā hetu saṃśaya dṛṣṭāntāḥ prāptiḥ ośayaḥ eva ca niruktam ca sandhiḥ ca asi viśeṣaṇam

original: guṇātipāto'tiśayastulyatarkaḥ padoccayaḥ || diṣṭaṃ caivopadiṣṭaṃ ca vicāro'tha viparyayaḥ| bhraṃśaścaivānunītiśca mālā dākṣiṇyagarhaṇe || arthāpattiḥ prasiddhiśca pṛcchā sārūpyameva ca| manorathaśca leśaśca yācñā protsāhanaṃ spṛhā || paścāttāpo'nuvṛttiśca yuktirnirbhāsanaṃ kṣamā| guṇānuvāda ākrandaḥ kapaṭaṃ parivādanam ||
analyzed: guṇa atipāta utiśayaḥ tulya tarkaḥ pada uccayaḥ diṣṭam ca eva upadiṣṭam ca vicāraḥ utha viparyayaḥ bhraṃśaḥ ca eva anunītiḥ ca mālā dākṣiṇya garhaṇe arthāpattiḥ prasiddhiḥ ca pṛcchā sārūpyam eva ca manorathaḥ ca leśaḥ ca yācñā protsāhanam spṛhā paścāttāpaḥ anuvṛttiḥ ca yuktiḥ nirbhāsanam kṣamā guṇa anuvādaḥ ākrandaḥ kapaṭam parivādanam

original: upapattiśca kāryaśca pratiṣedho mṛṣodyamaḥ| chaloktiḥ kākurunmādaḥva parihāso vikatthanam || yadṛcchāyogavaiṣamyapratijñātapravṛttayaḥ| āśīruktiśca siddhiśca priyaṃ vacanameva ca || lakṣaṇāni catuṣṣaṣṭi kāvyeṣvetāni nirdiśet || tatra ca, alaṅkārai rguṇaiścaiva bahubhiryadavekṣitam ||
analyzed: upapattiḥ ca kāryaḥ ca pratiṣedhaḥ mṛṣā udyamaḥ chala uktiḥ kākuḥ unmādaḥ iva parihāsaḥ vikatthanam yadṛcchā yoga vaiṣamya pratijñāta pravṛttayaḥ āśīḥ uktiḥ ca siddhiḥ ca priyam vacanam eva ca lakṣaṇāni catuṣṣaṣṭi kāvyeṣu etāni nirdiśet tatra ca alaṅkāraiḥ guṇaiḥ ca eva bahubhiḥ yat avekṣitam

original: yathā ratnāvalyāṃ prathame'ṅke, yaugandharāyaṇo viśrāntavigrahakatho ratimān janasya citte vasanpriyavasantaka eva sākṣāt| paryutsuko nijamahotsavadarśanāya vatseśvaraḥ kusumacāpa ivābhyupaiti || atra śleṣopamāpratyakṣādibhiralaṅkāraiḥ śleṣaprasādasaukumāryādibhiśca guṇairupetatā draṣṭavyā| evaṃ vakṣyamāṇeṣvapi guṇālaṅkārā yathāsambhavamūhanīyaḥ|
analyzed: yathā ratnāvalyām prathama iṅke yaugandharāyaṇaḥ viśrānta vigraha kathaḥ ratimān janasya citte vasan priya vasantake eva sākṣāt paryutsukaḥ nija mahā utsava darśanāya vatsa īśvaraḥ kusuma cāpaḥ iva abhyupaiti atra śleṣa upamā pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ alaṅkāraiḥ śleṣa prasāda saukumārya ādibhiḥ ca guṇaiḥ upeta tā draṣṭavyā evam vakṣyamāṇeṣu api guṇa alaṅkārāḥ yathāsambhavam ūhanīyaḥ

original: nāṭakakāraiśca niyamo nārabhyate| sandhyaṅgeṣu tu guṇālaṅkārayogo nāpekṣyata iti| yatrārthairakṣaraiḥ śliṣṭairvicitrārthopavarṇanam| tamatrākṣarasaṅghātaṃ vidyāllakṣaṇasaṃjñitam || yathābhijñānaśākuntale saptame'ṅke, (praviśya mṛṇmayūrahastā tāpasī savvadamaṇa, sauṃdalāvaṇṇaṃ pekkha|
analyzed: nāṭaka kāraiḥ ca niyamaḥ nā ārabhyate sandhi aṅgeṣu tu guṇa alaṅkāra yogaḥ na apekṣyate iti yatra arthaiḥ akṣaraiḥ śliṣṭaiḥ vicitra artha upavarṇanam tam atra akṣara saṅghātam vidyāt lakṣaṇa saṃjñitam yathā abhijñānaśākuntale saptama iṅke praviśya mṛṇmayūra hastā tāpasī savva damaṇa sauṃda lāvaṇṇam pekkha

original: (sarvadamana, śakuntalāvaṇyaṃ prekṣasva|) bālaḥ (sadṛṣṭikṣepaṃ), kahiṃ sā ajjū| (kutra me ambā? ) ubhe vihasya, ṇāmasāriccheṇa chalidotti bhaṇido| (nāmasādṛśyena vañcito'si mātṛvatsalaḥ|) rājā (ātmagataṃ), kiṃ śakuntaleti tasya māturākhyā ! siddhairarthaissamaṃ kṛtvā yatrāsiddhaṃ prasādhyate| śliṣṭā ślakṣṇā vicitrārthā sā śobhetyabhidhīyate ||
analyzed: sarvadamana śakuntalā vaṇyam prekṣasva bālaḥ sa dṛṣṭi kṣepam kahim sā ajjū kutra me ambā ubhe vihasya nāma sāriccheṇa chalidaḥ itti bhaṇidaḥ nāma sādṛśyena vañcitaḥ asi mātṛ vatsalaḥ rājā ātma gatam kim śakuntalā iti tasya mātuḥ ākhyā siddhaiḥ arthaiḥ samam kṛtvā yatra asiddham prasādhyate śliṣṭā ślakṣṇā vicitra arthā sā śobhā iti abhidhīyate

original: yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, prathame'ṅke, yaugandharāyaṇo dvīpādanyasmādapi madhyādapi jalanidherdiśo'pyantāt| ānīya jhaṭiti ghaṭayati vidhirabhimatamabhimukhībhūtaḥ ||
analyzed: yathā ratnāvalyām prathama iṅke yaugandharāyaṇaḥ dvīpāt anyasmāt api madhyāt api jalanidheḥ diśā upi antāt ānīya jhaṭiti ghaṭayati vidhiḥ abhimatam abhimukhībhūtaḥ

original: anyathā kva siddhādeśapratyayaprārthitāyāḥ siṃhaleśvaraduhituḥ samudre pravahaṇabhaṅganimnagāyāḥ phalakāsādanaṃ, kva ca kauśāmbīyena vaṇijā siṃhalebhyaḥ pratyāgacchatā tadavasthāyāḥ sambhāvanaṃ ratnamālācihnāyāśca pratyabhijñānādihānayanaṃ ca| sarvathā spṛśanti nassvāminamabhyudayā iti| tatra tulyārthayuktena vākyenābhipradarśanāt|
analyzed: anyathā kva siddhādeśa pratyaya prārthitāyāḥ siṃhala īśvara duhituḥ samudre pravahaṇa bhaṅga nimnagāyāḥ phalaka āsādanam kva ca kauśāmbīyena vaṇijā siṃhalebhyaḥ pratyāgacchatā tad avasthāyāḥ sambhāvanam ratna mālā cihnāyāḥ ca pratyabhijñānāt iha ānayanam ca sarvathā spṛśanti naḥ svāminam abhyudayāḥ iti tatra tulya artha yuktena vākyena abhipradarśanāt

original: sādhyante nipuṇairarthāstadudāharaṇaṃ smṛtam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, rājā vidūṣakaśca śārikāvacanaṃ niśamayataḥ| tato vidūṣakaḥ (ākāśe) kiṃ āprāraṇe kuppasi| jādiso tue ayaṃ kāmadevo ālihido tādisī mae rai ālihidetti| bho vaassa, kiṃ ṇedaṃ| rājā vayasya, evaṃ tarkayāmi|
analyzed: sādhyante nipuṇaiḥ arthāḥ tat udāharaṇam smṛtam yathā ratnāvalyām dvitīya iṅke rājā vidūṣakaḥ ca śārikā vacanam niśamayataḥ tatas vidūṣakaḥ ākāśe kim kuppasi jādisaḥ tue ayam kāmadevaḥ ālihidaḥ tādisī mae rai ālihida itti bho vaassa kim na idam rājā vayasyaḥ evam tarkayāmi

original: kayāpi hṛdayavallabho'nurāgādabhilikhya kāmapadevavyapadeśena nihnutastatsakhyāpi pratyabhijñāya vaidagdhyātpratibhandānayā sāpi tatraiva likhiteti| yatprayojanasāmathryādvākyamiṣṭārthasādhakam| samāsoktamanogrāhi sa heturiti saṃjñitaḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vidūṣakaḥ saccaṃ sabāmi bamhasutteṇa jai kadāvi amherhi īdisī diṭhṭhapuvvā|
analyzed: kayā api hṛdaya vallabha unurāgāt abhilikhya kāmapadeva vyapadeśena nihnutaḥ tad sakhyā api pratyabhijñāya vaidagdhyāt pratibhandā anayā sā api tatra eva likhitā iti yat prayojana sāmathryāt vākyam iṣṭa artha sādhakam samāsa ukta manogrāhi sa hetuḥ iti saṃjñitaḥ yathā ratnāvalyām dvitīya iṅke vidūṣakaḥ saccam bamha sutteṇa jai kadāvi īdisī diṭhṭha puvvā

original: vidūṣakaśca rājānaṃ bhāṣate ṇa kido kahaṃ pasādo jaṃ ajjavi akkhedasarīrā ciṭṭhahma| (na kṛtaḥ kathaṃ prasādo yadadyāpi akṣataśarīrāstiṣṭhāmaḥ|) tato jñātāyāṃ rājā parivadannāha tvatkṛto'yamanartho'smākamāpatita iti| prāptānāṃ yathā doṣāṇāṃ kriyate śamanaṃ punaḥ| jñeyā sābhyupapattistu lakṣaṇaṃ nāṭakāśrayam ||

original: yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vāsavadattā kaṃcaṇamāle aaṃ ayyautto| iaṃ uṇa sāriā| ajjautta kiṃ edam| (kāñcanamāle, ayamāryaputraḥ| iyaṃ punaḥ sārikā| āryaputra, kimetat? ) rājāpavārya, vayasya, vayasya kiṃ bravīmi? tvamevāsyā uttaraṃ prayaccha| vidūṣako hodi, appā kila dukkaṃ ālihaduṃti mama vaaṇaṃ suṇia piavaassaeṇa edaṃ viṇṇāṇaṃ daṃsidam|
analyzed: yathā ratnāvalyām dvitīya iṅke vāsavadattā kaṃcaṇamāle aam ayyauttaḥ iam una sāriā ajjautta kim edam kāñcanamāle ayam ārya putraḥ iyam punar sārikā ārya putra kim etat rājā apavārya vayasya vayasya kim bravīmi tvam eva asyāḥ uttaram prayaccha vidūṣakaḥ hodi appā kila dukkam mama vaaṇam suṇia pia vaassaeṇa edam viṇṇāṇam daṃsidam

original: (bhavati, ātmā kila duḥkhaṃ likhatīti mama vacanaṃ śrutvā priyavayasyenedaṃ vijñānaṃ darśitam|) rājā devi, yathāha vasantakaḥ| vāsavadattājjautta, esāpi jā avarā tuha samīpe ālihidā tā kiṃ vasaṃdaassa viṇṇāṇaṃ| (āryaputra, eṣāpi yā'parā tava samīpe ālikhitā, tatka vasantakasya vijñānam? ) rājā savailakṣasmitaṃ, devi, alamanyathā sambhāvitena|
analyzed: bhavati ātmā kila duḥkham likhati iti mama vacanam śrutvā priya vayasyena idam vijñānam darśitam rājā devi yathā āha vasantakaḥ esā api jā avarā tuha samīpe ālihidā tā kim vasaṃdaassa viṇṇānam ārya putraḥ eṣā api yā aparā tava samīpe ālikhitā tat ka vasantakasya vijñānam rājā sa vailakṣa smitam devi alam anyathā sambhāvitena

original: iyaṃ hi mayā kāpi kanyakā svacetasaiva parikalpyālikhitā| na tu dṛṣṭapūrveti| yatra saṅkīrtayandoṣaṃ guṇamarthena yojayet| .... kāryaṃ tadiha kīrtitam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, prathame'ṅke, yaugandharāyaṇaḥ prārambhe'smin svāmino vṛddhihetau daivenetthaṃ dattahastāvalambe| siddhebhrrāntirnāsti satyaṃ tathāpi svecchācārī bhīta evāsmi bhartuḥ ||
analyzed: iyam hi mayā kā api kanyakā sva cetasā eva parikalpya ālikhitā na tu dṛṣṭa pūrvā iti yatra saṅkīrtayan doṣam guṇam arthena yojayet kāryam tat iha kīrtitam yathā ratnāvalyām prathama iṅke yaugandharāyaṇaḥ prārambhe asmin svāminaḥ vṛddhi hetau daivena ittham datta hasta avalambe siddheḥ bhrāntiḥ nā asti satyam tathā api svecchā cārī bhītaḥ eva asmi bhartuḥ

original: kāryeṣu viparīteṣu yadi kaścitpravartate| nivāryate ca kāryajñaiḥ pratiṣedhassa kīrtitaḥ | yathā mahāvīracarite, daśaratho virama narapate kathaṃ dvije'sminnaviratavitīrṇagosahasraḥ| tava palitanirantaraḥ pṛṣatkaṃ spṛśati purāṇadhanurdharasya bāhuḥ || prayuktārthavidhānāya mohātra pravartate| nivartate vṛthākleśassa vijñeyo mṛṣodyamaḥ ||
analyzed: kāryeṣu viparīteṣu yadi kaścid pravartate nivāryate ca kārya jñaiḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ yathā mahāvīracarite daśarathaḥ virama narapate katham dvije asmin avirata vitīrṇa go sahasraḥ tava palita nirantaraḥ pṛṣatkam spṛśati purāṇa dhanurdharasya bāhuḥ prayukta artha vidhānāya mohā atra pravartate nivartate vṛthā kleśaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ mṛṣā udyamaḥ

original: yathā vīracarite tapo vā śastraṃ vā vyapadiśati yaḥ kaścidiha vo sadarpāduddāmaṃ dviṣamasahamānassakhalayatu| arāmāṃ nissīradhvajadaśarathīkṛtya vasudhāmatṛptastatkulyāmapi paraśurāmaśśamayati || kākvāśleṣeṇa vā yatra padaṃ vdyarthaṃ prayujyate| pradhānamatisandhātuṃ sā chaloktiḥprakīrtitā ||
analyzed: yathā vīracarite tapaḥ vā śastram vā vyapadiśati yaḥ kaścid iha vaḥ sa darpāt uddāmam dviṣam asahamānaḥ sakhalayatu arāmām nissīra dhvaja daśarathīkṛtya vasudhām atṛptaḥ tad kulyām api paraśurāmaḥ śamayati kāku āśleṣeṇa vā yatra padam prayujyate pradhānam atisandhātum sā chaloktiḥ prakīrtitā

original: yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vidūṣako devi, saccaṃ sabāmi bahmasutteṇa jai kadāvi ahmehiṃ īdisī diṭhṭhapuvvā| vāsavadattāi ujue, vasaṃdao khu eso| ṇa āṇāsi tumaṃ edassa vakkabhaṇidāiṃ ayya mama edaṃ cattiṃ pekkhia sīsaveaṇā samuppaṇā| tā gamissaṃ ahaṃ iti| yathā ca mālatīmādhave, prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya mahārāja iti|
analyzed: yathā ratnāvalyām dvitīya iṅke vidūṣakaḥ devi saccam bahma sutteṇa jai kadāvi ahmehiṃ īdisī diṭhṭha puvvā vāsavadattāi ujue vasaṃdao khu esaḥ naḥ āṇāsi tumam edassa vakka bhaṇidāim ayya mama edam cattim pekkhia sīsa veaṇā samuppaṇā tā gamissam aham iti yathā ca mālatī mādhave prabhavati nijasya kanyakā janasya mahā rājaḥ iti

original: vākye'bhidhīyamāno'rtho yenānyatvaṃ prapadyate| bhinnakaṇṭhadhvanirdhīraissa kākuriti kathyate || yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, bhīmaḥ sahadevamuddiśya, sandheyāste bhrātaro yuṣmākam| yathā cātraiva lākṣāgṛhānalaviṣānnasabhāpraveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vittanicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya| ākṛṣṭapāṇḍaḍḍatdhvavadhūparidhānakeśārasvasthā bhavanti mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ ||
analyzed: vākya ibhidhīyamāna ūrthaḥ yena anya tvam prapadyate bhinna kaṇṭha dhvaniḥ dhīraiḥ sa kākuḥ iti kathyate yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre bhīmaḥ sahadevam uddiśya sandheyāḥ te bhrātaraḥ yuṣmākam yathā ca atra eva lākṣāgṛha anala viṣa anna sabhā praveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vitta nicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya bhavanti mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ

original: asādhukāriṇaṃ kiñcitpaśyatassādhu māninaḥ| sotprāsaṃ vacanaṃ yatsyāttamunmāthaṃ pracakṣate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīye'ṅke, kāñcanamālā sāhu re vasantaa āhu| adisaido tue amacca joaṃdharāaṇovi imāe saṃdhiviggahacintāe| iti| yadagrāmyaṃ bhavedvākyaṃ gurūṇāmadhikeṣvapi| tathāvasaramāsādya parihāsassa kathyate ||
analyzed: asādhu kāriṇam kiñcid paśyataḥ sādhu māninaḥ sa utprāsam vacanam yat syāt tam unmātham pracakṣate yathā ratnāvalyām tṛtīya iṅke kāñcanamālā sāhu re vasantaa āhu tue amacca joaṃdhara aṇo vi imāe saṃdhi viggaha cintāe iti yat agrāmyam bhavet vākyam gurūṇām adhikeṣu api tathā avasaram āsādya parihāsaḥ sa kathyate

original: yathottararāmacarite, rāmo’sti cedānīmaśvamedhasahacāriṇī hiraṇmayī sītāpratikṛtiḥ| tatrāpi tāvadbāṣpadagdhaṃ cakṣurvinodayāmi| sītā dhaṇṇā khu sā jā evvaṃ ayyavutteṇa bahumaṇṇīadi| jā evvaṃ ayyavuttaṃ viṇodaaṃtī āsābaṃdhaṇaṃ khu jādā jīvaloassa| (dhanyā khalu sā yaivamāryaputreṇa bahumanyate|
analyzed: yathā uttara rāmacarite rāmaḥ usti ca idānīm aśvamedha sahacāriṇī hiraṇmayī sītā pratikṛtiḥ tatra api tāvat bāṣpa dagdham cakṣuḥ vinodayāmi sītā dhaṇṇā khu sā jā evvam ayya vutteṇa jā evvam ayya vuttam viṇodaaṃtī āsā baṃdhaṇam khu jādā jīva loassa dhanyā khalu sā yā evam ārya putreṇa bahu manyate

original: yaivamāryaputraṃ vinodayantī āśābandhanaṃ khalu jātā jīvalokasya|) iti| tamasā (sasmitasnehāsraṃ pariṣvajya) ayi vatse, evamātmā saṃstūyate| sītā (salajjaṃ), parihasidammi bhaavadīe| (parihasitāsmi bhagavatyā|) saguṇotkarṣato vāpi karmaṇo vāpadānataḥ| ātmaślāghāparaṃ vākyaṃ vikatthanamihocyate ||
analyzed: yā evam ārya putram vinodayantī āśā bandhanam khalu jātā jīva lokasya iti tamasā sa smita sneha asram pariṣvajya ayi vatse evam ātmā saṃstūyate sītā sa lajjam bhaavadīe parihasitā asmi bhagavatyā sa guṇa utkarṣataḥ vā api karmaṇaḥ vā apadānataḥ ātma ślāghā param vākyam vikatthanam iha ucyate

original: yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, arjunaḥ tāta, amba, sakalaripujayāśā yatra baddhā sutaiste tṛṇamiva paribhūto yasya garveṇa lokaḥ| raṇaśirasi nihantā tasya rādhāsutasya praṇamati pitarau vāṃ madhyamaḥ pāṇḍaḍḍatdhvo'yam || bhīmaḥ cūrṇitāśeṣakauravyaḥ kṣībo duḥśāsanāsṛjā| bhaṃktā suyodhanasyorvorbhīmo'yaṃ śirasāñcati ||
analyzed: yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre arjunaḥ tāta amba sakala ripu jaya āśā yatra baddhā sutaiḥ te tṛṇam iva paribhūtaḥ yasya garveṇa lokaḥ raṇa śirasi nihantā tasya rādhāsutasya praṇamati pitarau vām madhyamaḥ bhīmaḥ cūrṇita aśeṣa kauravyaḥ kṣībaḥ duḥśāsana asṛjā bhaṃktā suyodhanasya ūrvoḥ bhīmaḥ yam śirasā añcati

original: yadṛcchayā bhavedyogo yatrābhīṣṭena kenacit| acintitassa dhīmadbhiryadṛcchāyoga ucyate || yathā mālatīmādhave, mālatī ṇāha tuhme uṇa kahaṃ| mādhavaḥ salajjaṃ, tvatpāṇipaṅkajaparigrahadhanyajanmā bhūyāsamityabhiniveśakadathryamānaḥ| bhrāmyannṛmāṃsapaṇanāya paretabhūmāvākaṇrya bhīru ruditāni tavāgato'smi ||
analyzed: yadṛcchayā bhavet yogaḥ yatra abhīṣṭena kenacid a cintitaḥ sa dhīmadbhiḥ yadṛcchā yogaḥ ucyate yathā mālatī mādhave mālatī na āha tuhme una kaham mādhavaḥ sa lajjam tvad pāṇi paṅkaja parigraha dhanya janmā bhūyāsam iti abhiniveśa kadathryamānaḥ bhrāmyat nṛ māṃsa paṇanāya pareta bhūmau ākaṇrya bhīru ruditāni tava āgataḥ asmi

original: pratyakṣamiti yatraikaḥ parokṣamiti cāparaḥ| manyate'bhimataṃ vastu tadvaiṣamyamiti smṛtam || yathottararāmacarite, vāsantī kathamadyāpi nocchvasiti rāmabhadraḥ| hā priyasakhi kvāsi, saṃbhāvayātmano jīviteśvaram| vipattidagdhāmapi punaḥpunarmandabhāgyāṃ dahasi| sītāpasartumicchāmi|
analyzed: pratyakṣam iti yatra ekaḥ parokṣam iti ca aparaḥ manyate abhimatam vastu tat vaiṣamyam iti smṛtam yathā uttara rāmacarite vāsantī katham adya api nā ucchvasiti rāmabhadraḥ hā priya sakhi kva asi saṃbhāvaya ātmanaḥ jīvita īśvaram vipatti dagdhām api punar punar mandabhāgyām dahasi sītā apasartum icchāmi

original: eṣa punaścirapraṇayasaṃbhārasaumyaśītalena āryaputrasparśena dīrghadāruṇamapi jhaḍiḍḍatdhti santāpaṃ laghayatā vajralepopanaddhaṃ iva paryastavyāpāra āsañjito me hastaḥ| rāmaḥ sakhi, kutaḥ pralāpaḥ| gṛhīto yaḥ pūrvaṃ pariṇayavidhau kaṅkaṇadharassudhāsūteḥ pādairamṛtaśiśirairyaḥ paricitaḥ|
analyzed: eṣa punar cira praṇaya saṃbhāra saumya śītalena āryaputra sparśena dīrgha dāruṇam api santāpam laghayatā vajra lepa upanaddham iva paryasta vyāpāraḥ āsañjitaḥ me hastaḥ rāmaḥ sakhi kutas pralāpaḥ gṛhītaḥ yaḥ pūrvam pariṇaya vidhau kaṅkaṇa dharaḥ sudhā sūteḥ pādaiḥ amṛta śiśiraiḥ yaḥ paricitaḥ

original: sa evāyaṃ tasyāstaditarakaraupamyasubhago mayā labdhaḥ pāṇirlalitalavalīkandalanibhaḥ || gṛhṇāti|| sītā hanta, āryaputrasparśamohitāyāḥ pramādaḥ khalu saṃvṛttaḥ| rāmaḥ sakhi vāsanti, ānandanimīlitaḥ priyāsparśasādhvasena paravānasmi| tattvametaṃ dhāraya| vāsantī kaṣṭamunmāda eva| sītā sasambhramaṃ hastamākṣipyāpasarpati| rāmo hā dhikpramādaḥ|
analyzed: saḥ eva ayam tasyāḥ tad itara kara aupamya subhagaḥ mayā labdhaḥ pāṇiḥ lalita lavalī kandala nibhaḥ gṛhṇāti sītā hanta ārya putra sparśa mohitāyāḥ pramādaḥ khalu saṃvṛttaḥ rāmaḥ sakhi vāsanti ānanda nimīlitaḥ priyā sparśa sādhvasena paravān asmi tat tvam etam dhāraya vāsantī kaṣṭam unmādaḥ eva sītā sa sambhramam hastam ākṣipya apasarpati rāmaḥ hā dhik pramādaḥ

original: karapallavassa tasyāssahasaiva jaḍātmanaḥ paribhraṣṭaḥ| parikampinaḥ prakampī karikara iva pīvarassvidyan || tamasā sasnehakautukasmitaṃ nirvaṇrya, prasvedaromāñcitakampitāṅgī jātā priyasparśamukhena vatsā| marunnavāmbhaḥ paridhūtasiktā kadambayaṣṭissphuṭakorakeva || sītā avaśaṃ gatenātmanā lajjāpitāsmi bhagavatyā tamasayā|
analyzed: kara pallavaḥ sa tasyāḥ sahasā eva jaḍa ātmanaḥ paribhraṣṭaḥ parikampinaḥ prakampī kari karaḥ iva pīvaraḥ svidyan tamasā sa sneha kautuka smitam nirvaṇrya prasveda romāñcita kampita aṅgī jātā priya sparśa mukhena vatsā marut nava ambhaḥ paridhūta siktā kadamba yaṣṭiḥ sphuṭa korakā iva sītā avaśam gatena ātmanā lajjāpitā asmi bhagavatyā tamasayā

original: kiṃ kilaiṣā maṃsyate eṣa parityāgaḥ eṣa cāsaṅga iti| rāmaḥ sarvato'valokya, hā kathaṃ nāstyeva| nanvakaruṇe vaidehi| na māmevaṃ parityajya gantumarhasi| vāsantī deva prasīda| svenaiva lokottareṇa saṃstambhayā'tibhūmiṃ gatamātmānam| kuto'tra me priyasakhī| rāmo vyaktaṃ nāstyeva| kathamanyathā vāsantyapi na paśyet| eṣa khalu svapna eva syāt|
analyzed: kim kila eṣā maṃsyate eṣa parityāgaḥ eṣa ca asaṅgaḥ iti rāmaḥ sarvatas valokya hā katham na asti eva nanu akaruṇe vaidehi na mām evam parityajya gantum arhasi vāsantī deva prasīda svena eva lokottareṇa saṃstambhaya ati bhūmim gatam ātmānam kutas utra me priya sakhī rāmaḥ vyaktam na asti eva katham anyathā vāsantī api na paśyet eṣa khalu svapnaḥ eva syāt

original: kuto rāmasya nidreti| na sādhayāmi yadyetadevaṃ katrrāsmyahaṃ tadā| ityuddhavādervākyasya tatpratijñānamucyate || yathā makuṭatāpite, bhīma dhvastāḥ kṣubdhā dhārtarāṣṭrāssamastāḥ pītaṃ raktaṃ svādu duśśāsanasya| pūrṇā kṛṣṇākeśabandhapratijñā tiṣṭhatyekaḥ kauravasyorubhaṅgaḥ || ūrū nipīḍya gadayā yadi nāsya tasya pādena ratnamakuṭaṃ śakalīkaromi|
analyzed: kutas rāmasya nidrā iti na sādhayāmi yadi etat evam katrā asmi aham tadā iti uddha vādeḥ vākyasya tat pratijñānam ucyate yathā makuṭa tāpite bhīma dhvastāḥ kṣubdhāḥ dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ samastāḥ pītam raktam svādu duśśāsanasya pūrṇā kṛṣṇākeśa bandha pratijñā tiṣṭhati ekaḥ kauravasya ūru bhaṅgaḥ ūrū nipīḍya gadayā yadi na asya tasya pādena ratna makuṭam śakalīkaromi

original: dehaṃ nipītanijadhūmavijṛmbhamāṇajvālājaṭālavapuṣi jvalane juhomi || evaṃ mayātra kartavyamiti yanniścitaṃ vacaḥ| snehāddākṣiṇyato vāpi pravṛttissā nigadyate || yathā mālatīmādhave, kāmandakī māvāṃ sapatneṣvapi nāma tadbhūtpāpaṃpa yadasyāṃ tvayi vā viśaṃkyam| tatsarvathā saṅgamanāya yatnaḥ prāṇavyayenāpi mayā vidheyaḥ ||
analyzed: deham nipīta nija dhūma vijṛmbhamāṇa jvālā jaṭāla vapuṣi jvalane juhomi evam mayā atra kartavyam iti yat niścitam vacaḥ snehāt dākṣiṇyataḥ vā api pravṛttiḥ sā nigadyate yathā mālatī mādhave kāmandakī mā āvām sapatneṣu api nāma tat bhūt pāpam yat asyām tvayi vā viśaṃkyam tat sarvathā saṅgamanāya yatnaḥ prāṇa vyayena api mayā vidheyaḥ

original: yadā śāstyarthasampannaṃ manorathasamudbhavam| aprārthanīyamanyadvā vidustāmāśiṣaṃ budhāḥ || yathā mālatīmādhave, kāmandakī vidhātā bhadraṃ no vitaratu manojñāya vidhaye vidheyāsurdevā paramaramaṇīyāṃ pariṇatim| kṛtārthā bhūyāsaṃ priyasuhṛdapatyopanayataḥ prayatnaḥ kṛtsno'yaṃ phalatu śivatātiśca bhavatu ||
